Aur jab tum ne aurton ko talaq de di ho aur woh apni iddat ke qareeb pahunch jayen, to ya to un ko bhalayi ke saath (apni zawjiyat mein) rok rakho, ya unhein bhalayi ke saath chhor do , aur unhein satane ki khatir us liye rok kar na rakho ke un par zulm krsko aur jo shaks aisa kare ga woh khud apni jaan par zulm kare ga, aur Allah ki aayaton ko mazaq mat banao aur Allah ne tum par jo inam farmaya hai use aur tum par jo kitab aur hikmat ki baatein tumhein naseehat karne ke liye nazil ki hain unhein yaad rakho, aur Allah se darte raho, aur jaan rakho ke Allah har cheez ko khoob jaanta hai.

Aur jab tum ne orrton ko talaq de di ho aur woh apni iddat ko pahunch jayen to (ae mike walo) unhein us baat se mana na karo ke woh apne (pehle) shoharon se (dobara) nikah karen, ba-shart-e-ke woh bhalayi ke saath ek dusre se razi hogaye hon. Un baaton ki naseehat tum mein se un logon ko ki jarhi hai jo Allah aur yaum aakhirat par iman rakhte hon. Yehi tumhare liye ziyada sthra aur pakeeza tareeqa hai, Allah jaanta hai aur tum nahin jante.

Aur maayen apne bacchon ko poore do saal tak doodh pilayein, yeh muddat un ke liye hai jo doodh pilane ki muddat poori karna chahein, aur jis baap ka woh bcha hai us par wajib hai ke woh maroof tareeqe par un maaon ke khane aur libas ka kharch athaie, . (haan) kisi shaks ko us ki wusat se ziyada takleef nahin di jati, na to man ko apne bache ki wajah se sataya jaye, aur na baap ko apne bache ki wajah se aur usi tarah ki zma daari waris par bhi hai phir agar woh dono (yani walidain) aapas ki raza mandi aur bahumi mashware se (do saal guzarne se pehle hi) doodh churana chahein to us mein bhi un par koi gunaah nahin hai, aur agar tum yeh chaho ke apne bacchon ko kisi ana se doodh ploa to bhi tum par koi gunaah nahin, jabke tum ne jo ujrat thehraee thi woh (doodh pilane wali ana ko) bhale tareeqe se de do , aur Allah se darte raho, aur jaan rakho ke Allah tumhare sare kaamon ko achhi tarah dekh raha hai.

Aur tum mein se jo log wafaat pajaiin, aur biwiyan chhor kar jayen to woh biwiyan apne aap ko char mahine aur dus din intezar mein rakhen gi, phir jab woh apni (iddat ki) miyad ko pahunch jayen to woh apne bare mein jo karawai (maslan dusra nikah) qaeede ke mutabiq karen to tum par kuchh gunaah nahin, aur jo kuchh tum karte ho Allah us se poori tarah bakhabar hai.

Aur (iddat ke dauraan) agar tum un aurton ko ishare knaie mein nikah ka paygham do ya (un se nikah ka arada) dil mein chhpaie rakho to tum par koi gunaah nahin hai, Allah jaanta hai ke tum un (se nikah) ka khayal to dil mein lao ge, lekin un se nikah ka do tarfa wada mat karna, illa yeh ke munasib tareeqe se koi baat keh do aur nikah ka aqd pakka karne ka us waqt tak arada bhi mat karna jab tak iddat ki muqarrara muddat apni miyad ko na pahunch jaye, aur yaad rakho ke jo kuchh tumhare dilon mein hai Allah use khoob jaanta hai, lihaza us se darte raho, aur yaad kho ke Allah bohat bakhshne wala bara burdbaar hai.

Tum par us mein bhi koi gunaah nahin hai ke tum aurton ko aise waqt talaq do jabke abhi tum ne un ko chhoa bhi na ho, aur na un ke liye koi mehar muqarrar kiya ho, aur (aisi surat mein) un ko koi tohfa do , khushaal shaks apni haisiyat ke mutabiq aur gareeb aadmi apni haisiyat ke mutabiq bhale tareeqe se yeh tohfa de. Yeh nek aadmiyon par ek laazmi haqq hai.

Aur agar tum ne unhein chhone se pehle hi us halat mein talaq di ho jabke un ke liye (nikah ke waqt) koi mehar muqarrar karliya tha to jitna mehar tum ne muqarrar kiya tha us ka aadha dena (wajib hai) illa yeh ke woh aurten riayat karden (aur aadhe mehar ka bhi mutalaba na karen) ya woh (shohar) jis ke haath mein nikah ki girah hai, riayat kare ae (aur poora mehar de) aur agar tum riayat karo to yeh taqwa ke ziyada qareeb hai, aur aapas mein farakh dili ka bartao karna mat bhoolo. Jo amal bhi tum karte ho, Allah yaqeenan use dekh raha hai.
Tamam namazon ka poora khayal rakho, aur (khaas tor par) bech ki namaz ka aur Allah ke samne baadb farmanbardar bann kar khre hua karo.

Aur agar tumhein (dushman ka) khof lahiq ho to khre khre ya sawar hone ki halat hi mein (namaz parh lo) phir jab tum aman ki halat mein aajao to Allah ka zikr us tareeqe se karo jo us ne tumhein skhaia hai jis se tum pehle nawaqif the.

Aur tum mein se jo log wafaat pajaiin aur apne peechhe biwiyan chhor jayen to woh apni biwiyon ke haqq mein yeh wasiyat kar jaya karen ke ek saal tak woh (tarke se nafqa wasool karne ka) faida athaiin gi aur un ko (shohar ke ghar se) nikala nahin jaye ga haan agar woh khud nikal jayen to apne haqq mein qaeede ke mutabiq woh jo kuchh bhi karen us mein tum par koi gunaah nahin hoga. Aur Allah sahib iqtedar bhi hai, sahib hikmat bhi.
Aur mutallaqa aurton ko qaeede ke mutabiq faida pahunchana muttaqiyon par un ka haqq hai. ()
Allah apne ehkaam usi tarah wazahat se tumhare samne biyan karta hai taake tum samajh daari se kaam lo.

Kya tumhein un logon ka haal maloom nahin hua jo maut se bachne ke liye apne gharon se nikal aaye the, aur woh hazaaron ki tadaad mein the ? Chunanche Allah ne un se kaha : mrja, phir unhein zinda kya. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke Allah logon par bohat fazal farmane wala hai, lekin aksar log shukar ada nahin karte.
Aur Allah ke raaste mein jung karo, aur yaqeen rakho ke Allah khoob sunne wala, khoob janne wala hai.

Kaun hai jo Allah ko achhe tareeqe par qarz de, taake woh use us ke mafaad mein itna barhaye charhaye ke woh badr jahaaz ya da hojaye ? Aur Allah hi tangi paida karta hai, aur wahi wusat deta hai, aur usi ki taraf tum sab ko lotaya jaye ga.

Kya tumhein musa ke baad bani israel ke giroh ke us waqiye ka ilm nahin hua jab unhon ne apne ek nabi se kaha tha ke hamara ek baadshah muqarrar krdijie taake (us ke jhnde tale) hum Allah ke raaste mein jung krskin. Nabi ne kaha : kya tum logon se yeh baat kuchh baeed hai ke jab tum par jung farz ki jaye to tum na laro ? Unhon ne kaha : bhala humein kya hojaye ga jo hum Allah ke raaste mein jung na karen ge halaanke humein apne gharon aur apne bacchon ke paas se nikal bahar kya gaya hai. Phir (hua yehi ke) jab un par jung farz ki gayi to un mein se thore logon ko chhor kar baqi sab pith phir gaye, aur Allah zalimon ko khoob jaanta hai.

Aur un ke nabi ne un se kaha ke : Allah ne tumhare liye talut ko baadshah bana kar bheja hai. Kehne lage : bhala us ko hum par badshaat karne ka haqq kahan se aagaya ? Hum us ke muqable mein badshaat ke ziyada mustahiq hain, aur us ko to maali wusat bhi hasil nahin. Nabi ne kaha : Allah ne un ko tum par fazilat de kar chuna hai aur unhein ilm aur jism mein (tum se) ziyada wusat ata ki hai, aur Allah apna mulk jis ko chahta hai deta hai, aur Allah bari wusat aur bara ilm rakhne wala hai.

Aur un se un ke nabi ne yeh bhi kaha ke : talut ki badshaat ki alamat yeh hai ke tumhare paas woh sandook (wapas) aajaye ga jis mein tumhare Parwardigar ki taraf se sakinat ka samaan hai, aur musa aur haroon ne jo ashia chhori thin un mein se kuchh baqi maanda cheezen hain. Use farishte athaie hue layein ge agar tum momin ho to tumhare liye us mein bari nishani hai.

Chunanche jab talut lashkar ke saath roana hua to us ne (lashkar walon se) kaha ke : Allah ek darya ke zariye tumhara imtehan lene wala hai, jo shaks us darya se pani piye ga woh mera aadmi nahin hoga, aur jo use nahin chkhe ga woh mera aadmi hoga, illa yeh ke koi apne haath se ek chalo bhar le (to kuchh harj nahin) phir (hua yeh ke) un mein se thore aadmiyon ke siwa baqi sab ne us darya se (khoob) pani piya. Chunanche jab woh (yani talut) aur us ke saath iman rakhne wale darya ke paar utre, to yeh log (jinhon ne talut ka hukum nahin maana tha) kehne lage ke : aaj jaaluth aur us ke lashkar ka muqable karne ki hum mein bilkul taqat nahin hai. (magar) jin logon ka iman tha ke woh Allah se jaa milne wale hain unhon ne kaha ke : na jane kitni chhoti jamaten hain jo Allah ke hukum se bari jamaton par ghalib aayi hain, aur Allah un logon ka sathi hai jo sabar se kaam lete hain.

Aur jab yeh log jaaluth aur us ke lashkaron ke aamne samne hue to unhon ne kaha : ae humare Parwardigar sabar o astqlal ki siffat hum par undhail de, humein saabit qadami baksh de, aur humein us kafir qaum ke muqable mein fatah o nusrat ata farma.

Chunanche unhon ne Allah ke hukum se un (jaaluth ke saathiyon) ko shikast di aur dad ne jaaluth ko qatal kiya, aur Allah ne us ko sultanat aur danaee ata ki, aur jo ilm chaha us ko ata farmaya. Agar Allah logon ka ek dusre ke zariye dfa na kare to zameen mein fasaad phil jaye, lekin Allah tamam jahano par bara fazal farmane wala hai.
Yeh Allah ki aayat hain jo hum aap ke samne theek theek parh kar sunate hain, aur aap be-shak un payghumbaron mein se hain jo Rasool bana kar bheje gaye hain.

Yeh pighbr jo hum ne (makhlooq ki islaah ke liye) bheje hain, un ko hum ne ek dusre par fazilat ata ki hai, un mein se baaz woh hain jin se Allah ne kalaam farmaya, aur un mein se baaz ko us ne badarjaha bulandi ata ki aur hum ne essa ibne marium ko khuli nishaniyan den aur rooh alqds se un ki madad farmaee aur agar Allah chahta to un ke baad wale log apne paas roshan dalail aajane ke baad aapas mein na larte, lekin unhon ne khud ikhtilaf kiya, chunanche un mein se kuchh woh the jo iman laye aur kuchh woh jinhon ne kufr apnaia. Aur agar Allah chahta to woh aapas mein na larte, lekin Allah wahi karta hai jo woh chahta hai

Ae iman walo. Jo rizq hum ne tumhein diya hai us mein se woh din aane se pehle pehle (Allah ke raaste mein) kharch karlo jis din na koi sauda hoga na koi dosti (kaam aaye gi) aur na koi sifarish hosake gi. Aur zalim woh log hain jo kufr ikhtiyar kiye hue hain.

Allah woh hai jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin jo sada zinda hai jo poori qayinaat snbhale hue hai jis ko na kabhi aongh lagti hai, na neend. Aasmanon mein jo kuchh hai (woh bhi) aur zameen mein jo kuchh hai (woh bhi) sab usi ka hai. Kaun hai jo us ke huzoor us ki ijazat ke baghair kisi ki sifarish karsake ? Woh sare bandon ke tamam aage peechhe ke halaat ko khoob jaanta hai, aur woh log us ke ilm ki koi baat apne ilm ke daiyre mein nahin laskte, siwaye us baat ke jise woh khud chahaye, us ki kursi ne sare aasmanon aur zameen ko ghira hua hai, aur un dono ki nigehbani se use zara bhi bojh nahin hota, aur woh bara aali muqaam, sahib azmat hai.

Deen ke maamle mein koi zabardasti nahin hai, hidayat ka raasta gumrahi se mumtaz ho kar wazeh hochka, us ke baad jo shaks taghut ka inkar kar ke Allah par iman le aaye ga, us ne ek mazboot knda tham liya jis ke tootne ka koi imkan nahin, aur Allah khoob sunne wala, sab kuchh janne wala hai.

Allah iman walon ka rkhoala hai, woh unhein andhirion se nikal kar roshni mein laata hai, aur jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai, un ke rkhoale woh shetan hain jo unhein roshni se nikal kar andhirion mein le jate hain, woh sab aag ke basi hain, woh hamesha usi mein rahen ge.

Kya tum ne us shaks (ke haal) par gaur kya jis ko Allah ne sultanat kya de di thi ke woh apne Parwardigar (ke wajood hi) ke bare mein Ibrahim se behas karne laga ? Jab Ibrahim ne kaha ke : mera Parwardigar woh hai jo zindagi bhi deta hai aur maut bhi, to woh kehne laga ke : mein bhi zindagi deta hon aur maut deta hon. Ibrahim ne kaha : achha Allah to suraj ko mashriq se nikalta hai, tum zara use magrib se to nikal kar lao, us par woh kafir mbhot ho kar reh gaya. Aur Allah aise zalimon ko hidayat nahin diya karta.

Ya (tum ne) us jaise shaks (ke waqiye) par (gaur kya) jis ka ek basti par aise waqt guzar hua jab woh chathon ke bal giri pari thi ? Us ne kaha ke : Allah us basti ko us ke marne ke baad kaise zinda kare ga ? Phir Allah ne us shaks ko so saal tak ke liye maut di, aur us ke baad zinda kardiya. (aur phir) pochha ke tum kitne rse tak (us halat mein) rahe ho ? Us ne kaha : ek din ya ek din ka kuchh hissa. Allah ne kaha : nahin bulke tum so saal usi tarah rahe ho. Ab apne khane peene ki cheezon ko dekho ke woh zara nahin srin. Aur (dusri taraf) apne gadhe ko dekho (ke gal sara kar us ka kya haal hogaya hai) aur yeh hum ne us liye kya taake hum tumhein logon ke liye (apni qudrat ka) ek nishan banadein, aur (ab apne gadhe ki) haddiyon ko dekho ke hum kis tarah unhein athate hain, phir un ko gosht ka libas pehnate hain. Chunanche jab haqeeqat kahala kar us ke samne aagaee to woh bol atha ke : mujhe yaqeen hai Allah har cheez par qudrat rakhta hai.

Aur (us waqt ka tzkra suno) jab Ibrahim ne kaha tha ke mere Parwardigar mujhe dkhaie ke aap mardon ko kaise zinda karte hain ? Allah ne kaha : kya tumhein yaqeen nahin ? Kehne lage : yaqeen kyun na hota ? Magar (yeh khwahish us liye ki hai) taake mere dil ko poora itminaan hasil hojaye. Allah ne kaha : achha to char parinde lo, aur unhein apne se manoos karlo, phir (un ko zibah kar ke) un ka ek ek hissa har pahar par rakaha do , phir un ko bulao, woh charon tumhare paas dore chale aayein ge. Aur jaan rakho ke Allah poori tarah sahib iqtedar bhi hai, ali darje ki hikmat wala bhi.

Jo log Allah ke raaste mein apne maal kharch karte hain un ki misal aisi hai jaise ek dana saat baalein ugaye (aur) har bali mein so daane hon aur Allah jis ke liye chahta hai (sawab mein) kaee gunaa azafa kardyta hai, Allah bohat wusat wala (aur) bare ilm wala hai.

Jo log apne maal Allah ke raaste mein kharch karte hain, phir kharch karne ke baad na ehsan jtlate hain aur na koi takleef pahunchate hain, woh apne Parwardigar ke paas apna sawab payen ge, na un ko koi khof lahiq hoga aur na koi ghum pahunche ga.
Bhali baat keh dena aur darguzar karna us sadqe se behtar hai jis ke baad koi takleef pahunchayi jaye aur Allah bara bey-niaz, bohat burdbaar hai.

Ae iman walo apne sadaqaat ko ehsan jtla kar aur takleef pahuncha kar us shaks ki tarah zaya mat karo jo apna maal logon ko dikhane ke liye kharch karta hai aur Allah aur yaum aakhirat par iman nahin rakhta. Chunanche us ki misal aisi hai jaise ek chikni chattan par mitti jami ho, phir us par zoar ki baarish pare aur us (mitti ko baha kar chattan) ko (dobara) chikni bana chhore. Aise logon ne jo kamayi ki hoti hai woh zara bhi un ke haath nahin lagti, aur Allah (aise) kafiron ko hidayat tak nahin pahunchata.

Aur jo log apne maal Allah ki khushnudi talab karne ke liye aur apne aap mein pukhtagi paida karne ke liye kharch karte hain un ki misal aisi hai jaise ek baagh kisi teele par waqe ho, us par zoar ki baarish barse to woh dugna pahala le kar aaye. Aur agar us par zoar ki baarish na bhi barse to halki phoar bhi us ke liye kafi hai, aur tum jo amal bhi karte ho Allah use khoob achhi tarah dekhta hai.

Kya tum mein se koi yeh pasand kare ga ke us ka khajooron aur angooron ka ek baagh ho jis ke niche nehrein behti hon (aur) us ko us baagh mein aur bhi har tarah ke pahala hasil hon, aur burhape ne use pakra ho, aur us ke bache abhi kamzor hon, itne mein ek aag se bhara bgola aaker us ko apni zada mein le le aur poora baagh jal kar reh jaye ? Usi tarah Allah tumhare liye apni aayaten khol khol kar biyan karta hai taake tum gaur karo.

Ae iman walo. Jo kuchh tum ne kamaya ho aur jo paidawaar hum ne tumhare liye zameen se nikali ho us ki achhi cheezon ka ek hissa (Allah ke raaste mein) kharch kiya karo, aur yeh niyat na rakho ke bas aisi kharab qasam ki cheezen (Allah ke naam par) diya karo ge jo (agar koi dusra tumhein de to nafrat ke maare) tum use aankhein miche baghair na le sako. Aur yaad rakho ke Allah aisa bey-niaz hai ke har qasam ki tareef usi ki taraf lotti hai.
Shetan tumhein muflisi se darata hai aur tumhein behiaii ka hukum deta hai aur Allah tum se apni magfirat aur fazal ka wada karta hai. Allah bari wusat wala, har baat janne wala hai.
Woh jis ko chahta hai danaee ata kardyta hai, aur jise danaee ata hogaee use waffir miqdar mein bhalayi mill gayi. Aur naseehat wahi log hasil karte hain jo samajh ke maalik hain.
Aur tum jo koi kharch karo ya koi manata mano Allah use jaanta hai. Aur zalimon ko kisi tarah ke madadgar muyassar nahin aayein ge.

Agar tum sadaqaat zaahir kar ke do tab bhi achha hai, aur agar un ko chhpa kar fqra ko do to yeh tumhare haqq mein kahin behtar hai, aur Allah tumhari buraiyon ka kaffara karde ga, aur Allah tumhare tamam kaamon se poori tarah bakhabar hai.

(ae payghumbar) un (kafiron) ko raah raast par le aana aap ki zma daari nahin hai, lekin Allah jis ko chahta hai raah raast par le aata hai. Aur jo maal bhi tum kharch karte ho woh khud tumhare faiyde ke liye hota hai jabke tum Allah ki khushnudi talab karne ke siwa kisi aur garz se kharch nahin karte. Aur jo maal bhi tum kharch karo ge tumhein poora poora diya jaye ga aur tum par zara bhi zulm nahin hoga.

(maali imdad ke bator khaas) mustahiq woh fqra hain jinhon ne apne aap ko Allah ki raah mein us tarah mqid kar rakhha hai ke woh (muaash ki talash ke liye) zameen mein chal phir nahin sakte. Chunke woh itne pak daaman hain ke kisi se sawal nahin karte, us liye nawaqif aadmi unhein maal daar samajhta hai, tum un ke chehre ki alamaton se un (ki andaruni halat) ko pehchan sakte ho (magar) woh logon se lag lapat kar sawal nahin karte. Aur tum jo maal bhi kharch karte ho Allah use khoob jaanta hai.
Jo log apne maal din raat khamoshi se bhi aur lania bhi kharch karte hain woh apne Parwardigar ke paas apna sawab payen ge, aur na unhein koi khof lahiq hoga, na koi ghum pahunche ga.

Jo log sood kahate hain woh (qayamat mein) athin ge to us shaks ki tarah athin ge jise shetan ne chhokr pagal banadiya ho, yeh us liye hoga ke unhon ne kaha tha ke : be bhi to sood hi ki tarah hoti hai. Halaanke Allah ne be ko halal kiya hai aur sood ko haram qarar diya hai. Lihaza jis shaks ke paas us ke Parwardigar ki taraf se naseehat aagaee aur woh (sodi maamlaat se) baaz aagaya to mazi mein jo kuchh hua woh usi ka hai. Aur us (ki baatini kaifiyat) ka mamla Allah ke hawale hai. Aur jis shaks ne lot kar phir wahi kaam kiya to aise log dozakhi hain, woh hamesha usi mein rahen ge.
Allah sood ko mitata hai aur sadaqaat ko barhata hai, aur Allah har us shaks ko pasand karta hai jo shukra gunehgar ho.
(haan) woh log jo iman layein, nek amal karen, namaz qayam karen aur zakat ada karen woh apne rubb ke paas apne ajar ke mustahiq hon ge, na unhein koi khof lahiq hoga na koi ghum pahunche ga.
Ae iman walo Allah se daro aur agar tum waqayi momin ho to sood ka jo hissa bhi (kisi ke zimme) baqi reh gaya ho use chhor do .

Phir bhi agar tum aisa na karo ge to Allah aur us ke Rasool ki taraf se ailaan jung sunn lo. Aur agar tum (sood se) toubah karo to tumhara asal sarmaya tumhara haqq hai, na tum kisi par zulm karo na tum par zulm kiya jaye.
Aur agar koi tangdast (qarz daar) ho to us ka haath khulne tak mohlat deeni hai, aur sadqa hi kardo to yeh tumhare haqq mein kahin ziyada behtar hai, ba-shart-e-ke tum ko samajh ho.
Aur daro us din se jab tum sab Allah ke paas lot kar jao ge, phir har har shaks ko jo kuchh us ne kamaya hai poora poora diya jaye ga, aur un par koi zulm nahin hoga.

Ae iman walo jab tum kisi moyyen miyad ke liye adhar ka koi mamla karo to use lakaha liya karo, aur tum mein se jo shaks likhna jaanta ho insaf ke saath tehrir lkhe, aur jo shaks likhna jaanta ho likhne se inkar na kare. Jab Allah ne use yeh ilm diya hai to use likhna chahiye. Aur tehrir woh shaks lkhoaie jis ke zimme haqq wajib horha ho, aur use chahiye ke woh Allah se dare jo us ka Parwardigar hai aur us (haqq) mein koi kami na kare. Haan agar woh shaks jis ke zimme haqq wajib horha hai na-samajh ya kamzor ho ya (kisi aur wajah se) tehrir na lkhoa sakta ho to us ka sarparast insaf ke saath lkhoaie. Aur apne mein se do mardon ko gawah bana lo, haan agar do mard maujood na hon to ek mard aur do aurten un gawahon mein se hojayen jinhen tum pasand karte ho, taake agar un do aurton mein se ek bhool jaye to dusri use yaad dlade. Aur jab gawahon ko (gawahi dene ke liye) bulaya jaye to woh inkar na karen, aur jo mamla apni miyad se wabasta ho, chahaye woh chhota ho ya bara, use likhne se akta nahin. Yeh baat Allah ke nazdeek ziyada qareen insaf aur gawahi ko durust rakhne ka behtar zria hai, aur us baat ki qareebi zmant hai ke tum aainda shakk mein nahin paro ge. Haan agar tumhare darmiyan koi naqad lein deen ka sauda ho to us ko na likhne mein tumhare liye kuchh harj nahin hai. Aur jab khareed farokht karo to gawah bana liya karo. Aur na likhne wale ko koi takleef pahunchayi jaye, na gawah ko. Aur agar aisa karo ge to yeh tumhari taraf se nafarmani hogi, aur Allah ka khof dil mein rakho, Allah tumhein taleem deta hai, aur Allah har cheez ka ilm rakhta hai.

Aur agar tum safar par ho aur tumhein koi likhne wala na mile to (adaayegi ki zmant ke tor par) rehan qabze mein rakaha liye jayen. Haan agar tum ek dusre par bharosa karo to jis par bharosa kiya gaya hai woh apni amanat theek theek ada kare aur Allah se dare jo us ka Parwardigar hai. Aur gawahi ko chhpa, aur jo gawahi ko chhpaie woh gunehgar dil ka haamil hai, aur jo amal bhi tum karte ho Allah us se khoob waqif hai.

Jo kuchh aasmanon mein hai aur jo kuchh zameen mein hai sab Allah hi ka hai, aur jo baatein tumhare dilon mein hain, khwah tum un ko zaahir karo ya chhpa, Allah tum se un ka hisab le ga phir jis ko chahaye ga maaf karde ga aur jis ko chahaye ga saza de ga (aur Allah har cheez par qudrat rakhta hai.)

Yeh Rasool (yani hazrat Muhammad (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) us cheez par iman laye hain jo un ki taraf un ke rubb ki taraf se nazil ki gayi hai aur (un ke saath) tamam musalman bhi, yeh sab Allah par, us ke farishton par us ki kitabon par aur us ke rasoolon par iman laye hain (woh kehte hain ke) hum us ke rasoolon ke darmiyan koi tafreeq nahin karte (ke kisi par iman layein, kisi par na layein) aur woh yeh kehte hain ke : hum ne (Allah aur Rasool ke ehkaam ko tawajjuh se) sunn liya hai, aur hum khushi se (un ki) tameel karte hain. Ae humare Parwardigar hum aap ki magfirat ke tlbgar hain, aur aap hi ki taraf humein lot krjana hai.

Allah kisi bhi shaks ko us ki wusat se ziyada zma daari nahin sonpta, us ko faida bhi usi kaam se hoga jo woh apne irade se kare, aur nuksan bhi usi kaam se hoga jo apne irade se kare. (musalmano Allah se yeh dua kiya karo ke) ae humare Parwardigar agar hum se koi bhool chook hojaye to hamari giraft na frmaiie. Aur ae humare Parwardigar hum par us tarah ka bojh na daliye jaisa aap ne hum se pehle logon par dala tha. Aur ae humare Parwardigar hum par aisa bojh na daliye jise athane ki hum mein taqat na ho, aur hamari khataon se darguzar frmaiie, humein baksh dijiye aur hum par reham frmaiie. Aap hi humare haami o nasir hain, us liye kafir logon ke muqable mein humein nusrat ata frmaiie.
Alif Laam Meem
Allah woh hai jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin, jo sada zinda hai, jo poori qayinaat snbhale hue hai.
Us ne tum par woh kitab nazil ki hai jo haqq par mushtamil hai jo apne se pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq karti hai aur usi ne toraat aur injeel atarin.

Jo us se pehle logon ke liye majasam hidayat bann kar aayi thin, aur usi ne haqq o baatil ko prkhne ka miar nazil kiya. . Be-shak jin logon ne Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya hai un ke liye sakht azab hai, aur Allah zabardast iqtedar ka maalik aur buraee ka badla dene wala hai
Yaqeen rakho ke Allah se koi cheez cahahap nahin sakti, na zameen mein na aasman mein.
Wahi hai jo maaon ke pait mein jis tarah chahta hai tumhari soorten banata hai, us ke siwa koi mabood nahin, woh zabardast iqtedar ka bhi maalik hai, ali darje ki hikmat ka bhi

(ae Rasool) wahi Allah hai jis ne tum par kitab nazil ki hai jis ki kuchh aayaten to mohkum hain jin par kitab ki asal bunyaad hai aur kuchh dusri aayaten mutashabeh hain. Ab jin logon ke dilon mein terh hai woh un mutashabeh aayaton ke peechhe pare rehte hain taake fitna paida karen aur un aayaton ki taoilat talash karen, halaanke un aayaton ka theek theek matlab Allah ke siwa koi nahin jaanta, aur jin logon ka ilm pukhta hai woh yeh kehte hain ke : hum us (matlab) par iman late hain (jo Allah ko maloom hai) sab kuchh humare Parwardigar hi ki taraf se hai, aur naseehat wahi log hasil karte hain jo aqal wale hain.

(aise log yeh dua karte hain ke) ae humare rubb to ne humein jo hidayat ata farmaee hai us ke baad humare dilon mein terh paida na hone de, aur khaas apne paas se humein rehmat ata farma. Be-shak teri aur sirf teri zaat woh hai jo beantha bakhsish ki khugar hai.
Humare Parwardigar to tamam insano ko ek aise din jama karne wala hai jis ke aane mein koi shakk nahin. Be-shak Allah apne wade ki khilaf warzi nahin karta.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai Allah ke muqable mein na un ki daulat un ke kuchh kaam aaye gi, na un ki aulad aur wahi hain jo aag ka indhan bann kar rahen ge.

Un ka haal Firaun aur un se pehle ke logon ke maamle jaisa hai. Unhon ne hamari aayaton ko jhutlaya, chunanche Allah ne un ko un ke gunahon ki wajah se pakar mein le liya, aur Allah ka azab bara sakht hai.
Jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai un se keh do ke tum magloob hogaye aur tumhein jama kar ke jahannam ki taraf le jaya jaye ga, aur woh bohat bura bichona hai.

Tumhare liye un do girohon (ke waqiye) mein bari nishani hai jo ek dusre se tkraie the. Un mein se ek giroh Allah ke raaste mein larr raha tha, aur dusra kafiron ka giroh tha jo apne aap ko khuli aankhon un se kaee gunaa ziyada dekh raha tha. Aur Allah jis ki chahta hai apni madad se taeed karta hai. Be-shak us waqiye mein aankhon walon ke liye ibrat ka bara samaan hai.

Logon ke liye un cheezon ki mohabbat khushnuma bnadi gayi hai jo un ki nafsani khwahish ke mutabiq hoti hai ,. Yani aurten, bache, sone chandi ke lage hue dhair, nishan lagaye hue ghore, chopaye aur khetiyan. Yeh sab dunyawi zindagi ka samaan hai (lekin) abadi anjaam ka husn to sirf Allah ke paas hai.

Keh do kya mein tumhein woh cheezen bataon jo un sab se kahin behtar hain ? Jo log taqwa ikhtiyar karte hain un ke liye un ke rubb ke paas woh baghaat hain jin ke niche nehrein behti hain, jin mein woh hamesha rahen ge, aur pakeeza biwiyan hain, aur Allah ki taraf se khushnudi hai. Aur tamam bandon ko Allah achhi tarah dekh raha hai.
Yeh woh log hain jo kehte hain ke : ae humare Parwardigar hum aap par iman le aaye hain, ab humare gunahon ko baksh dijiye, aur humein dozakh ke azab se bacha lijiye.
Yeh log bare sabar karne wale hain, sacchayi ke khugar hain, ibadat guzar hain (Allah ki khushnudi ke liye) kharch karne wale hain, aur shri ke auqat mein istaghfaar karte rehte hain.

Allah ne khud us baat ki gawahi di hai, aur farishton aur ehle ilm ne bhi ke us ke siwa koi mabood nahin jis ne insaf ke saath (qayinaat) ka intezam snbhala hua hai. Us ke siwa koi ibadat ke layaq nahin jis ka iqtedar bhi kamil hai hikmat bhi kamil.

Be-shak (moatbar) deen to Allah ke nazdeek islam hi hai, aur jin logon ko kitab di gayi thi unhon ne alag raasta lalmi mein nahin bulke ilm aajane ke baad mehaz aapas ki zidd ki wajah se ikhtiyar kiya aur jo shaks bhi Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaye to (use yaad rakhna chahiye ke) Allah bohat jald hisab lene wala hai.

Phir bhi agar yeh tum se jhagren to keh do ke : mein ne to apna rukh Allah ki taraf karliya hai aur jinhon ne meri ittabaa ki hai unhon ne bhi, aur ehle kitab se aur (arab ke) un parh (mushrikeen) se keh do ke kya tum bhi islam late ho ? Phir agar woh islam le aayein to hidayat pajaiin ge, aur agar unhon ne moonh mora to tumhari zma daari sirf paygham pahunchane ki hadd tak hai aur Allah tamam bandon ko khud dekh raha hai.
Jo log Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlate hain aur nabiyon ko na-haqq qatal karte hain aur insaf ki talqeen karne wale logon ko bhi qatal karte hain, un ko dardnaak azab ki “ khushkhabri ” suna do .
Yeh woh log hain jin ke aemaal duniya aur aakhirat mein ghaarat hochke hain, aur un ko kisi qasam ke madadgar naseeb nahin hon ge.

Kiya tum ne un logon ko nahin dekha jinhen kitab ka ek hissa diya gaya tha ke unhein Allah ki kitab ki taraf dawat di jati hai taake woh un ke darmiyan faisla kare, us ke bawajood un mein se ek giroh moonh mor kar anhraf krjata hai.

Yeh sab us liye hai ke unhon ne yeh kaha hua hai ke humein ginti ke chandh dino ke siwa aag hargiz nahin chhoe gi, aur unhon ne jo jhooti baatein tarash rkhi hain unhon ne un ke deen ke maamle mein un ko dhoke mein daal diya hai.

Bhala us waqt un ka kiya haal hoga jab hum unhein ek aise din (ka saamna karne) ke liye jama kar layein ge jis ke aane mein zara bhi shakk nahin hai aur har har shaks ne jo kuchh kamayi ki hogi woh us ko poori poori de di jaye gi, aur kisi par koi zulm nahin hoga.

Kaho ke : ae Allah ! Ae iqtedar ke maalik ! To jis ko chahta hai iqtedar bakshta hai, aur jis se chahta hai iqtedar chhin leta hai, aur jis ko chahta hai izzat bakshta hai aur jis ko chahta hai ruswa kardyta hai, tamam tar bhalayi tere hi haath mein hai. Yaqeenan to har cheez par qadir hai.

To hi raat ko din mein dakhil karta hai aur din ko raat mein dakhil karta hai. Aur to hi bejan cheez mein se jaandaar ko baramad krlita hai aur jaandaar mein se bejan cheez nikal laata hai, aur jis ko chahta hai hisab rizq ata farmata hai.

Momin log musalmanon ko chhor kar kafiron ko apna yaromddgar na banayen aur jo aisa kare ga us ka Allah se koi talluq nahin, illa yeh ke tum un (ke zulm) se bachne ke liye bachao ka koi tareeqa ikhtiyar karo, aur Allah tumhein apne (azab) se bachata hai, aur usi ki taraf (sab ko) lot kar jana hai.

(ae Rasool) logon ko btado ke jo kuchh tumhare dilon mein hai tum use chhpa ya zaahir karo, Allah use jaan le ga. Aur jo kuchh aasmanon mein hai aur jo kuchh zameen mein hai, woh sab jaanta hai, aur Allah har cheez par qadir hai.

Woh din yaad rakho jis din kisi bhi shaks ne neki ka jo kaam kiya hoga, use apne samne maujood paye ga, aur buraee ka jo kaam kiya hoga us ko bhi (apne samne dekh kar) yeh tamanna kare ga ke kaash us ke aur us ki badi ke darmiyan bohat door ka faasla hota. Aur Allah tumhein apne (azab) se bachata hai, aur Allah bandon par bohat shafqat rakhta hai.

(ae payghumbar ! Logon se) keh do ke agar tum Allah se mohabbat rakhte ho to meri ittabaa karo, Allah tum se mohabbat kare ga aur tumhari khatir tumhare gunaah maaf karde ga. Aur Allah bohat maaf karne wala, bara meharban hai.
Keh do ke Allah aur Rasool ki itaat karo, phir bhi agar moonh moro ge to Allah kafiron ko pasand nahin karta.
Allah ne adam, nooh, Ibrahim ke khandaan, aur imran ke khandaan ko chun kar tamam jahano par fazilat di thi.
Yeh aisi nasal thi jis ke afraad (neki aur ikhlaas mein) ek dusre se milte julte the, aur Allah (har ek ki baat) sunne wala hai, har cheez ka ilm rakhta hai.

(chunanche Allah ke dua sunne ka woh waqa yaad karo) jab imran ki biwi ne kaha tha ke : ya rubb ! Mein ne nazar maani hai ke mere pait mein jo bcha hai mein use har kaam se aazad kar ke tere liye waqf rakhoon gi. Meri us nazar ko qabool farma. Be-shak to sunne wala hai, har cheez ka ilm rakhta hai.

Phir jab un se larki paida hui to woh (hasrat se) kehne lagen : ya rubb yeh to mujh se larki paida hogaee hai. Halaanke Allah ko khoob ilm tha ke un ke yahan kiya paida hua hai. Aur larka larki jaisa nahin hota, mein ne us ka naam marium rakaha diya hai aur mein use aur us ki aulad ko shetan mardood se hifazat ke liye aap ki panaah mein deti hon.

Chunanche us ke rubb ne us (marium) ko ba-tareeq ahsan qabool kya aur use behtareen tareeqe se proan charhaya. Aur zakriya us ke sarparast bane. Jab bhi zakriya un ke paas un ki ibadat gaah mein jate, un ke paas koi rizq pate, unhon ne pochha : marium ! Tumhare paas yeh cheezen kahan se aayein ? Woh bolenge : Allah ke paas se. Allah jis ko chahta hai hisab rizq deta hai
Us mauqa par zakriya ne apne rubb se dua ki, kehne lage : ya rubb mujhe khaas apne paas se pakeeza aulad ata farma. Be-shak to dua ka sunne wala hai.

Chunanche (ek din) jab zakriya ibadat gaah mein khre namaz parh rahe the, farishton ne unhein aawaz di ke : Allah aap ko yhi ki (pedaeesh) ki khushkhabri deta hai jo us shaan se paida hon ge ke Allah ke ek kalme ki tasdeeq karen ge, logon ke paishwa hon ge, apne aap ko nafsani khwahishat se mukammal tor par roke hue hon ge, aur nabi hon ge aur un ka shumar raast bazon mein hoga.
Zakriya ne kaha : ya rubb ! Mere yahan larka kis tarah paida hoga jabke mujhe burhapa aaphncha hai aur meri biwi baanjh hai ? Allah ne kaha : usi tarah Allah jo chahta hai karta hai.

Unhon ne kaha : Parwardigar mere liye koi nishani muqarrar krdijie, Allah ne kaha : tumhari nishani yeh hogi ke tum teen din tak isharon ke siwa koi baat nahin krsko ge. Aur apne rubb ka kasrat se zikr karte raho, aur dhle din ke waqt bhi aur subah sawere bhi Allah ki tasbeeh kiya karo.

Aur (ab us waqt ka tzkra suno) jab farishton ne kaha tha ke : ae marium ! Be-shak Allah ne tumhein chun liya hai, tumhein pakeezgi ata ki hai aur duniya jahaan ki saari aurton mein tumhein muntakhab karke fazilat bakshi hai.
Ae marium ! Tum apne rubb ki ibadat mein lagi raho, aur sajda karo aur rukoo karne walon ke saath rukoo bhi kiya karo.

(ae payghumbar) yeh sab gaib ki khabren hain jo hum wahee ke zariye tumhein de rahe hain, tum us waqt un ke paas nahin the jab woh yeh tai karne ke liye apne qalam daal rahe the ke un mein se kaun marium ki kafalat kare ga, aur na us waqt tum un ke paas the jab woh (us msile mein) ek dusre se ikhtilaf krrhe the.

(woh waqt bhi yaad karo) jab farishton ne marium se kaha tha ke : ae marium ! Allah taalaa tumhein apne ek kalme ki (pedaeesh) ki khushkhabri deta hai jis ka naam maseeh essa ibne marium hoga, jo duniya aur aakhirat dono mein sahib wjaht hoga, aur (Allah ke) muqarrab bandon mein se hoga.
Aur woh gehware mein bhi logon se baat kare ga aur bari umar mein bhi, aur raast baaz logon mein se hoga.

Marium ne kaha : Parwardigar mujh se larka kaise paida hojaye ga jabke mujhe kisi bashar ne chhoa tak nahin ? Allah ne farmaya : Allah usi tarah jis ko chahta hai paida karta hai. Jab woh koi kaam karne ka faisla krlita hai to sirf itna kehta hai ke “ hoja ” bas woh hojata hai.
Aur wahi (Allah) us ko (yani essa ibne marium ko) kitab o hikmat aur toraat o injeel ki taleem de ga.

Aur use bani israel ke paas Rasool bana kar bheje ga (jo logon se yeh kahe ga) ke : mein tumhare paas tumhare rubb ki taraf se ek nishani le kar aaya hon, (aur woh nishani yeh hai) ke mein tumhare samne gaare se parinde jaisi ek shakal banata hon, phir us mein phonk maarta hon, to woh Allah ke hukum se parinda bann jata hai, aur mein Allah ke hukum se madar zaad andhe aur korhi ko tandrust kardyta hon, aur mardon ko zinda kardyta hon, aur tum log jo kuchh apne gharon mein kahate ya zakheera kar ke rakhte ho mein woh sab btadita hon. Agar tum iman lane wale ho to un tamam baaton mein tumhare liye (kafi) nishani hai.

Aur jo kitab mujh se pehle chuki hai, yani toraat, mein us ki tasdeeq karne wala hon, aur (us liye bheja gaya hon) taake kuchh cheezen jo tum par haram ki gayi thin, ab tumhare liye halal kardoon. Aur mein tumhare paas tumhare Parwardigar ki taraf se nishani le kar aaya hon, lihaza Allah se daro aur mera kehna mano.
Be-shak Allah mera bhi Parwardigar hai aur tumhara bhi Parwardigar. Yehi seedha raasta hai (ke sirf usi ki ibadat karo)

Phir jab essa ne mehsoos kya ke woh kufr par aamada hain, to unhon ne (apne piron se) kaha : kaun kaun log hain jo Allah ki raah mein mere madadgar hon ? Hawariyon ne kaha : hum Allah (ke deen) ke madadgar hain, hum Allah par iman lachke hain, aur aap gawah rahiye ke hum farmanbardar hain.
Ae humare rubb ! Aap ne jo kuchh nazil kiya hai hum us par iman laye hain aur hum ne Rasool ki ittabaa ki hai, lihaza humein un logon mein lakaha lijiye jo (haqq ki) gawahi dene wale hain.
Aur un kafiron ne (essa (alh alh-e-salam) ke khilaf) khfia tadbeer ki, aur Allah ne bhi khfia tadbeer ki. Aur Allah sab se behtar tadbeer karne wala hai.

(us ki tadbeer us waqt samne aayi) jab Allah ne kaha tha ke : ae essa mein tumhein sahih saalim wapas le loon ga, aur tumhein apni taraf athalon ga, aur jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai un (ki ezza) se tumhein pak kardoon ga. Aur jin logon ne tumhari ittabaa ki hai, un ko qayamat ke din tak un logon par ghalib rakhoon ga jinhon ne tumhara inkar kiya hai. Phir tum sab ko mere paas lot kar aana hai, us waqt mein tumhare darmiyan un baaton ka faisla karoon ga jin mein tum ikhtilaf karte the.
Chunanche jo log aise hain ke unhon ne kufr apna liya hai, un ko to mein duniya aur aakhirat mein sakht azab doon ga, aur un ko kisi tarah ke madadgar muyassar nahin aayein ge.
Albatta jo log iman laye hain aur unhon ne nek amal kiye hain, un ko Allah un ka poora poora sawab de ga, aur Allah zalimon ko pasand nahin karta.
(ae payghumbar) yeh woh aayaten aur hikmat bhara zikr hai jo hum tumhein parh kar suna rahe hain.
Allah ke nazdeek essa ki misal adam jaisi hai, Allah ne unhein mitti se paida kiya, phir un se kaha : hojao. Bas woh hogaye.
Haqq wahi hai jo tumhare rubb ki taraf se aaya hai, lihaza shakk karne walon mein shamil na hojana.

Tumhare paas (hazrat essa (alh alh-e-salam) ke waqiye ka) jo sahih ilm aagaya hai us ke baad bhi jo log us maamle mein tum se behas karen to un se keh do ke :“ aao hum apne beton ko bulayen aur tum apne beton ko, aur hum apni aurton ko aur tum apni aurton ko, aur hum apne logon ko aur tum apne logon ko, phir hum sab malakar Allah ke samne girr girayen, aur jo jhoote hon un par Allah ki laanat bhejein.
Yaqeen jaano ke waqiyaat ka sacha biyan yehi hai. Aur Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin hai. Aur yaqeenan Allah hi hai jo iqtedar ka bhi maalik hai, hikmat ka bhi maalik.
Phir bhi agar yeh log moonh moren to Allah mufsidon ko achhi tarah jaanta hai.

(musalmano ! Yahud o nsari se) keh do ke : ae ehle kitab ! Ek aisi baat ki taraf aajao jo hum tum mein mushtarik ho, (aur woh yeh) ke hum Allah ke siwa kisi ki ibadat na karen, aur us ke saath kisi ko shareek na thehrayen, aur Allah ko chhor kar hum ek dusre ko rubb na banayen. Phir bhi agar woh moonh moren to keh do : gawah rehna ke hum musalman hain.
Ae ehle kitab ! Tum Ibrahim ke bare mein kyun behas karte ho halaanke toraat aur injeel un ke baad hi to nazil hui thin, kya tumhein itni bhi samajh nahin hai ?

Dekho ! Yeh tum hi to ho jinhon ne un maamlaat mein apni si behas karli hai jin ka tumhein kuchh na kuchh ilm tha. Ab un maamlaat mein kyun behas karte ho jin ka tumhein sire se koi ilm hi nahin hai ? Allah jaanta hai, aur tum nahin jante.
Ibrahim na yahudi the, na nasrani, bulke woh to seedhe seedhe musalman the, aur shirk karne walon mein kabhi shamil nahin hue.

Ibrahim ke saath talluq ke sab se ziyada haqq daar woh log hain jinhon ne un ki pairwi ki, neiz yeh nabi (aakhir alzman (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) aur woh log hain jo (un par) iman laye hain, aur Allah momino ka kaarsaaz hai.
(musalmano) ehle kitab ka ek giroh yeh chahta hai ke tum logon ko gumraah karde, halaanke woh apne siwa kisi aur ko gumraah nahin kar rahe, agarche unhein us ka ehsaas nahin hai.
Ae ehle kitab ! Allah ki aayaton ka kyun inkar karte ho halaanke tum khud (un ke mann janib Allah hone ke) gawah ho.
Ae ehle kitab ! Tum haqq ko baatil ke saath kyun gudd mudd karte ho aur kyun jaan bojh kar haqq baat ko chupate ho ?

Ehle kitab ke ek giroh ne (ek dusre se) kaha hai ke : jo kalaam musalmanon par nazil kiya gaya hai us par din ke shuroo mein to iman le aao, aur un ke aakhri hisse mein us se inkar krdina, shayad us tarah musalman (bhi apne deen se) phrjaiin.

Magar dil se un logon ke siwa kisi ki na manna jo tumhare deen ke mataba hain. Aap un se keh dijiye ke hidayat to wahi hidayat hai jo Allah ki di hui ho, yeh saari baatein tum us zidd mein kar rahe ho ke kisi ko us jaisi cheez (yani nabuwat aur aasmani kitab) kyun mill gayi jaisi kabhi tumhein di gayi thi ya yeh (musalman) tumhare rubb ke aage tum par ghalib kyun aagaye. Aap keh dijiye ke fazilat tamam tar Allah ke haath mein hai, woh jis ko chahta hai de deta hai, aur Allah bari wusat wala hai, har cheez ka ilm rakhta hai.
Woh apni rehmat ke liye jis ko chahta hai khaas tor par muntakhab krlita hai, aur Allah fazal azeem ka maalik hai.

Ehle kitab mein kuchh log to aise hain ke agar tum un ke paas daulat ka ek dhair bhi amanat ke tor par rkhoa do to woh tumhein wapas karden ge, aur unhi mein se kuchh aise hain ke agar ek dinar ki amanat bhi un ke paas rkhoa to woh tumhein wapas nahin den ge, illa yeh ke tum un ke sar par khre raho. Un ka yeh tarz amal us liye hai ke unhon ne yeh keh rakhha hai ke : ummiyon (yani ghair yahudi arabon) ke saath mamla karne mein hamari koi pakar nahin hogi. Aur (us tarah) woh Allah par jaan bojh kar jhoot bandhte hain.
Bhala pakar kyun nahin hogi ? (qada yeh hai ke) jo apne ahad ko poora kare ga aur gunaah se bache ga to Allah aise perhezgaron se mohabbat karta hai.

(us ke bar-khilaf) jo log Allah se kiye hue ahad aur apni khaii hui qasmon ka sauda kar ke thori si keemat hasil krlite hain un ka aakhirat mein koi hissa nahin hoga, aur qayamat ke din na Allah un se baat kare ga, na unhein (riayat ki nazar se) dikhe ga, na unhein pak kare ga, aur un ka hissa to bas azab hoga, intehaee dardnaak.

Aur unhi mein se ek giroh ke log aise hain jo kitab (yani toraat) parhte waqt apni zubaano ko mrorte hain taake tum (un ki mror kar banaee hui) us ibarat ko kitab ka hissa samjho, halaanke woh kitab ka hissa nahin hoti, aur woh kehte hain ke yeh (ibarat) Allah ki taraf se hai, halaanke woh Allah ki taraf se nahin hoti. Aur (us tarah) woh Allah par jante boojhte jhoot bandhte hain.

Yeh kisi bashar ka kaam nahin ke Allah to use kitab aur hikmat aur nabuwat ata kare, aur woh us ke bawajood logon se kahe ke Allah ko chhor kar mere bande bann jao. Us ke bajaye (woh to yehi kahe ga ke) Allah wale bann jao, kyunke tum jo kitab prhate rahe ho aur jo kuchh parhte rahe ho, us ka yehi nateeja hona chahiye.
Aur na woh tumhein yeh hukum de sakta hai ke farishton aur payghumbaron ko khuda qarar de do . Jab tum musalman hochke to kya us ke baad woh tumhein kufr ikhtiyar karne ka hukum de ga ?

Aur (un ko woh waqt yaad dilao) jab Allah ne payghumbaron se ahad liya tha ke : agar mein tum ko kitab aur hikmat ata karoon, phir tumhare paas koi Rasool aaye jo us (kitab) ki tasdeeq kare jo tumhare paas hai, to tum us par zaroor iman lao ge, aur zaroor us ki madad karo ge. Allah ne (un payghumbaron se) kaha tha ke : kya tum us baat ka iqrar karte ho aur meri taraf se di hui yeh zma daari athate ho ? Unhon ne kaha tha : hum iqrar karte hain. Allah ne kaha : to phir (ek dusre ke iqrar ke) gawah bann jao, aur mein bhi tumhare saath gawahi mein shamil hon.
Us ke baad bhi jo log (hidayat se) moonh moren ge to aise log nafarman hon ge.

Ab kya yeh log Allah ke deen ke laoa kisi aur deen ki talash mein hain ? Halaanke aasmanon aur zameen mein jitni makhlooqat hain un sab ne Allah hi ke aage gardan jhuka rkhi hai, (kuchh ne) khushi se aur (kuchh ne) nachar hoker, aur usi ki taraf woh sab lot kar jayen ge.

Keh do ke : hum iman laye Allah par aur jo (kitab) hum par utari gayi us par, aur us (hidayat) par jo Ibrahim, ismail, ashaq, yaqoob aur (un ki) aulad par un ke Parwardigar ki taraf se utari gayi, aur un baaton par jo musa , essa aur (dusre) payghumbaron ko ata ki gaeen. Hum un (payghumbaron) mein se kisi ke darmiyan koi farq nahin karte, aur hum usi (ek Allah) ke aage srjhkaie hue hain.
Jo koi shaks islam ke siwa koi aur deen ikhtiyar karna chahaye ga to us se woh deen qabool nahin kiya jaye ga, aur aakhirat mein woh un logon mein shamil hoga jo sakht nuksan athane wale hain.

Allah aise logon ko kaise hidayat de jinhon ne iman lane ke baad kufr ikhtiyar karliya ? Halaanke woh gohi de chuke the ke yeh Rasool sache hain, aur un ke paas (us ke) roshan dalail bhi chuke the. Allah aise zalimon ko hidayat nahin diya karta.
Aise logon ki saza yeh hai ke un par Allah ki, farishton ki aur tamam insano ki phtkar hai.
Usi (phtkar) mein yeh hamesha rahen ge, na un ke liye azab halka kiya jaye ga, aur na unhein koi mohlat di jaye gi.
Albatta jo log us sab ke baad bhi toubah kar ke apni islaah karlen, to be-shak Allah bohat bakhshne wala, bara meharban hai.
(us ke bar-khilaf) jin logon ne iman lane ke baad kufr ikhtiyar kiya, phir kufr mein brhte hi chale gaye, un ki toubah hargiz qabool na hogi. Aise log raaste se bilkul hi bhatak chuke hain.

Jin logon ne kufr apnaia aur kafir hone ki halat hi mein mare, un mein se kisi se poori zameen bhar kar sona qabool nahin kiya jaye ga, khwah woh apni jaan churane ke liye us ki peshkash hi kyun na kare. Un ko to dardnaak azab ho kar rahe ga, aur un ko kisi qasam ke madadgar muyassar nahin aayein ge.

Tum neki ke muqaam tak us waqt tak hargiz nahin pahuncho ge jab tak un cheezon mein se (Allah ke liye) kharch na karo jo tumhein mehboob hain. Aur jo kuchh bhi tum kharch karo, Allah use khoob jaanta hai.

Toraat ke nazil hone se pehle khane ki tamam cheezen (jo musalmanon ke liye halal hain) bani israel ke liye (bhi) halal thin, siwaye us cheez ke jo israel (yani yaqoob (alh alh-e-salam)) ne apne upar haram karli thi. (ae payghumbar ! Yahudiyon se) keh do ke : agar tum sache ho to toraat le kar aao aur us ki tilawat karo.
Phir un baaton ke (wazeh hone ke) baad bhi jo log Allah par jhoota bohatan bandhen, to aise log bare zalim hain.

Aap kahiye ke Allah ne sach kaha hai, lihaza tum Ibrahim ke deen ka ittabaa karo jo poori tarah seedhe raaste par the, aur un logon mein se nahin the jo Allah ki khudayi mein kisi ko shareek maante hain.

Haqeeqat yeh hai ke sab se pehla ghar jo logon (ki ibadat) ke liye banaya gaya yaqeeni tor par woh hai jo makkah mein waqe hai (aur) banane ke waqt hi se barkaton wala aur duniya jahaan ke logon ke liye hidayat ka samaan hai.

Us mein roshan nishaniyan hain, muqaam Ibrahim hai, aur jo us mein dakhil hota hai aman paa jata hai. Aur logon mein se jo log us tak pahunchne ki istitaat rakhte hon un par Allah ke liye us ghar ka hajj karna farz hai, aur agar koi inkar kare to Allah duniya jahaan ke tamam logon se bey-niaz hai.
Keh do ke : ae ehle kitab ! Allah ki aayaton ka kyun inkar karte ho ? Jo kuchh tum karte ho Allah us sab ka gawah hai.

Keh do ke : ae ehle kitab ! Allah ke raaste mein terh paida karne ki koshish kar ke ek momin ke liye us mein kyun rukawat daalte ho jabke tum khud haqeeqat haal ke gawah ho ? Jo kuchh tum kar rahe ho Allah us se ghafil nahin hai.
Ae iman walo ! Agar tum ehle kitab ke ek giroh ki baat maan lo ge to woh tumhare iman lane ke baad tum ko dobara kafir ban kar choren ge.

Aur tum kaise kufr apna ge jabke Allah ki aayaten tumhare samne tilawat ki jati hain aur us ka Rasool tumhare darmiyan maujood hai ? Aur (Allah ki sunnat yeh hai ke) jo shaks Allah ka sahara mazbooti se tham le, woh seedhe raaste tak pahuncha diya jata hai.
Ae iman walo ! Dil mein Allah ka waisa hi khof rakho jaisa khof rakhna us ka haqq hai, aur khabardar ! Tumhein kisi aur halat mein maut na aaye, bulke usi halat mein aaye ke tum musalman ho.

Aur Allah ki rassi ko sab malakar mazbooti se thame rakho, aur aapas mein phot na dalo, aur Allah ne tum par jo inam kiya hai use yaad rakho ke ek waqt tha jab tum ek dusre ke dushman the, phir Allah ne tumhare dilon ko jor diya aur tum Allah ke fazal se bhai bhai bann gaye, aur tum aag ke garhe ke kinare par the, Allah ne tumhein us se nijat ata farmaee. Usi tarah Allah tumhare liye apni nishaniyan khol khol kar wazeh karta hai, taake tum raah raast par aajao.
Aur tumhare darmiyan ek jamat aisi honi chahiye jis ke afraad (logon ko) bhalayi ki taraf bulayen, neki ki talqeen karen, aur buraee se rokein. Aise hi log hain jo falaah pane wale hain.
Aur un logon ki tarah na hojana jin ke paas khle khle dalail chuke the, us ke baad bhi unhon ne aapas mein phot daal li aur ikhtilaf mein prgie, aise logon ko sakht saza hogi.

Us din jab kuchh chehre chamakte hon ge aur kuchh chehre siyah prjaiin ge. Chunanche jin logon ke chehre siyah prjaiin ge un se kaha jaye ga ke : kya tum ne apne iman ke baad kufr ikhtiyar karliya ? Lo phir ab mza chkho us azab ka, kyunke tum kufr kya karte the.
Dusri taraf jin logon ke chehre chamakte hon ge woh Allah ki rehmat mein jagah payen ge, woh usi mein hamesha hamesha rahen ge.
Yeh Allah ki aayaten hain jo hum tumhein theek theek parh kar suna rahe hain, aur Allah duniya jahaan ke logon par kisi tarah ka zulm nahin chahta.
Aasman aur zameen mein jo kuchh hai, Allah hi ka hai aur usi ki taraf tamam maamlaat lotaye jayen ge.

(musalmano) tum woh behtareen ummat ho jo logon ke faiyde ke liye wajood mein layi gayi hai, tum neki ki talqeen karte ho, buraee se rokte ho aur Allah par iman rakhte ho. Agar ehle kitab iman le aate to yeh un ke haqq mein kahin behtar hota, un mein se kuchh to momin hain, magar un ki aksariyat nafarman hai.
Woh thora bohat satane ke siwa tumhein koi nuksan hargiz nahin pahuncha saken ge, aur agar woh tum se laren ge bhi to tumhein pith dkha jayen ge, phir unhein koi madad bhi nahin pahunche gi.

Woh jahan kahin paye jayen, un par zillat ka thpa laga diya gaya hai, illa yeh ke Allah ki taraf se koi sabab paida hojaye ya insano ki taraf se koi zria nikal aaye jo un ko sahara de, anjaam kaar woh Allah ka gazab le kar lote hain aur un par mohtaji musallat kardi gayi hai. Us ki wajah yeh hai woh Allah ki aayaton ka inkar karte the, aur payghumbaron ko na-haqq qatal karte the. (neiz) us ki wajah yeh hai ke woh nafarmani karte the, aur saari hadein phlang jaya karte the.

(lekin) sare ehle kitab ek jaise nahin hain, ehle kitab hi mein woh log bhi hain jo (raah raast par) qayam hain, jo raat ke auqat mein Allah ki aayaton ki tilawat karte hain aur jo (Allah ke aage) sajda raiz hote hain.
Yeh log Allah par aur aakhirat ke din par iman rakhte hain, achhaii ki talqeen karte aur buraee se rokte hain, aur nek kaamon ki taraf lpkte hain. Yeh woh log hain jin ka shumar saliheen mein hai.
Woh jo bhalayi bhi karen ge, us ki hargiz qadri nahin ki jaye gi, aur Allah perhezgaron ko khoob jaanta hai.
(us ke baraks) jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai, Allah ke muqable mein na un ke maal un ke kuchh kaam aayein ge, na aulad, woh dozakhi log hain, usi mein woh hamesha rahen ge.

Jo kuchh yeh log dunyawi zindagi mein kharch karte hain, us ki misal aisi hai jaise ek sakht srdi wali tez hua ho jo un logon ki khiti ko jaa lage jinhon ne apni janon par zulm kar rakhha ho aur woh us khiti ko barbaad karde. Un par Allah ne zulm nahin kiya, bulke woh khud apni janon par zulm karte rahe hain.

Ae iman walo ! Apne se bahar ke kisi shaks ko razdar na banao, yeh log tumhari bdkhoahi mein koi kasar atha nahin rakhte. Un ki dili khwahish yeh hai ke tum takleef atha, bugz un ke moonh se zaahir hochka hai aur jo kuchh (adawat) un ke seene chhpaie hue hain woh kahin ziyada hai. Hum ne patte ki baatein tumhein khol khol kar btadi hain, ba-shart-e-ke tum samajh se kaam lo.

Dekho tum to aise ho ke un se mohabbat rakhte ho, magar woh tum se mohabbat nahin rakhte, aur tum to tamam (aasmani) kitabon par iman rakhte ho, aur (un ka haal yeh hai ke) woh jab tum se milte hain to kehte hain ke hum (quran par) iman le aaye, aur jab tanahi mein jate hain to tumhare khilaf gusse ke maare apni ungliyan chabate hain. (un se) keh do ke : apne gusse mein khud marr raho, Allah seeno mein chhpi hui baatein khoob jaanta hai.

Agar tumhein koi bhalayi mill jaye to un ko bura lagta hai, aur agar tumhein koi gaznad pahunche to yeh us se khush hote hain, agar tum sabar aur taqwa se kaam lo to un ki chalein tumhein koi nuksan nahin pahunchayein gi. Jo kuchh yeh kar rahe hain woh sab Allah ke (ilm aur qudrat ke) ahate mein hai.
(ae pighbr ! Jung uhud ka woh waqt yaad karo) jab tum subah ke waqt apne ghar se nikal kar musalmanon ko jung ke thkanon par jamaa rahe the, aur Allah sab kuchh sunne janne wala hai.
Jab tumhi mein ke do girohon ne yeh socha tha ke woh himmat haar bethen, halaanke Allah un ka haami o nasir tha, aur momino ko Allah hi par bharosa rakhna chahiye.
Allah ne to (jung) badr ke mauqa par aisi halat mein tumhari madad ki thi jab tum bilkul besrosaman the. Lihaza (sirf) Allah ka khof dil mein rakho, taake tum shukar guzar bann sako.
Jab (badr ki jung mein) tum momino se keh rahe the ke : kya tumhare liye yeh baat kafi nahin hai ke tumhara Parwardigar teen hazar farishte utaar kar tumhari madad ko bhej de ?

Haan ! Bulke agar tum sabar aur taqwa ikhtiyar karo aur woh log apne usi raile mein achanak tum tak pahunch jayen to tumhara Parwardigar paanch hazar farishte tumhari madad ko bhej de ga jinhon ne apni pehchan numayan ki hui hogi

Allah ne yeh sab intezam sirf us liye kiya tha taake tumhein khushkhabri mile, aur us se tumhare dilon ko itminaan naseeb ho, wrna fatah to kisi aur ki taraf se nahin, sirf Allah ke paas se aati hai jo mukammal iqtedar ka bhi maalik hai, tamam tar hikmat ka bhi maalik.

(aur jung badr mein yeh madad Allah ne us liye ki) taake jin logon ne kufr apnaia hai un ka ek hissa kaat kar rakaha de, ya un ko aisi zillat aamez shikast de ke woh na-murad ho kar wapas chale jayen.
(ae pighbr) tumhein us faisle ka koi ikhtiyar nahin ke Allah un ki toubah qabool kare ya un ko azab de kyunke yeh zalim log hain.
Aasmanon aur zameen mein jo kuchh hai Allah hi ka hai. Woh jis ko chahta hai maaf kardyta hai aur jis ko chahta hai azab deta hai, aur Allah bohat bakhshne wala bara meharban hai.
Ae iman walo ! Kaee gunaa barha charha kar sood mat kha, aur Allah se daro taake tumhein falaah hasil ho
Aur us aag se daro jo kafiron ke liye tayyar ki gayi hai.
Aur Allah aur Rasool ki baat mano, taake tum se rehmat ka bartao kiya jaye.

Aur apne rubb ki taraf se magfirat aur woh jannat hasil karne ke liye ek dusre se barh kar tezi dkha jis ki choraii itni hai ke us mein tamam aasman aur zameen samaa jayen. Woh un perhezgaron ke liye tayyar ki gayi hai.
Jo khushali mein bhi aur badh-haali mein bhi (Allah ke liye) maal kharch karte hain, aur jo gusse ko pee jane aur logon ko maaf kardene ke aadi hain. Allah aise nek logon se mohabbat karta hai.

Aur yeh woh log hain ke agar kabhi koi behiaii ka kaam kar bhi bithte hain ya (kisi aur tarah) apni jaan par zulm kar guzarte hain to fora Allah ko yaad karte hain ke aur us ke natije mein apne gunahon ki maafi maangte hain, aur Allah ke siwa hai bhi kaun jo gunahon ki maafi de ? Aur yeh apne kiye par jante boojhte israr nahin karte.

Yeh hain woh log jin ka sla un ke Parwardigar ki taraf se magfirat hai, aur woh baghaat hain jin ke niche darya behte hon ge, jin mein unhen daeemi zindagi hasil hogi, kitna behtareen badla hai jo kaam karne walon ko milna hai.
Tum se pehle bohat se waqiyaat guzar chuke hain, ab tum zameen mein chal phir kar dekh lo ke jinhon ne (payghumbaron ko) jhutlaya tha un ka anjaam kaisa hua ?
Yeh tamam logon ke liye wazeh ailaan hai aur perhezgaron ke liye hidayat aur naseehat.
(musalmano) tum na to kamzor paro, aur na ghumgeen raho, agar tum waqayi momin raho to tum hi sarabalnd hoge.

Agar tumhein ek zakm laga hai to un logon ko bhi usi jaisa zakm pehle lag chuka hai. Yeh to aate jate din hain jinhen hum logon ke darmiyan bari bari badalte rehte hain, aur maqsad yeh tha ke Allah iman walon ko jaanch le, aur tum mein se kuchh logon ko shaheed qarar de, aur Allah zalimon ko pasand nahin karta.
Aur maqsad yeh (bhi) tha ke Allah iman walon ko mail kuchail se nkhar kar rakaha de aur kafiron ko maliyameit kar dale.

Bhala kya tum yeh samajhte ho ke (yunhi) jannat ke andar japhncho ge ? Halaanke abhi tak Allah ne tum mein se un logon ko jaanch kar nahin dekha jo jihad karen, aur na un ko jaanch kar dekha hai jo saabit qadam rehne wale hain.
Aur tum to khud maut ka saamna karne se pehle (shahadat ki) maut ki tamanna kiya karte the. Chunanche ab tum ne khuli aankhon use dekh liya hai.

Aur Muhammad (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) ek Rasool hi to hain. Un se pehle bohat se Rasool guzar chuke hain, bhala agar un ka intiqal hojaye ya unhein qatal kardiya jaye to kya tum ulte paon phir jao ge ? Aur jo koi ulte paon phre ga woh Allah ko hargiz koi nuksan nahin pahuncha sakta. Aur jo shukar guzar bande hain Allah un ko sawab de ga.

Aur yeh kisi bhi shaks ke ikhtiyar mein nahin hai ke use Allah ke hukum ke baghair maut aajaye, jis ka ek moyyen waqt par aana lkha hua hai. Aur jo shaks duniya ka badla chahaye ga hum use us ka hissa de den ge, aur jo aakhirat ka sawab chahaye ga hum use us ka hissa ata karden ge, aur jo log shukar guzar hain un ko hum jald hi un ka ajar ata karen ge.

Aur kitne sare payghumbar hain jin ke saath malakar bohat se Allah walon ne jung ki ! Ntijta unhein Allah ke raaste mein jo takleef pahunchenge un ki wajah se na unhon ne himmat haari, na woh kamzor pare aur na unhon ne apne aap ko jhkaia, Allah aise saabit qadam logon se mohabbat karta hai.

Un ke moonh se jo baat nikli woh us ke siwa nahin thi ke woh keh rahe the : humare Parwardigar ! Humare gunahon ko bhi aur hum se apne kaamon mein jo zyadati hui ho us ko bhi maaf farma, humein saabit qadami baksh de, aur kafir logon ke muqable mein humein fatah ata farma.
Chunanche Allah ne unhein duniya ka inam bhi diya aur aakhirat ka behtareen sawab bhi, aur Allah aise nek logon se mohabbat karta hai.
Ae iman walo ! Jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai agar tum un ki baat mano ge to woh tumhein ulte paon (kufr ki taraf) lota den ge, aur tum palat kar sakht nuksan atha ge.
(yeh log tumhare khair khwah nahin) bulke Allah tumhara haami o nasir hai, aur woh behtareen madadgar hai.

Jin logon ne kufr apnaia hai hum anqareeb un ke dilon mein rob daal den ge kyunke unhon ne Allah ki khudayi mein aisi cheezon ko shareek thehraya hai jin ke bare mein Allah ne koi daleel nahin utari. Un ka thikana jahannam hai aur woh zalimon ka badhtareen thikana hai.

Aur Allah ne yaqeenan us waqt apna wada poora kardiya tha jab tum dushmano ko usi ke hukum se qatal kar rahe the, yahan tak ke jab tum ne kamzori dkhaii aur hukum ke bare mein baham ikhtilaf kiya aur jab Allah ne tumhari pasandeeda cheez tumhein dkhaii to tum ne (apne amir ka) kehna nahin maana tum mein se kuchh log woh the jo duniya chahte the, aur kuchh woh the jo aakhirat chahte the. Phir Allah ne un se tumhara rukh phir diya taake tumhein aazmaye. Albatta ab woh tumhein maaf krchka hai, aur Allah momino par bara fazal karne wala hai.

(woh waqt yaad karo) jab tum moonh athaie chale jarahe the aur kisi ko murr kar nahin dekhte the, aur Rasool tumhare peechhe se tumhein pukar rahe the, chunanche Allah ne tumhein (Rasool ko) ghum (dene) ke badle (shikast ka) ghum diya, taake aainda tum ziyada sadma na kiya karo, na us cheez par jo tumhare haath se jati rahe, aur na kisi aur museebat par jo tumhein pahunch jaye. Aur Allah tumhare tamam kaamon se poori tarah bakhabar hai.

Phir us ghum ke baad Allah ne tum par tmanint nazil ki, ek aongh jo tum mein se kuchh logon par chah rahi thi. Aur ek giroh woh tha jise apni janon ki pari hui thi, woh log Allah ke bare mein na-haqq aise gumaan kar rahe the jo jahalat ke khayalat the, woh keh rahe the : kya humein bhi koi ikhtiyar hasil hai ? Keh do ke : ikhtiyar to tamam tar Allah ka hai. Yeh log apne dilon mein woh baatein chupate hain jo aap ke samne zaahir nahin karte. Kehte hain ke agar humein bhi kuchh ikhtiyar hota to hum yahan qatal na hote. Keh do ke : agar tum apne gharon mein hote tab bhi jin ka qatal hona muqaddar mein lkha jachka tha woh khud bahar nikal kar apni apni qatal gaahon tak pahunch jate. Aur yeh sab us liye hua taake jo kuchh tumhare seeno mein hai Allah use aazmaye, aur jo kuchh tumhare dilon mein hai us ka mail kuchail door karde. Allah dilon ke bhed ko khoob jaanta hai.

Tum mein se jin logon ne us din pith pehri jab dono lashkar ek dusre se tkraie, dar-haqeeqat un ke baaz aemaal ke natije mein shetan ne un ko lagzish mein mubtila kardiya tha. Aur yaqeen rakho ke Allah ne unhein maaf kardiya hai. Yaqeenan Allah bohat maaf karne wala, bara burdbaar hai.

Ae iman walo ! Un logon ki tarah na hojana jinhon ne kufr ikhtiyar karliya hai, aur jab un ke bhai kisi sar-zameen mein safar karte hain ya jung mein shamil hote hain to yeh un ke bare mein kehte hain ke : agar woh humare paas hote to na marte, aur na maare jate. (un ki us baat ka) nateeja to (sirf) yeh hai ke Allah aisi baaton ko un ke dilon mein hasrat ka sabab bana deta hai, (wrna) zindagi aur maut to Allah deta hai. Aur jo amal bhi tum karte ho Allah use dekh raha hai.
Aur agar tum Allah ke raaste mein qatal hojao ya mrja, tab bhi Allah ki taraf se milne wali magfirat aur rehmat un cheezon se kahin behtar hai jo yeh log jama kar rahe hain.
Aur agar tum mrja ya qatal hojao to Allah hi ke paas to le jakr akthe kiye jao ge.

Un waqiyaat ke baad Allah ki rehmat hi thi jis ki bana par (ae payghumbar) tum ne un logon se narmi ka bartao kiya. Agar tum sakht mzaj aur sakht dil wale hote to yeh tumhare aas paas se hatt kar tatara batara hojate. Lihaza un ko maaf kardo, un ke liye magfirat ki dua karo, aur un se (eham) maamlaat mein mashwara lete raho. Phir jab tum raye pukhta kar ke kisi baat ka azam karlo to Allah par bharosa karo. Allah yaqeenan tawakkal karne walon se mohabbat karta hai.

Agar Allah tumhari madad kare to koi tum par ghalib aane wala nahin, aur agar woh tumhein tanha chhor de to kaun hai jo us ke baad tumhari madad kare ? Aur momino ko chahiye ke woh Allah hi par bharosa rakhen.

Aur kisi nabi se yeh nahin sakta ke woh maal ghanimat mein khayanat kare. Aur jo koi khayanat kare ga woh qayamat ke din woh cheez le kar aaye ga jo us ne khayanat kar ke li hogi, phir har shaks ko us ke kiye ka poora poora badla diya jaye ga, aur kisi par koi zulm nahin hoga.
Bhala jo shaks Allah ki khushnudi ka tabe ho woh us shaks ki tarah sakta hai jo Allah ki taraf se narazi le kar lota ho, aur jis ka thikana jahannam ho ? Aur woh bohat bura thikana hai.
Allah ke nazdeek un logon ke drjat mukhtalif hain, aur jo kuchh yeh karte hain Allah us ko khoob dekhta hai.

Haqeeqat yeh hai ke Allah ne momino par bara ehsan kiya ke un ke darmiyan unhi mein se ek Rasool bheja jo un ke samne Allah ki aayaton ki tilawat kare, unhein pak saaf banaye aur unhein kitab aur hikmat ki taleem de, jabke yeh log us se pehle yaqeenan khuli gumrahi mein mubtila the.

Jab tumhein ek aisi msibt pahunchi jis se dugni tum (dushman ko) pahuncha chuke the to kya tum aise mauqa par yeh kehte ho ke yeh museebat kahan se aagaee ? Keh do ke : yeh khud tumhari taraf se aayi hai. Be-shak Allah har cheez par qadir hai.
Aur tumhein jo museebat us din pahunchi jab dono lashkar tkraie the, woh Allah ke hukum se pahunchi, taake woh momino ko bhi parakah kar dekh le.

Aur munafiqeen ko bhi dekh le, aur un (munafiqon) se kaha gaya tha ke aao Allah ke raaste mein jung karo yaad fa karo, to unhon ne kaha tha ke : agar hum dekhte ke (jung ki tarah) jung hogi to hum zaroor aap ke peechhe chalte. Us din (jab woh yeh baat keh rahe the) woh iman ki beh nisbat kufr se ziyada qareeb the. Woh apne moonh se woh baat kehte hain jo un ke dilon mein nahin hoti aur jo kuchh yeh chupate hain Allah use khoob jaanta hai.

Yeh woh log hain jo apne (shaheed) bhaiyon ke bare mein bithe bithe yeh baatein banate hain ke agar woh hamari baat maante to qatal na hote, keh do ke : agar tum sache ho to khud apne aap hi se maut ko taal dena.
Aur (ae pighbr) jo log Allah ke raaste mein qatal hue hain, unhein hargiz murda na samajhna, bulke woh zinda hain, unhein apne rubb ke paas rizq milta hai.

Allah ne un ko apne fazal se jo kuchh diya hai woh us par magan hain, aur un ke peechhe jo log abhi un ke saath (shahadat mein) shamil nahin hue, un ke bare mein us baat par bhi khushi manate hain ke (jab woh un se aaker milen ge to) na un par koi khof hoga aur na woh ghumgeen hon ge.
Woh Allah ki niyamat aur fazal par bhi khushi manate hain aur us baat par bhi ke Allah momino ka ajar zaya nahin karta.
Woh log jinhon ne zakm khane ke baad bhi Allah aur Rasool ki pukar ka farmanbardari se jawab diya, aise nek aur muttaqi logon ke liye zabardast ajar hai.

Woh log jin se kehne walon ne kaha tha : yeh (makkah ke kafir) log tumhare (muqable) ke liye (phir se) jama hogaye hain, lihaza un se darte rehna, to us (khabar) ne un ke iman mein aur azafa kardiya aur woh bol utahe ke : humare liye Allah kafi hai aur woh behtareen kaarsaaz hai.
Nateeja yeh ke yeh log Allah ki niyamat aur fazal le kar us tarah wapas aaye ke unhein zara bhi gaznad nahin pahunchi, aur woh Allah ki khushnudi ke tabe rahe. Aur Allah fazal azeem ka maalik hai.
Dar-haqeeqat yeh to shetan hai jo apne doston se darata hai, lihaza agar tum momin ho to un se khof na kha, aur bas mera khof rakho.

Aur (ae payghumbar) jo log kufr mein ek dusre se barh kar tezi dkha rahe hain, woh tumhein sdme mein na dalen, yaqeen rakho woh Allah ka zara bhi nuksan nahin krskte, Allah yeh chahta hai ke aakhirat mein un koi hissa na rkhe, aur un ke liye zabardast azab (tayyar) hai.
Jin logon ne iman ke badle kufr ko mol le liya hai woh Allah ko hargiz zara bhi nuksan nahin pahuncha sakte, aur un ke liye ek dakaha dene wala azab (tayyar hai.)

Aur jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai woh hargiz yeh na samjhen ke hum unhein jo dheel de rahe hain taake woh gunaah mein aur aage barh jayen aur (aakhir kaar) un ke liye aisa azab hoga jo unhein zaleel kar ke rakaha de ga.

Allah aisa nahin krskta ke momino ko us halat par chhor rkhe jis par tum log us waqt ho, jab tak woh napaak ko pak se alag na karde, aur (dusri taraf) woh aisa bhi nahin krskta ke tum ko (braa raast) gaib ki baatein btade. Haan woh (jitna batana munasib samajhta hai us ke liye) apne payghumbaron mein se jis ko chahta hai chun leta hai. Lihaza tum Allah aur us ke rasoolon par iman rakho, aur agar iman rakho ge aur taqwa ikhtiyar karo ge to zabardast sawab ke mustahiq hoge.

Aur jo log us (maal) mein bukhl se kaam lete hain jo unhein Allah ne apne fazal se ata farmaya hai woh hargiz yeh na samjhen ke yeh un ke liye koi achhi baat hai, us ke baraks yeh un ke haqq mein bohat buri baat hai, jis maal mein unhon ne bukhl se kaam liya hoga, qayamat ke din woh un ke gale ka toq banadiya jaye ga. Aur sare aasman aur zameen ki miras sirf Allah hi ke liye hai, aur jo amal bhi tum karte ho Allah us se poori tarah bakhabar hai.

Allah ne un logon ki baat sunn li hai jo yeh kehte hain ke : Allah fakeer hai aur hum maal daar hain. Hum un ki yeh baat bhi (un ke aemaal name mein) lkhe lete hain, aur unhon ne anbiya ko jo na-haqq qatal kiya hai, us ko bhi, aur (phir) kahin ge ke : dehakti aag ka mza chkho.
Yeh sab tumhare haathon ke kartoot ka nateeja hai jo tum ne aage bhej rakhha tha, wrna Allah bandon par zulm karne wala nahin hai.

Yeh woh log hain jo kehte hain ke : Allah ne hum se yeh wada liya hai ke kisi payghumbar par us waqt tak iman na layein jab tak woh humare paas aisi qurbani le kar na aaye jise aag khajaie. Tum kaho ke : mujh se pehle tumhare paas bohat se payghumbar khuli nishaniyan bhi le kar aaye aur woh cheez bhi jis ke bare mein tum ne (mujh se) kaha hai. Phir tum ne unhein kyun qatal kya agar tum waqayi sache ho ?

(ae payghumbar) agar phir bhi yeh log tumhein jhutlayen to (yeh koi naee baat nahin) tum se pehle bhi bohat se un rasoolon ko jhutlaya jachka hai jo khuli khuli nishaniyan bhi laye the, lkhe hue saheefe bhi aur aisi kitab bhi jo (haqq ko) roshan kardene wali thi.

Har jaandaar ko maut ka mza chakhna hai, aur tum sab ko (tumhare aemaal ke) poore poore badle qayamat hi ke din milen ge. Phir jis kisi ko dozakh se door htalia gaya aur jannat mein dakhil kardiya gaya woh sahih maani mein kaamyaab hogaya, aur yeh dunyawi zindagi to (jannat ke muqable mein) dhoke ke samaan ke siwa kuchh bhi nahin.

(musalmano) tumhein apne maal o daulat aur janon ke maamle mein (aur) aazmaya jaye ga, aur tum ehle kitab aur mushrikeen dono se bohat si takleef da baatein suno ge. Aur agar tum ne sabar aur taqwa se kaam liya to yaqeenan yehi kaam bari himmat ke hain (jo tumhein ikhtiyar karne hain)

Aur (un logon ko woh waqt na bholna chahiye) jab Allah ne ehle kitab se yeh ahad liya tha ke : tum us kitab ko logon ke samne zaroor khol khol kar biyan karo ge, aur us ko chhpa ge nahin. Phir unhon ne us ahad ko pus pusht daal diya aur us ke badle thori se keemat hasil karli, us tarah kitni buri hai woh cheez jo yeh mol le rahe hain.

Yeh hargiz na samajhna ke jo log apne kiye par bare khush hain, aur chahte hain ke un ki tareef un kaamon par bhi ki jaye jo unhon ne kiye hi nahin, aise logon ke bare mein hargiz yeh na samajhna ke woh azab se bachne mein kaamyaab hojayen ge. Un ke liye dardnaak saza (tayyar) hai.
Aur aasmanon aur zameen ki sultanat sirf Allah ki hai, aur Allah har cheez par mukammal qudrat rakhta hai.
Be-shak aasmanon aur zameen ki takhleeq mein aur raat din ke bare bare aane jane mein un aqal walon ke liye bari nishaniyan hain.

Jo athte bithte aur lete hue (har haal mein) Allah ko yaad karte hain, aur aasmanon aur zameen ki takhleeq par gaur karte hain, (aur unhein dekh kar bol athte hain ke) ae humare Parwardigar ! Aap ne yeh sab kuchh bemqsd paida nahin kiya. Aap (aise fizool kaam se) pak hain, pus humein dozakh ke azab se bacha lijiye.
Ae humare rubb ! Aap jis kisi ko dozakh mein dakhil karden, use aap ne yaqeenan ruswa hi kardiya, aur zalimon ko kisi qasam ke madadgar naseeb na hon ge.

Ae humare Parwardigar ! Hum ne ek munadi ko suna jo iman ki taraf pukar raha tha ke apne Parwardigar par iman lao, chunanche hum iman le aaye. Lihaza ae humare Parwardigar ! Hamari khatir humare gunaah baksh dijiye, hamari buraiyon ko hum se mita dijiye, aur humein nek logon mein shamil kar ke apne paas bulaiye.

Aur ae humare Parwardigar ! Humein woh kuchh bhi ata frmaiie jis ka wada aap ne apne payghumbaron ke zariye hum se kiya hai, aur humein qayamat ke din ruswa na kijiye. Yaqeenan aap wade ki kabhi khilaf warzi nahin kiya karte.

Chunanche un ke Parwardigar ne un ki dua qabool ki (aur kaha) ke : mein tum mein se kisi ka amal zaya nahin karoon ga, khwah woh mard ho ya aurat. Tum sab aapas mein ek jaise ho. Lihaza jin logon ne hijrat ki, aur unhein un ke gharon se nikala gaya, aur mere raaste mein takleef di gaeen, aur jinhon ne (deen ki khatir) laraee lari aur qatal hue, mein un sab ki buraiyon ka zaroor kaffara kardoon ga, aur unhein zaroor bil-zaroor aise baghaat mein dakhil karoon ga jin ke niche nehrein behti hon gi. Yeh sab kuchh Allah ki taraf se inam hoga, aur Allah hi hai jis ke paas behtareen inam hai.
Jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai un ka shehron mein (khushali ke saath) chalna phrna tumhein hargiz dhoke mein na dale.
(yeh to thora sa mza hai jo yeh ura rahe hain) phir un ka thikana jahannam hai, aur woh badhtareen bichona hai.

Lekin jo log apne Parwardigar se darte hue amal karte hain, un ke liye aise baghaat hain jin ke niche nehrein behti hain, Allah ki taraf se mezbani ke tor par woh hamesha un mein rahen ge. Aur jo kuchh Allah ke paas hai woh woh nek logon ke liye kahin behtar hai.

Aur be-shak ehle kitab mein bhi aise log maujood hain jo Allah ke aage ijz o niyaz ka mzahra karte hue Allah par bhi iman rakhte hain, us kitab par bhi jo tum par nazil ki gayi hai aur us par bhi jo un par nazil ki gayi thi, aur Allah ki aayaton ko thori si keemat le kar bech nahin daalte. Yeh woh log hain jo apne Parwardigar ke paas apne ajar ke mustahiq hain. Be-shak Allah hisab jald chukane wala hai.
Ae iman walo ! Sabar ikhtiyar karo, muqable ke waqt saabit qadami dkha, aur sarhadon ki hifazat ke liye jame raho. Aur Allah se darte raho, taake tumhein falaah naseeb ho.

Ae logo ! Apne Parwardigar se daro jis ne tumhein ek jaan se paida kiya, aur usi se us ki biwi paida ki, aur un dono se bohat se mard aur aurten (duniya mein) pehla diye. Aur Allah se daro jis ka wasta de kar tum ek dusre se apne huqooq maangte ho, aur rishta darion (ki haqq talafi se) daro. Yaqeen rakho ke Allah tumhari nigrani krrha hai.
Aur yateemon ko un ke maal de do , aur achhe maal ko kharab maal se tabdeel na karo, aur un (yateemon) ka maal apne maal ke saath mila kar mat kha, be-shak yeh bara gunaah hai.

Aur agar tumhein yeh andesha ho ke tum yateemon ke bare mein insaf se kaam nahin le sako ge to (un se nikah karne ke bajaye) dusri aurton mein se kisi se nikah karlo jo tumhein pasand aayein do do se, teen teen se, aur char char se, haan ! Agar tumhein yeh khatra ho ke tum (un biwiyon) ke darmiyan insaf na krsko ge to phir ek hi biwi par aktfa karo, ya un kaneezon par jo tumhari milkiyat mein hain. Us tareeqe mein us baat ka ziyada imkan hai ke tum beyinsafi mein mubtila nahin hoge.
Aur aurton ko un ke mehar khushi se d ya karo. Haan ! Agar woh khud us ka kuchh hissa khush dili se chhor den to use khoshgoari aur maze se khalo.
Aur na-samajh (yateemon) ko apne woh maal hawale na karo jin ko Allah ne tumhare liye zindagi ka sarmaya banaya hai, haan un ko un mein se khla aur pehnao aur un se munasib andaz mein baat karlo.

Aur yateemon ko janchte raho, yahan tak ke jab woh nikah ke layaq umar ko pahunch jayen, to agar tum yeh mehsoos karo ke un mein samajh daari chuki hai to un ke maal unhi ke hawale kardo. Aur yeh maal fizool kharchi kar ke aur yeh soch kar jaldi jaldi na kha bitho ke woh kahin bare na hojayen. Aur (yateemon ke sarparaston mein se) jo khud maal daar ho woh to apne aap ko (yateem ka maal khane se) bilkul pak rkhe, haan agar woh khud mohtaj ho to maroof tareeq kaar ko malhooz rakhte hue khale. Phir jab tum un ke maal unhein do to un par gawah bana lo, aur Allah hisab lene ke liye kafi hai.

Mardon ke liye bhi us maal mein hissa hai jo walidain aur qareeb tareen rishta daron ne chhora ho, aur aurton ke liye bhi us maal mein hissa hai jo walidain aur qareeb tareen rishta daron ne chhora ho, chahaye woh (tarke) thora ho ya ziyada, yeh hissa (Allah ki taraf se) muqarrar hai.
Aur jab (miras ki) taqseem ke waqt (ghair waris) rishta daar, yateem aur miskeen log aajayen, to un ko bhi us mein se kuchh de do , aur un se munasib andaz mein baat karo.

Aur woh log (yateemon ke maal mein khird burd karne se) darein jo agar apne peechhe kamzor bache chhor kar jayen to un ki taraf se fikr mand rahen ge. Lihaza woh Allah se darein aur seedhi seedhi baat kaha karen.
Yaqeen rakho ke jo log yateemon ka maal na-haqq kahate hain, woh apne pait mein aag bhar rahe hain, aur unhein jald hi ek dehakti aag mein dakhil hona hoga.

Allah tumhari aulad ke bare mein tum ko hukum deta hai ke : mard ka hissa do aurton ke barabar hai. Aur agar (sirf) aurten hi hon, do ya do se ziyada, to marne wale ne jo kuchh chhora ho, unhein us ka do tihayi hissa mile ga. Aur agar sirf ek aurat ho to use (tarke ka) aadha hissa mile ga. Aur marne wale ke walidain mein se har ek ko tarke ka chhta hissa mile ga, ba-shart-e-ke marne wale ki koi aulad ho, aur agar us ki koi aulad na ho aur us ke walidain hi us ke waris hon to us ki man tihayi hisse ki haqq daar hai. Haan agar us ke kaee bhai hon to us ki man ko chhta hissa diya jaye ga (aur yeh saari taqseem) us wasiyat par amal karne ke baad hogi jo marne wale ne ki ho, ya agar us ke zimme koi qarz hai to us ki adaayegi ke baad tumhein us baat ka theek theek ilm nahin hai ke tumhare baap beton mein se kaun faida pahunchane ke lihaz se tum se ziyada qareeb hai ? Yeh to Allah ke muqarrar kiye hue hisse hain, yaqeen rakho ke Allah ilm ka bhi maalik hai, hikmat ka bhi maalik.

Aur tumhari biwiyan jo kuchh chhor kar jayen, us ka aadha hissa tumhara hai, ba-shart-e-ke un ki koi aulad (zinda) na ho. Aur agar un ki koi aulad ho to us wasiyat par amal karne ke baad jo unhon ne ki ho, aur un ke qarz ki adaayegi ke baad tumhein un ke tarke ka chothaii hissa mile ga. Aur tum jo kuchh chhor kar jao us ka ek chothaii un (biwiyon) ka hai, ba-shart-e-ke tumhari koi aulad (zinda) na ho. Aur agar tumhari koi aulad ho to us wasiyat par amal karne ke baad jo tum ne ki ho, aur tumhare qarz ki adaayegi ke baad un ko tumhare tarke ka aathoan hissa mile ga. Aur agar woh mard ya aurat jis ki miras taqseem honi hai, aisa ho ke na us ke walidain zinda hon, na aulad, aur us ka ek bhai ya ek behan zinda ho to un mein se har ek chhte hisse ka haqq daar hai. Aur agar woh us se ziyada hon to woh sab ek tihayi mein shareek hon ge, (magar) jo wasiyat ki gayi ho us par amal karne ke baad aur marne wale ke zimme jo qarz ho us ki adaayegi ke baad, ba-shart-e-ke (wasiyat ya qarz ke iqrar karne se) us ne kisi ko nuksan na pahunchaya ho. Yeh sab kuchh Allah ka hukum hai, aur Allah har baat ka ilm rakhne wala, burdbaar hai.

Yeh Allah ki muqarrar ki hui hudood hain, aur jo shaks Allah aur us ke Rasool ki itaat kare ga, woh us ko aise baghaat mein dakhil kare ga jin ke niche nehrein behti hon gi, aise log hamesha un (baghaat) mein rahen ge, aur yeh zabardast kamiyabi hai.

Aur jo shaks Allah aur us ke Rasool ki nafarmani kare ga aur us ki muqarrar ki hui hudood se tajawuz kare ga, use Allah dozakh mein dakhil kare ga jis mein woh hamesha rahe ga, aur us ko aisa azab hoga jo zaleel kar ke rakaha de ga.

Tumhari aurton mein se jo bad-kaari ka irteqab karen, un par apne mein se char gawah bana lo. Chunanche agar woh (un ki bad-kaari ki) gawahi den to un aurton ko gharon mein rok kar rakho yahan tak ke unhein maut atha karle jaye, ya Allah un ke liye koi aur raasta paida karde.

Aur tum mein se jo do mard bad-kaari ka irteqab karen, un ko aziyat do . Phir agar woh toubah kar ke apni islaah karlen to un se darguzar karo. Be-shak Allah bohat toubah qabool karne wala, bara meharban hai.

Allah ne toubah qabool karne ki jo zma daari li hai woh un logon ke liye jo nadaani se koi buraee kar daalte hain, phir jaldi hi toubah krlite hain. Chunanche Allah un ki toubah qabool krlita hai, aur Allah har baat ko khoob janne wala bhi hai, hikmat wala bhi.

To beh ki qabooliyat un ke liye nahin jo bure kaam kiye jate hain, yahan tak ke jab un mein se kisi par maut ka waqt aakhra hota hai to woh kehta hai ke mein ne ab toubah karli hai, aur na un ke liye hai jo kufr hi ki halat mein mrjate hain. Aise logon ke liye to hum ne dakaha dene wala azab tayyar kar rakhha hai.

Ae iman walo ! Yeh baat tumhare liye halal nahin hai ke tum zabardasti aurton ke maalik bann bitho, aur un ko us garz se mqid mat karo ke tum ne jo kuchh un ko diya hai us ka kuchh hissa le aro, illa yeh ke woh khuli behiaii ka irteqab karen, aur un ke saath bhale andaz mein zindagi basar karo, aur agar tum unhein pasand na karte ho to yeh ain mumkin hai ke tum kisi cheez ko pasand karte ho aur Allah ne us mein bohat kuchh bhalayi rakaha di ho.

Aur agar tum ek biwi ke badle dusri biwi se nikah karna chahte ho aur un mein se ek ko dhair sara mehar de chuke ho, to us mein se kuchh wapas na lo. Kya tum bohatan laga kar aur khla gunaah kar ke (mehar) wals lo ge ?
Aur aakhir tum kaise (woh mehar) wapas le sakte ho jabke tum ek dusre ke itne qareeb hochke the aur unhon ne tum se bara bhari ahad liya tha ?

Aur jin aurton se tumhare baap dada (kisi waqt) nikah krchke hon, tum unhein nikah mein na lao, albatta pehle jo kuchh hochka woh hochka. Yeh bari behiaii hai, ghnana amal hai, aur beraa rawi ki baat hai.

Tum par haram kardi gayi hain tumhari maayen, tumhari betiyan, tumhari behnein, tumhari phophian, tumhari khalayein, aur bhatijiyan aur bhanjiyan, aur tumhari woh maayen jinhon ne tumhein doodh pilaya hai, aur tumhari doodh shareek behnein, aur tumhari biwiyon ki maayen, aur tumhare zere perwerish tumhari sotili betiyan jo tumhari un biwiyon (ke pait) se hon jin ke saath tum ne khilwat ki ho. Haan agar tum ne un ke saath khilwat na ki ho (aur unhein talaq de di ho ya un ka intiqal hogaya ho) to tum par (un ki larkiyon se nikah karne mein) koi gunaah nahin hai, neiz tumhare salbi beton ki biwiyan bhi tum par haram hain, aur yeh baat bhi haram hai ke tum do behno ko ek saath nikah mein jama karo, albatta jo kuchh pehle hochka woh hochka. Be-shak Allah bohat maaf karne wala, bara meharban hai.

Neiz woh aurten (tum par haram hain) jo dusre shoharon ke nikah mein hon, albatta jo knizin tumhari milkiyat mein aajayen (woh mstsni hain) Allah ne yeh ehkaam tum par farz kardiye hain. Un aurton ko chhor kar tamam aurton ke bare mein yeh halal kardiya gaya hai ke tum apna maal (bator mehar) kharch kar ke unhein (apne nikah mein lana) chaho, ba-shart-e-ke tum un se baqada nikah ka rishta qayam kar ke fata hasil karo, sirf shehwat nikalna maqsood na ho. Chunanche jin aurton se (nikah kar ke) tum ne lutf utahaya ho, un ko un ka woh mehar ada karo jo muqarrar kiya gaya ho. Albatta mehar muqarrar karne ke baad bhi jis (kami beshi) par tum aapas mein razi hojao, us mein tum par koi gunaah nahin. Yaqeen rakho ke Allah har baat ka ilm bhi rakhta hai, hikmat ka bhi maalik hai.

Aur tum mein se jo log us baat ki taqat na rakhte hon ke aazad musalman aurton se nikah krskin, to woh un musalman kaneezon mein se kisi se nikah kar sakat hain jo tumhari milkiyat mein hon, aur Allah ko tumhare iman ki poori halat khoob maloom hai.
