Haqeeqat yeh hai ke Allah logon par zara bhi zulm nahin karta, lekin insan hain jo khud apni janon par zulm karte hain.

Aur jis din Allah un ko (maidan hashar mein) aktha kare ga, to unhein aisa maloom hoga jaise woh (duniya mein ya qabar mein) din ki ek ghri se ziyada nahin rahe, (usi liye) woh aapas mein ek dusre ko pehchante hon ge. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke un logon ne bare ghate ka sauda kiya hai jinhon ne Allah se (aakhirat mein) jamlne ko jhutlaya hai aur jo raah raast par nahin aaye.

Aur (ae payghumbar) jin baaton ki hum ne un (kafiron ko) dhamki di hui hai, chahaye un mein se koi baat hum tumhein (tumhari zindagi mein) dkha den, ya (us se pehle) tumhari rooh qabz karlen, bhrsort un ko aakhir mein hamari taraf hi lotna hai, phir (yeh to zaahir hi hai ke) jo kuchh yeh karte hain, Allah us ka poora poora mushahida kar raha hai. (lihaza wahan un ko saza de ga)
Aur har ummat ke liye ek Rasool bheja gaya hai, phir jab un ka Rasool aajata hai to un ka faisla poore insaf se kiya jata hai, aur un par zulm nahin kiya jata.
Aur yeh (kafir) log (musalmanon se mazaq urane ke liye) kehte hain ke : agar tum sache ho to (Allah ki taraf se azab ka) yeh wada kab poora hoga ?

(ae payghumbar ! Un se) keh do ke : mein to khud apni zaat ko bhi koi nuksan pahunchane ka ikhtiyar rakhta hon, na faida pahunchane ka, magar jitna Allah chahaye. Har ummat ka ek waqt muqarrar hai, chunanche jab un ka woh waqt aajata hai to woh us se na ek ghri peechhe sakte hain na aage sakte hain.

Un se kaho ke : zara mujhe yeh batao ke agar Allah ka azab tum par raat ke waqt aaye ya din ke waqt to us mein kaun si aisi (ashtiaq ke qabil) cheez hai jis ke jald aane ka yeh mujrim log mutalaba kar rahe hain ?
Kya jab woh azab hi pare ga, tab use mano ge ? (us waqt to tum se yeh kaha jaye ga ke) ab maane ? Halaanke tum hi (us ka inkar kar ke) us ki jaldi machaya karte the.
Phir zalimon se kaha jaye ga ke : ab hamesha ke azab ka mza chkho, tumhein kisi aur cheez ka nahin, sirf us (badi) ka badla diya jaraha hai jo tum kamate rahe ho.
Aur yeh log tum se puchte hain ke kya yeh (aakhirat ka azab) waqayi sach hai ? Kaho do ke : mere Parwardigar ki qasam yeh bilkul sach hai, aur tum (Allah ko) aajiz nahin krskte.

Aur jis jis shaks ne zulm ka irteqab kiya hai, agar us ke paas aur zameen ki saari daulat bhi hogi to woh apni jaan churane ke liye us ki peshkash karde ga, aur jab woh azab ko aankhon se dekh len ge to apni shrmndgi ko chhpana chahein ge, aur un ka faisla insaf ke saath hoga, aur un par zulm nahin hoga.
Yaad rakho ke aasmanon aur zameen mein jo kuchh hai Allah hi ka hai. Ya drkho ke Allah ka wada sacha hai, lekin aksar log nahin jante.
Wahi zinda karta hai aur wahi maut deta hai, aur usi ke paas tum sab ko lotaya jaye ga.
Logo tumhare paas ek aisi cheez aayi hai jo tumhare Parwardigar ki taraf se ek naseehat hai, aur dilon ki bimarion ke liye shifa hai, aur iman walon ke liye hidayat aur rehmat ka samaan hai.

(ae payghumbar) kaho ke : yeh sab kuchh Allah ke fazal aur rehmat se hua hai, lihaza usi par to unhein khush hona chahiye, yeh us tamam daulat se kahin behtar hai jise yeh jama kar kar ke rakhte hain.

Kaho ke : bhala batao Allah ne tumhare liye jo rizq nazil kya tha, tum ne apni taraf se us mein se kisi ko haram aur kisi ko halal qarar de diya, un se pochho ke : kya Allah ne tumhein us ki ijazat di thi ya tum Allah par jhoota bohatan bandhte ho ?

Aur jo log Allah par bohatan bandhte hain roz qayamat ke bare mein un ka kya gumaan hai ? Us mein shakk nahin ke Allah insano ke saath fazal ka mamla karne wala hai, lekin un mein se aksar log shukar ada nahin karte.

Aur (ae payghumbar) tum jis halat mein bhi hote ho aur quran ka jo hissa bhi tilawat karte ho aur (ae logo) tum jo kaam bhi karte ho, to jis waqt tum us kaam mein mashgul hote ho hum tumhein dekhte rehte hain aur tumhare rubb se koi zra barabar cheez bhi posheeda nahin hai, na zameen mein na aasman mein, na us se chhoti, na bari, magar woh ek wazeh kitab mein darj hai.
Ya drkho ke jo Allah ke dost hain un ko na koi khof hoga na woh ghumgeen hon.
Yeh woh log hain jo iman laye, aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiye rahe.
Un ke liye khushkhabri hai dunyawi zindagi mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi, Allah ki baaton mein koi tabdili nahin hoti, yehi zabardast kamiyabi hai.
Aur (ae payghumbar) yeh log jo baatein banate hain woh tumhein ranjeeda na karen, yaqeen rakho ke iqtedar tamam tar Allah ka hai, aur woh har baat sunne wala, sab kuchh janne wala hai.

Yaad rakho ke aasmanon aur zameen mein jitne jaan daar hain woh sab Allah hi ki milkiyat mein hain aur jo log Allah ke siwa dusron ko pukarte hain woh koi Allah ke (haqeeqi) shrka ki pairwi nahin karte, woh kisi aur cheez ki nahin, mehaz gumaan ki pairwi karte hain aur un ka kaam us ke siwa kuchh nahin ke andazon ke teer chalate rahen.

Allah woh hai jis ne tumhare liye raat banaee, taake tum us mein sukoon hasil karo, aur din ko aisa banaya jo tumhein dekhne ki salahiyat de, us mein yaqeenan un logon ke liye nishaniyan hain jo gaur se sunte hon.

(kuchh) logon ne keh diya ke Allah aulad rakhta hai, pak hai us ki zaat, woh har cheez se bey-niaz hai. Aasmanon aur zameen mein jo kuchh hai usi ka hai. Tumhare paas us baat ki zara bhi koi daleel nahin hai, kya tum Allah ke zimme woh baat lagate ho jis ka tumhein koi ilm nahin ?
Keh do ke : jo log Allah par jhoota bohatan bandhte hain woh falaah nahin payen ge.
(un ke liye) bas duniya mein thora sa mza hai, phir humare paas hi unhein lot kar aana hai, phir kufr ka jo roia unhon ne apna rakhha tha, us ke badle hum unhein shadeed azab ka mza chakhayen ge.

Aur (ae payghumbar) un ke samne nooh ka waqa parh kar sunao, jab unhon ne apni qaum se kaha tha ke : meri qaum ke logo ! Agar tumhare darmiyan mera rehna, aur Allah ki aayat ke zariye khabardar karna tumhein bhari maloom horha hai to mein ne to Allah hi par bharosa kar rakhha hai, ab tum apne shareekon ko saath mila kar (mere khilaf) apni tadbeeron ko khoob pukhta karlo, phir jo tadbeer tum karo woh tumhare dil mein kisi ghuttan ka baais na bane, bulke mere khilaf jo faisla tum ne kiya ho, use (dil khol kar) kar guzro, aur mujhe zara mohlat na do .

Phir bhi agar tum ne moonh more rakhha to mein ne tum se us (tableeg) par koi ujrat to nahin maangi mera ajar kisi aur ne nahin, Allah ne zimme liya hai, aur mujhe yeh hukum diya gaya hai ke mein farmanbardar logon mein shamil rahoon.

Phir hua yeh ke un logon ne nooh ko jhutlaya aur nateeja yeh hua ke hum ne nooh ko aur jo log un ke saath kashti mein the unhein bacha liya, aur un ko kafiron ki jagah zameen mein basaya, aur jin logon ne hamari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya tha, unhein (toofaan mein) garq kardiya. Ab dekho ke jin logon ko khabardar kya gaya tha un ka anjaam kaisa hua ?

Us ke baad hum ne mukhtalif payghumbar un ki apni apni qaumon ke paas bheje, woh un ke paas khle khle dalail le kar aaye, lekin un logon ne jis baat ko pehli baar jhutlaya diya tha use maan kar hi na diya. Jo log hadd se guzar jate hain un ke dilon par hum usi tarah mehar laga dete hain.
Us ke baad hum ne musa aur haroon ko Firaun aur us ke sardaron ke paas apni nishaniyan de kar bheja, to unhon ne takabbur ka mamla kiya, aur woh mujrim log the.
Chunanche jab un ke paas hamari taraf se haqq ka paygham aaya to woh kehne lage ke zaroor yeh khla hua jadoo hai.
Musa ne kaha : kya tum haqq ke bare mein aisi baat keh rahe ho jabke woh tumhare paas chuka hai ? Bhala kya yeh jadoo hai ? Halaanke jadoo gir falaah nahin paya karte.

Kehne lage : kya tum humare paas us liye aaye ho ke jis tor tareeqe par hum ne apne baap dadon ko paya hai us se humein bargashta kardo, aur us sar-zameen mein tum dono ki chodhraht qayam hojaye ? Hum to tum dono ki baat maanne wale nahin hain.
Aur Firaun ne (apne mulazimon se) kaha ke : jitne maahir jadoogar hain un sab ko mere paas le kar aao.
Chunanche jab jadoogar aagaye to musa ne un se kaha : phinko jo kuchh tumhein phinkna hai.

Phir jab unhon ne (apni lathion aur rsion ko) phinka (aur woh saanp bann kar chalti hui nazar aayein) to musa ne kaha ke : yeh jo kuchh tum ne dkhaia hai jadoo hai. Allah abhi us ko mill ya mait kiye deta hai. Allah fasadiyon ka kaam banne nahin deta.
Aur Allah sach ko apne hukum se sach kar dikhata hai, chahaye mujrim log kitna bura samjhen.

Phir hua yeh ke musa par koi aur nahin, lekin khud us ki qaum ke kuchh no-jawan Firaun aur apne sardaron se darte darte iman laye ke kahin Firaun unhein na sataye. Aur yaqeenan Firaun zameen mein bara zoar aawar tha, aur woh un logon mein se tha jo kisi hadd par qayam nahin rehte.
Aur musa ne kaha : ae meri qaum agar tum waqayi Allah par iman le aaye ho to phir usi par bharosa rakho, agar tum farmanbardar ho.
Us par unhon ne kaha : Allah hi par hum ne bharosa karliya hai, ae humare Parwardigar humein un zalim logon ke haathon aazmaish mein na daliye.
Aur apni rehmat se humein kafir qaum se nijat de dijiye.

Aur hum ne musa aur un ke bhai par wahee bheji ke : tum dono apni qaum ko misr hi ke gharon mein basao, aur apne gharon ko namaz ki jagah bana lo. Aur (us tarah) namaz qayam karo aur iman lane walon ko khushkhabri de do .

Aur musa ne kaha : ae humare Parwardigar ! Aap ne Firaun aur us ke sardaron ko dunyawi zindagi mein bari saja dahaja aur maal o daulat bakshi hai, ae humare Parwardigar ! Un ke maal o daulat ko tehas nehas krdijie, aur un ke dilon ko itna sakht krdijie ke woh us waqt tak iman na layein jab tak dardnaak azab aankhon se na dekh len.
Allah ne farmaya : tumhari dua qabool karli gayi hai. Ab tum dono saabit qadam raho, waar un logon ke peechhe hargiz na chalna jo haqeeqat se nawaqif hain.

Aur hum ne bano israel ko samandar paar kradia, to Firaun aur us ke lashkar ne bhi zulm aur zyadati ki niyat se un ka pichha kiya, yahan tak ke jab doobne ka anjaam us ke sar par aaphncha to kehne laga : mein maan gaya ke jis khuda par bano israel iman laye hain us ke siwa koi mabood nahin, aur mein bhi frmanbrdaron mein shamil hota hon.
(jawab diya gaya ke) ab iman laata hai ? Halaanke us se pehle nafarmani karta raha, aur musalsal fasaad hi mchata raha.
Lihaza aaj hum tere (sirf) jism ko bachayenge taake to apne baad ke logon ke liye ibrat ka nishan bann jaye. (kyunke) bohat se log hamari nishaniyon se ghafil bane hue hain.

Aur hum ne bano israel ko aisi jagah basaya jo sahih maani mein basne ke layaq jagah thi, aur un ko pakeeza cheezon ka rizq baksha. Phir unhon ne (deen haqq ke bare mein) us waqt tak ikhtilaf nahin kiya jab tak un ke paas ilm nahin aagaya. Yaqeen rakho ke jin baaton mein woh ikhtilaf kiya karte the, un ka faisla tumhara Parwardigar qayamat ke din kare ga.

Phir (ae payghumbar) agar (bil-farz muhaal) tumhein us kalaam mein zara bhi shakk ho jo hum ne tum par nazil kiya hai to un logon se pochho jo tum se pehle se (aasmani) kitab parhte hain. Yaqeen rakho ke tumhare paas tumhare Parwardigar ki taraf se haqq hi aaya hai. Lihaza tum kabhi bhi shakk karne walon mein shamil na hona.
Neiz kabhi hargiz un logon mein shamil na hona, jinhon ne Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaya hai, wrna tum un logon mein shamil hojao ge jinhon ne ghate ka sauda karliya hai.
Be-shak jin logon ke bare mein tumhare rubb ki baat tai hochuki hai woh iman nahin layein ge.
Chahaye har qasam ki nishani un ke samne aajaye, yahan tak ke woh dardnaak azab aankhon se na dekh len.

Bhala koi basti aisi kyun na hui ke aise waqt iman le aati ke us ka iman use faida pahuncha sakta ? Albatta sirf younus ki qaum ke log aise the. Jab woh iman le aaye to hum ne dunyawi zindagi mein ruswayi ka azab un se atha liya, aur un ko ek muddat tak zindagi ka lutf athane diya.
Aur agar Allah chahta to aur zameen par basne wale sab ke sab iman le aate to kya tum logon par zabardasti karo ge taake woh sab momin bann jayen ?
Aur kisi bhi shaks ke liye yeh mumkin nahin hai ke woh Allah ki ijazat ke baghair momin bann jaye, aur jo log aqal se kaam nahin lete, Allah un par gandagi musallat kardyta hai.

(ae payghumbar) un se kaho ke : zara nazar dora ke aasmanon aur zameen kya kya cheezen hain ? Lekin jin logon ko iman lana hi nahin hai un ke liye (zameen o aasman mein phili hui) nishaniyan aur aagaah karne wale (payghumbar) kuchh bhi kaar aamad nahin hote.

Bhala batao ke yeh log (iman lane ke liye) us ke siwa kis baat ka intezar kar rahe hain ke us tarah ke din yeh bhi dekhen jaise un se pehle ke logon ne dikhe the ? Keh do ke : achha tum intezar karo, mein bhi tumhare saath muntazir hon.

Phir (jab azab aata hai to) hum apne payghumbaron ko aur jo log iman le aate hain un ko nijat de dete hain, usi tarah hum ne yeh baat apne zimme le rkhi hai ke hum tamam (dusre) momino ko bhi nijat den.

(ae payghumbar) un se kaho ke : ae logo agar tum mere deen ke bare mein kisi shakk mein mubtila ho to (sunn lo ke) tum Allah ke siwa jin jin ki ibadat karte ho mein un ki ibadat nahin karta, bulke mein us Allah ki ibadat karta hon jo tumhari rooh qabz karta hai. Aur mujhe yeh hukum diya gaya hai ke mein momino mein shamil rahoon.
Aur (mujh se) yeh (kaha gaya hai) ke : apna rukh yaksui ke saath us deen ki taraf qayam rakhna, aur hargiz un logon mein shamil na hona jo Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek maante hain.

Aur Allah taalaa ko chhor kar kisi aise (mann gharat mabood) ko na pukarna jo tumhein na koi faida pahuncha sakta hai, na koi nuksan. Phir bhi agar tum (bafaraz muhaal) aisa kar bithe to tumhara shumar bhi zalimon mein hoga.

Aur agar tumhein Allah koi takleef pahuncha de to us ke siwa koi nahin hai jo use door karde, aur agar woh tumhein koi bhalayi pahunchane ka arada karle to koi nahin hai jo us ke fazal ka rukh phir de. Woh apna fazal apne bandon mein se jis ko chahta hai pahuncha deta hai, aur woh bohat bakhshne wala bara meharban hai.

(ae payghumbar) keh do ke : logo tumhare Parwardigar ki taraf se tumhare paas haqq aagaya hai, ab jo shaks hidayat ka raasta apnaie ga woh khud apne faiyde ke liye apnaie ga, aur jo gumrahi ikhtiyar kare ga, us ki gumrahi ka nuksan khud usi ko pahunche ga, aur mein tumhare kaamon ka zma daar nahin hon.
Aur jo wahee tumhare paas bheji jarhi hai, tum us ki ittabaa karo, aur sabar se kaam lo, yahan tak ke Allah koi faisla karde. Aur woh behtareen faisla karne wala hai.
Alif Laam Raa
(yeh kitab payghumbar ko hukum deti hai ke woh logon se yeh kahin) ke Allah ke siwa kisi ki ibadat na karo, mein us ki taraf se tumhein aagaah karne wala aur khushkhabri sunane wala hon.

Aur yeh (hidayat deta) ke : apne Parwardigar se gunahon ki maafi maango, phir us ki taraf rujoo karo. Woh tumhein ek muqarrar waqt tak (zindagi se) achha lutf athane ka mauqa de ga, aur har us shaks ko jis ne ziyada amal kiya hoga, apni taraf se ziyada ajar de ga. Aur agar tum ne moonh mora to mujhe tum par ek bare din ke azab ka andesha hai.
Allah hi ke paas tumhein lot kar jana hai, aur woh har cheez ki poori qudrat rakhta hai.

Dekho yeh (kafir) log apne seeno ko us se chupne ke liye dohra krlite hain. Yaad rakho jab yeh apne upar kapre lapette hain, Allah un ki woh baatein bhi jaanta hai jo yeh chupate hain, aur woh bhi jo yeh li alalan karte hain, yaqeenan Allah seeno mein chhpi hui baaton ka (bhi) poora poora ilm rakhta hai.

Aur zameen par chalne wala koi jaandaar aisa nahin hai jis ka rizq Allah ne apne zimme na le rakhha ho woh us ke mustaqil thikane ko bhi jaanta hai, aur arzi thikane ko bhi. Har baat ek wazeh kitab mein darj hai.

Aur wahi hai jis ne tamam aasmanon aur zameen ko cheh din mein paida kiya. Jabke us ka arsh pani par tha. Taake tumhein aazmaye ke amal ke aitbaar se tum mein kaun ziyada achha hai. Aur agar tum (logon se) yeh kaho ke tumhein marne ke baad dobara zinda kiya jaye ga to jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai, woh yeh kahin ge ke yeh khle jadoo ke siwa kuchh nahin hai.

Aur agar hum un logon se kuchh rse ke liye azab ko mokhr karden to woh yehi kehte rahen ge ke : aakhir kis cheez ne us (azab) ko rok rakhha hai ? Are jis din woh azab aagaya to woh un se tlaie nahin tale ga, aur jis cheez ka yeh mazaq ura rahe hain, woh un ko charon taraf se ghir le gi.
Aur jab hum insan ko apni taraf se kisi rehmat ka mza chakhate dete hain, phir woh us se wapas le lete hain to woh mayous (aur) shukra bann jata hai.
Aur agar use koi takleef pahunchne ke baad hum use nematon ka mza chkha den to woh kehta hai ke saari buraiyan mujh se door hogaeen. (us waqt) woh itra kar shikhian bgharne lagta hai.
Haan ! Magar jo log sabar se kaam lete hain, aur nek amal karte hain woh aise nahin hain, un ko magfirat aur bara ajar naseeb hoga.

Phir (ae payghumbar) jo wahee tum par nazil ki jarhi hai, kya yeh mumkin hai ke tum us ka koi hissa chhor bitho ? Aur us se tumhara dil tangg hojaye ? Kyunke yeh log kehte hain ke : un (Muhammad (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) par koi khazana kyun nazil nahin hua, ya koi farishta un ke saath kyun nahin aaya ? Tum to ek aagaah karne wale ho, aur Allah hai jo har cheez ka mukammal ikhtiyar rakhta hai.

Bhala kya yeh log yun kehte hain ke yeh wahee us (payghumbar) ne apni taraf se gahara li hai ? (ae payghumbar un se) keh do ke : phir to tum bhi us jaisi ghri hui dus suratein bana lao, aur (us kaam mein madad ke liye) Allah ke siwa jis kisi ko bula sako bula lo, agar tum sache ho.

Us ke baad agar yeh tumhari baat qabool na karen to (ae logo) yaqeen karlo ke yeh wahee sirf Allah ke ilm se utri hai, aur yeh ke Allah ke siwa koi ibadat ke layaq nahin hai. To kya ab tum farmanbardar bano ge ?
Jo log (sirf) dunyawi zindagi aur us ki saja dahaja chahte hain, hum un ke aemaal ka poora poora sla usi duniya mein bhgta den ge, aur yahan un ke haqq mein koi kami nahin hogi.

Yeh woh log hain jin ke liye aakhirat mein dozakh ke siwa kuchh nahin hai, aur jo kuchh kaar-guzari unhon ne ki thi, woh aakhirat mein bekar hojaye gi, aur jo amal woh kar rahe hain, (aakhirat ke lihaz se) kaldm hain.

Bhala batao ke woh shaks (un ke barabar kaise sakta hai) jo apne rubb ki taraf se aayi hui roshan hidayat (yani quran) par qayam ho, jis ke peechhe us ki haqqaniyat ka ek saboot to khud usi mein aaya hai, aur us se pehle musa ki kitab bhi (us ki haqqaniyat ka saboot hai) jo logon ke liye qabil ittabaa aur baais rehmat thi. Aise log us (quran par) iman rakhte hain. Aur un girohon mein se jo shaks us ka inkar kare, to dozakh hi us ki tai shda jagah hai. Lihaza us (quran) ke bare mein shakk mein na paro. Yaqeen rakho ke yeh haqq hai jo tumhare Parwardigar ki taraf se aaya hai, lekin aksar log iman nahin larhe.

Aur us shaks se bara zalim kaun hoga jo Allah par jhoot bandhe ? Aise logon ki un ke rubb ke paas peshi hogi, aur gawahi dene wale kahin ge ke : yeh hain woh log jinhon ne apne Parwardigar par jhooti baatein lagayi thin. Sab log sunn len ke Allah ki laanat hai un zalimon par.
Jo Allah ke raaste se dusron ko rokte the, aur us mein kuji talash karte the aur aakhirat ke to woh bilkul hi munkir the.

Aise log aur zameen par kahin bhi Allah se bach kar nahin nikal sakte, aur Allah ke siwa unhein koi yaromddgar muyassar nahin sakte. Un ko dugna azab diya jaye ga. Yeh (haqq baat ko nafrat ki wajah se) na sunn sakte the, aur un ko (haqq) sujhayi deta tha.
Yeh woh log hain jinhon ne apni janon ke liye ghate ka sauda karliya tha, aur jo mabood unhon ne gahara rkhe the, unhein un ka koi sragh nahin mile ga.
Lamhala yehi log hain jo aakhirat mein sab se ziyada nuksan athane wale hain.
(dusri taraf) jo log iman laye hain aur unhon ne nek amal kiye hain aur woh apne Parwardigar ke aage jhuk kar mutmaeen hogaye hain, to woh jannat ke basne wale hain, woh hamesha usi mein rahen ge.
Un do girohon ki misal aisi hai jaise ek andha aur behra ho, aur dusra dekhta bhi ho, sunta bhi ho. Kya yeh dono apne halaat mein barabar sakte hain ? Kya phir bhi tum ibrat hasil nahin karte ?
Aur hum ne nooh ko un ki qaum ke paas yeh paygham de kar bheja ke : mein tumhein us baat se saaf saaf aagaah karne wala payghumbar hon.
Ke Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki ibadat na karo. Yaqeen jaano mujhe tum par ek dakaha dene wale din ke azab ka andesha hai.

Us par un ki qaum ke woh sardar log jinhon ne kufr ikhtiyar karliya tha, kehne lage ke : humein to us se ziyada (tum mein) koi baat nazar nahin aarahi ke tum hum jaise hi ek insan ho, aur hum yeh bhi dekh rahe hain ke sirf woh log tumhare peechhe lage hain jo hum mein sab se ziyada behisit hain, aur woh bhi sthi tor par raye qayam karke. Aur humein tum mein koi aisi baat bhi dkhaii nahin deti jis ki wajah se hum par tumhein koi fazilat hasil ho, bulke hamara khayal to yeh hai ke tum sab jhoote ho.

Nooh ne kaha : ae meri qaum ! Zara mujhe yeh batao ke agar mein apne Parwardigar ki taraf se aayi hui ek roshan hidayat par qayam hon, aur us ne mujhe khaas apne paas se ek rehmat (yani nabuwat) ata farmaee hai, phir bhi woh tumhein sujhayi nahin de rahi, to kya hum us ko tum par zabardasti musallat karden jabke tum use pasand karte ho ?

Aur ae meri qaum ! Mein us (tableeg) par tum se koi maal nahin maangta, mera ajar Allah ke siwa kisi aur ne zimme nahin liya, aur jo log iman lachke hain, mein un ko dhtkarne wala nahin hon, un sab ko apne rubb se jaa milna hai. Lekin mein to yeh dekh raha hon ke tum aise log ho jo nadaani ki baatein kar rahe ho.
Aur ae meri qaum ! Agar mein un logon ko dhtkardon to kaun mujhe Allah (ki pakar) se bachaye ga ? Kya tum phir bhi dhyaan nahin do ge ?

Aur mein tum se yeh nahin keh raha hon ke mere qabze mein Allah ke khazane hain, na mein gaib ki saari baatein jaanta hon, aur na mein tum se yeh keh raha hon ke mein koi farishta hon. Aur jin logon ko tumhari nigahen hakeer samajhti hain, un ke bare mein bhi mein yeh nahin keh sakta ke Allah unhein kabhi koi bhalayi ata nahin kare ga. Un ke dilon mein jo kuchh hai use Allah sab se ziyada jaanta hai. Agar mein un ke bare mein aisi baatein kahon to mera shumar yaqeenan zalimon mein hoga.
Unhon ne kaha ke : ae nooh ! Tum hum se behas krchke, aur bohat behas krchke. Ab agar tum sache ho to le aao woh (azab) jis ki dhkmi humein de rahe ho.
Nooh ne kaha ke : use to Allah hi tumhare paas le aaye ga, agar chahaye ga, aur tum use bus nahin krskte.

Agar mein tumhari khair khwahi karna chahoon to meri khair khwahi us surat mein tumhare koi kaam nahin sakti jab Allah hi ne (tumhari zidd aur hatt dharmi ki wajah se) tumhein gumrahi karne ka arada karliya ho. Wahi tumhara Parwardigar hai, aur usi ke paas tumhein wapas le jaya jaye ga.

Bhala kya (arab ke yeh kafir) log kehte hain ke Muhammad (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) ne yeh quran apni taraf se gahara liya hai ? (ae payghumbar) keh do ke : agar mein ne use ghra hoga to mere jurm ka wabal mujhi par hoga, aur jo jurm tum kar rahe ho, mein us ka zma daar nahin hon.

Aur nooh ke paas wahee bheji gayi ke : tumhari qaum mein se jo log ab tak iman lachke hain, un ke siwa ab koi aur iman nahin laye ga. Lihaza jo harkatein yeh log karte rahe hain, tum un par sadma na karo.
Aur hamari nigrani mein aur hamari wahee ki madad se kashti banao, aur jo log zalim bann chuke hain un ke bare mein mujh se koi baat na karna. Yeh ab garq ho kar rahen ge.

Chunanche woh kashti banane lage. Aur jab bhi un ki qaum ke kuchh sardar un ke paas se guzarte to un ka mazaq urate the. Nooh ne kaha ke : agar tum hum par haste ho to jaise tum hans rahe ho, usi tarah hum bhi tum par haste hain.
Anqareeb tumhein pata chal jaye ga ke kis par woh azab aaraha hai jo use ruswa kar ke rakaha de ga, aur kis par woh qahara nazil hone wala hai jo kabhi tal nahin sake ga.

Yahan tak ke jab hamara hukum aagaya aur tanoor ubal para, to hum ne (nooh se) kaha ke : us kashti mein har qasam ke jaanwaron mein se do do ke jore sawar karlo aur tumhare ghar walon mein se jin ke bare mein pehle kaha jaa chuka hai (ke woh kufr ki wajah se garq hon ge) un ko chhor kar baqi ghar walon ko bhi, aur jitne log iman laye hain un ko bhi (saath le lo) aur thore hi se log the jo un ke saath iman laye the.

Aur nooh ne (un sab se) kaha ke : us kashti mein sawar hojao, us ka chalna bhi Allah hi ke naam se hai, aur lanagar daalna bhi, yaqeen rakho ke mera Parwardigar bohat bakhshne wala, bara meharban hai.
Aur woh kashti paharon jaisi maujon ke darmiyan chali jati thi. Aur nooh ne apne us bete ko jo sab se alag tha, aawaz di ke : bete ! Humare saath sawar hojao, aur kafiron ke saath na raho.

Woh bola : mein abhi kisi pahar ki panaah le loon ga jo mujhe pani se bacha le ga, nooh ne kaha : aaj Allah ke hukum se koi kisi ko bachane wala nahin hai, siwaye us ke jis par woh hi reham farma. Us ke baad un ke darmiyan mauj hayal hogaee, aur doobne walon mein woh bhi shamil hua.

Aur hukum hua ke : ae zameen ! Apna pani nigal le, aur ae aasman ! Tahama jaa. Chunanche pani utar gaya aur sara qsa chuka diya gaya. Kashti judi pahar par aathhri aur keh diya gaya ke : barbadi hai us qaum ki jo zalim ho.
Aur nooh ne apne Parwardigar ko pukara aur kaha ke : ae mere Parwardigar ! Mera beta mere ghar hi ka ek fard hai, aur be-shak tera wada sacha hai, aur to sare hakimon se barh kar hakim hai.

Allah ne farmaya : ae nooh ! Yaqeen jaano woh tumhare ghar walon mein se nahin hai, woh to napaak amal ka plnda hai. Lihaza mujh se aisi cheez na maango jis ki tumhein khabar nahin, mein tumhein naseehat karta hon ke tum nadano mein shamil na ho.

Nooh ne kaha : mere Parwardigar mein aap ki panaah maangta hon us baat se ke aainda aap se woh cheez maangoon jis ka mujhe ilm nahin, aur agar aap ne meri magfirat na farmaye aur mujh par reham na kiya to mein bhi un logon mein shamil hojaoon ga jo barbaad hogaye hain.

Farmaya gaya ke : ae nooh ab (kashti se) utar jao, hamari taraf se woh salamati aur barkatein le kar jo tumhare liye bhi hain aur tumhari jitni qaumein hain, un ke liye bhi. Aur kuchh qaumein aisi hain jin ko hum (duniya mein) lutf athane ka mauqa den ge, phir un ko hamari taraf se ek dardnaak azab pakre ga.

(ae payghumbar) yeh gaib ki kuchh baatein hain jo hum tumhein wahee ke zariye bata rahe hain. Yeh baatein na tum us se pehle jante the, na tumhari qaum. Lihaza sabar se kaam lo aur aakhri anjaam muttaqiyon hi ke haqq mein hoga.

Aur qaum aad ke paas hum ne un ke bhai hood ko payghumbar bana kar bheja unhon ne kaha : ae meri qaum ! Allah ki ibadat karo, us ke siwa tumhara koi mabood nahin hai, tumhari haqeeqat us ke siwa kuchh nahin ke tum ne jhooti baatein tarash rkhi hain.
Ae meri qaum ! Mein tum se us (tableeg) par koi ujrat nahin maangta, mera ajar kisi aur ne nahin, us zaat ne apne zimme liya hai jis ne mujhe paida kya hai, kya phir bhi tum aqal se kaam nahin lete ?

Ae meri qaum ! Apne Parwardigar se gunahon ki maafi maango, phir us ki taraf rujoo karo, woh tum par aasman se mosla dhar baarishein barsaye ga, aur tumhari maujooda qooat mein mazeed qooat ka azafa kare ga, aur mujrim bann kar moonh na moro.
Unhon ne kaha : ae hood ! Tum humare paas koi roshan daleel le kar nahin aaye. Aur hum apne khudaon ko sirf tumhare kehne se chorne wale nahin hain, aur na hum tumhari baat par iman laskte hain.

Hum to us ke siwa kuchh aur nahin keh sakte ke humare khudaon mein se kisi ne tumhein buri tarah jhpite mein le liya hai, hood ne kaha : mein Allah ko gawah banata hon, aur tum bhi gawah raho ke tum Allah ke siwa jis jis ko us ki khudayi mein shareek maante ho, mein us se buri hon.
Ab tum sab ke sab malakar mere khilaf chalein chal lo, aur mujhe zara mohlat na do .

Mein ne to Allah par bharosa kar rakhha hai jo mera bhi Parwardigar hai aur tumhara bhi Parwardigar. Zameen par chalne wala koi jaandaar aisa nahin jis ki choti us ke qabze mein na ho, yaqeenan mera Parwardigar seedhe raaste par hai. .

Phir bhi agar tum moonh morte ho to jo paygham de kar mujhe tumhare paas bheja gaya tha mein ne woh tumhein pahuncha diya hai, aur (tumhare kufr ki wajah se) mera Parwardigar tumhari jagah kisi aur qaum ko yahan basa de ga, aur tum us ka kuchh na bigar sako ge. Be-shak mera Parwardigar har cheez ki nigrani karta hai.
Aur (aakhir kaar) jab hamara hukum aagaya to hum ne apni rehmat ke zariye hood ko aur jo log un ke saath iman laye the, un ko bacha liya, aur unhein ek sakht azab se nijat de di.

Yeh the aad ke log jinhon ne apne Parwardigar ki nishaniyon ka inkar kiya, aur us ke payghumbaron ki nafarmani ki, aur har aise shaks ka hukum maana jo parle darje ka jabr aur haqq ka pakka dushman tha.

Aur (us ka nateeja yeh hua ke) us duniya mein bhi phtkar un ke peechhe laga di gayi, aur qayamat ke din bhi. Yaad rakho ke qaum aad ne apne rubb ke saath kufr ka mamla kiya tha. Ya drkho ke barbadi aad hi ki hui, jo hood ki qaum thi.

Aur qaum samood ke psa hum ne un ke bhai saleh ko payghumbar bana kar bheja. Unhon ne kaha : ae meri qaum ! Allah ki ibadat karo, us ke siwa tumhara koi mabood nahin hai. Usi ne tum ko zameen se paida kiya, aur us mein tumhein abad kiya. Lihaza us se apne gunahon ki maafi maango, phir us ki taraf rujoo karo. Yaqeen rakho ke mera rubb (tum se) qareeb bhi hai, duaein qabool karne wala bhi.

Woh kehne lage : ae saleh ! Us se pehle to tum humare darmiyan us tarah rahe ho ke tum se bari umeeden wabasta thi jin (buthon) ki ibadat humare baap dada karte aaye hain kya tum humein un ki ibadat karne se mana karte ho ? Jis baat ki tum dawat de rahe ho, us ke bare mein to humein aisa shakk hai jis ne humein iztaraab mein daal diya hai.

Saleh ne kaha : ae meri qaum ! Zara mujhe yeh batao ke agar mein apne Parwardigar ki taraf se aayi hui ek roshan hidayat par qayam hon, aur us ne mujhe khaas apne paas se ek rehmat (yani nabuwat) ata farmaee hai, phir bhi agar mein us ki nafarmani karoon to kaun hai jo mujhe Allah (ki pakar) se bacha le ? Lihaza tum (mere fraiz se rok ruk) barbadi mein mubtila karne ke siwa mujhe aur kya de rahe ho ?

Aur ae meri qaum ! Yeh Allah ki ountni tumhare liye ek nishani bann kar aayi hai. Lihaza us ko aazad chhor do ke yeh Allah ki zameen mein khati phre, aur us ko bure irade se chhona bhi nahin, kahin aisa na ho ke tumhein anqareeb aane wala azab pakre.
Phir hua yeh ke unhon ne us ko maar dala, chunanche saleh ne kaha ke : tum apne gharon mein teen din aur maze karlo, (us ke baad azab aaye ga aur) yeh aisa wada hai jise koi jhoota nahin krskta.

Phir jab hamara hukum aagaya to hum ne saleh ko aur un ke saath jo iman laye the, un ko apni khaas rehmat ke zariye nijat di, aur us din ki ruswayi se bacha liya, yaqeenan tumhara Parwardigar bari qooat ka, bare iqtedar ka maalik hai.
Aur jin logon ne zulm ka raasta apnaia tha, un ko ek chinghar ne pakra, jis ke natije mein woh apne gharon mein us tarah ondhe pare reh gaye.
Jaise kabhi wahan base hi na the. Yaad rakho ke samood ne apne rubb ke saath kufr ka mamla kiya tha, yaad rakho ke barbadi samood hi ki hui.

Aur humare farishte (insani shakal mein) Ibrahim ke paas (beta paida hone ki) khushkhabri le kar aaye. Unhon ne salam kaha, Ibrahim ne bhi salam kaha, phir Ibrahim ko kuchh dair nahin guzri thi ke woh (un ki mehmani ke liye) ek bhoona hua bachra le aaye.

Magar jab dekha ke un ke haath us (bachre) ki taraf nahin barh rahe, to woh un se khatak gaye, aur un ki taraf se dil mein khof mehsoos kiya. Farishton ne kaha : dariye nahin, humein (aap ko bete ki khushkhabri sunane aur) loot ki qaum ke paas bheja gaya hai.
Aur Ibrahim ki biwi khri hui thin, woh hans paren, to hum ne unhein (dobara) ashaq ki, aur ashaq ke baad yaqoob ki pedaeesh ki khushkhabri di.
Woh kehne lagen : haaye ! Kya mein us halat mein bcha jinno gi ke mein boorhi hon, aur yeh mere shohar hain jo khud burhape ki halat mein hain ? Waqayi yeh to bari ajeeb baat hai.

Farishton ne kaha : kya aap Allah ke hukum par tajjub kar rahi hain ? Aap jaise muqaddas gharane par Allah ki rehmat aur barkatein hi barkatein hain, be-shak woh har tareef ka mustahiq, bari shaan wala hai.
Phir jab Ibrahim se ghabrahat door hui, aur un ko khushkhabri mill gayi to unhon ne hum se loot ki qaum ke bare mein (naaz ke taa aur par) jhgrna shuroo kardiya.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke Ibrahim bare burdbaar, (Allah ki yaad mein) bari aahin bharne wale (aur) har waqt hum se lo lagaye hue the.
(hum ne un se kaha) Ibrahim ! Us baat ko jane do . Yaqeen karlo ke tumhare rubb ka hukum chuka hai, aur un logon par aisa azab aaker rahe ga jis ko koi peechhe nahin lota sakta.
Aur jab humare farishte loot ke paas pahunche to woh un ki wajah se ghabraye, un ka dil pareshan hua aur woh kehne lage ke : aaj ka yeh din bohat kathin hai.

Aur un ki qaum ke log un ke paas dorte hue aaye, aur us se pehle woh bure kaam kya hi karte the. Loot ne kaha : ae meri qaum ke logo ! Yeh meri betiyan maujood hain, yeh tumhare liye kahin ziyada pakeeza hain us liye Allah se daro aur mere mehmano ke maamle mein mujhe ruswa na karo. Kya tum mein koi ek bhi bhala aadmi nahin hai ?
Kehne lage : tumhein maloom hai ke tumhari betiyon se humein kuchh matlab nahin, aur tum khoob jante ho ke hum kya chahte hain ?
Lo taa ne kaha : kaash ke mere paas tumhare muqable mein koi taqat hoti, ya mein kisi mazboot sahare ki panaah le sakta.

(ab) farishton ne (loot se) kaha : ae loot ! Hum tumhare Parwardigar ke bheje hue farishte hain. Yeh (kafir) log hargiz tum tak rasayi hasil nahin krskin ge. Lihaza tum raat ke kisi hisse mein apne ghar walon ko le kar basti se roana hojao, aur tum mein se koi peechhe murr kar bhi na dikhe. Haan magar tumhari biwi (tumhare saath nahin jaye gi) us par bhi wahi museebat aane wali hai jo aur logon par aarahi hai. Yaqeen rakho ke un (par azab nazil karne) ke liye subah ka waqt muqarrar hai. Kiya subah bilkul nazdeek nahin aagaee.
Phir jab hamara hukum aagaya to hum ne us zameen ke upar wale hisse ko niche wale hisse mein tabdeel kardiya, aur un par paki mitti ke teh bar teh pathar barsaye.
Jin par tumhare rubb ki taraf se nishan lage hue the. Aur yeh basti (makkah ke un) zalimon se kuchh door nahin hai.

Aur madiyan ki taraf hum ne un ke bhai shoaib ko payghumbar bana kar bheja unhon ne (un se) kaha ke : ae meri qaum ! Allah ki ibadat karo, us ke siwa tumhara koi mabood nahin hai. Aur naap tol mein kami mat kiya karo. Mein dekh raha hon ke tum log khushaal ho. Aur mujhe tum par ek aise din ke azab ka khof hai jo tumhein charon taraf se ghir le ga.
Aur ae meri qaum ke logo ! Naap tol porapora kiya karo, aur logon ko un ki cheezen ghta kar na diya karo. Aur zameen mein fasaad philate mat phro.

Agar tum meri baat mano to (logon ka haqq un ko dene ke baad) jo kuchh Allah ka diya bach rahe, woh tumhare haqq mein kahin behtar hai, aur (agar na mano to) mein tum par phra daar muqarrar nahin hua hon.

Woh kehne lage : ae shoaib ! Kya tumhari namaz tumhein yeh hukum deti hai ke humare baap dada jin ki ibadat karte aaye the, hum unhein bhi chhor den aur apne maal o daulat ke bare mein jo kuchh hum chahein, woh bhi na karen. ? Waqayi tum to bare aqal mand, nek chalan aadmi ho.

Shoaib ne kaha : ae meri qaum ke logo ! Zara mujhe yeh batao ke agar mein apne Parwardigar ki taraf se ek roshan daleel par qayam hon, aur us ne khaas apne paas se mujhe achha rizq ata farmaya hai, (to phir mein tumhare galat tareeqe par kyun chalon ?) aur mera aisa koi arada nahin hai ke mein jis baat se tumhein mana kar raha hon, tumhare peechhe jakr wahi kaam khud karne lgon. Mera maqsad apni istitaat ki hadd tak islaah ke siwa kuchh nahin hai, aur mujhe jo kuchh tofiq hoti hai sirf Allah ki madad se hoti hai, usi par mein ne bharosa kar rakhha hai aur usi ki taraf mein (har maamle mein) rujoo karta hon.

Aur ae meri qaum ! Mere saath zidd ka jo mamla tum kar rahe ho, woh kahin tumhein us anjaam tak na pahuncha de ke tum par bhi waisi hi museebat nazil ho jaisi nooh ki qaum par ya hood ki qaum par ya saleh ki qaum par nazil hochuki hai. Aur loot ki qaum to tum se kuchh door bhi nahin hai.
Tum apne rubb se maafi maango, phir usi ki taraf rujoo karo, yaqeen rakho ke mera rubb bara meharban, bohat mohabbat karne wala hai.

Woh bole : ae shoaib ! Tumhari bohat si baatein to hamari samajh hi mein nahin aatin, aur hum dekh rahe hain ke tum humare darmiyan ek kamzor aadmi ho, aur agar tumhara khandaan na hota to hum tumhein pathar maar maar kar halaak kardete. Hum par tumhara kuchh zoar nahin chalta.

Shoaib ne kaha : ae meri qaum ! Kya tum par mere khandaan ka dabao Allah se ziyada hai ? Aur us ko tum ne bilkul hi pus pusht daal rakhha hai. Yaqeen jaano ke jo kuchh tum kar rahe ho, mera Parwardigar us sab ka poora ahata kiye hue hai.

Aur ae meri qaum ! Tum apne haal par reh kar (jo chaho) amal kiye jao, mein bhi (apne tareeqe ke mutabiq) amal kar raha hon. Anqareeb tumhein pata chal jaye ga ke kis par woh azab nazil hoga jo use ruswa kar ke rakaha de ga, aur kaun hai jo jhoota hai ? Aur tum bhi intezar karo, mein bhi tumhare saath intezar kar raha hon.

Aur (aakhir kaar) jab hamara hukum aaphncha to hum ne shoaib ko aur un ke saath jo iman laye the, un ko apni khaas rehmat se bacha liya, aur jin logon ne zulm kiya tha unhein ek chinghar ne pakra, aur woh apne gharon mein us tarah ondhe moonh gire reh gaye.
Jaise kabhi wahan base hi na the. Yaad rakho ! Madiyan ki bhi waisi hi barbadi hui jaisi barbadi samood ki hui thi.
Aur hum ne musa ko apni nishaniyon aur roshan daleel ke saath payghumbar bana kar.
Firaun aur us ke sardaron ke paas bheja, to unhon ne Firaun hi ki baat maani. Halaanke Firaun ki baat koi thikane ki baat nahin thi.
Woh qayamat ke din apni qaum ke aage aage hoga, aur un sab ko dozakh mein laa utare ga. Aur woh badhtareen ghat hai jis par koi utre.
Aur phtkar us duniya mein bhi un ke peechhe laga di gayi hai, aur qayamat ke din bhi. Yeh badhtareen sla hai jo kisi ko diya jaye.
Yeh un bastiyon ke kuchh halaat hain jo hum tumhein suna rahe hain. Un mein se kuchh (bastiyan) woh hain jo abhi apni jagah khri hain, aur kuchh kati hui fasal (ki tarah benshan) bann chuki hain.

Aur un par hum ne koi zulm nahin kiya, bulke unhon ne khud apni janon par zulm kiya tha, jis ka nateeja yeh hua ke jab tumhare Parwardigar ka hukum aaya to jin maboodon ko woh Allah ke bajaye pukara karte the, woh un ke zara bhi kaam na aaye, aur unhon ne un ko tabahi ke siwa aur kuchh nahin diya.
Aur jo bastiyan zalim hoti hain, tumhara rubb jab un ko giraft mein leta hai to us ki pakar aisi hi hoti hai. Waqayi us ki pakar bari dardnaak, bari sakht hai.

Un saari baaton mein us shaks ke liye bari ibrat hai jo aakhirat ke azab se darta ho. Woh aisa din hoga jis ke liye tamam logon ko aktha kiya jaye ga, aur woh aisa din hoga jise sab ke sab khuli aankhon dekhen ge.
Hum ne use multawi kiya hai to bas ek gini chuni muddat ke liye multawi kiya hai.
Jab woh din aajaye ga to koi Allah ki ijazat ke baghair baat nahin karsake ga. Phir un mein koi bad-haal hoga, aur koi khushaal.
Chunanche jo bad-haal hon ge woh dozakh mein hon ge jahan un ki cheekhne chalane ki aawazen aayein gi.
Yeh us mein hamesha hamesha rahen ge jab tak aasman aur zameen qayam hain. Illa yeh ke tumhare rubb hi ko kuchh aur manzoor ho yaqeenan tumhara rubb jo arada karle, us par achhi tarah amal karta hai.

Aur jo log khushaal hon ge woh jannat mein hon ge jis mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen ge, jab tak aasman aur zameen qayam hain, illa yeh ke tumhare rubb hi ko kuchh aur manzoor ho. Yeh ek aisi ata hogi jo kabhi khatam hone mein nahin aaye gi.

Lihaza (ae payghumbar) yeh (mushrikeen) jin (buthon) ki ibadat karte hain, un ke bare mein zara bhi shakk mein na rehna. Yeh to usi tarah ibadat kar rahe hain jaise un ke baap dade pehle hi ibadat kiya karte the, aur yaqeen rakho ke hum un sab ko un ka hissa poora poora chuka den ge, jis mein koi kami nahin ki jaye gi.

Aur hum ne musa ko kitab di thi to us mein bhi ikhtilaf kiya gaya tha. Aur agar tumhare Parwardigar ki taraf se ek baat pehle hi tai na hochuki hoti (ke un ko poora azab aakhirat mein diya jaye ga) to un ka faisla (yahin duniya mein) hochka hota. Aur yeh log us ke bare mein (abhi tak) sakht qasam ke shakk mein pare hue hain.
Aur yaqeen rakho ke sab logon ka mamla yehi hai ke tumhara Parwardigar un ke aemaal ka badla poora poora de ga. Yaqeenan woh un ke tamam aemaal se poori tarah bakhabar hai.

Lihaza (ae payghumbar) jis tarah tumhein hukum diya gaya hai us ke mutabiq tum bhi seedhe raaste par saabit qadam raho, aur woh log bhi jo toubah kar ke tumhare saath hain, aur hadd se aage na niklo. Yaqeen rakho ke jo amal bhi tum karte ho woh use poori tarah dekhta hai.

Aur (musalmano) un zalim logon ki taraf zara bhi na jhukna, kabhi dozakh ki aag tumhein bhi pakre aur tumhein Allah ko chhor kar kisi qasam ke dost muyassar na aayein, phir tumhari koi madad bhi na kare.
Aur (ae payghumbar) din ke dono siron par aur raat ke kuchh hisson mein namaz qayam karo. Yaqeenan nekiyan buraiyon ko mita deti hain, yeh ek naseehat hai un logon ke liye jo naseehat manen.
Aur sabar se kaam lo, us liye ke Allah neki karne walon ka ajar zaya nahin karta.

Tum se pehle jo ummaten guzri hain, bhala un mein aise log kyun na hue jin ke paas itni bacchi khchi samajh to hoti ke woh logon ko zameen mein fasaad machane se rokte ? Haan thore se log the jin ko hum ne (azab se) nijat di thi. Aur jo log zalim the, woh jis aish o aish-o-ishrat mein the, usi ke peechhe lage rahe, aur jaraeem ka irteqab karte rahe.
Aur tumhara Parwardigar aisa nahin hai ke bastiyon par zulm kar ke unhein tabaah kar de jabke un ke bashinde sahih roshan par chal rahe hon.

Aur agar tumhara Parwardigar chahta to tamam insano ko ek hi tareeqe ka pairo bana deta, (magar kisi ko zabardasti kisi deen par majboor karna hikmat ka taqaza nahin hai, us liye unhein apne ikhtiyar se mukhtalif tareeqe apnane ka mauqa diya gaya hai) aur woh ab hamesha mukhtalif raaston par hi rahen ge.

Albatta jin par tumhara Parwardigar reham farmaye ga, un ki baat aur hai (ke Allah unhein haqq par qayam rkhe ga) aur usi (imtehan) ke liye us ne un ko paida kiya hai. Aur tumhare rubb ki woh baat poori hogi jo us ne kahi thi ke : mein jahannam ko jinnat aur insano dono se bhar doon ga.

Aur (ae payghumbar) guzishat payghumbaron ke waqiyaat mein se woh sare waqiyaat hum tumhein suna rahe hain jin se hum tumhare dil ko taqviyat pahunchayein. Aur un waqiyaat ke zamana mein tumhare paas jo baat aayi hai woh khud bhi haqq hai aur tamam momino ke liye naseehat aur yaddhani bhi hai.
Aur jo log iman nahin larhe hain, un se kaho ke : tum apni maujooda halat par amal kiye jao, hum bhi (apne tareeqe par) amal kar rahe hain.
Aur tum bhi (Allah ke faisle ka) intezar karo, hum bhi intezar karte hain.

Aasmanon aur zameen mein jitne posheeda bhed hain, woh sab Allah ke ilm mein hain, aur usi ki taraf sare maamlaat lotaye jayen ge. Lihaza (ae payghumbar) us ki ibadat karo, aur us par bharosa rakho. Aur tum log jo kuchh karte ho, tumhara Parwardigar us se bikhbr nahin hai.
Alif Laam Raa
Hum ne us ko aisa quran bana kar utara hai jo arabi zubaan mein hai, taake tum samajh sako.
(ae payghumbar) hum ne tum par yeh quran jo wahee ke zariye bheja hai us ke zariye hum tumhein ek behtareen waqa sunate hain, jabke tum us se pehle us (waqiye se) bilkul bikhbr the.

(yeh us waqt ki baat hai) jab yousuf ne apne walid (yaqoob (alh alh-e-salam)) se kaha tha ke : abba jaan ! Mein ne (khuwab mein) gyarah sitaron aur suraj aur chand ko dekha hai. Mein ne dekha hai ke yeh sab mujhe sajda kar rahe hain.
Unhon ne kaha : beta ! Apna yeh khuwab apne bhaiyon ko na batana, kahin aisa na ho ke woh tumhare liye koi saazish tayyar karen, kyunke shetan insan ka khla dushman hai.

Aur usi tarah tumhara Parwardigar tumhein (nabuwat ke liye) muntakhab kare ga, aur tumhein tamam baaton ka sahih matlab nikalna skhaie ga (jis mein khwabon ki tabeer ka ilm bhi dakhil hai) aur tum par aur yaqoob ki aulad par apni niyamat usi tarah poori kare ga jaise us ne us se pehle tumhare man baap par aur Ibrahim aur ashaq par poori ki thi. Yaqeenan tumhara Parwardigar ilm ka bhi maalik hai, hikmat ka bhi maalik.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke jo log (tum se yeh waqa) pochh rahe hain, un ke liye yousuf aur un ke bhaiyon (ke halaat mein) bari nishaniyan hain.

(yeh us waqt ka waqa hai) jab yousuf ke un (sautele) bhaiyon ne (aapas mein) kaha tha ke : yaqeeni tor par humare walid ko humare muqable mein yousuf aur us ke (haqeeqi) bhai (bniamin) se ziyada mohabbat hai, halaanke hum (un ke liye) ek mazboot jataha bane hue hain. Humein yaqeen hai ke humare walid kisi khuli galat fehmi mein mubtila hain.

(ab us ka hala yeh hai ke) yousuf ko qatal hi krdalo, ya use kisi aur sar-zameen mein phink aao, taake tumhare walid ki saari tawajjuh khalis tumhari taraf hojaye, aur yeh sab karne ke baad phir (toubah kar ke) nek bann jao.
Unhi mein se ek kehne wale ne kaha : yousuf ko qatal to na karo, albatta agar tumhein kuchh karna hi hai to use kisi andhe kuwein mein phink aao, taake koi qafila use atha karle jaye.

(chunanche) un bhaiyon ne (apne walid se) kaha ke : abba ! Yeh aap ko kya hogaya hai ke aap yousuf ke maamle mein hum par itminaan nahin karte ? Halaanke us mein koi shakk na hona chahiye ke hum us ke pakke khair khwah hain.
Kal aap use humare saath (tafreeh ke liye) bhej dijiye, taake woh kahe piye, aur kuchh khil kood le. Aur yaqeen rkhie ke hum us ki poori hifazat karen ge.
Yaqoob ne kaha : tum use le jao ge to mujhe (us ki judaee ka) ghum hoga. Aur mujhe yeh andesha bhi hai ke kisi waqt jab tum us ki taraf se ghafil ho, to koi bheyriya use khajaie.
Woh bole : hum ek mazboot jthe ki shakal mein hain, agar phir bhi bheyriya use khajaie to hum to bilkul hi gaye guzre hue.

Phir hua yeh ke jab woh un ko saath le gaye, aur unhon ne yeh tai kar hi rakhha tha ke unhein ek andhe kuwein mein daal den ge, (chunanche daal bhi diya) to hum ne yousuf par wahee bheji ke (ek waqt aaye ga jab) tum un sab ko jtla ge ke unhon ne yeh kya kaam kya tha. Aur us waqt unhein pata bhi na hoga (ke tum kaun ho ?)
Aur raat ko woh sab apne baap ke paas rote hue pahunch gaye.

Kehne lage : abba ji ! Yaqeen janie, hum dorne ka muqable karne chale gaye the, aur hum ne yousuf ko apne samaan ke paas chhor diya tha, itne mein ek bheyriya use kha gaya. Aur aap hamari baat ka yaqeen nahin karen ge, chahaye hum kitne hi sache hon.

Aur woh yousuf ki kamees par jhoot moot ka khoon bhi laga karle aaye. Un ke walid ne kaha : (haqeeqat yeh nahin hai) bulke tumhare dilon ne apni taraf se ek baat bana li hai. Ab to mere liye sabar hi behtar hai. Aur jo baatein tum bana rahe ho, un par Allah hi ki madad darkaar hai.

Aur (dusri taraf jis jagah unhon ne yousuf ko kuwein mein dala tha, wahan) ek qafila aaya. Kafile ke logon ne ek aadmi pani lane ke liye bheja, aur us ne apna dol (kuwein mein) dala to (wahan yousuf (alh alh-e-salam) ko dekh kar) pukar atha : lo khushkhabri suno ! Yeh to ek larka hai. Aur kafile walon ne unhein ek tijarat ka maal samajh kar chhpalia, aur jo kuchh woh kar rahe the, Allah ko us ka poora ilm tha.
Aur (phir) unhon ne yousuf ko bohat kam keemat mein bech diya jo ginti ke chandh dirhamo ki shakal mein thi, aur un ko yousuf se koi dilchaspi nahin thi.

Aur misr ke jis aadmi ne unhein khareeda, us ne apni biwi se kaha ke : us ko izzat se rakhna. Mujhe aisa lagta hai ke yeh humein faida pahunchaye ga, ya phir hum use beta bnalin ge, us tarah hum ne us sar-zameen mein yousuf ke qadam jamaye taake unhein baaton ka sahih matlab nikalna skhaiin, aur Allah ko apne kaam par poora qaabu hasil hai, lekin bohat se log nahin jante.
Aur jab yousuf apni bharpoor jawani ko pahunche to hum ne unhein hikmat aur ilm ata kiya, aur jo log nek kaam karte hain un ko hum usi tarah badla dete hain.

Aur jis aurat ke ghar mein woh rehte the, us ne un ko wrghlane ki koshish ki, aur sare darwazon ko bandh kardiya, aur kehne lagi : aa bhi jao !. Yousuf ne kaha : Allah ki panaah ! Woh mera aaqa hai, us ne mujhe achhi tarah rakhha hai. Sachi baat yeh hai ke jo log zulm karte hain unhein falaah hasil nahin hoti.

Us aurat ne to wazeh tor par yousuf (ke saath buraee) ka arada karliya tha, aur yousuf ke dil mein bhi us aurat ka khayal aachla tha, agar woh apne rubb ki daleel ko na dekh lete, hum ne aisa us liye kiya taake un se buraee aur behiaii ka rukh phir den. Be-shak woh humare muntakhab bandon mein se the.

Aur dono aage peechhe darwaze ki taraf dore, aur (us kash-ma-kash mein) us aurat ne un ki kamees ko peechhe ki taraf se phar dala. Itne mein dono ne us aurat ke shohar ko darwaze par khra paya. Us aurat ne fora (baat banane ke liye apne shohar se) kaha ke : jo koi tumhari biwi ke saath buraee ka arada kare, us ki saza us ke siwa aur kya hai ke use qaid kardiya jaye, ya koi aur dardnaak saza di jaye ?

Yousuf ne kaha : yeh khud thin jo mujhe wrghla rahi thin, aur us aurat ke khandaan hi mein se ek gawahi dene wale ne yeh gawahi di ke : agar yousuf ki kamees samne ki taraf se phti ho to aurat sach kehti hai, aur woh jhoote hain.
Aur agar un ki kamees peechhe ki taraf se phti hai to aurat jhoot bolti hai, aur yeh sache hain.
Phir jab shohar ne dekha ke un ki kamees peechhe se phti hai to us ne kaha ke : yeh tum aurton ki makkari hai, waqayi tum aurton ki makkari bari sakht hai.
Yousuf ! Tum us baat ka khayal na karo, aur ae aurat ! To apne gunaah ki maafi maang, yaqeeni tor par to hi khtakar thi.

Aur shehar mein kuchh aurten yeh baatein karne lagen ke : aziz ki biwi apne no-jawan ghulam ko wrghla rahi hai. Us no-jawan ki mohabbat ne use farifta karliya hai. Humare khayal mein to yaqeeni tor par woh khuli gumrahi mein mubtila hai.

Chunanche jab us (aziz ki biwi) ne un aurton ke makar ki yeh baat suni to us ne paygham bhej kar unhein (apne ghar) bulwa liya. Aur un ke liye ek takiyon wali nishist tayyar ki, aur un mein se har ek ke haath mein ek chaqo de diya. Aur (yousuf se) kaha ke : zara bahar nikal kar un ke samne aajao, ab jo un aurton ne yousuf ko dekha to unhein heyrat angez (hadd tak haseen) paya, aur (un ke husn se mbhot hoker) apne haath kaat dale, aur bol athin ke : hasha lla ! Yeh shaks koi insan nahin hai, ek qabil tkrim farishte ke siwa yeh kuchh aur nahin sakta.

Aziz ki biwi ne kaha : ab dekho ! Yeh hai woh shaks jis ke bare mein tum ne mujhe taane diye the. Yeh baat waqayi sach hai ke mein ne apna matlab nikalne ke liye us par dore dale, magar yeh bach nikla, aur agar yeh mere kehne par amal nahin kare ga, to use qaid zaroor kiya jaye ga, aur yeh zaleel ho kar rahe ga.

Yousuf ne dua ki ke : ya rubb ! Yeh aurten mujhe jis kaam ki dawat de rahi hain, us ke muqable mein qaid khana mujhe ziyada pasand hai. Aur agar to ne mujhe un ki chaalon se mehfooz na kiya to mera dil bhi un ki taraf khnchne lage ga, aur jo log jahalat ke kaam karte hain, un mein mein bhi shamil hojaoon ga.
Chunanche yousuf ke rubb ne un ki dua qabool ki, aur un aurton ki chaalon se unhein mehfooz rakhha. Be-shak wahi hai jo har baat sunne wala, har cheez janne wala hai.
Phir un logon ne (yousuf ki pakdamni ki) bohat si nishaniyan dekh lene ke baad bhi munasib yehi samjha ke unhein ek muddat tak qaid khane bhej den.

Aur yousuf ke saath do aur no-jawan qaid khane mein dakhil hue. Un mein se ek ne (ek din yousuf se) kaha ke : mein (khuwab mein) apne aap ko dekhta hon ke mein sharab nichor raha hon. Aur dusre ne kaha ke : mein (khuwab mein) yun dekhta hon ke mein ne apne sar par roti athaii hui hai (aur) parinde us mein se kha rahe hain. Zara humein us ki tabeer batao, humein tum nek aadmi nazar aate ho.

Yousuf ne kaha : jo khana tumhein (qaid khane mein) diya jata hai, woh abhi aane nahin paye ga ke mein tumhein us ki haqeeqat btadon ga yeh us ilm ka ek hissa hai jo mere Parwardigar ne mujhe ata farmaya hai. (magar us se pehle meri ek baat suno) baat yeh hai ke mein ne un logon ka deen chhor diya hai jo Allah par iman nahin rakhte, aur jo aakhirat ke munkir hain.

Aur mein ne apne baap dada Ibrahim, ashaq aur yaqoob ke deen ki pairwi ki hai. Humein yeh haqq nahin hai ke Allah ke saath kisi bhi cheez ko shareek thehrayen. Yeh (toheed ka qida) hum par aur tamam logon par Allah ke fazal ka hissa hai, lekin aksar log (us niyamat ka) shukar ada nahin karte.
Ae mere qaid khane ke sathio ! Kya bohat se mutafarriq rubb behtar hain, ya woh ek Allah jis ka iqtedar sab par chhaia hua hai ?

Us ke siwa jis jis ki tum ibadat karte ho, un ki haqeeqat chandh naamon se ziyada nahin hai jo tum ne aur tumhare baap dadon ne rakaha liye hain. Allah ne un ke haqq mein koi daleel nahin utari. Hakmt Allah ke siwa kisi ko hasil hain hai, usi ne yeh hukum diya hai ke us ke siwa kisi ki ibadat na karo. Yehi seedha seedha deen hai, lekin aksar log nahin jante.

Ae mere qaid khane ke sathio ! (ab apne khwabon ki tabeer suno) tum mein se ek ka mamla to yeh hai ke woh (qaid se aazad hoker) apne aaqa ko sharab pilaye ga. Raha dusra to use sooli di jaye gi, jis ke natije mein parinde us ke sar ko (noch kar) kahyenge. Jis maamle mein tum pochh rahe the, us ka faisla (usi tarah) hochka hai.

Aur un dono mein se jis ke bare mein un ka gumaan tha ke woh raha hojaye ga, us se yousuf ne kaha ke : apne aaqa se mera bhi tzkra krdina. Phir hua yeh ke shetan ne us ko yeh baat bhala di ke woh apne aaqa se yousuf ka tzkra karta. Chunanche woh kaee baras qaid khane mein rahe.

Aur (chandh saal baad misr ke) baadshah ne (apne darbariyon se) kaha ke : mein (khuwab mein) kiya dekhta hon ke saat moti taza gaayein hain jinhen saat dubli patli gaayein kha rahi hain, neiz saat khoshe hare bhare hain, aur saat aur hain jo sokhe hue hain. Ae darbariyo ! Agar tum khuwab ki tabeer de sakte ho to mere us khuwab ka matlab batao.
Unhon ne kaha ke : yeh pareshan qasam ke khayalat (maloom hote) hain, aur hum khwabon ki tabeer ke ilm se waqif (bhi) nahin.

Aur un do qaidiyon mein se jo raha hogaya tha, aur use ek lambe rse ke baad (yousuf ki) baat yaad aayi thi, us ne kaha ke : mein aap ko us khuwab ki tabeer bataye deta hon, bas mujhe (yousuf ke paas qaid khane mein) bhej dijiye.

(chunanche us ne qaid khane mein pahunch kar yousuf se kaha) yousuf ! Ae woh shaks jis ki har baat sachi hoti hai, tum humein us (khuwab) ka matlab batao ke saat moti taza gaayein hain jinhen saat dubli patli gaayein kha rahi hain, aur saat khoshe hare bhare hain, aur dusre saat aur hain jo sokhe hue hain, shayad mein logon ke paas wapas jaon (aur unhein khuwab ki tabeer bataon) taake woh bhi haqeeqat jaan len.

Yousuf ne kaha : tum saat saal tak musalsal ghla zameen mein aga ge, us dauraan jo fasal kaato, us ko us ki baaliyon hi mein rehne dena, albatta thora sa ghla jo tumhare khane ke kaam aaye, (woh nikal liya karo) .

Phir us ke baad tum par saat saal aise aayein ge jo bare sakht hon ge, aur jo kuchh zakheera tum ne un salon ke waste jama kar rakhha hoga, us ko kha jayen ge, haan albatta thora sa hissa jo tum mehfooz krsko ge (sirf woh bach jaye ga)
Phir us ke baad ek saal aisa aaye ga jis mein logon par khoob baarish hogi, aur woh us mein angoor ka shira nichoren ge.

Aur baadshah ne kaha ke : us ko (yani yousuf ko) mere paas le kar aao. Chunanche jab un ke paas elchi pahuncha to yousuf ne kaha : apne maalik ke paas wapas jao, aur un se pochho ke un aurton ka kya qsa hai jinhon ne apne haath kaat da le the ? Mera Parwardigar un aurton ke makar se khoob waqif hai.

Baadshah ne (un aurton ko bula kar un se) kaha : tumhara kya qsa tha jab tum ne yousuf ko wrghla ne ki koshish ki thi ? Un sab aurton ne kaha ke : hasha lla ! Hum ko un mein zara bhi koi buraee maloom nahin hui. Aziz ki biwi ne kaha ke : ab to haqq baat sab par kahala hi gayi hai. Mein ne hi un ko wrghlane ki koshish ki thi, aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke woh bilkul sache hain.

(jab yousuf ko qaid khane mein us guftagu ki khabar mili to unhon ne kaha ke :) yeh sab kuchh mein ne us liye kiya taake aziz ko yeh baat yaqeen ke saath maloom hojaye ke mein ne us ki ghair mojoodgi mein us ke saath koi khayanat nahin ki, aur yeh bhi ke jo log khayanat karte hain Allah un ke fareb ko chalne nahin deta.

Aur mein yeh doi nahin karta ke mera nafs bilkul pak saaf hai, waqa yeh hai ke nafs to buraee ki talqeen karta hi rehta hai, haan mera rubb reham farma to baat aur hai (ke us surat mein nafs ka koi dao nahin chalta) be-shak mera rubb bohat bakhshne wala, bara meharban hai.

Aur baadshah ne kaha ke : us ko mere paas le aao, mein use khalis apna (muawin) banaoon ga. Chunanche jab (yousuf baadshah ke paas aagaye aur) baadshah ne un se baatein kin to us ne kaha : aaj se humare paas tumhara bara martaba hoga, aur tum par poora bharosa kiya jaye ga.
Yousuf ne kaha ke : aap mujhe mulk ke khazano (ke intezam) par muqarrar krdijie. Yaqeen rkhie ke mujhe hifazat karna khoob aata hai (aur) mein (us kaam ka) poora ilm rakhta hon.

Aur us tarah hum ne yousuf ko mulk mein aisa iqtedar ata kiya ke woh us mein jahan chahein apna thikana banayen. Hum apni rehmat jis ko chahte hain pahunchate hain aur nek logon ke ajar ko zaya nahin karte.
Aur aakhirat ka jo ajar hai woh un logon ke liye kahin ziyada behtar hai jo iman late aur taqwa par karbnd rehte hain
Aur (jab qehat para to) yousuf ke bhai aaye, aur un ke paas pahunche. To yousuf ne unhein pehchan liya, aur woh yousuf ko nahin pehchane.

Aur jab yousuf ne un ka samaan tayyar kardiya to un se kaha ke (aainda) apne baap shareek bhai ko bhi mere paas le kar aana. Kya tum yeh nahin dekh rahe ho ke mein paimana bhar bhar kardyta hon, aur mein behtareen mehmaan nawaz bhi hon ?
Ab agar tum use le kar na aaye to mere paas tumhare liye koi ghla nahin hoga, aur tum mere paas bhi na phtkna.
Woh bole : hum us ke walid ko us ke bare mein behlane ki koshish karen ge (ke woh use humare saath bhej den) aur hum aisa zaroor karen ge.

Aur yousuf ne apne nokron se keh diya ke woh un (bhaiyon) ka maal (jis ke badle unhon ne ghla khareeda hai) unhi ke kjaoon mein rakaha den, taake jab yeh apne ghar walon ke paas wapas pahunchenge to apne maal ko pehchan len. Shayad (us ehsan ki wajah se) woh dobara aayein.

Chunanche jab woh apne walid ke paas wapas pahunche to unhon ne kaha : abba jaan ! Aainda humein ghla dene se inkar kardiya gaya hai. Lihaza aap humare bhai (bniamin) ko humare saath bhej dijiye, taake hum (phir) ghla laskin, aur yaqeen rkhie ke hum us ki poori poori hifazat karen ge.

Walid ne kaha : kya mein us ke bare mein tum par waisa hi bharosa karoon jaisa uske bhai (yousuf) ke bare mein tum par pehle kya tha ? Khair ! Allah sab se barh kar nigehbaan hai, aur woh sab se barh kar reham farmane wala hai.

Aur jab unhon ne apna samaan khola to dekha ke un ka maal bhi un ko lota diya gaya hai, woh kehne lage : abba jaan ! Humein aur kya chahiye ? Yeh hamara maal hai jo humein lota diya gaya hai, aur (us martaba) hum apne ghar walon ke liye aur ghla layein ge, apne bhai ki hfazt karen ge, aur ek ount ka bojh ziyada le kar aayein ge (us tarah) yeh ziyada ghla bari aasani se mill jaye ga.

Walid ne kaha : mein us (bniamin) ko tumhare saath us waqt tak hargiz nahin bhejunga jab tak tum Allah ke naam par mujh se yeh ahad na karo ke use zaroor mere paas wapas le kar aao ge, illa yeh ke tum (waqayi) bus hojao. Chunanche jab unhon ne apne walid ko yeh ahad de diya to walid ne kaha : jo qaul wqrar hum kar rahe hain us par Allah nigehbaan hai.

Aur (saath hi yeh bhi) kaha ke : mere bito ! Tum sab ek darwaze se (shehar mein) dakhil na hona, bulke mukhtalif darwazon se dakhil hona mein Allah ki mashiyat se tumhein bacha sakta, hukum Allah ke siwa kisi ka nahin chalta. Usi par mein ne bharosa kar rakhha hai, aur jin jin ko bharosa karna ho, unhein chahiye ke usi par bharosa karen.

Aur jab woh (bhai) usi tarah (misr mein) dakhil hue jis tarah un ke walid ne kaha tha, to yeh amal Allah ki mashiyat se un ko zra bhi bachane wala nahin tha, lekin yaqoob ke dil mein ek khwahish thi jo unhon ne poori karli. Be-shak woh humare skhaie hue ilm ke haamil the, lekin aksar log (maamle ki haqeeqat) nahin jante

Aur jab yeh log yousuf ke paas pahunche to unhon ne apne (sage) bhai (bniamin) ko apne paas khaas jagah di, (aur unhein) bataya ke mein tumhara bhai hon, lihaza tum un baaton par ranjeeda na hona jo yeh (dusre bhai) karte rahe hain.
Phir jab yousuf ne un ka samaan tayyar kardiya to pani peene ka piala apne (sage) bhai ke kjaoe mein rkhoa diya, phir ek munadi ne pukar kar kaha ke : ae kafile walo ! Tum chor ho, .
Unhon ne un ki taraf murr kar pochha ke : kya cheez hai jo tum se ghum hogaee hai ?
Unhon ne kaha ke : humein baadshah ka paimana nahin mill raha  aur jo shaks use lakr de ga, us ko ek ount ka bojh (inam mein) mile ga, aur mein us (inam ke dloane) ki zma daari leta hon.
Woh (bhai) bole : Allah ki qasam ! Aap log jante hain ke hum zameen mein fasaad philane ke liye nahin aaye the, aur na hum chori karne wale log hain.
Unhon ne kaha ke : agar tum log jhoote (saabit) hue to us ki kya saza hogi ?
Unhon ne kaha : us ki saza yeh hai ke jis ke kjaoe mein se woh (piala) mill jaye, woh khud saza mein dhar liya jaye. Jo log zulm karte hain, hum un ko aisi hi saza diya karte hain,

Chunanche yousuf ne apne (sage) bhai ke thile se pehle dusre bhaiyon ke thilon ki talashi shuroo ki, phir us pyale ko apne (sage) bhai ke thile mein se baramad karliya. Us tarah hum ne yousuf ki khatir yeh tadbeer ki. Allah ki yeh mashiyat na hoti to yousuf ke liye yeh mumkin nahin tha ke woh baadshah ke kanoon ke mutabiq apne bhai ko apne paas rakaha lete, aur hum jis ko chahte hain, us ke darje buland kardete hain, aur jitne ilm wale hain, un sab ke upar ek bara ilm rakhne wala maujood hai.

(bahr-haal) woh bhai bole ke : agar us (bniamin) ne chori ki hai to (kuchh tajjub nahin, kyunke) us ka ek bhai us se pehle bhi chori krchka hai. Us par yousuf ne un par zaahir kiye baghair chupke se (dil mein) kaha ke : tum to us maamle mein kahin ziyada bure ho. Aur jo biyan tum de rahe ho, Allah us ki haqeeqat khoob jaanta hai.
(ab) woh kehne lage ke : ae aziz ! Us ka ek bohat boorha baap hai, us liye us ki jagah hum mein se kisi ko apne paas rakaha lijiye, hum aap ko un logon mein se samajhte hain jo ehsan kiya karte hain.

Yousuf ne kaha : us (insafi) se mein Allah ki panaah maangta hon ke jis shaks ke paas se hamari cheez mili hai, us ko chhor kar kisi aur ko pakar len. Agar hum aisa karen ge to yaqeeni tor par hum zalim hon ge.

Chunanche jab woh yousuf se mayous hogaye to alag ho kar chupke chupke mashwara karne lage. Un sab mein jo bara tha, us ne kaha : kiya tumhein maloom nahin ke tumhare walid ne tum se Allah ke naam par ahad liya tha, aur us se pehle tum yousuf ke maamle mein jo kasoor krchke ho, (woh bhi maloom hai) lihaza mein to us mulk se us waqt tak nahin tlon ga jab tak mere walid mujhe ijazat na den, ya Allah hi mere haqq mein koi faisla farma. Aur wahi sab se behtar faisla karne wala hai.

Jao. Apne walid ke paas wapas jao, aur un se kaho ke : abba jaan ! Aap ke bete ne chori karli thi aur hum ne wahi baat kahi hai jo humare ilm mein aayi hai, aur gaib ki nigehbani to humare bas mein nahin thi.
Aur jis basti mein hum the us se pochh lijiye, aur jis kafile mein hum aaye hain, us se tehqeeq krlijie, yeh bilkul paki baat hai ke hum sache hain.

Chunanche yeh bhai yaqoob (alh alh-e-salam) ke paas gaye, aur un se wahi baat kahi jo bare bhai ne skhaii thi) yaqoob ne (yeh sunn kar) kaha : nahin, bulke tumhare dilon ne apni taraf se ek baat bana li hai. Ab to mere liye sabar hi behtar hai, kuchh baeed nahin ke Allah mere paas un sab ko le aaye. Be-shak us ka ilm bhi kamil hai, hikmat bhi kamil.
Aur (yeh keh kar) unhon ne moonh phirlia, aur kehne lage : haaye yousuf ! Aur un ki dono aankhein sdme se (rote rote) safaid prgii thin, aur woh dil hi dil mein ghte jate the.
Un ke bete kehne lage : Allah ki qasam ! Aap yousuf ko yaad karna nahin choren ge, yahan tak ke bilkul gahala kar reh jayen ge, ya halaak ho bethen ge.
Yaqoob ne kaha : mein apne ranj o ghum ki faryad (tum se nahin) sirf Allah se karta hon, aur Allah ke bare mein jitna mein jaanta hon, tum nahin jante.
Mere bito ! Jao, aur yousuf aur us ke bhai ka kuchh sragh lagao, aur Allah ki rehmat se na-umeed na ho. Yaqeen jaano, Allah ki rehmat se wahi log na-umeed hote hain jo kafir hain.

Chunanche jab woh yousuf ke paas pahunche to unhon ne (yousuf se) kaha : ae aziz ! Hum par aur humare ghar walon par sakht museebat pari hui hai, aur hum ek mamooli si poonji le kar aaye hain, aap humein poora poora ghla de dijiye, aur Allah ke liye hum par ehsan kijiye, yaqeenan Allah apni khatir ehsan karne walon ko bara ajar ata farmata hai.
Yousuf ne kaha : tumhein kuchh pata hai ke tum jab jahalat mein mubtila the to tum ne yousuf aur us ke bhai ke saath kya kya tha ?

(us par) woh bol utahe : are kya tum hi yousuf ho ? Yousuf ne kaha : mein yousuf hon, aur yeh mera bhai hai. Allah ne hum par bara ehsan farmaya hai. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke jo shaks taqwa aur sabar se kaam leta hai, to Allah neki karne walon ka ajar zaya nahin karta.
Unhon ne kaha : Allah ki qasam ! Allah ne tum ko hum par tarjeeh di hai, aur hum yaqeenan khata kaar the.
Yousuf bole : aaj tum par koi malamat nahin hogi, Allah tumhein maaf kare, woh sare reham karne walon se barh kar reham karne wala hai.
Mera yeh kamees le jao, aur use mere walid ke chehre par daal dena, us se un ki binayi wapas aajaye gi, aur apne sare ghar walon ko mere paas le aao.

Aur jab yeh qafila (misr se kanaan ki taraf) roana hua to un ke walid ne (kanaan mein aas paas ke logon se) kaha ke : agar tum mujhe yeh na kaho ke boorha sthia gaya hai, to mujhe to yousuf ki khusboo aarahi hai.
Logon ne kaha : Allah ki qasam ! Aap abhi tak apni purani galat fehmi mein pare hue hain.

Phir jab khushkhabri dene wala pahunch gaya to us ne (yousuf ki) kamees un ke moonh par daal di, aur fora un ki binayi wapas aagaee. Unhon ne (apne beton se) kaha : kya mein ne tum se nahin kaha tha ke Allah ke bare mein jitna mein jaanta hon, tum nahin jante ?
Woh kehne lage : abba jaan ! Aap humare gunahon ki bakhsish ki dua frmaiie. Hum yaqeenan bare khata kaar the.
Yaqoob ne kaha : mein anqareeb apne Parwardigar se tumhari bakhsish ki dua karoon ga. Be-shak wahi hai jo bohat bakhshne wala, bara meharban hai.
Phir jab yeh sab log yousuf ke paas pahunche to unhon ne apne walidain ko apne paas jagah di, aur sab se kaha ke : aap sab misr mein dakhil hojayen, jahan ansha Allah sab chain se rahen ge.

Aur unhon ne apne walidain ko takht par bthaia, aur woh sab un ke samne sajde mein grpre, aur yousuf ne kaha : abba jaan ! Yeh mere purane khuwab ki tabeer hai jise mere Parwardigar ne sach kar dkhaia, aur us ne mujh par bara ehsan farmaya ke mujhe qaid khane se nikal diya, aur aap logon ko dihat se yahan le aaya. Halaanke us se pehle shetan ne mere aur mere bhaiyon ke darmiyan fasaad daal diya tha, haqeeqat yeh hai ke mera Parwardigar jo kuchh chahta hai, us ke liye bari lateef tadbeerein karta hai. Be-shak wahi hai jis ka ilm bhi kamil hai, hikmat bhi kamil.

Mere Parwardigar ! To ne mujhe hukumat se bhi hissa ata farmaya, aur mujhe tabeer khuwab ke ilm se bhi nawaza. Aasmanon aur zameen ke paida karne wale ! To hi duniya aur aakhirat mein mera rkhoala hai. Mujhe us halat mein duniya se athana ke mein tera farmanbardar hon, aur mujhe nek logon mein shamil karna.

(ae payghumbar) yeh tamam waqa gaib ki khabron ka ek hissa hai jo hum tumhein wahee ke zariye bata rahe hain, aur tum us waqt un (yousuf ke bhaiyon) ke paas maujood nahin the jab unhon ne saazish kar ke apna faisla pukhta karliya tha (ke yousuf ko kuwein mein dalen ge) .
Us ke bawajood aksar log iman lane wale nahin hain, chahaye tumhara kaisa hi dil chahta ho.
Halaanke tum un se us (tableeg) par koi ujrat nahin maangte. Yeh to duniya jahaan ke sab logon ke liye bas ek naseehat ka paygham hai.
Aur aasmanon aur zameen mein kitni hi nishaniyan hain jin par un ka guzar hota rehta hai, magar yeh un se moonh mor jate hain.
Aur un mein se aksar log aise hain ke Allah par iman rakhte bhi hain to us tarah ke woh us ke saath shirk bhi karte jate hain.
Bhala kya un logon ko us baat ka zara darr nahin hai ke Allah ke azab ki koi bula aaker un ko lapet le, ya un par qayamat achanak toot pare aur unhein pehle se ehsaas bhi na ho ?

(ae payghumbar) keh do ke : yeh mera raasta hai, mein bhi poori baseerat ke saath Allah ki taraf bulata hon, aur jinhon ne meri pairwi ki hai woh bhi, aur Allah (har qasam ke sharr se) pak hai, aur mein un logon mein se nahin hon jo Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek thehrate hain.

Aur hum ne tum se pehle jo Rasool bheje woh sab mukhtalif bastiyon mein basne wale insan hi the jin par hum wahee bhejte the. To kya un logon ne zameen mein chal phir kar yeh nahin dekha ke un se pehle ki qaumon ka anjaam kaisa hua ? Aur aakhirat ka ghar yaqeenan un logon ke liye kahin behtar hai jinhon ne taqwa ikhtiyar kya. Kya phir bhi tum aqal se kaam nahin lete ?

(pichle anbiya ke saath bhi yehi hua ke un ki qaumon par azab aane mein kuchh dair lagi) yahan tak ke jab payghumbar logon se mayous hogaye aur kafir log yeh samajhne lage ke unhein jhooti dhamkiyan di gayi thin to un payghumbaron ke paas hamari madad pahunch gayi (yani kafiron par azab aaya) aur jin ko hum chahte the, unhein bacha liya gaya, aur jo log mujrim hote hain, un se humare azab ko taala nahin sakta.

Yaqeenan un ke waqiyaat mein aqal o hosh rakhne walon ke liye bara ibrat ka samaan hai. Yeh koi aisi baat nahin hai jo jhoot moot gahara li gayi ho, bulke us se pehle jo kitabein chuki hain un ki tasdeeq hai, aur har baat ki wazahat aur jo log iman layein un ke liye hidayat aur rehmat ka samaan.
Alif Laam Meem Raa

Allah woh hai jis ne aise sutuno ke baghair aasmanon ko buland kiya jo tumhein nazar aaskin, phir us ne arsh par astoa farmaya aur suraj aur chand ko kaam par laga diya har cheez ek moyyen miyad tak ke liye rawan doan hai. Wahi tamam kaamon ki tadbeer karta hai, wahi un anshanion ko khol khol kar biyan karta hai, taake tum us baat ka yaqeen karlo ke (ek din) tumhein apne Parwardigar se jaa milna hai

Aur wahi zaat hai jis ne yeh zameen philaii, us mein pahar aur darya banaye, aur us mein har qasam ke phlon ke do do jore paida kiye. Woh din ko raat ki chadr arha deta hai. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke un saari baaton mein un logon ke liye nishaniyan hain jo gaur o fikr karen.

Aur zameen mein mukhtalif qte hain jo paas paas waqiye hue hain aur angoor ke baagh aur khetiyan aur khajoor ke darakht hain, jin mein se kuchh dhre tane wale hain, aur kuchh ekehre tane wale. Sab ek hi pani se sairaab hote hain, aur hum un mein se kisi ko zaiqe mein dusre par foqiyat de dete hain. Yaqeenan un sab baaton mein un logon ke liye nishaniyan hain jo aqal se kaam len.

Aur agar tumhein (un kafiron par) tajjub hota hai to un ka yeh kehna (waqayi) ajeeb hai ke : kya jab hum mitti hojayen ge to kya sach much hum naye sire se paida hon ge ? Yeh woh log hain jinhon ne apne rubb (ki qudrat) ka inkar kya hai, aur yehi woh log hain jin ke galon mein toq pare hue hain aur woh dozakh ke basi hain. Woh hamesha usi mein rahen ge.

Aur yeh log khushali (ki miyad khatam hone) se pehle tum se badh-haali ki jaldi mchaie hue hain halaanke un se pehle aise azab ke waqiyaat guzar chuke hain jis ne logon ko ruswa kar dala tha. Aur yeh haqeeqat hai ke logon ke liye un ki zyadati ke bawajood tumhare rubb ki zaat ek maaf karne wali zaat hai, aur yeh bhi haqeeqat hai ke us ka azab bara sakht hai.

Aur jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai woh kehte hain ke : bhala un par (yani aanhzrt (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) par) un ke rubb ki taraf se koi moajiza kyun nahin utara gaya ? (ae payghumbar) baat yeh hai ke tum to sirf khatre se hoshiyaar karne wale ho, aur har qaum ke liye koi na koi aisa shaks hua hai jo hidayat ka raasta dikahyega.
Jis kisi mada ko jo hamal hota hai, Allah us ko bhi jaanta hai, aur maaon ke reham mein jo koi kami beshi hoti hai us ko bhi, aur har cheez ka us ke haan ek andaza muqarrar hai.
Woh gayab o hazir tamam baaton ka janne wala hai, us ki zaat bohat bari hai, us ki shaan bohat unchi.
Tum mein se koi chupke se baat kare ya zoar se, koi raat ke waqt chhpa hua ho, ya din ke waqt chal phir raha ho, woh sab (Allah ke ilm ke lihaz se) barabar hain.

Har shaks ke aage aur peechhe woh nigraan (farishte) muqarrar hain jo Allah ke hukum se bari bari us ki hifazat karte hain yaqeen jaano ke Allah kisi qaum ki halat us waqt tak nahin badalta jab tak woh khud apne halaat mein tabdili na le aaye. Aur jab Allah kisi qaum par koi aafat lane ka arada krlita hai to us ka talna mumkin nahin, aur aise logon ka khud us ke siwa koi rkhoala nahin sakta.
Wahi hai jo tumhein bijli ki chamak dikhlata hai jis se tumhein (us ke girne ka) darr bhi lagta hai, aur (baarish ki) umeed bhi bandhti hai aur wahi (pani se) lade hue badal athata hai.

Aur baadalon ki garaj usi ki tasbeeh aur hamd karti hai aur us ke rob se farishte bhi (tasbeeh mein lage hue hain) aur wahi krkti hui bijliyan bhejta hai. Phir jis par chahta hai unhein museebat bana kar gira deta hai, aur un (kafiron) ka haal yeh hai ke Allah hi ke bare mein behasein kar rahe hain, halaanke us ki taqat bari zabardast hai.

Wahi hai jis se dua karna barhaqq hai. Aur us ko chhor kar yeh log jin (diotan) ko pukarte hain woh un ki duaon ka koi jawab nahin dete, albatta un ki misal us shaks ki si hai jo pani ki taraf apne dono haath pehla kar yeh chahaye ke pani khud us ke moonh tak pahunch jaye, halaanke woh kabhi khud moonh tak nahin pahunch sakta. Aur (buthon se) kafiron ke dua karne ka nateeja us ke siwa kuchh nahin ke woh bhtkti hi phrti rahe.
Aur woh Allah hi hai jis ko aasmanon aur zameen ki saari makhlooqat sajda karti hain, kuchh khushi se, kuchh majboori se, aur un ke saaye bhi subah o shaam us ke aage sajda raiz hote hain.

(ae payghumbar ! Un kafiron se) kaho ke : woh kaun hai jo aasmanon aur zameen ki perwerish karta hai ? Kaho ke : woh Allah hai ! Kaho ke : kya phir bhi tum ne us ko chhor kar aise kaarsaaz bana liye hain jinhen khud apne aap ko bhi na koi faida pahunchane ki qudrat hasil hai na nuksan pahunchane ki ? Kaho ke : kya andha aur dekhne wala barabar sakta hai ? Ya kya andheriyan aur roshni ek jaisi sakti hain ? Ya un logon ne Allah ke aise shareek maane hue hain jinhon ne koi cheez usi tarah paida ki ho jaise Allah paida karta hai, aur us wajah se un ko dono ki takhleeq ek jaisi maloom horhi ho ? (agar koi us galat fehmi mein mubtila hai to us se) keh do ke : sirf Allah har cheez ka khaliq hai, aur woh tanha hi aisa hai ke us ka iqtedar sab par haawi hai.

Usi ne aasman se pani barsaya jis se nadi nale apni apni bshat ke mutabiq beh pare, phir pani ke raile ne phole hue jhaag ko upar atha liya, aur usi qasam ka jhaag us waqt bhi athta hai jab log zewar ya bartan banane ke liye dhaton ko aag par tapate hain. Allah haqq aur baatil ki misal usi tarah biyan kar raha hai ke (dono qasam ka) jo jhaag hota hai woh to bahar gir kar zaya hojata hai, lekin woh cheez jo logon ke liye faida mand hoti hai woh zameen mein thehar jati hai. Usi qasam ki tamseelein hain jo Allah biyan karta hai.

Bhalayi unhi logon ke hisse mein hai jinhon ne apne rubb ka kehna maana hai aur jinhon ne us ka kehna nahin maana, agar un ke paas duniya bhar ki saari cheezen bhi hon gi, bulke itni hi aur bhi, to woh (qayamat ke din) apni jaan bachane ke liye woh sab kuchh dene ko tayyar hojayen ge. Un logon ke hisse mein buri tarah ka hisab hai, aur un ka thikana jahannam hai aur woh bohat bura thikana hai.

Jo shaks yeh yaqeen rakhta ho ke tum par tumhare Parwardigar ki taraf se jo kuchh nazil hua hai, barhaqq hai, bhala woh us jaisa kaise sakta hai jo bilkul andha ho ? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke naseehat to wahi log qabool karte hain jo aqal o hosh rakhte hon.
(yani) woh log jo Allah se kiye hue ahad ko poora karte hain, aur muhaide ki khilaf warzi nahin karte.
Aur jin rishton ko Allah ne jore rakhne ka hukum diya hai, yeh log unhein jore rakhte hain, aur apne par wrgar se darte hain, aur hisab ke bure anjaam se khof kahate hain.

Aur yeh woh log hain jinhon ne apne rubb ki khushnudi ki khatir sabar se kaam liya hai, aur namaz qayam ki hai aur hum ne unhein jo rizq ata farmaya hai, us mein se khfia bhi aur lania bhi kharch kiya hai, aur woh badhsulooki ka dfa husn sulook se karte hain, watan asli mein behtareen anjaam un ka hissa, .

Yani hamesha rehne ke liye woh baghaat jin mein woh khud bhi dakhil hon ge, aur un ke baap dadon, biwiyon aur aulad mein se jo nek hon ge woh bhi, aur (un ke isteqbal ke liye) farishte un ke paas har darwaze se (yeh kehte hue) dakhil hon ge.
Ke tum ne (duniya mein) jo sabar se kaam liya tha, us ki badaulat ab tum par salamati hi salamati nazil hogi, aur (tumhare) asli watan mein yeh tumhara behtareen anjaam hai.

Aur (dusri taraf) jo log Allah se kiye hue ahad ko mazbooti se bandhne ke baad torte hain aur jin rishton ko Allah ne jore rakhne ka hukum diya hai, unhein kaat daalte hain, aur zameen mein fasaad machate hain, to aise logon ke hisse mein laanat aati hai, aur asli watan mein bura anjaam unhi ka hai.

Allah jis ke liye chahta hai rizq mein wusat kardyta hai, aur (jis ke liye chahta hai) tangi kardyta hai, yeh (kafir) log dunyawi zindagi par magan hain, halaanke aakhirat ke muqable mein dunyawi zindagi ki haisiyat us se ziyada nahin ke woh mamooli si poonji hai.

Aur jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai, woh yeh kehte hain ke un par (yani Muhammad (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) par) un ke Parwardigar ki taraf se koi nishani kyun nahin utari gayi ? Keh do ke : Allah jis ko chahta hai, gumraah kardyta hai aur apne raaste par unhi ko laata hai jo us ki taraf rujoo karen.
Yeh woh log hain jo iman laye hain aur jin ke dil Allah ke zikr se itminaan hasil karte hain. Ya drkho ke sirf Allah ka zikr hi woh cheez hai jis se dilon ko itminaan naseeb hota hai.
(garz) jo log iman laye hain aur jinhon ne nek amal kiye hain, un ke hisse mein khush haali bhi hai aur behtareen anjaam bhi.

(ae payghumbar ! Jis tarah dusre Rasool bheje gaye the) usi tarah hum ne tumhein ek aisi ummat mein Rasool bana kar bheja hai jis se pehli bohat si ummaten guzar chuki hain, taake tum un ke samne woh kitab parh kar suna do jo hum ne wahee ke zariye tum par nazil ki hai, aur yeh log us zaat ki shukri kar rahe hain jo sab par meharban hai, keh do ke : woh mera paalne wala hai, us ke siwa koi ibadat ke layaq nahin hai. Usi par mein ne bharosa kar rakhha hai, aur usi ki taraf mujhe lot kar jana hai.

Aur agar koi quran aisa bhi utarta hai jis ke zariye pahar apni jagah se hata diye jate ya us ki badaulat zameen shaqq kardi jati (aur us se darya nikal parte) ya us ke natije mein mardon se baat karli jati, (tab bhi yeh log iman na late) . Haqeeqat to yeh hai ke tamam tar ikhtiyar Allah ka hai. Kya phir bhi iman walon ne yeh soch kar apna zehan faarig nahin kya ke agar Allah chahta to sare hi insano ko (zabardasti) raah par le aata ? Aur jinhon ne kufr apnaia hai un par to un ke kartoot ki wajah se hamesha koi na koi kahara khrane wali museebat parti rehti hai, ya un ki basti ke qareeb kahin nazil hoti rehti hai, yahan tak ke (ek din) Allah ne jo wada kar rakhha hai woh aaker poora hojaye ga. Yaqeen rakho ke Allah wade ki khilaf warzi nahin karta.

Aur (ae payghumbar) haqeeqat yeh hai ke tum se pehle payghumbaron ka bhi mazaq uraya gaya tha, aur aise kafiron ko bhi mein ne mohlat di thi magar kuchh waqt ke baad mein ne un ko giraft mein le liya, ab dekh lo ke mera azab kaisa tha ?

Bhala batao ke ek taraf woh zaat hai jo har har shaks ke har har kaam ki nigrani kar rahi hai, aur dusri taraf un logon ne Allah ke saath shareek maane hue hain ? Kaho ke : zara un (khuda ke shareekon) ke naam to batao (agar koi naam lo ge) to kya Allah ko kisi aise wajood ki khabar do ge jis ka duniya bhar mein Allah ko bhi pata nahin hai ? Ya khali zubaan se aise naam le lo ge jin ke peechhe koi haqeeqat nahin ? Haqeeqat to yeh hai ke un kafiron ko apni makkarana baatein bari khoobsurat lagti hain aur (us tarah) un ki hidayat ke raaste mein rukawat paida hogaee hai. Aur jise Allah gumrahi mein para rehne de, use koi raah par lane wala muyassar nahin sakta.
Aise logon ke liye dunyawi zindagi mein bhi azab hai aur yaqeenan aakhirat ka azab kahin ziyada bhari hoga, aur koi nahin hai jo unhein Allah (ke azab) se bacha sake.

(dusri taraf) woh jannat jis ka muttaqi logon se wada kiya gaya hai us ka haal yeh hai ke us ke niche nehrein behti hain, us ke pahala bhi sada bahaar hain, aur us ki chahaon bhi ! Yeh anjaam hai un logon ka jinhon ne taqwa ikhtiyar kiya, jabke kafiron ka anjaam dozakh ki aag hai.

Aur (ae payghumbar) jin logon ko hum ne kitab di hai, woh us kalaam se khush hote hain jo tum par nazil kiya gaya hai, aur unhi girohon mein woh bhi hain jo us ki baaz baaton ka maanne se inkar karte hain. Keh do ke : mujhe to yeh hukum diya gaya hai ke mein Allah ki ibadat karoon, aur us ke saath kisi ko khudayi mein shareek na manon, usi baat ki mein dawat deta hon, aur usi (Allah) ki taraf mujhe lot kar jana hai, .
