Us ke sathi ne us se baatein karte hue kaha : kya tum us zaat ke saath kufr ka mamla kar rahe raho jis ne tumhein mitti se, aur phir nutfe se paida kya, phir tumhein ek bhala changa insan banadiya ?
Jahan tak mera talluq hai, mein to yeh qida rakhta hon ke Allah mera Parwardigar hai, aur mein apne Parwardigar ke saath kisi ko shareek nahin maanta.

Aur jab tum apne baagh mein dakhil horahe the, us waqt tum ne yeh kyun nahin kaha ke masha Allah laqo illa balla ! (jo Allah chahta hai, wahi hota hai, Allah ki tofiq ke baghair kisi mein koi taqat nahin) . Agar tumhein yeh nazar aaraha hai ke meri daulat aur aulad tum se kam hai.
To mere rubb se kuchh baeed nahin hai ke woh mujhe tumhare baagh se behtar cheez ata farma, aur tumhare us baagh par koi aasmani aafat bhej de, jis se woh chukne maidan mein tabdeel ho kar reh jaye.
Ya us ka pani zameen mein utar jaye, phir tum use talash bhi na krsko.

Aur (phir hua yeh ke) us ki saari daulat azab ke ghire mein aagaee, aur subah hui to us halat mein ke us ne baagh par jo kuchh kharch kiya tha, woh us par haath milta reh gaya, jabke us ka baagh apni tattiyon par gira para tha, aur woh keh raha tha : kaash ! Mein ne apne rubb ke saath kisi ko shareek na maana hota.
Aur use koi aisa jataha muyassar na aaya jo Allah ko chhor kar us ki madad karta, aur na woh khud us qabil tha ke apna dfa karsake.
Aise mauqa par (aadmi ko pata chalta hai ke) madad ka sara ikhtiyar sache Allah ko hasil hai. Wahi hai jo behtar sawab deta aur behtar anjaam dikhata hai.

Aur un logon se dunyawi zindagi ki yeh misal bhi biyan kardo ke woh aisi hai jaise hum ne aasman se pani barsaya, to us se zameen ka sbza khoob ghna hogaya, phir woh aisa riza riza hua ke use hawayen ura le jati hain. Aur Allah har cheez par mukammal qudrat rakhta hai.
Maal aur aulad dunyawi zindagi ki zeenat hain, aur jo nekiyan payedaar rehne wali hain, woh tumhare rubb ke nazdeek sawab ke aitbaar se bhi behtar hain, aur umeed wabasta karne ke liye bhi behtar.

Aur (us din ka dhyaan rakho) jis din hum paharon ko chalayenge. Aur tum zameen ko dekho ge ke woh khuli pari hai, aur hum un sab ko ghir kar aktha karden ge, aur un mein se kisi ek ko bhi nahin choren ge.

Aur sab ko tumhare rubb ke samne saff bandh kar pesh kiya jaye ga. Aakhir tum humare paas usi tarah aagaye jis tarah hum ne tumhein pehli baar paida kiya tha. Us ke baraks tumhara doi yeh tha ke hum tumhare liye (yeh) muqarrar waqt kabhi nahin layein ge.

Aur (aemaal ki) kitab samne rakaha di jaye gi. Chunanche tum mujreemon ko dekho ge ke woh us ke mndrjat se khof zadah hain, aur keh rahe hain ke : haaye hamari barbadi ! Yeh kaisi kitab hai jis ne hamara koi chhota bara amal aisa nahin chhora jis ka poora ahata na karliya ho. Aur woh apna sara kiya dhara apne samne maujood payen ge. Aur tumhara Parwardigar kisi par koi zulm nahin kare ga.

Aur woh waqt yaad karo jab hum ne farishton se kaha tha ke : adam ke aage sajda karo. Chunanche sab ne sajda kya, siwaye iblees ke woh jinnat mein se tha, chunanche us ne apne rubb ke hukum ki nafarmani ki. Kya phir bhi tum mere bajaye use aur us ki zrit ko apna rkhoala banate ho. Halaanke woh sab tumhare dushman hain ? (Allah taalaa ka) kitna bura mtbadl hai jo zalimon ko mila hai.
Mein ne na aasmanon aur zameen ki takhleeq ke waqt un ko hazir kiya tha, na khud un ko paida karte waqt, aur mein aisa nahin hon ke gumraah karne walon ko dast wbazo banaoon.

Aur us din ka dhyaan karo jab Allah (un mushrikon se) kahe ga ke : zara pukaro un ko jinhen tum ne meri khudayi mein shareek samajh rakhha tha. Chunanche woh pukaren ge, lekin woh un ko koi jawab nahin den ge, aur hum un ke darmiyan ek mahalak aarr hayal karden ge.
Aur mujrim log aag ko dekhen ge to samajh jayen ge ke unhein usi mein girna hai, aur us se bach nikalne ka koi raasta nahin payen ge.
Aur hum ne logon ke faiyde ke liye us tarah quran mein tarah tarah se har qasam ke mazameen biyan kiye hain, aur insan hai ke jhagra karne mein har cheez se barh gaya hai.

Aur jab logon ke paas hidayat chuki to ab unhein iman lane aur apne rubb se maafi maangne se us (mutalibe) ke siwa koi aur cheez nahin rok rahi ke un ke saath bhi pichle logon jaise waqiyaat pesh aajayen, ya azab un ke bilkul samne aakhra ho.

Aur hum payghumbaron ko sirf us liye bhejte hain ke woh (momino ko) khushkhabri den, aur (kafiron ko azab se) mutanabbeh karen. Aur jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai woh baatil ka sahara le kar jhagra karte hain, taake us ke zariye haqq ko dagmaga den, aur unhon ne meri aayaton ko aur unhein jo tanbeeh ki gayi thi us ko mazaq bana rakhha hai.

Aur us shaks se barh kar zalim kaun hoga jise us ke rubb ki aayaton ke hawale se naseehat ki jaye, to woh un se moonh mor le, aur apne haathon ke kartoot ko bhala bithe ? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke hum ne (un logon ke kartoot ki wajah se) un ke dilon par gilaf charha diye hain jin ki wajah se woh us (quran) ko nahin samajhte, aur un ke kaano mein daat laga di hai. Aur agar tum unhein hidayat ki taraf bulao, tab bhi woh sahih raaste par hargiz nahin aayein ge.

Aur tumhara Parwardigar bohat bakhshne wala, bara rehmat wala hai. Jo kamayi unhon ne ki hai, agar woh us ki wajah se unhein pakarne par aata to un ko jald hi azab de deta, lekin un ke liye ek waqt muqarrar hai, jis se bachne ke liye unhein koi panaah gaah nahin mile gi.
Yeh saari bastiyan (tumhare samne) hain, jab unhon ne zulm ki rawish apnaii to hum ne un ko halaak kar dala, aur un ki halakat ke liye (bhi) hum ne ek waqt muqarrar kiya hua tha.

Aur (us waqt ka zikr suno) jab musa ne apne no-jawan (shagrd) se kaha tha ke : mein us waqt tak apna safar jari rakhoon ga jab tak do samandaron ke sanagahm par na pahunch jaon, wrna barson chalta rahoon ga.
Chunanche jab woh un ke sanagahm par pahunche to dono apni machli ko bhool gaye, aur us ne samandar mein ek surang ki tarah ka raasta bana liya.
Phir jab dono aage nikal gaye, to musa ne apne no-jawan se kaha ke : hamara nashta lao, sachi baat yeh hai ke humein us safar mein bari thkaot lahiq hogaee hai.

Us ne kaha : bhala bataiye ! (ajeeb qsa hogaya) jab hum us chattan par thehre the to mein machli (ka aap se zikr karna) bhool gaya. Aur shetan ke siwa koi nahin hai jis ne mujh se us ka tzkra karna bhala ya ho, aur us (machli) ne to bare ajeeb tareeqe par darya mein apni raah le li thi.
Musa ne kaha : usi baat ki to humein talash thi. Chunanche dono apne qadmon ke nishan dekhte hue wapas lote.
Tab unhein humare bandon mein se ek banda mila jis ko hum ne apni khsosi rehmat se nawaza tha, aur khaas apni taraf se ek ilm skhaia tha.
Musa ne un se kaha : kya mein aap ke saath us garz se reh sakta hon ke aap ko bhalayi ka jo ilm ata hua hai, us ka kuchh hissa mujhe bhi skha den ?
Unhon ne kaha : mujhe yaqeen hai ke aap mere saath rehne par sabar nahin krskin ge.
Aur jin baaton ki aap ko poori poori nawaqifiyat nahin hai, un par aap sabar kar bhi kaise sakte hain ?
Musa ne kaha : ansha Allah aap mujhe saabir payen ge, aur mein aap ke kisi hukum ki khilaf warzi nahin karoon ga.
Unhon ne kaha : achha ! Agar aap mere saath chalte hain to jab tak mein khud hi aap se kisi baat ka tzkra shuroo na karoon, aap mujh se kisi bhi cheez ke bare mein sawal na karen.

Chunanche dono roana hogaye, yahan tak ke jab dono ek kashti mein sawar hue to un sahib ne kashti mein chhid kardiya. Musa bole : are kya aap ne us mein chhid kardiya taake sare kashti walon ko dobo dalen ? Yeh to aap ne bara khaufnaak kaam kya.
Unhon ne kaha : kya mein ne kaha nahin tha ke aap mere saath reh kar sabar nahin krskin ge ?
Musa ne kaha : mujh se jo bhool hogaee, us par meri giraft na kijiye, aur mere kaam ko ziyada mushkil na bnaie.

Woh dono phir roana hogaye, yahan tak ke un ki mulaqat ek larke se hui to un sahib ne use qatal kar dala. Musa bol utahe : are kya aap ne ek pakeeza jaan ko halaak kardiya, jabke us ne kisi ki jaan nahin li thi, jis ka badla us se liya jaye ? Yeh to aap ne bohat hi bura kaam kya.
Unhon ne kaha : kya mein ne aap se nahin kaha tha ke aap mere saath rehne par sabar nahin krskin ge ?
Musa bole : agar ab mein aap se koi baat puchoon to aap mujhe apne saath na rkhie. Yaqeenan aap meri taraf se uzur ki hadd ko pahunch gaye hain.

Chunanche woh dono phir roana hogaye, yahan tak ke jab ek basti walon ke paas pahunche to us ke bashindon se khana maanga to un logon ne un ki mehmani karne se inkar kardiya. Phir unhein wahan ek deewar mili jo gira hi chahati thi, un sahib ne use khra kardiya. Musa ne kaha : agar aap chahte to us kaam par kuchh ujrat le lete.
Unhon ne kaha : lijiye mere aur aap ke darmiyan judaee ka waqt aagaya. Ab mein aap ko un baaton ka maqsad bataye deta hon jin par aap se sabar nahin hoska.

Jahan tak kashti ka talluq hai woh kuchh gareeb aadmiyon ki thi jo darya mein mazdoori karte the, mein ne chaha ke us mein koi aib paida kardoon, (kyunke) un ke aage ek baadshah tha jo har (achhi) kashti ko zabardasti chhin kar rakaha liya karta tha.
Aur larke ka mamla yeh tha ke us ke man baap momin the, aur humein us baat ka andesha tha ke yeh larka un dono ko sarkashi aur kufr mein na phnsa de.
Chunanche hum ne yeh chaha ke un ka Parwardigar unhein us larke ke badle aisi aulad de jo pakeezgi mein bhi us se behtar ho, aur husn sulook mein bhi us se barhi hui ho.

Rahi yeh deewar, to woh us shehar mein rehne wale do yateem larkon ki thi, aur us ke niche un ka ek khazana gra hua tha, aur un dono ka baap ek nek aadmi tha. Us liye aap ke Parwardigar ne yeh chaha ke yeh dono larke apni jawani ki umar ko pahunchenge, aur apna khazana nikal len. Yeh sab kuchh aap ke rubb ki rehmat ki bana par hua hai, aur mein ne koi kaam apni raye se nahin kiya. Yeh tha maqsad un baaton ka jin par aap se sabar nahin hoska.
Aur yeh log tum se zul-qarnain ke bare mein puchte hain. Keh do ke : mein un ka kuchh haal tumhein parh kar sunata hon.
Waqa yeh hai ke hum ne un ko zameen mein iqtedar baksha tha, aur unhein har kaam ke wasail ata kiye the.
Jis ke natije mein woh ek raaste ke peechhe chal pare.

Yahan tak ke jab woh suraj ke doobne ki jagah pahunche to unhein dkhaii diya ke woh ek daldal jaise (siyah) chashme mein doob raha hai. Aur wahan unhein ek qaum mili. Hum ne (un se) kaha : ae zul-qarnain ! (tumhare paas do raaste hain) ya to un logon ko saza do , ya phir un ke maamle mein achha roia ikhtiyar karo.
Unhon ne kaha : un mein se jo koi zulm ka raasta ikhtiyar kare ga, use to hum saza den ge, phir use apne rubb ke paas pahuncha diya jaye ga, aur woh use sakht azab de ga.
Albatta jo koi iman laye ga, aur nek amal kare ga to woh badle ke tor par achhe anjaam ka mustahiq hoga, aur hum bhi us ko apna hukum dete waqt aasani ki baat kahin ge.
Us ke baad woh ek aur raaste ke peechhe chal pare.
Yahan tak ke jab woh suraj ke tulu hone ki jagah pahunche to unhon ne dekha ke woh ek aisi qaum par tulu horha hai jise hum ne us (ki dhoop) se bachne ke liye koi oat muhaiyya nahin ki thi.
Waqa usi tarah hua, aur zul-qarnain ke paas jo kuchh (sazosaman) tha, humein us ki poori poori khabar thi.
Us ke baad woh ek aur raaste ke peechhe chal pare.
Yahan tak ke jab woh do paharon ke darmiyan pahunche to unhein un paharon se pehle kuchh log mile jin ke bare mein aisa lagta tha ke woh koi baat nahin samajhte.

Unhon ne kaha : ae zul-qarnain ! Yaajuj aur maajuj us zameen mein fasaad philane wale log hain. To kya hum aap ko kuchh maal ki pesh kash krskte hain, jis ke badle aap humare aur un ke darmiyan koi deewar banadein ?

Zul-qarnain ne kaha : Allah ne mujhe jo iqtedar ata farmaya hai, wahi (mere liye) behtar hai. Lihaza tum log (haath paon ki) taqat se meri madad karo, to mein tumhare aur un ke darmiyan ek mazboot deewar bana doon ga.

Mujhe lohe ki chadarein lado, yahan tak ke jab unhon ne (darmiyani khala ko paat kar) dono phari siron ko ek dusre se mila diya to kaha ke : ab aag dehkao, yahan tak ke jab us (deewar) ko laal angara kardiya to kaha ke : pigla hua tanbaa lao, ab mein us par undailunga.
Chunanche (woh deewar aisi bann gayi ke) yaajuj maajuj na us par charhne ki taqat rakhte the, aur na us mein koi soorakh bana sakte the.

Zul-qarnain ne kaha : yeh mere rubb ki rehmat hai (ke us ne aisi deewar banane ki tofiq di) phir mere rubb ne jis waqt ka wada kiya hai jab woh waqt aaye ga to woh us (deewar) ko dha kar zameen ke barabar karde ga, aur mere rubb ka wada bilkul sacha hai.
Aur us din hum un ki yeh halat karden ge ke woh maujon ki tarah ek dusre se tkra rahe hon ge, aur soor phonka jaye ga to hum sab ko ek saath jama karlen ge.
Aur us din hum dozakh ko un kafiron ke samne khuli aankhon le aayein ge.
Jin ki aankhon par (duniya mein) meri naseehat ki taraf se purda para hua tha, aur jo sunne ki salahiyat nahin rakhte the.

Jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai, kya woh phir bhi yeh samajhte hain ke mujhe chhor kar mere hi bandon ko apna rkhoala bnalin ge ? Yaqeen rakho ke hum ne aise kafiron ki mehmani ke liye dozakh tayyar kar rkhi hai.
Keh do ke : kya hum tumhein batayein ke kaun log hain jo apne aemaal mein sab se ziyada nakaam hain ?
Yeh woh log hain ke dunyawi zindagi mein un ki saari dor dhoop seedhe raaste se bhatki rahi, aur woh samajhte rahe ke woh bohat achha kaam kar rahe hain.

Yeh wahi log hain jinhon ne apne maalik ki aayaton ka aur us ke samne pesh hone ka inkar kiya, us liye un ka sara kiya dhara ghaarat hogaya. Chunanche qayamat ke din hum un ka koi wazan shumar nahin karen ge.
Yeh hai jahannam ki shakal mein un ki saza, kyunke unhon ne kufr ki rawish ikhtiyar ki thi, aur meri aayaton aur mere payghumbaron ka mazaq banaya tha.
(dusri taraf) jo log iman laye hain, aur jinhon ne nek amal kiye hain, un ki mehmani ke liye be-shak firdous ke baagh hon ge.
Jin mein woh hamesha rahen ge (aur) woh wahan se kahin aur jana nahin chahein ge.

(ae payghumbar logon se) keh do ke : agar mere rubb ki baatein likhne ke liye samandar roshnayi bann jaye, to mere rubb ki baatein khatam nahin hon gi ke us se pehle samandar khushk hochka hoga, chahaye us samandar ki kami poori karne ke liye hum waisa hi ek aur samandar kyun na le aayein.

Keh do ke : mein to tumhi jaisa ek insan hon (albatta) mujh par yeh wahee aati hai ke tum sab ka khuda bas ek khuda hai. Lihaza jis kisi ko apne maalik se jamlne ki umeed ho, use chahiye ke woh nek amal kare, aur apne maalik ki ibadat mein kisi aur ko shareek na thehraye.
Kaaf Haa Yaa Ain Saad
Yeh tzkra hai us rehmat ka jo tumhare Parwardigar ne apne bande zakriya par ki thi.
Yeh us waqt ki baat hai jab unhon ne apne Parwardigar ko aahista aahista aawaz se pukara tha.
Unhon ne kaha tha ke : mere Parwardigar ! Meri haddiyan kamzor prgii hain, aur sar burhape ki sfidi se bharak atha hai, aur mere Parwardigar ! Mein aap se dua maang kar kabhi na-murad nahin hua.
Aur mujhe apne baad apne chchazad bhaiyon ka andesha laga hua hai. Aur meri biwi baanjh hai, lihaza aap khaas apne paas se mujhe ek aisa waris ata krdijie.
Jo mera bhi waris ho, aur yaqoob (alh alh-e-salam) ki aulad se bhi miras paye. Aur ya rubb ! Use aisa bnaie jo (khud aap ka) pasandeeda ho.
(aawaz aayi ke) ae zakriya ! Hum tumhein ek aise larke ki khushkhabri dete hain jis ka naam yhi hoga. Us se pehle hum ne us ke naam ka koi aur shaks paida nahin kiya.
Zakriya ne kaha : mere Parwardigar ! Mere yahan larka kis tarah paida hoga jabke meri biwi baanjh hai, aur mein burhape se us haal ko pahunch gaya hon ke mera jism sokh chuka hai.
Kaha : haan ! Aisa hi hoga. Tumhare rubb ne farmaya hai ke yeh to mere liye mamooli baat hai, aur us se pehle mein ne tumhein paida kiya tha jab tum kuchh bhi nahin the.
Zakriya ne kaha : mere Parwardigar ! Mere liye koi nishani muqarrar farma dijiye. Farmaya : tumhari nishani yeh hai ke tum sahata mand hone ke bawajood teen raat tak logon se baat nahin krsko ge.
Chunanche woh ibadat gaah se nikal kar apni qaum ke samne aaye, aur un ko ishare se hidayat di ke tum log subah o shaam Allah ki tasbeeh kiya karo.
(phir jab yhi paida ho kar bare hogaye to hum ne un se farmaya) ae yhi ! Kitab ko mazbooti se tham lo. Aur hum ne bachpan hi mein un ko danaee bhi ata kardi thi.
Aur khaas apne paas se naram dili aur pakeezgi bhi. Aur woh bare perhezgar the.
Aur apne walidain ke khidmat guzar ! Na woh sirkash the, na nafarman.
Aur (Allah taalaa ki taraf se) salam hai un par us din bhi jis roz woh paida hue, us din bhi jis roz unhein maut aaye gi, aur us din bhi jis roz unhein zinda kar ke dobara utahaya jaye ga.
Aur us kitab mein marium ka bhi tzkra karo. Us waqt ka tzkra jab woh apne ghar walon se alaheda ho kar us jagah chali gaeen jo mashriq ki taraf waqe tha.
Phir unhon ne un logon ke aur apne darmiyan ek purda daal liya. Us mauqa par hum ne un ke paas apni rooh (yani ek farishte) ko bheja jo un ke samne ek mukammal insan ki shakal mein zaahir hua.
Marium ne kaha : mein tum se khuda Rahman ki panaah maangti hon. Agar tum mein khuda ka khof hai (to yahan se hatt jao)
Farishte ne kaha : mein to tumhare rubb ka bheja hua (farishta) hon (aur us liye aaya hon) taake tumhein ek pakeeza larka doon.
Marium ne kaha : mere larka kaise hojaye ga, jabke mujhe kisi bashar ne chhoa tak nahin hai, aur na mein koi badhkaar aurat hon ?

Farishte ne kaha : aise hi hojaye ga. Tumhare rubb ne farmaya hai ke : yeh mere liye ek mamooli baat hai. Aur hum yeh kaam us liye karen ge taake us larke ko logon ke liye (apni qudrat ki) ek nishani banayen. Aur apni taraf se rehmat ka mzahra karen aur yeh baat poori tarah tai hochuki hai.
Phir hua yeh ke marium ko us bache ka hamal thehar gaya (aur jab wiladat ka waqt qareeb aaya) to woh us ko le kar logon se alag ek door muqaam par chali gaeen.
Phir zachgi ke dard ne unhein ek khajoor ke darakht ke paas pahuncha diya. Woh kehne lagen : kaash ke mein us se pehle hi mrgii hoti, aur marr kar bhooli bisri hojati.
Phir farishte ne un ke niche ek jagah se unhein aawaz di ke : ghum na karo, tumhare rubb ne tumhare niche ek chashma paida kardiya hai.
Aur khajoor ke tane ko apni taraf hla, us mein se paki hui taza khajoorein tum par jhrin gi.

Ab kha, aur piyo, aur aankhein thandi rakho. Aur agar logon mein se kisi ko aata dekho to (ishare se) keh dena ke : aaj mein ne khuda Rahman ke liye ek roze ki manata maani hai, us liye mein kisi bhi insan se baat nahin karoon gi.
Phir woh us bache ko athaie hue apni qaum ke paas aayein woh kehne lage ke : marium tum ne to bara gazab dha diya.
Ae haroon ki behan na to tumhara baap koi bura aadmi tha, na tumhari man koi badhkaar aurat thi.
Us par marium ne us bache ki taraf ashara kya. Logon ne kaha : bhala hum us se kaise baat karen jo abhi paalne mein para hua bcha hai ?
(us par) bcha bol atha ke : mein Allah ka banda hon, us ne mujhe kitab di hai, aur nabi banaya hai.
Aur jahan bhi mein rahoon, mujhe ba-barkat banaya hai, aur jab tak zinda rahoon, mujhe namaz aur zakat ka hukum diya hai.
Aur mujhe apni walda ka farmanbardar banaya hai, aur mujhe sirkash aur sangh dil nahin banaya.
Aur (Allah ki taraf se) salamati hai mujh par us din bhi jab mein paida hua, aur us din bhi jis din mein maroon ga, aur us din bhi jab mujhe dobara zinda kar ke utahaya jaye ga.
Yeh hain essa bann marium ! Un (ki haqeeqat) ke bare mein sachi baat yeh hai jis mein log jhagar rahe hain.
Allah ki yeh shaan nahin hai ke woh koi beta banaye, us ki zaat pak hai. Jab woh kisi baat ka faisla krlita hai to bas us se yeh kehta hai ke hoja. Chunanche woh ho jati hai.
Aur (ae payghumbar ! Logon se keh do ke :) yaqeenan Allah mera bhi Parwardigar hai aur tumhara bhi Parwardigar, us liye us ki ibadat karo, yehi seedha raasta hai.
Phir bhi un mein se mukhtalif girohon ne ikhtilaf daal diya hai, chunanche jis din yeh ek zabardast din ka mushahida karen ge, us din un ki bari tabahi hogi jinhon ne kufr ka irteqab kiya hai.
Jis roz yeh humare paas aayein ge us din yeh kitne sunne wale aur dekhne wale bann jayen ge. Lekin yeh zalim aaj khuli gumrahi mein pare hue hain.
Aur (ae payghumbar) un ko us pachtawe ke din se draie jab har baat ka aakhri faisla hojaye ga, jabke yeh log (us waqt) gaflat mein hain, aur iman nahin larhe.
Yaqeen jaano ke zameen aur us par sare rehne walon ke waris hum hi hon ge, aur hamari taraf hi un sab ko lotaya jaye ga.
Aur us kitab mein Ibrahim ka bhi tzkra karo. Be-shak woh sacchayi ke khugar nabi the.
Yaad karo jab unhon ne apne baap se kaha tha ke : abba jaan ! Aap aisi cheezon ki kyun ibadat karte hain jo na sunti hain, na dekhti hain, aur na aap ka koi kaam krskti hain ?
Abba jaan ! Mere paas ek aisa ilm aaya hai jo aap ke paas nahin aaya, us liye meri baat maan lijiye, mein aap ko seedha raasta batla doon ga.
Abba jaan ! Shetan ki ibadat na kijiye yaqeen janie ke shetan khuda Rahman ka nafarman hai.
Abba jaan ! Mujhe andesha hai ke khuda Rahman ki taraf se aap ko koi azab na pakre, jis ke natije mein aap shetan ke sathi bann kar reh jayen.
Un ke baap ne kaha : Ibrahim ! Kya tum mere khudaon se bezaar ho ? Yaad rakho, agar tum baaz na aaye to mein tum par pathar brsan ga, aur ab tum hamesha ke liye mujh se door hojao.
Ibrahim ne kaha : mein aap ko (rukhsat ka) salam karta hon. Mein apne Parwardigar se aap ki bakhsish ki dua karoon ga. Be-shak woh mujh par bohat meharban hai.

Aur mein aap logon se bhi alag hota hon, aur Allah ko chhor kar aap log jin jin ki ibadat karte hain, un se bhi, aur mein apne Parwardigar ko pukarta rahoon ga. Mujhe poori umeed hai ke apne rubb ko pukar kar mein na-murad nahin rahoon ga.
Chunanche jab woh un se aur un (buthon) se alag hogaye jinhen woh Allah ke bajaye pukara karte the, to hum ne unhein ashaq aur yaqoob (jaisi aulad) bakshi, aur un mein se har ek ko nabi banaya.
Aur un ko apni rehmat se nawaza, aur unhein unche darje ki nek naami ata ki.
Aur us kitab mein musa ka bhi tzkra karo. Be-shak woh Allah ke chune hue bande the, aur Rasool aur nabi the.
Hum ne unhein koh tor ki dayen janib se pukara aur unhein apna raaz daar bana kar apna qurb ata kiya.
Aur hum ne un ke bhai haroon ko nabi bana kar apni rehmat se unhein (ek madadgar) ata kiya.
Aur us kitab mein ismail ka bhi tzkra karo. Be-shak woh wade ke sache the aur Rasool aur nabi the.
Aur woh apne ghar walon ko bhi namaz aur zakat ka hukum diya karte, aur apne Parwardigar ke nazdeek pasandeeda the.
Aur us kitab mein idris ka bhi tzkra karo, be-shak woh sacchayi ke khugar nabi the.
Aur hum ne unhein rafata de kar ek buland muqaam tak pahuncha diya tha

Adam ki aulad mein se yeh woh nabi hain jin par Allah ne inam farmaya, aur un mein se kuchh un logon ki aulad mein se hain jin ko hum ne nooh ke saath (kashti mein) sawar kiya tha, aur kuchh Ibrahim aur israel (yaqoob (alh alh-e-salam)) ki aulad mein se hain. Aur yeh sab un logon mein se hain jin ko hum ne hidayat di, aur (apne deen ke liye) muntakhab kiya. Jab un ke samne khuda Rahman ki aayaton ki tilawat ki jati to yeh rote hue sajde mein grjate the.
Phir un ke baad aise log un ki jagah aaye jinhon ne namazon ko barbaad kiya, aur apni nafsani khwahishat ke peechhe chale. Chunanche un ki gumrahi bohat jald un ke samne aajaye gi.
Albatta jin logon ne toubah karli, aur iman le aaye, aur nek amal kiye to aise log jannat mein dakhil hon ge, aur un par zara bhi zulm nahin hoga.

(un ka daakhila) aise hamesha baqi rehne wale baghaat mein (hoga) jin ka khuda Rahman ne apne bandon se un ke dikhe baghair wada kar rakhha hai. Yaqeenan us ka wada aisa hai ke yeh us tak zaroor pahunchenge.
Woh us mein salamati ki baaton ke siwa koi laghaw baat nahin sunen ge. Aur wahan un ka rizq unhein subah o shaam mila kare ga.
Yeh hai woh jannat jis ka waris hum apne bandon mein se us ko banayen ge jo muttaqi ho.

Aur (farishte tum se yeh kehte hain ke) hum aap ke rubb ke hukum ke baghair utar kar nahin aate. Jo kuchh humare aage hai aur jo kuchh humare peechhe hai aur jo kuchh un ke darmiyan hai, woh sab usi ki milkiyat hai. Aur tumhara rubb aisa nahin hai jo bhool jaya kare.

Woh aasmanon aur zameen ka bhi maalik hai, aur jo makhlooqat un ke darmiyan hain, un ka bhi, lihaza tum us ki ibadat karo, aur us ki ibadat par jame raho. Kya tumhare ilm mein koi aur hai jo us jaisi siffat rakhta ho ?
Aur (kafir) insan yeh kehta hai ke : jab mein mrchka hon ga to kya waqayi us waqt mujhe zinda kar ke nikala jaye ga ?
Kya us insan ko yeh baat yaad nahin aati ke hum ne use shuroo mein us waqt paida kya tha jab woh kuchh bhi nahin tha ?
To qasam hai tumhare Parwardigar ki ! Hum un ko aur un ke saath sare shetanon ko zaroor aktha karen ge, phir un ko dozakh ke gird us tarah le kar aayein ge ke yeh sab ghutno ke bal gire hue hon ge.
Phir un ke har giroh mein se un logon ko khich nikalenge jo khuda Rahman ke saath sarkashi karne mein ziyada sakht the.
Phir yeh baat hum hi khoob jante hain ke woh kaun log hain jo sab se pehle us dozakh mein jhonke jane ke ziyada mustahiq hain.
Aur tum mein se koi nahin hai jis ka us (dozakh) par guzar na ho. Us baat ka tumhare Parwardigar ne htmi tor par zma le rakhha hai.
Phir jin logon ne taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai, unhein to hum nijat de den ge, aur jo zalim hain, unhein us halat mein chhor den ge ke woh us (dozakh mein) ghutno ke bal pare hon ge.

Aur jab un ke samne hamari khuli khuli aayaten tilawat ki jati hain, to kafir log momino se kehte hain ke : batao, hum dono fareeqon mein se kis ka muqaam ziyada behtar hai, aur kis ki majlis ziyada achhi hai ?
Aur (yeh nahin dekhte ke) un se pehle hum kitni nasalein halaak krchke hain, jo apne sazo samaan aur zaahiri aan ban mein un se kahin behtar thin.

Keh do ke : jo log gumrahi mein jaa paren to un ke liye munasib yehi hai ke khuda Rahman unhein khoob dheel deta rahe. Yahan tak ke jab yeh log woh cheez khud dekh len ge jis se unhein daraya jaraha hai, chahaye woh (us duniya ka) azab ho, ya qayamat, to us waqt unhein pata chale ga ke badhtareen muqaam kis ka tha, aur lashkar kis ka ziyada kamzor tha.

Aur jin logon ne seedha raasta ikhtiyar karliya hai, Allah un ko hidayat mein aur taraqqi deta hai. Aur jo nek amal baqi rehne wale hain, un ka badla bhi tumhare Parwardigar ke yahan behtar mile ga, aur un ka (mjmoi) anjaam bhi behtar hoga.
Bhala tum ne us shaks ko bhi dekha jis ne hamari aayaton ko maanne se inkar kiya, aur yeh kaha hai ke : mujhe maal aur aulad (aakhirat mein bhi) zaroor milen ge.
Kya us ne aalam gaib mein jhaank kar dekh liya hai, ya us ne khuda Rahman se koi ahad le rakhha hai ?
Hargiz nahin ! Jo kuchh yeh keh raha hai hum use bhi lakaha rakhen ge, aur us ke azab mein aur azafa karden ge.
Aur jis (maal aur aulad) ka yeh hoala de raha hai, us ke waris hum hon ge, aur yeh humare paas tan-e- tanha aaye ga.
Aur un logon ne Allah ke siwa dusre mabood us liye bana rkhe hain taake woh un ki pusht pnahi karen.
Yeh sab galat baat hai ! Woh to un ki ibadat hi ka inkar karden ge, aur ulte un ke mukhalif hojayen ge.
(ae payghumbar) kya tumhein yeh maloom nahin hai ke hum ne kafiron par shayateen chhor rkhe hain jo unhein barabar uksate rehte hain ?
Lihaza tum un ke maamle mein jaldi na karo, hum to un ke liye ginti gin rahe hain.
(us din ko na bhoolo) jis din hum sare muttaqi logon ko mehmaan bana kar khuda Rahman ke paas jama karen ge.
Aur mujreemon ko pyase jaanwaron ki tarah hanka kar dozakh ki taraf le jayen ge.
Logon ko kisi ki sifarish karne ka ikhtiyar bhi nahin hoga, siwaye un logon ke jinhon ne khuda Rahman se koi ijazat hasil karli ho.
Aur yeh log kehte hain ke khuda Rahman ki koi aulad hai.
(aisi baat kehne walo !) haqeeqat yeh hai ke tum ne bari sangeen harakat ki hai.
Kuchh baeed nahin ke us ki wajah se aasman pahata paren, zameen shaqq hojaye aur pahar toot kar grprin.
Ke un logon ne khuda Rahman ke liye aulad hone ka doi kiya hai.
Halaanke khuda Rahman ki yeh shaan nahin hai ke us ki koi aulad ho.
Aasmanon aur zameen mein jitne log hain, un mein se koi aisa nahin hai jo khuda Rahman ke huzoor banda bann kar na aaye.
Yaqeen rakho ke us ne sab ka ahata kar rakhha hai aur unhein khoob achhi tarah gin rakhha hai.
Aur qayamat ke din mein se ek ek shaks us ke paas akela aaye ga.
(haan) be-shak jo log iman le aaye hain aur unhon ne nek amal kiye hain, khuda Rahman un ke liye dilon mein mohabbat paida karde ga.

Chunanche (ae payghumbar) hum ne us quran ko tumhari zubaan mein aasan banadiya hai taake tum us ke zariye muttaqi logon ko khoshkhbrdi do , aur usi ke zariye un logon ko darao jo zidd ki wajah se jhagre par aamada hain.
Un se pehle hum kitni hi qaumon ko halaak krchke hain. Kya tumhein tatolne se bhi un mein se kisi ka pata milta hai, ya un mein se kisi ki bhanak bhi tumhein sunayi deti hai ?
Taa Haa
Hum ne tum par quran us liye nazil nahin kiya ke tum takleef atha
Albatta yeh us shaks ke liye ek naseehat hai jo darta ho.
Use us zaat ki taraf se thor ae thora kar ke nazil kiya jaraha hai jis ne zameen aur unche unche aasman paida kiye hain.
Woh bari rehmat wala arsh par astoa farmaye hue hai.
Aasmanon aur zameen mein jo kuchh hai aur un ke darmiyan jo kuchh hai woh sab bhi usi ki milkiyat hai, aur zameen ki thon ke niche jo kuchh hai woh bhi.
Agar tum koi baat buland aawaz se kaho (ya aahista) to woh chupke se kahi hui baaton ko, bulke aur ziyada chhpi hui baaton ko bhi jaanta hai.
Allah woh hai jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin, usi ke achhe achhe naam hain.
Aur (ae payghumbar) kya tum tak musa ka waqa pahuncha hai ?

Yeh us waqt ki baat hai jab un ko ek aag nazar aayi to unhon ne apne ghar walon se kaha : tum yahin thehro, mein ne ek aag dikhi hai. Shayad mein us mein se koi shla tumhare paas le aaon, ya us aag ke paas mujhe raaste ka pata mill jaye.
Chunanche jab woh aag ke paas pahunche to unhein aawaz di gayi ke : ae musa .
Yaqeen se jaan lo ke mein hi tumhara rubb hon. Ab tum apne jote utaar do , tum us waqt toi ki muqaddas wadi mein ho.
Aur mein ne tumhein (nabuwat ke liye) muntakhab kiya hai. Lihaza jo baat wahee ke zariye kahi jarhi hai use gaur se suno.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke mein hi Allah hon. Mere siwa koi mabood nahin hai, us liye meri ibadat karo, aur mujhe yaad rakhne ke liye namaz qayam karo.
Yaqeen rakho ke qayamat ki ghri aane wali hai, mein us (ke waqt) ko khfia rakhna chahta hon, taake har shaks ko us ke kiye ka badla mile.
Lihaza koi shaks tumhein us se hargiz ghafil na karne paye jo us par iman na rakhta ho, aur apni khwahishat ke peechhe chalta ho, wrna tum halakat mein prja ge.
Aur musa yeh tumhare dayen haath mein kya hai ?
Musa ne kaha : yeh meri lathi hai, mein us ka sahara leta hon, aur us se apni bakriyon par (darakht se) patte jharta hon, aur us se meri dusri zroriat bhi poori hoti hain.
Farmaya : musa ! Use niche phink do .
Chunanche unhon ne use phink diya. Bas phir kiya tha. Woh achanak ek dorta hua saanp bann gayi.
Allah ne farmaya : use pakar lo, aur daro nahin. Hum abhi use us ki pichli halat par lota den ge.
Aur apne haath ko apni bagal mein dabao, woh kisi beemari ke baghair safaid ho kar nikle ga. Yeh (tumhari nabuwat ki) ek aur nishani hogi.
(yeh hum us liye kar rahe hain) taake apni bari nishaniyon mein se kuchh tumhein dikhayen.
(ab) Firaun ke paas jao. Woh sarkashi mein hadd se nikal gaya hai.
Musa ne kaha : Parwardigar ! Meri khatir mera sina khol dijiye.
Aur mere liye mera kaam aasan bana dijiye.
Aur meri zubaan mein jo girah hai use door krdijie
Taake log meri baat samajh saken.
Aur mere liye mere khandaan hi ke ek fard ko madadgar muqarrar krdijie.
Yani haroon ko jo mere bhai hain.
Un ke zariye meri taqat mazboot krdijie.
Aur un ko mera shareek kaar bana dijiye.
Taake hum kasrat se aap ki tasbeeh karen.
Aur kasrat se aap ka zikr karen.
Be-shak aap humein achhi tarah dekhne wale hain.
Allah ne farmaya : musa ! Tum ne jo kuchh maanga hai tumhein de diya gaya.
Aur hum ne tum par ek aur martaba bhi ehsan kiya tha.
Jab hum ne tumhari man se wahee ke zariye woh baat kahi thi jo ab wahee ke zariye (tumhein) batayi jarhi hai.

Ke us (bache) ko sandook mein rakho, phir us sandook ko darya mein daal do . Phir darya ko chhor do ke woh use sahil ke paas lakr daal de, jis ke natije mein ek aisa shaks us (bache) ko athale ga jo mera bhi dushman hoga, aur us ka bhi dushman. Aur mein ne apni taraf se tum par ek mhbobit nazil kardi thi. Aur yeh sab us liye kiya tha ke tum meri nigrani mein perwerish pao.

Us waqt ka tasavvur karo jab tumhari behan ghar se chalti hai, aur (Firaun ke karndon se) yeh kehti hai ke : kya mein tumhein us (aurat) ka pata bataon jo us (bache) ko pale ? Us tarah hum ne tumhein tumhari man ke paas lota diya, taake us ki aankh thandi rahe, aur woh ghumgeen na ho. Aur tum ne ek shaks ko maar dala tha, phir hum ne tumhein us ghuttan se nijat di, aur tumhein kaee aazmaaishon se guzara. Phir tum kaee saal madiyan walon mein rahe, us ke baad ae musa ! Tum ek aise waqt par yahan aaye ho jo pehle se muqaddar tha.
Aur mein ne tumhein khaas apne liye banaya hai.
Tum aur tumhara bhai dono meri nishaniyan le kar jao, aur mera zikr karne mein susti na karna.
Dono Firaun ke paas jao, woh hadd se aage nikal chuka hai.
Jakr dono us se narmi se baat karna, shayad woh naseehat qabool kare, ya (Allah se) darr jaye.
Dono ne kaha : humare Parwardigar ! Humein andesha hai ke kahin woh hum par zyadati na kare, ya kahin sarkashi par aamada na hojaye.
Allah ne farmaya : daro nahin, mein tumhare saath hon, sunn bhi raha hon, aur dekh bhi raha hon.

Ab us ke paas jao, aur kaho ke hum dono tumhare rubb ke payghumbar hain, us liye bano israel ko humare saath bhej do , aur unhein takleef na phncha, hum tumhare paas tumhare rubb ki taraf se nishani le kar aaye hain, aur salamati usi ke liye jo hidayat ki pairwi kare.
Hum par yeh wahee nazil ki gayi hai ke azab us ko hoga jo (haqq ko) jhutlaye, aur moonh more.
(yeh saari baatein sunn kar) Firaun ne kaha : musa tum dono ka rubb kaun ?
Musa ne kaha : hamara rubb woh hai jis ne har cheez ko woh banawat ata ki jo us ke munasib thi, phir (us ki) rehnumayi bhi farmaee.
Firaun bola : achha phir un qaumon ka kya mamla hua jo pehle guzar chuki hain ?
Musa ne kaha : un ka ilm mere rubb ke paas ek kitab mein mehfooz hai. Mere rubb ko na koi ghalati lagti hai, na woh bhoolta hai

Yeh woh zaat hai jis ne zameen ko tumhare liye farsh banadiya, aur us mein tumhare liye raaste banaye, aur aasman se pani barsaya, phir hum ne us ke zariye tarah tarah ki mukhtalif nabataat nikalenge.
Khud bhi kha, aur apne maweshiyon ko bhi charao, yaqeenan un sab baaton mein aqal walon ke liye bari nishaniyan hain.
Usi zameen se hum ne tumhein paida kiya tha, usi mein hum tumhein wapas le jayen ge, aur usi se ek martaba phir tumhein nikal layein ge.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke hum ne us (Firaun) ko apni saari nishaniyan dikhayen, magar woh jhutlata hi raha, aur maan kar nahin diya.
Kehne laga : musa ! Kya tum us liye aaye ho ke apne jadoo ke zariye humein apni zameen se nikal bahar karo ?
Achha to hum bhi tumhare samne aisa hi jadoo laa kar rahen ge. Ab tum kisi khle maidan mein humare aur apne darmiyan muqable ka aisa waqt tai karlo jis ki khilaf warzi na hum karen, na tum karo.
Musa ne kaha : tum se woh din tai hai jis mein jashn mnaia jata hai. Aur yeh bhi tai hai ke din charhe hi logon ko jama karliya jaye.
Chunanche Firaun (apni jagah) wapas chala gaya, aur us ne apni saari tadbeerein akthi kin, phir (muqable ke liye) aagaya.
Musa ne un (jaadugaron se) kaha : afsos hai tum par ! Allah par bohatan na baandho wrna woh ek sakht azab se tumhein mill ya mait karde ga, aur jo koi bohatan bandhta hai, na-murad hota hai.
Us par un ke darmiyan apni raye qayam karne mein ikhtilaf hogaya, aur woh chupke chupke sargoshiyan karne lage.

(aakhir kaar) unhon ne kaha ke : yaqeeni tor par yeh dono (yani musa aur haroon) jadoogar hain jo yeh chahte hain ke apne jadoo ke zoar par tum logon ko tumhari sar-zameen se nikal bahar karen, aur tumhare behtareen (deeni) tareeqe ka khatma hi kar dalen.
Lihaza apni saari tadbeerein pukhta karlo, phir saff bandh kar aao, aur yaqeen rakho ke aaj jo ghalib aajaye ga, falaah usi ko hasil hogi.
Jadoogar bole : musa ! Ya to tum (apni lathi pehle) daal do , ya phir hum daalne mein pahala karen ?
Musa ne kaha : nahin, tum hi dalo. Bas phir achanak un ki (daali hui) rassiyan aur laathiyan un ke jadoo ke natije mein musa ko aisi mehsoos hone lagen jaise dor rahi hain.
Us par musa ko apne dil mein kuchh khof mehsoos hua.
Hum ne kaha : daro nahin, yaqeen rakho tum hi tum sarabalnd raho ge.

Aur jo (lathi) tumhare dayen haath mein hai, use (zameen par) daal do , un logon ne jo karigari ki hai, woh us sab ko nigal jaye gi, un ki saari karigari ek jadoogar ke kartab ke siwa kuchh nahin, aur jadoogar chahaye kahin chala jaye, use falaah naseeb nahin hoti.
Chunanche (yehi hua aur) sare jadoogar sajde mein gira diye gaye. Kehne lage ke : hum haroon aur musa ke rubb par iman le aaye.

Firaun bola : tum un par mere ijazat dene se pehle hi iman le aaye, mujhe yaqeen hai ke yeh (musa) tum sab ka srghna hai jis ne tumhein jadoo skhlaia hai. Ab mein ne bhi pakka arada karliya hai ke tumhare haath paon mukhalif simton se kaaton ga, aur tumhein khajoor ke tano par sooli charhaon ga. Aur tumhein yaqeenan pata lag jaye ga ke hum dono mein se kis ka azab ziyada sakht aur dairpaa hai.

Jaadugaron ne kaha : qasam us zaat ki jis ne humein paida kiya hai. Humare samne jo roshan nishaniyan aagaee hain un par hum tumhein hargiz tarjeeh nahin de sakte. Ab tumhein jo kuchh karna ho, karlo. Tum jo kuchh bhi karo ge usi dunyawi zindagi ke liye hoga.

Hum to apne rubb par iman lachke hain, taake woh humare gunahon ko bhi baksh de, aur jadoo ke us kaam ko bhi jis par tum ne humein majboor kiya. Aur Allah hi sab se achha aur hamesha baqi rehne wala hai.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke jo shaks apne Parwardigar ke paas mujrim bann kar aaye ga, us ke liye jahannam hai jis mein na woh mare ga aur na jie ga.
Aur jo shaks us ke paas momin bann kar aaye ga jis ne nek amal bhi kiye hon ge, to aise hi logon ke liye buland drjat hain.
Woh hamesha rehne wale baghaat jin ke niche se nehrein behti hon gi, jin mein woh hamesha rahen ge. Aur yeh sla hai us ka jis ne pakeezgi ikhtiyar ki.

Aur hum ne musa par wahee bheji ke : tum mere bandon ko le kar raaton raat roana hojao phir un ke liye samandar mein ek khushk raasta us tarah nikal lena ke na tumhein (dushman ke) pakarne ka andesha rahe, aur na koi aur khof ho
Chunanche Firaun ne apne lashkaron samet un ka pichha kiya to samandar ki jis (khaufnaak) cheez ne unhein dhanpa, woh unhein dhanp kar hi rahi.
Aur Firaun ne apni qaum ko bure raaste par lagaya, aur unhein sahih raasta na dkhaia.
Ae bani israel ! Hum ne tumhein tumhare dushman se nijat di, aur tum se koh tor ke dayen janib aane ka wada thehraya, aur tum par mann wsloi nazil kiya.

Jo pakeeza rizq hum ne tumhein ata kiya hai us mein se kha, aur us mein sarkashi na karo jis ke natije mein tum par mera gazab nazil hojaye. Aur jis kisi par mera gazab nazil hojata hai woh tabahi mein gir kar rehta hai.
Aur yeh bhi haqeeqat hai ke jo shaks toubah kare, iman laye, aur nek amal kare, phir seedhe raaste par qayam rahe to mein us ke liye bohat bakhshne wala hon.
Aur (jab musa koh tor par apne logon se pehle chale aaye to Allah ne un se kaha) musa ! Tum apni qaum se pehle jaldi kyun aagaye ?
Unhon ne kaha : woh mere peechhe peechhe aaya hi chahte hain, aur Parwardigar ! Mein aap ke paas us liye jaldi aagaya taake aap khush hon.
Allah ne farmaya : phir tumhare aane ke baad hum ne tumhari qaum ko fitne mein mubtila kardiya hai, aur unhein saamri ne gumraah kar dala hai.

Chunanche musa ghum o gusse mein bhare hue apni qaum ke paas wapas lote. Kehne lage : meri qaum ke logo ! Kya tumhare Parwardigar ne tum se ek achha wada nahin kya tha ? To kya tum par koi bohat lambi muddat guzar gayi thi, ya tum chahte hi yeh the ke tum par tumhare rubb ka gazab nazil hojaye, aur us wajah se tum ne mujh se wada khilafi ki ?

Kehne lage : hum ne apne ikhtiyar se aap ke wade ki khilaf warzi nahin ki, bulke hua yeh ke hum par logon ke zewraat ke bojh lade hue the, us liye hum ne unhein phink diya. Phir usi tarah saamri ne kuchh dala
Aur logon ke samne ek bachra bana kar nikal laya, ek jism tha jis mein se aawaz nikalti thi. Log kehne lage ke : yeh tumhara mabood hai aur musa ka bhi mabood hai, magar musa bhool gaye hain.
Bhala kya unhein yeh nazar nahin aaraha tha ke woh na un ki baat ka jawab deta tha aur na un ko koi nuksan ya nafa pahuncha sakta tha ?

Aur haroon ne un se pehle hi kaha tha ke : meri qaum ke logo ! Tum us (bachre) ki wajah se fitne mein mubtila hogaye ho, aur haqeeqat mein tumhara rubb to Rahman hai, us liye tum mere peechhe chalo aur meri baat mano
Woh kehne lage ke : jab tak musa wapas na aajayen, hum to usi ki ibadat par jame rahen ge.
Musa ne (wapas aaker) kaha : haroon ! Jab tum ne dekh liya tha ke yeh log gumraah hogaye hain to tumhein kis cheez ne roka tha.
Ke tum mere peechhe chale aate ? Bhala kya tum ne meri baat ki khilaf warzi ki ?

Haroon ne kaha : mere man ke bete ! Meri darhi na pakro, aur na mera sar. Haqeeqat mein mujhe yeh andesha tha ke tum yeh kaho ge ke tum ne bani israel mein tafarqa daal diya, aur meri baat ka paas nahin kiya.
Musa ne kaha : achha to saamri ! Tujhe kya hua tha ?

Woh bola : mein ne ek aisi cheez dekh li thi jo dusron ko nazar nahin aayi thi. Us liye mein ne Rasool ke nakshe qadam se ek mthi athali, aur use (bachre par) daal diya. Aur mere dil ne mujhe kuchh aisa hi samjhaya.

Musa ne kaha : achha to jaa, ab zindagi bhar tera kaam yeh hoga ke to logon se yeh kaha kare ga ke mujhe na chhona. Aur (us ke laoa) tere liye ek wade ka waqt muqarrar hai jo tujh se tlaia nahin sakta. Aur dekh apne us (jhoote) mabood ko jis par to jamaa bitha tha ! Hum use jila dalen ge, aur phir us (ki rakh) ko choora choora kar ke samandar mein bikhair den ge.
Haqeeqat mein tum sab ka mabood to bas ek hi Allah hai, jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin hai. Us ka ilm har cheez ka ahata kiye hue hai.
(ae payghumbar) mazi mein jo halaat guzre hain un mein se kuchh waqiyaat hum usi tarah tum ko sunate hain, aur hum ne tumhein khaas apne paas se ek naseehat nama ata kiya hai.
Jo log us se moonh moren ge, to woh qayamat ke din bara bhari bojh lade hon ge.
Jis (ke azab) mein woh hamesha rahen ge, aur qayamat ke din un ke liye yeh badhtareen bojh hoga.
Jis din soor phonka jaye ga, aur us din hum sare mujreemon ko ghir kar us tarah jama karen ge ke woh nile pare hon ge.
Aapas mein sargoshiyan kar rahe hon ge ke tum (qabron mein ya duniya mein) dus din se ziyada nahin thehre.
Jis bare mein woh baatein karen ge us ki haqeeqat humein khoob maloom hai. Jabke un mein se jis ka tareeqa sab se behtar hoga, woh kahe ga ke tum ek din se ziyada nahin thehre .
Aur log tum se paharon ke bare mein puchte hain (ke qayamat mein un ka kya bane ga ?) jawab mein keh do ke mera Parwardigar un ko dhool ki tarah ura de ga.
Aur zameen ko aisa humwaar chatiyal maidan bana kar chhore ga.
Ke us mein tumhein na koi bal nazar aaye ga, na koi ubhar.

Un din sab ke sab munadi ke peechhe us tarah chale aayein ge ke us ke samne koi terh nahin dkha saken ge. Aur khuda Rahman ke aage tamam aawazen dub kar reh jayen gi, chunanche tumhein paon ki sar-sarahat ke siwa kuchh sunayi nahin de ga.
Us din kisi ki sifarish kaam nahin aaye gi, siwaye us shaks (ki sifarish) ke jise khuda Rahman ne ijazat de di ho, aur jis ke bolne par woh razi ho.
Woh logon ki saari agli pichli baaton ko jaanta hai, aur woh us ke ilm ka ahata nahin krskte.
Aur sare ke sare chehre hi wqiom ke aage jhuke hon ge, aur jo koi zulm ka bojh lad kar laya hoga na-murad hoga.
Aur jis ne nek amal kiye hon ge jabke woh momin bhi ho to use na kisi zyadati ka andesha hoga, na kisi haqq talafi ka.

Aur hum ne usi tarah yeh wahee ek arabi quran ki shakal mein nazil ki hai, aur us mein tnbihat ko tarah tarah se biyan kiya hai, taake log perhezgari ikhtiyar karen, ya yeh quran un mein kuchh soch samajh paida kare.

Aisi hi unchi shaan hai Allah ki, jo sultanat ka haqeeqi maalik hai. Aur (ae payghumbar) jab quran wahee ke zariye nazil horha ho to us ke mukammal hone se pehle quran parhne mein jaldi na kiya karo. Aur yeh dua karte raha karo ke : mere Parwardigar ! Mujhe ilm mein aur taraqqi ata farma.
Aur hum ne us se pehle adam ko ek baat ki takeed ki thi, phir un se bhool hogaee, aur hum ne un mein azam nahin paya.
Yaad karo woh waqt jab hum ne farishton se kaha tha ke adam ko sajda karo, chunanche sab ne sajda kiya, albatta iblees tha jis ne inkar kiya.
Chunanche hum ne kaha ke : ae adam ! Yeh tumhara aur tumhari biwi ka dushman hai, lihaza aisa na ho ke yeh tum dono ko jannat se nikalwa de, aur tum mushakkat mein prja.
Yahan to tumhein yeh faida hai ke na tum bhuke hoge, na nange.
Aur na yahan pyase raho ge, na dhoop mein tpo ge.
Phir shetan ne un ke dil mein wsosa dala. Kehne laga : ae adam ! Kya mein tumhein ek aisa darakht bataon jis se jaodani zindagi aur woh baadshahi hasil hojati hai jo kabhi purani nahin parti ?

Chunanche un dono ne us darakht mein se kuchh khalia jis se un dono ke sharm ke muqamaat un ke samne kahala gaye, aur woh dono jannat ke patton ko apne upar ganthne lage. Aur (us tarah) adam ne apne rubb ka kaha taala, aur bhatak gaye.
Phir un ke rubb ne unhein chun liya, chunanche un ki toubah qabool farmaee, aur unhein hidayat ata farmaee.

Allah ne farmaya : tum dono ke dono yahan se niche utar jao, tum ek dusre ke dushman hoge phir agar tumhein meri taraf se koi hidayat pahunche to jo koi meri hidayat ki pairwi kare ga, woh na gumraah hoga, aur na kisi mushkil mein giraftar hoga.
Aur jo meri naseehat se moonh more ga to us ko bari tangg zindagi mile gi, aur qayamat ke din hum use andha kar ke athaiin ge.
Woh kahe ga ke : ya rubb ! To ne mujhe andha kar ke kyun utahaya, halaanke mein to aankhon wala tha ?
Allah kahe ga : usi tarah hamari aayaten tere paas aayi thin, magar to ne unhein bhala diya. Aur aaj usi tarah tujhe bhala diya jaye ga.

Aur jo shaks hadd se guzar jata hai, aur apne Parwardigar ki nishaniyon par iman nahin laata, use hum usi tarah saza dete hain, aur aakhirat ka azab waqayi ziyada sakht aur ziyada dair rehne wala hai.

Phir kya un logon ko us baat ne bhi koi hidayat ka sabaq nahin diya ke un se pehle kitni nasalein thin jinhen hum ne halaak kardiya, jin ki bastiyon mein yeh log chalte phrte bhi hain ? Yaqeenan jin logon ke paas aqal hai, un ke liye us baat mein ibrat ke bare samaan hain.
Aur agar tumhare rubb ki taraf se ek baat pehle hi tai na kardi gayi hoti, aur (us ke natije mein azab ki) ek miyad muqarrar na hoti, to laazmi tor par azab (un ko) chimat chuka hota.

Lihaza (ae payghumbar) yeh log jo baatein karte hain, tum un par sabar karo, aur suraj nikalne se pehle aur us ke ghuroob se pehle apne rubb ki tasbeeh aur hamd karte raho, aur raat ke auqat mein bhi tasbeeh karo, aur din ke kinaron mein bhi, taake tum khush hojao.

Aur dunyawi zindagi ki us bahaar ki taraf aankhein atha kar bhi na dekho jo hum ne un (kafiron) mein se mukhtalif logon ko maze urane ke liye de rkhi hai, taake hum un ko us ke zariye aazmayein. Aur tumhare rubb ka rizq sab se behtar aur sab se ziyada dairpaa hai.
Aur apne ghar walon ko namaz ka hukum do , aur khud bhi us par saabit qadam raho. Hum tum se rizq nahin chahte rizq to hum tumhein den ge aur behtar anjaam taqwa hi ka hai.
Aur yeh log kehte hain ke : yeh (nabi) humare paas apne rubb ki taraf se koi nishani kyun nahin le aate ? Bhala kya un ke paas pichle (aasmani) saheefon ke mazameen ki gawahi nahin aagaee ?

Aur agar hum unhein us (quran) se pehle un ko kisi azab se halaak kardete to yeh log kehte ke : humare Parwardigar ! Aap ne humare paas koi payghumbar kyun nahin bheja, taake hum zaleel aur ruswa hone se pehle aap ki aayaton ki pairwi karte ?

(ae payghumbar un se) keh do ke : (hum) sab intezar kar rahe hain, lihaza tum bhi intezar karo, kyunke anqareeb tumhein pata chal jaye ga ke seedhe raaste wale log kaun hain, aur kaun hain jo hidayat paagaye hain ?
Logon ke liye un ke hisab ka waqt qareeb aaphncha hai, aur woh hain ke gaflat ki halat mein moonh phire hue hain.
Jab kabhi un ke Parwardigar ki taraf se naseehat ki koi naee baat un ke paas aati hai to woh use mazaq bana bana kar us halat mein sunte hain.

Ke un ke dil fzoliat mein munhamik hote hain. Aur yeh zalim chupke chupke (ek dusre se) sirgoshi karte hain ke : yeh shaks (yani Muhammad (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) tumhi jaisa ek insan nahin to aur kya hai ? Kya phir bhi tum sojhte boojhte jadoo ki baat sunne jao ge ?
Payghumbar ne (jawab mein) kaha ke : aasman aur zameen mein jo kuchh kaha jata hai, mera Parwardigar us sab ko jaanta hai. Woh har baat sunta hai, har cheez se bakhabar hai.

Yehi nahin bulke un logon ne yeh bhi kaha ke : yeh (quran) bejor khwabon ka majmooa hai, bulke yeh un sahib ne khud gahara liya hai, bulke yeh ek shayar hain. Bhala yeh humare samne koi nishani to le aayein jaise pichle payghumbar (nishaniyon ke saath) bheje gaye the.
Halaanke un se pehle jis kisi basti ko hum ne halaak kya, woh iman nahin layi, ab kya yeh log le aayein ge ?

Aur (ae payghumbar) hum ne tum se pehle kisi aur ko nahin, aadmiyon hi ko Rasool bana kar bheja tha jin par hum wahee nazil karte the. Lihaza (kafiron se kaho ke) agar tumhein khud ilm nahin hai to naseehat ka ilm rakhne walon se pochh lo.
Aur hum ne un (rasoolon) ko aise jism bana kar paida nahin kardiya tha ke woh khana na kahate hon, aur na woh aise the ke hamesha zinda rahen.
Phir hum ne un se jo wada kiya tha use sacha kar dkhaia ke un ko bhi bacha liya, aur (un ke laoa) jin ko hum ne chaha un ko bhi, aur jo log hadd se guzar chuke the, unhein halaak kardiya.
(ab) hum ne tumhare paas ek aisi kitab utari hai jis mein tumhare liye naseehat hai. Kya phir bhi tum nahin samajhte ?
Aur hum ne kitni bastiyon ko pees dala jo zalim thin aur un ke baad hum ne dusri nasalein paida kin.
Chunanche jab unhon ne humare azab ki aahat payi to woh ek dum wahan se bhagne lage.
(un se kaha gaya) bhago mat, aur wapas jao, apne unhi makanaat aur usi aish o aish-o-ishrat ke samaan ki taraf jis ke maze tum lot rahe the, shayad tum se kuchh pochha jaye.
Woh kehne lage : haaye hamari kam bakhti ! Sachi baat hai ke hum log hi zalim the.
Un ki yehi pukar jarhi rahi yahan tak ke hum ne un ko ek kati hui khiti, ek bujhi hui aag bana kar rakaha diya.
Aur hum ne aasman, zameen aur jo kuchh un ke darmiyan hai, us ko us liye paida nahin kiya ke hum koi khil karna chahte hon.
Agar humein koi khil banana hota to hum khud apne paas se bana lete, agar humein aisa karna hi hota.
Bulke hum to haqq baat ko baatil par khench maarte hain, jo us ka sar tor daalta hai, aur woh ek dum mill ya mait hojata hai. Aur jo baatein tum bana rahe ho, un ki wajah se kharabi tumhari hi hai.
Aur aasmanon aur zameen mein jo log bhi hain, Allah ke hain. Aur jo (farishte) Allah ke paas hain, woh na us ki ibadat se sarkashi karte hain, na thakte hain.
Woh raat din us ki tasbeeh karte rehte hain, aur sust nahin parte.
Bhala kya un logon ne zameen mein se aise khuda bana rkhe hain jo naee zindagi dete hain ?
Agar aasman aur zameen mein Allah ke siwa dusre khuda hote to dono darhum barhum hojate. Lihaza arsh ka maalik Allah un baaton se bilkul pak hai jo yeh log banaya karte hain.
Woh jo kuchh karta hai us ka kisi ko jawab da nahin hai, aur un sab ko jawab dahi karni hogi.

Bhala kya use chhor kar unhon ne dusre khuda bana rkhe hain ? (ae payghumbar) un se kaho ke : lao apni daleel ! Yeh (quran) bhi maujood hai jis mein mere saath walon ke liye naseehat hai, aur woh (kitabein) bhi maujood hain jin mein mujh se pehle logon ke liye naseehat thi. Lekin waqa yeh hai ke un mein se aksar log haqq baat ka yaqeen nahin karte, us liye moonh more hue hain.
Aur tum se pehle hum ne koi aisa Rasool nahin bheja jis par hum ne yeh wahee nazil na ki ho ke : mere siwa koi khuda nahin hai, lihaza meri ibadat karo.
Yeh log kehte hain ke : khuda Rahman (farishton ki shakal mein) aulad rakhta hai. Subhan Allah ! Bulke (farishte to Allah ke) bande hain jinhen izzat bakshi gayi hai.
Woh us se aage barh kar koi baat nahin karte, aur woh usi ke hukum par amal karte hain.
Woh un ki tamam agli pichli baaton ko jaanta hai aur woh kisi ki sifarish nahin krskte, siwaye us ke jis ke liye Allah ki marzi ho, aur woh us ke khof se shme rehte hain.
Aur agar un mein se koi (bil-farz) yeh kahe ke : Allah ke laoa mein bhi mabood hon. To us ko hum jahannam ki saza den ge. Aise zalimon ko hum aisi hi saza dete hain.

Jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai, kya unhein yeh maloom nahin hai ke sare aasman aur zameen bandh the, phir hum ne unhein khol diya. Aur pani se har jaandaar cheez paida ki hai ? Kya phir bhi yeh iman nahin layein ge ?
Aur hum ne zameen mein jame hue pahar paida kiye hain taake woh unhein le kar hlne na paye, aur us mein hum ne chore chore raaste banaye hain, taake woh manzil tak pahunch saken.
Aur hum ne aasman ko ek mehfooz chhat banadiya hai, aur yeh log hain ke us ki nishaniyon se moonh more hue hain.
Aur wahi (Allah) hai jis ne raat aur din aur suraj aur chand paida kiye, sab kisi na kisi madaar mein teer rahe hain.
Aur (ae payghumbar) tum se pehle bhi hamesha zinda rehna hum ne kisi fard bashar ke liye tai nahin kya. Chunanche agar tumhara intiqal hogaya to kya yeh log aise hain jo hamesha zinda rahen ?
Har jaan daar ko maut ka mza chakhna hai. Aur hum tumhein aazmane ke liye buri bhali haalaton mein mubtila karte hain, aur tum sab humare paas hi lota kar laye jao ge.

Aur jin logon ne kufr apna rakhha hai, woh jab tumhein dekhte hain to us ke siwa un ka koi kaam nahin hota ke woh tumhara mazaq banane lagte hain (aur kehte hain) kya yehi sahib hain jo tumhare khudaon ka zikr kya karte hain ? (yani yeh kehte hain ke un ki koi haqeeqat nahin) halaanke un (kafiron) ki apni halat yeh hai ke woh khuda Rahman hi ka zikr karne se inkar kiye bithe hain.
Insan jald baazi ki kahasalt le kar paida hua hai. Mein anqareeb tumhein apni nishaniyan dikhla doon ga, lihaza tum mujh se jaldi mat machao
Aur yeh log (musalmanon se) kehte hain ke : agar tum sache ho to aakhir yeh (azab ki) dhamki kab poori hogi ?
Kaash un kafiron ko us waqt ki kuchh khabar lag jati jab yeh na apne chehron se aag ko door krskin ge, aur na apni pushton se, aur na un ko koi madad muyassar aaye gi.
Bulke woh (aag) un ke paas ek dum aadhmke gi, aur un ke hosh o hawaas ghum kar ruke rakaha de gi, phir na yeh use peechhe hata saken ge, aur na unhein koi mohlat di jaye gi.
Aur (ae payghumbar) tum se pehle bhi payghumbaron ka mazaq uraya gaya tha, phir un ka mazaq banane walon ko usi cheez ne aaghira jis ka woh mazaq uraya karte the.
Keh do ke : kaun hai jo raat mein aur din mein khuda Rahman (ke azab se) se tumhara bachao kare ? Magar woh hain ke apne Parwardigar ke zikr se moonh more hue hain.
Bhala kya un ke paas humare siwa koi aise khuda hain jo un ki hifazat karte hon ? Woh to khud apni madad nahin krskte aur na humare muqable mein koi un ka saath de sakta hai.

Bulke mamla yeh hai ke hum ne un ko aur un ke aabaajdad ko samaan aish ata kya, yahan tak ke (usi halat mein) un par ek umar guzar gayi. Bhala kya unhein yeh nazar nahin aata ke hum zameen ko us ke mukhtalif kinaron se ghtate chale aarahe hain. Phir kya woh ghalib aajayen ge ?
Keh do ke : mein to tumhein wahee ke zariye darata hon, lekin behre log aise hain ke jab unhein daraya jata hai to woh koi pukar nahin sunte.
Aur agar tumhare Parwardigar ke azab ka ek jhonka bhi unhein chho jaye to yeh keh athin ge ke : haaye hamari kam bakhti ! Waqayi hum log zalim the.

Aur hum qayamat ke din aisi trazoin laa rakhen ge jo sarapa insaf hon gi, chunanche kisi par koi zulm nahin hoga. Aur agar koi amal rai ke daane ke barabar bhi hoga, to hum use samne le aayein ge, aur hisab lene ke liye hum kafi hain.
Aur hum ne musa aur haroon ko haqq o baatil ka ek miar (hidayat ki) ek roshni aur un muttaqi logon ke liye naseehat ka samaan ata kiya tha.
Jo dikhe baghair apne Parwardigar se darein, aur jin ko qayamat ki ghri ka khof laga hua ho.
Aur ab yeh (quran) barkaton wala paygham naseehat hai jo hum ne nazil kya hai. Kya phir bhi tum use maanne se inkar karte ho ?
Aur us se pehle hum ne Ibrahim ko woh samajh bojh ata ki thi jo un ke layaq thi aur hum unhein khoob jante the.
Woh waqt yaad karo jab unhon ne apne baap aur apni qaum se kaha tha ke : yeh kya muratein hain jin ke aage tum dhrna diye bithe ho ?
Woh bole ke : hum ne apne baap dadon ko un ki ibadat karte hue paya hai.
Ibrahim ne kaha : haqeeqat yeh hai ke tum bhi aur tumhare baap dade bhi khuli gumrahi mein mubtila rahe ho.
Unhon ne kaha : kya tum hum se sach much ki baat kar rahe ho, ya dil lagi kar rahe ho ?
Ibrahim ne kaha : nahin, bulke tumhara Parwardigar woh hai jo tamam aasmanon aur zameen ka maalik hai, jis ne yeh saari cheezen paida ki hain, aur logo mein us baat par gawahi deta hon.
Aur Allah ki qasam ! Jab tum pith phir kar chale jao ge to mein tumhare buthon ke saath ek (aisa) kaam karoon ga (jis se un ki haqeeqat kahala jaye gi)
Chunanche Ibrahim ne un ke bare butt ke siwa sare buthon ko tukre tukre kardiya, taake woh log us ki taraf rujoo karen.
Woh kehne lage ke : humare khudaon ke saath yeh harakat kis ne ki hai ? Woh koi bara hi zalim tha.
Kuchh logon ne kaha : hum ne ek no-jawan ko suna hai ke woh un buthon ke bare mein baatein banaya karta hai, use Ibrahim kehte hain.
Unhon ne kaha : to phir us ko sab logon ke samne le kar aao, taake sab gawah bann jayen.
(phir jab Ibrahim ko laya gaya to) woh bole : Ibrahim ! Kya humare khudaon ke saath yeh harakat tum hi ne ki hai ?
Ibrahim ne kaha : nahin, bulke yeh harakat un ke us bare sardar ne ki hai, ab unhi buthon se pochh lo, agar yeh bolte hon.
Us par woh log apne dil mein kuchh sochne lage, aur (apne aap se) kehne lage ke : sachi baat to yehi hai ke tum khud zalim ho.
Phir unhon ne apne sar jhuka liye, aur kaha : tumhein to maloom hi hai ke yeh bolte nahin hain.
Ibrahim ne kaha : bhala batao ke kya tum Allah ko chhor kar aisi cheezon ki ibadat kar rahe ho jo tumhein na kuchh faida phnchati hain na nuksan ?
Tuff hai tum par bhi, aur un par bhi jin ki tum Allah ko chhor kar ibadat kare ho. Bhala kya tumhein itni samajh nahin ?
Woh (ek dusre se) kehne lage : aag mein jila dalo us shaks ko, aur apne khudaon ki madad karo, agar tum mein kuchh karne ka dum kham hai.
(chunanche unhon ne Ibrahim ko aag mein daal diya aur) hum ne kaha : ae aag ! Thndi hoja, aur Ibrahim ke liye salamati bann jaa.
Un logon ne Ibrahim ke liye buraee ka mansuba banaya tha, magar nateeja yeh hua ke hum ne unhi ko buri tarah nakaam kardiya.
Aur hum unhein aur loot ko bacha kar us sar-zameen ki taraf le gaye jis mein hum ne duniya jahaan ke logon ke liye barkatein rkhi hain.
Aur hum ne un ko inam ke tor par ashaq aur yaqoob ata kiye, aur un mein se har ek ko hum ne nek banaya.

Aur un sab ko hum ne paishwa banaya jo humare hukum se logon ki rehnumayi karte the, aur hum ne wahee ke zariye unhein nekiyan karne, namaz qayam karne aur zakat ada karne ki takeed ki thi, aur woh humare ibadat guzar the.
Aur loot ko hum ne hikmat aur ilm ata kiya, aur unhein us basti se nijat di jo gande kaam karti thi. Haqeeqat mein woh bohat buraee wali nafarmani qaum thi.
Aur loot ko hum ne apni rehmat mein dakhil karliya, woh yaqeenan nek logon mein se the.

Aur nooh ko bhi (hum ne hikmat aur ilm ata kiya) woh waqt yaad karo jab us waqiye se pehle unhon ne humein pukara to hum ne un ki dua qabool ki, aur un ko aur un ke saathiyon ko bari bhari museebat se bacha liya.
Aur jis qaum ne hamari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya tha, us ke muqable mein un ki madad ki. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke woh bohat bure log the, us liye hum ne un sab ko garq kardiya.

Aur dad aur suliman (ko bhi hum ne hikmat aur ilm ata kiya tha) jab woh dono ek khit ke jhagre ka faisla kar rahe the, kyunke kuchh logon ki bakriyan raat ke waqt us khit mein jaa ghsi thin. Aur un logon ke bare mein jo faisla hua use hum khud dekh rahe the.

Chunanche us faisle ki samajh hum ne suliman ko de di, aur (waise) hum ne dono hi ko hikmat aur ilm ata kiya tha. Aur hum ne dad ke saath paharon ko tabe daar banadiya tha ke woh parindon ko saath le kar tasbeeh karen. Aur yeh sare kaam karne wale hum the.
Aur hum ne unhein tumhare faiyde ke liye ek jungi libas (yani zra) banane ki san’at skhaii taake woh tumhein laraee mein aikd wsre ki zada se bachayenge. Ab batao ke kya tum shukar guzar ho ?
Aur hum ne tez chalti hui hua ko suliman ke tabe kardiya tha jo un ke hukum se us sar-zameen ki taraf chalti thi jis mein hum ne barkatein rkhi hain. Aur humein har har baat ka poora poora ilm hai.
Aur kuchh aise shrir jinnat bhi hum ne un ke tabe krdiie the jo un ki khatir pani mein ghote lagate the. Aur us ke siwa aur bhi kaam karte the. Aur un sab ki dekh bhaal karne wale hum the.
Aur ayub ko dekho ! Jab unhon ne apne Parwardigar ko pukara ke : mujhe yeh takleef lag gayi hai, aur to sare reham karne walon se barh kar reham karne wala hai.

Phir hum ne un ki dua qabool ki, aur unhein jo takleef lahiq thi, use door kardiya aur un ko un ke ghar wale bhi diye, aur un ke saath itne hi log aur bhi taake hamari taraf se rehmat ka mzahra ho, aur ibadat karne walon ko ek yaadgaar sabaq mile.
Aur ismail aur idris aur zulkifl ko dekho ! Yeh sab sabar karne walon mein se the.
Aur un ko hum ne apni rehmat mein dakhil karliya tha, yaqeenan un ka shumar nek logon mein hai.

Aur machli wale (payghumbar yani younus (alh alh-e-salam)) ko dekho ! Jab woh khfa ho kar chal khre hue the aur yeh samajhte the ke hum un ki koi pakar nahin karen ge. Phir unhon ne andhirion mein se aawaz lagayi ke : (ya Allah !) tere siwa koi mabood nahin, to har aib se pak hai, be-shak mein kasoor waar hon.
Us par hum ne un ki dua qabool ki, aur unhein ghuttan se nijat ata ki. Aur usi tarah hum iman rakhne walon ko nijat dete hain.
Aur zakriya ko dekho ! Jab unhon ne apne Parwardigar ko pukara tha ke : ya rubb ! Mujhe akela na chhoriie, aur aap sab se behtar waris hain.

Chunanche hum ne un ki dua qabool ki, aur un ko yhi (jaisa beta) ata kiya, aur un ki khatir un ki biwi ko achha kardiya, yaqeenan yeh log bhalayi ke kaamon mein tezi dikhate the, aur humein shoq aur rob ke aalam mein pukara karte the, aur un ke dil humare aage jhuke hue the.
Aur us khaatun ko dekho jis ne apni ismat ki hifazat ki thi, phir hum ne us ke andar apni rooh phonki, aur unhein aur un ke bete ko duniya jahaan ke logon ke liye ek nishani banadiya.
(logo) yaqeen rakho ke yeh (deen jis ki yeh tamam anbiya dawat dete rahe hain) tumhara deen hai jo ek hi deen hai, aur mein tumhara Parwardigar hon. Lihaza tum meri ibadat karo.
Aur logon ne apne deen ko aapas mein tukre tukre kar ke bant liya, (magar) sab humare paas lot kar aane wale hain.
Phir jo momin bann kar nek amal kare ga to us ki koshish ki qadri nahin hogi, aur hum us koshish ko lkhe jate hain.
Aur jis kisi basti (ke logon) ko hum ne halaak kiya hai, us ke liye mumkin hai ke woh palat kar (duniya mein) aajayen.
Yahan tak ke jab yaajuj aur maajuj ko khol diya jaye ga, aur woh har bulandi se phslte nazar aayein ge.

Aur sacha wada poora hone ka waqt qareeb aajaye ga to achanak halat yeh hogi ke jin logon ne kufr apna liya tha un ki aankhein phti ki phti reh jayen gi (aur woh kahin ge ke :) haaye hamari kam bakhti ! Hum us cheez se bilkul hi gaflat mein the, bulke hum ne bare sitam dhaie the.
(ae shirk karne walo !) yaqeen rakho ke tum aur jin ki tum Allah ko chhor kar ibadat karte ho, woh sab jahannam ka indhan hain. Tumhein usi jahannam mein jaa atrna hai.
Agar yeh wqi khuda hote to us (jahannam) mein na jate. Aur sab ke sab us mein hamesha rahen ge.
Wahan un ki cheekhen niklen gi, aur wahan woh kuchh sunn nahin saken ge.
(albatta) jin logon ke liye hamari taraf se bhalayi pehle se lkhi jachki hai, (yani nek momin) un ko us jahannam se door rakhha jaye ga.
Woh us ki sar-sarahat bhi nahin sunen ge, aur woh hamesha hamesha apni mann pasand cheezon ke darmiyan rahen ge.
Un ko woh (qayamat ki) sab se bari pareshani ghumgeen nahin kare gi, aur farishte un ka (yeh keh kar) isteqbal karen ge (ke) yeh tumhara woh din hai jis ka tum se wada kiya jata tha.

Us din (ka dhyaan rakho) jab hum aasman ko us tarah lapet den ge jaise kaghzon ke tumar mein tehrirein lapet di jati hain. Jis tarah hum ne pehle baar takhleeq ki ibtida ki thi, usi tarah hum use dobara paida karden ge. Yeh ek wada hai jise poora karne ka hum ne zma liya hai. Humein yaqeenan yeh kaam karna hai.
Aur hum ne zaboor mein naseehat ke baad yeh lakaha diya tha ke zameen ke waris mere nek bande hon ge.
Be-shak us (quran) mein ibadat guzar logon ke liye kafi paygham hai.
Aur (ae payghumbar) hum ne tumhein sare jahano ke liye rehmat hi rehmat bana kar bheja hai.
Keh do ke : mujh par to yehi wahee aati hai ke tumhara khuda bas ek hi khuda hai. To kya tum itaat qabool karte ho ?
Phir bhi agar yeh log moonh moren to keh do ke : mein ne tumhein li alalan khabardar kardiya hai. Aur mujhe yeh maloom nahin hai ke jis (saza) ka tum se wada kiya jaraha hai, woh qareeb hai ya door.
Be-shak Allah taalaa woh baatein bhi jaanta hai jo buland aawaz se kahi jati hain, aur woh baatein bhi jaanta hai jo tum chupate ho.
Aur mein nahin jaanta shayad (saza mein) yeh (takheer) tumhare liye ek aazmaish hai aur kisi khaas waqt tak ke liye maze karne ka mauqa dena hai.

(aakhir-e-kaar) payghumbar ne kaha ke : ae mere Parwardigar ! Haqq ka faisla krdijie, aur hamara Parwardigar bri rehmat wala hai, aur jo baatein tum banate ho, un ke muqable mein usi ki madad darkaar hai.
Ae logo ! Apne Parwardigar (ke gazab) se daro. Yaqeen jaano ke qayamat ka bhonchal bari zabardast cheez hai.

Jis din woh tumhein nazar aajaye ga us din har doodh pilane wali us bache (tak) ko bhool bithe gi, jis ko us ne doodh pilaya aur har hamal wali apna hamal gira bithe gi, aur log tumhein yun nazar aayein ge ke woh nashe mein bdhoas hain, halaanke woh nashe mein nahin hon ge, bulke Allah ka azab bara sakht hoga.
Aur logon mein kuchh aise hain jo Allah ke bare mein bejane boojhe jhagre karte hain, aur us sirkash shetan ke peechhe chal khre hote hain.
Jis ke muqaddar mein yeh lakaha diya gaya hai ke jo koi use dost banaye ga to woh us ko gumraah kare ga, aur use bharakti dozakh ke azab ki taraf le jaye ga.

Ae logo ! Agar tumhein dobara zinda hone ke bare mein kuchh shakk hai to (zara socho ke) hum ne tumhein mitti se paida kiya. Phir nutfe se, phir ek jame hue khoon se, phir ek gosht ke lothre se jo (kabhi) poora bann jata hai, aur (kabhi) poora nahin banta taake hum tumhare liye (tumhari) haqeeqat khol kar btadin, aur hum (tumhein) maaon ke pait mein jab tak chahte hain, ek mutayin muddat tak thehraye rakhte hain, phir tumhein ek bache ki shakal mein bahar late hain, phir (tumhein palte hain) taake tum apni bhar por umar tak pahunch jao, aur tum mein se baaz woh hain jo (pehle hi) duniya se athalie jate hain aur tumhi mein se baaz woh hote hain jin ko badhtareen umar (yani intehaee burhape) tak lota diya jata hai, yahan tak ke woh sab kuchh janne ke baad bhi kuchh nahin jante. Aur tum dekhte ho ke zameen mujahee hui pari hai, phir jab hum us par pani barsate hain to woh harakat mein aati hai, us mein brhotri hoti hai, aur woh har qasam ki khushnuma cheezen ugati hai.
Yeh sab kuchh us wajah se hai ke Allah hi ka wajood barhaqq hai, aur wahi bejanon mein jaan daalta hai, aur woh har cheez par mukammal qudrat rakhta hai.
Aur us liye ke qayamat ki ghri aane wali hai, jis mein koi shakk nahin hai, aur us liye ke Allah un sab logon ko dobara zinda kare ga jo qabron mein hain.
Aur logon mein kuchh aise hain jo Allah ke bare mein jhagre karte hain, halaanke un ke paas na koi ilm hai na hidayat, aur na koi roshni dene wali kitab.

Woh takabbur se apna pehlu akraie hue hain, taake dusron ko bhi Allah ke raaste se gumraah karen, aise hi shaks ke liye duniya mein ruswayi hai, aur qayamat ke din hum use julti hui aag ka mza chakhayen ge.
(ke) yeh sab kuchh tere us kartoot ka badla hai jo to ne apne haathon se aage bheja tha, aur yeh baat tai hai ke Allah bandon par zulm dhane wala nahin hai.

Aur logon mein woh shaks bhi hai jo ek kinare par reh kar Allah ki ibadat karta hai. Chunanche agar use (duniya mein) koi faida pahunch gaya to woh us se mutmaeen hojata hai aur agar use koi aazmaish pesh aagaee to woh moonh mor kar (phir kufr ki taraf) chal deta hai. Aise shaks ne duniya bhi khoii, aur aakhirat bhi. Yehi to khla hua ghata hai.
Woh Allah ko chhor kar un ki ibadat karta hai jo na use nuksan pahuncha sakte hain, na koi faida de sakte hain. Yehi to parle darje ki gumrahi hai.
Yeh aise (jhoote khuda) ko pukarte hain jis ka nuksan us ke faiyde se ziyada qareeb hai. Aisa madadgar bhi kitna bura hai, aur aisa sathi bhi kitna bura.

Jo log iman laye hain, aur unhon ne nek amal kiye hain, Allah yaqeenan un ko aise baghaat mein dakhil kare ga jin ke niche nehrein behti hon gi, yaqeenan Allah har woh kaam karta hai jis ka arada krlita hai.

Jo shaks yeh samajhta tha ke Allah duniya aur aakhirat mein us (payghumbar) ki madad nahin kare ga to woh aasman tak ek rassi taan kar rabta kaat dale, phir dikhe ke kya us ki yeh tadbeer us ki jhnjlaht door krskti hai ?
Aur hum ne us (quran) ko khuli khuli nishaniyon ki surat mein usi tarah utara hai, aur Allah jis ko chahta hai, hidayat deta hai.

Bilshuba momin hon ya yahudi, saabi hon ya nasrani aur majoosi, ya woh jinhon ne shirk ikhtiyar kiya hai, Allah qayamat ke din un sab ke darmiyan faisla kare ga. Yaqeenan Allah har cheez ka gawah hai.

Kiya tum ne nahin dekha ke Allah ke aage woh sab sajda karte hain jo aasmanon mein hain aur woh sab jo zameen mein hain. Neiz suraj aur chand, aur sitare aur pahar, aur darakht aur jaanwar, aur bohat se insan bhi. Aur bohat se aise bhi hain jin par azab tai hochka hai. Aur jise Allah zaleel karde, koi nahin hai jo use izzat de sake. Yaqeenan Allah wahi karta hai jo chahta hai.

Yeh (momin aur kafir) do fareeq hain jinhon ne apne Parwardigar ke bare mein ek dusre se jhagra kiya hai. Ab (us ka faisla us tarah hoga ke) jin logon ne kufr apna ya hai, un ke liye aag ke kapre trashy jayen ge, un ke siron ke upar se kholta hua pani chhora jaye ga.
Jis se un ke pait ke andar ki cheezen aur khaalen gal jayen gi.
Aur un ke liye lohe ke hathore hon ge.
Jab kabhi takleef se tangg aaker woh us se nikalna chahein ge to unhein phir usi mein lota diya jaye ga, ke chkho julti aag ka mza.

(dusri taraf) jo log iman laye hain aur jinhon ne nek kaam kiye hain, Allah un ko aisi jannaton mein dakhil kare ga jin ke niche se nehrein behti hon gi, jahan unhein sone ke kangano aur motiyon se sjaia jaye ga, aur jahan un ka libas resham hoga.
Aur (wajah yeh hai ke) un logon ki rasayi pakeeza baat (yani kalma toheed) tak hogaee thi, aur woh us khuda ke raaste tak pahunch gaye the jo har tareef ka mustahiq hai.

Be-shak woh log (saza ke layaq hain) jinhon ne kufr apna liya hai aur jo dusron ko Allah ke raaste se aur us masjid haram se rokte hain jise hum ne logon ke liye aisa banaya hai ke us mein wahan ke bashinde aur bahar se aane wale sab barabar hain. Aur jo koi shaks us mein zulm kar ke tairhi raah nikale ga, hum use dardnaak azab ka mza chakhayen ge.

Aur yaad karo woh waqt jab hum ne Ibrahim ko us ghar (yani khana kba) ki jagah btadi thi. (aur yeh hidayat di thi ke) mere saath kisi ko shareek na thhrana, aur mere ghar ko un logon ke liye pak rakhna jo (yahan) tawaf karen, aur ibadat ke liye khre hon, aur rukoo sajde baja layein.
Aur logon mein hajj ka ailaan kardo, ke woh tumhare paas paidal aayein, aur door daraz ke raaston se safar karne wali un aontnion par sawar ho kar aayein jo (lambe safar se) dubli hogaee hon.

Taake woh un fawaid ko aankhon se dekhen jo un ke liye rkhe gaye hain, aur mutayin dino mein un chopayon par Allah ka naam len jo Allah ne unhein ata kiye hain. Chunanche (musalmano) un jaanwaron mein se khud bhi kha aur tangg dast mohtaj ko bhi khla.
Phir (hajj karne wale) logon ko chahiye ke woh apna mail kuchail door karen, aur apni mntin poori karen, aur us bayt tiq ka tawaf karen.

Yeh saari baatein yaad rakho, aur jo shaks un cheezon ki tazeem kare ga jin ko Allah ne hurmat di hai to us ke haqq mein yeh amal us ke Parwardigar ke nazdeek bohat behtar hai. Sare maweshi tumhare liye halal krdie gaye hain, siwaye un jaanwaron ke jin ki tafseel tumhein parh kar suna di gayi hai. Lihaza buthon ki gandagi aur jhot baat se us tarah bach kar raho.

Ke tum yaksui ke saath Allah ki taraf rukh kiye hue ho, us ke saath kisi ko shareek na maante ho. Aur jo shaks Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek thehraye to goya woh aasman se grpra. Phir ya to parinde use uchak le jayen, ya hua use kahin door daraz ki jagah laa phinke.
Yeh saari baatein yaad rakho, aur jo shaks Allah ke shaair ki tazeem kare, to yeh baat dilon ke taqwa se hasil hoti hai.
Tumhein ek moyyen waqt tak un (jaanwaron se) fawaid hasil karne ka haqq hai. Phir un ke halal hone ki manzil usi qadeem ghar (yani khana kba) ke aas paas hai.

Aur hum ne har ummat ke liye qurbani us garz ke liye muqarrar ki hai ke woh un maweshiyon par Allah ka naam len jo Allah ne unhein ata farmaye hain. Lihaza tumhara khuda bas ek hi khuda hai, chunanche tum usi ki farmanbardari karo, aur khoshkhbrdi suna do un logon ko jin ke dil Allah ke aage jhuke hue hain.

Jin ka haal yeh hai ke jab un ke samne Allah ka zikr kiya jata hai to un ke dilon par rob taari hojata hai, aur jo apne upar parne wali har museebat par sabar karne wale hain, aur namaz qayam karne wale hain, aur jo rizq hum ne unhein diya hai, us mein se (Allah ke raaste mein) kharch karte hain.

Aur qurbani ke ount aur gai ko hum ne tumhare liye Allah ke shaair mein shamil kiya hai, tumhare liye un mein bhalayi hai. Chunanche jab woh ek qataar mein khre hon, un par Allah ka naam lo, phir jab (zibah hoker) un ke pehlu zameen par grjaiin to un (ke gosht) mein se khud bhi kha, aur un mohtajon ko bhi khla jo sabar se bithe hon, aur un ko bhi jo apni haajat zaahir karen. Aur un jaanwaron ko hum ne usi tarah tabe banadiya hai taake tum shukar guzar bano.

Allah ko na un ka gosht pahunchta hai na un ka khoon, lekin us ke paas tumhara taqwa pahunchta hai, us ne yeh jaanwar usi tarah tumhare tabe bana diie hain taake tum us baat par Allah ki takbeer karo ke us ne tumhein hidayat ata farmaee, aur jo log khush aslobi se nek amal karte hain, unhein khushkhabri suna do .
Be-shak Allah un logon ka dfa kare ga jo iman le aaye hain, yaqeen jaano ke Allah kisi dagha baaz shukre ko pasand nahin karta.
Jin logon se jung ki jarhi hai, unhein ijazat di jati hai (ke woh apne dfa mein laren) kyunke un par zulm kiya gaya hai, aur yaqeen rakho ke Allah un ko fatah dlane par poori tarah qadir hai.

Yeh woh log hain jinhen sirf itni baat par apne gharon se na-haqq nikala gaya hai ke unhon ne yeh kaha tha ke hamara Parwardigar Allah hai. Aur agar Allah logon ke ek giroh (ke sharr) ko dusre ke zariye dafa na karta rehta to khanqahein aur klisa aur ibadat ga hain aur masjidein jin mein Allah ka kasrat se zikr kiya jata hai, sab mismaar kardi jatin. Aur Allah zaroor un logon ki madad kare ga jo us (ke deen) ki madad karen ge. Bilshuba Allah bari qooat wala, bare iqtedar wala hai.

Yeh aise log hain ke agar hum unhein zameen mein iqtedar bakshenge to woh namaz qayam karen, aur zakat ada karen, aur logon ko neki ki takeed karen, aur buraee se rokein, aur tamam kaamon ka anjaam Allah hi ke qabze mein hai.
Aur (ae payghumbar) agar yeh log tumhein jhutlate hain to un se pehle nooh ki qaum, aur aad wsmod ki qaumein bhi (apne apne payghumbaron ko) jhutla chuki hain.
Neiz Ibrahim ki qaum aur loot ki qaum.
Aur madiyan ke log bhi, aur musa ko bhi jhutlaya gaya tha, chunanche un kafiron ko mein ne kuchh dheel di, phir unhein pakar mein le liya, ab dekh lo ke meri pakar kaisi thi.

Garz kitni bastiyan thin jin ko hum ne us waqt halaak kiya jab woh zulm kar rahi thin, chunanche woh apni chathon ke bal giri pari hain, aur kitne hi kuwein jo ab bekar hue pare hain, aur kitne pakke bane hue mehal (jo khandar bann chuke hain) .

To kya yeh log zameen mein chale phre nahin hain jis se unhein woh dil hasil hote jo unhein samajh de sakte, ya aise kaan hasil hote jin se woh sunn sakte ? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke aankhein andhi nahin hotin, bulke woh dil andhe hojate hain jo seeno ke andar hain.

Aur yeh log tum se azab jaldi lane ka mutalaba karte hain, halaanke Allah apne wade ki hargiz khilaf warzi nahin kare ga, aur yaqeen jaano ke tumhare rubb ke yahan ka ek din tumhari ginti ke mutabiq ek hazar saal ki tarah ka hota hai.
Aur kitni hi bastiyan aisi thin jinhen mein ne mohlat di thi, aur woh zulm karti rahen, phir mein ne unhein pakar mein le liya, aur sab ko aakhir kaar mere paas hi lotna hoga.
(ae payghumbar) keh do ke : ae logo ! Mein to tumhein wazahat ke saath khabardar karne wala hon.
Phir jo log iman le aaye, aur nek amal karne lage, to un ke liye magfirat hai, aur ba-izzat rizq hai.
Aur jin logon ne hamari nishaniyon ko nicha dikhane ke liye dor dhoop ki hai, to woh dozakh ke basi hain.

Aur (ae payghumbar) tum se pehle hum ne jab bhi koi Rasool ya nabi bheja to us ke saath yeh waqa zaroor hua ke jab us ne (Allah ka kalaam) parha to shetan ne us ke parhne ke saath hi (kuffaar ke dilon mein) koi rukawat daal di, phir jo rukawat shetan daalta hai, Allah use door kardyta hai, phir apni aayaton ko ziyada mazboot kardyta hai, aur Allah bare ilm ka, bari hikmat ka maalik hai.

Yeh (shetan ne rukawat us liye daali) taake jo rukawat shetan ne daali thi, Allah use un logon ke liye fitna bana de jin ke dilon mein rog hai, aur jin ke dil sakht hain. Aur yaqeen jaano ke yeh zalim log mukhalifat mein bohat door chale gaye hain.

Aur (us rukawat ko Allah taalaa ne us liye door kiya) taake jin logon ko ilm ata hua hai, woh jaan len ke yehi (kalaam) barhaqq hai jo tumhare Parwardigar ki taraf se aaya hai, phir woh us par iman layein, aur un ke dil us ke aage jhuk jayen, aur yaqeen rakho ke Allah iman walon ko seedhe raaste ki hidayat dene wala hai.

Aur jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai woh us (kalaam) ki taraf se barabar shakk hi mein pare rahen ge, yahan tak ke un par achanak qayamat aajaye, ya aise din ka azab un tak aaphnche jo (un ke liye) kisi bhalayi ko janum dene ki salahiyat se khali hoga.
Baadshahi us din Allah ki hogi, woh un ke darmiyan faisla kare ga, chunanche jo log iman laye hain, aur unhon ne nek amal kiye hain, woh nematon ke baghaat mein hon ge.
Aur jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai, aur hamari aayaton ko jhutlaya hai, to aise logon ke liye zillat wala azab hoga.
Aur jin logon ne Allah ke raaste mein hijrat ki, phir qatal krdie gaye ya un ka intiqal hogaya to Allah unhein zaroor achha rizq de ga, aur yaqeen rakho ke Allah hi behtareen rizq dene wala hai.
Woh unhein zaroor aisi jagah pahunchaye ga jis se woh khush hojayen ge, aur Allah yaqeenan har baat janne wala, bara burdbaar hai.

Yeh baat tai hai aur (aage yeh bhi sunn lo ke) jis shaks ne kisi ko badle mein itni hi takleef pahunchayi jitni us ko pahunchayi gayi thi, us ke baad phir us se zyadati ki gayi, to Allah us ki zaroor madad kare ga. Yaqeen rakho ke Allah bohat maaf karne wala, bohat bakhshne wala hai.
Yeh us liye ke Allah (ki qudrat itni bari hai ke woh) raat ko din mein dakhil kardyta aur din ko raat mein dakhil kardyta hai. Aur us liye ke Allah har baat sunta, har cheez dekhta hai.
Yeh us liye ke Allah hi haqq hai aur yeh log use chhor kar jin cheezon ki ibadat karte hain, woh sab baatil hain aur Allah hi woh hai jis ki shaan bhi unchi hai, rutba bhi bara.
Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke Allah ne aasman se pani utara, jis se zameen sar-sabz hojati hai ? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke Allah bara meharban, har baat se bakhabar hai.
Jo kuchh aasmanon mein hai, aur jo kuchh zameen mein hai, sab usi ka hai. Aur yaqeen rakho ke Allah hi woh zaat hai jo sab se bey-niaz hai, bzat khud qabil tareef.

Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke Allah ne zameen ki saari cheezen tumhare kaam mein laga rkhi hain, aur woh kashtiyan bhi jo us ke hukum se samandar mein chalti hain ? Aur us ne aasman ko us tarah tham rakhha hai ke woh us ki ijazat ke baghair zameen par nahin gir sakta. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke Allah logon ke saath shafqat ka bartao karne wala, bara meharban hai.
Aur wahi hai jis ne tumhein zindagi di, phir woh tumhein maut de ga, phir tumhein zinda kare ga. Waqayi insan bara shukra hai.

Hum ne har ummat ke logon ke liye ibadat ka ek tareeqa muqarrar kiya hai, jis ke mutabiq woh ibadat karte hain. Lihaza (ae payghumbar) logon ko tum se us maamle mein jhagra nahin karna chahiye aur tum apne Parwardigar ki taraf dawat dete raho. Tum yaqeenan seedhe raaste par ho.
Aur agar woh tum se jhagren to keh do ke : jo kuchh tum kar rahe ho, Allah use khoob jaanta hai.
Allah qayamat ke din tumhare darmiyan un baaton ka faisla kare ga jin mein tum ikhtilaf kiya karte the.
