Kya tum nahin jante ke aasman aur zameen ki tamam cheezen Allah ke ilm mein hain ? Yeh sab baatein ek kitab mein mehfooz hain. Be-shak yeh sare kaam Allah ke liye bohat aasan hain.

Aur yeh log Allah ko chhor kar un cheezon ki ibadat karte hain jin (ke mabood hone) ki Allah ne koi daleel nazil nahin ki, aur khud un logon ko bhi us ke bare mein koi ilm hasil nahin. Aur un zalimon ka (aakhirat mein) koi madadgar nahin hoga.

Aur jab un ko hamari aayaten apni poori wzahton ke saath parh kar sunayi jati hain, to tum un kafiron ke chehron par nagoari ke asraat saaf pehchan lete ho, aisa lagta hai ke yeh un logon par hamla karden ge jo unhein hamari aayaten parh kar suna rahe hain. Keh do ke : logo ! Kya mein tumhein aisi cheez batla doon jo us se ziyada nagawaar hai ? Aag ! Allah ne kafiron se us ka wada kar rakhha hai aur woh bohat bura thikana hai.

Logo ! Ek misal biyan ki jarhi hai ab use kaan laga kar suno ! Tum log Allah ko chhor kar jin jin ko dua ke liye pukarte ho woh ek mkhi bhi paida nahin krskte, chahaye us kaam ke liye sab ke sab akthe hojayen, aur agar mkhi un se koi cheez chhin karle jaye to woh us se chhra bhi nahin sakte. Aisa dua maangne wala bhi boda aur jis se dua maangi jarhi hai woh bhi.
Un logon ne Allah ki theek theek qadar hi nahin pehchani. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke Allah qooat ka bhi maalik hai, iqtedar ka bhi maalik.
Allah farishton mein se bhi apna paygham pahunchane wale muntakhab karta hai aur insano mein se bhi. Yaqeenan Allah har baat sunta har cheez dekhta hai.
Woh un ke aage aur peechhe ki saari baaton ko jaanta hai, aur Allah hi par tamam maamlaat ka daromdar hai.
Ae iman walo ! Rukoo karo, aur sajda karo, aur apne Parwardigar ki bandagi karo, aur bhalayi ke kaam karo, taake tumhein falaah hasil ho.

Aur Allah ke raaste mein jihad karo, jaisa ke jihad ka haqq hai. Us ne tumhein (apne deen ke liye) muntakhab karliya hai, aur tum par deen ke maamle mein koi tangi nahin rkhi. Apne baap Ibrahim ke deen ko mazbooti se tham lo, us ne pehle bhi tumhara naam muslim rakhha tha, aur us (quran) mein bhi, taake yeh Rasool tumhare liye gawah banein, aur tum dusre logon ke liye gawah bano. Lihaza namaz qayam karo, aur zakat ada karo, aur Allah ko mazbooti se thame rakho, woh tumhara rkhoala hai, dekho, kitna achha rkhoala, aur kitna achha madadgar.
Un iman walon ne yaqeenan falaah paali hai.
Jo apni namaz mein dil se jhukne wale hain.
Aur jo laghaw cheezon se moonh more hue hain.
Aur jo zakat par amal karne wale hain.
Aur jo apni sharmgaahon ki (aur sab se) hifazat karte hain.
Siwaye apni biwiyon aur un kaneezon ke jo un ki milkiyat mein chuki hon. Kyunke aise log qabil malamat nahin hain.
Haan jo us ke laoa koi aur tareeqa ikhtiyar karna chahein to aise log hadd se guzre hue hain.
Aur woh jo apni amanaton aur apne ahad ka paas rakhne wale hain.
Aur jo apni namazon ki poori nigrani rakhte hain.
Yeh hain woh waris.
Jinhen jannat al-firdous ki miras mile gi. Yeh us mein hamesha hamesha rahen ge.
Aur hum ne insan ko mitti ke saatt se paida kiya.
Phir hum ne use tapki hui boondh ki shakal mein ek mehfooz jagah par rakhha.

Phir hum ne us boondh ko jame hue khoon ki shakal de di, phir us jame hue khoon ko ek lothra banadiya, phir us lothre ko haddiyon mein tabdeel kardiya, phir haddiyon ko gosht ka libas pehnaya, phir use aisi athan di ke woh ek dusri hi makhlooq bann kar khra hogaya. Garz bari shaan hai Allah ki jo sare karigron se barh kar karigr hai.
Phir us sab ke baad tumhein yaqeenan maut aane wali hai.
Phir qayamat ke din tumhein yaqeenan dobara zinda kiya jaye ga.
Aur hum ne tumhare upar saat teh bar teh raaste paida kiye hain aur hum makhlooq se ghafil nahin hain.
Aur hum ne aasman se theek andaze ke mutabiq pani utara, phir use zameen mein thehra diya, aur yaqeen rakho, hum use gayab kardene par bhi qadir hain.
Phir hum ne us se tumhare liye khajooron aur angooron ke baghaat paida kiye jin se tumhein bohat se mewe hasil hote hain, aur unhi mein se tum kahate ho.
Aur woh darakht bhi paida kiya jo tor sinai se nikalta hai jo apne saath tel le kar aur khane walon ke liye saalan le kar ugta hai.

Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke tumhare liye maweshiyon mein bari naseehat ka samaan hai jo (doodh) un ke pait mein hai, us se hum tumhein sairaab karte hain, aur un mein tumhare liye bohat se fawaid hain, aur unhi se tum giza bhi hasil karte ho.
Aur unhi par aur kashtiyon par tumhein sawar bhi kiya jata hai.

Aur hum ne nooh ko un ki qaum ke paas bheja tha, chunanche unhon ne (qaum se) kaha ke : meri qaum ke logo ! Allah ki ibadat karo, us ke siwa tumhara koi mabood nahin hai, bhala kya tum darte nahin ho ?

Us par un ki qaum ke kafir sardaron ne (ek dusre se) kaha : us shaks ki us ke siwa koi haqeeqat nahin ke yeh tumhi jaisa ek insan hai jo tum par apni bartari jmana chahta hai, aur agar Allah chahta to farishte nazil kardyta. Yeh baat to hum ne apne pichle baap dadon mein kabhi nahin suni.
(raha yeh shaks, to) yeh aur kuchh nahin ek aisa aadmi hai jise junoon lahiq hogaya hai, us liye kuchh waqt tak us ka intezar kar ke dekh lo (ke shayad apne hawaas mein aajaye)
Nooh ne kaha : ya rubb ! Un logon ne mujhe jis tarah jhoota banaya hai, us par to hi meri madad farma.

Chunanche hum ne un ke paas wahee bheji ke : tum hamari nigrani mein aur hamari wahee ke mutabiq kashti banao. Phir jab hamara hukum aajaye, aur tanoor ubal pare. To har qasam ke jaanwaron mein se ek ek jora le kar use bhi us kashti mein sawar krlina. Aur apne ghar walon ko bhi, siwaye un ke jin ke khilaf pehle hi hukum sadir hochka hai. Aur un zalimon ke bare mein mujh se koi baat na karna, yeh baat tai hai ke yeh sab garq kiye jayen ge.
Phir jab tum aur tumhare sathi kashti mein theek theek bith chuken to kehna : shukar hai Allah ka jis ne humein zalim logon se nijat ata farmaee.
Aur kehna : yarb ! Mujhe aisa atrna naseeb kar jo barkat wala ho, aur to behtareen utaarne wala hai.
Us sare waqiye mein bari nishaniyan hain, aur yaqeeni baat hai ke humein aazmaish to karni hi karni thi.
Phir un ke baad hum ne dusri nasalein paida kin.
Aur un ke darmiyan unhi mein ke ek shaks ko Rasool bana kar bheja. (jis ne kaha) ke : Allah ki ibadat karo, us ke siwa tumhara koi mabood nahin hai. Bhala kya tum darte nahin ho ?

Un ki qaum ke woh sardar jinhon ne kufr apna rakhha tha, aur jinhon ne aakhirat ka saamna karne ko jhutlaya tha, aur jin ko hum ne dunyawi zindagi mein khoob aish de rakhha tha, unhon ne (ek dusre se) kaha : us shaks ki haqeeqat us ke siwa kuchh nahin hai ke yeh tumhi jaisa ek insan hai. Jo cheez tum kahate ho, yeh bhi khata hai, aur jo tum peete ho, yeh bhi peeta hai.
Aur agar kahin tum ne apne hi jaise ek insan ki farmanbardari qabool karli to tum bare hi ghate ka sauda karo ge.
Bhala batao yeh shaks tumhein darata hai ke jab tum mrja ge, aur mitti aur haddiyon mein tabdeel hojao ge to tumhein dobara zameen se nikala jaye ga ?
Jis baat se tumhein daraya jaraha hai woh to bohat hi baeed baat hai, samajh se bilkul hi door.
Zindagi to hamari us dunyawi zindagi ke siwa koi aur nahin hai (yahin) hum marte aur jeete hain, aur humein dobara zinda nahin kiya sakta.
(raha yeh shaks, to) yeh aur kuchh nahin, ek aisa aadmi hai jis ne Allah par jhoota bohatan ghra hai, aur hum us par iman lane wale nahin hain.
Payghumbar ne kaha : ya rubb ! Un logon ne mujhe jis tarah jhoota banaya hai, us par to hi meri madad farma.
Allah ne farmaya : ab thori hi dair ki baat hai ke yeh log pachtate reh jayen ge.
Chunanche us sache wade ke mutabiq un ko ek chinghar ne pakra aur hum ne unhein kora karkat bana kar rakaha diya. Phtkar hai aise zalim logon par.
Us ke baad hum ne dusri nasalein paida kin.
Koi ummat na apne moyyen waqt se pehle sakti hai, na us ke baad thehar sakti hai.

Phir hum ne pai dar pai apne payghumbar bheje, jab bhi kisi qaum ke paas us ka payghumbar aata to woh use jhutlate, chunanche hum ne bhi ek ke baad ek (ko halaak karne) ka silsila bandh diya, aur unhein qsa kahaniyan bana dala. Phtkar hai un logon par jo iman nahin late.
Phir hum ne musa aur un ke bhai haroon ko apni nishaniyon aur wazeh saboot ke saath bheja
Firaun aur us ke sardaron ke paas to unhon ne ghamand ka mzahra kiya, aur woh bare takabbur wale log the.
Chunanche kehne lage : kya hum apne jaise do aadmiyon par iman le aayein, halaanke un ki qaum hamari gulami kar rahi hai ?
Us tarah unhon ne un dono ko jhutlaya, aur aakhir kaar woh bhi un logon se jaa mile jinhen halaak kiya gaya tha.
Aur musa ko hum ne kitab ata farmaee, taake un ke log rehnumayi hasil karen.
Aur marium ke bete (essa (alh alh-e-salam)) ko aur un ki man ko hum ne ek nishani banaya, aur un dono ko ek aisi bulandi par panaah di jo ek prskon jagah thi, aur jahan saaf sthra pani bhyta tha.
Ae paigambaron ! Pakeeza cheezon mein se (jo chaho) kha aur nek amal karo. Yaqeen rakho ke jo kuchh tum karte ho, mujhe us ka poora poora ilm hai.
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke yehi tumhara deen hai, (sab ke liye) ek hi deen, aur mein tumhara Parwardigar hon, us liye dil mein (sirf) mera rob rakho.
Phir hua yeh ke logon ne apne deen mein baham phot daal kar firqe bana liye, har giroh ne apne khayal mein jo tareeqa ikhtiyar karliya hai, usi par magan hai.
Lihaza (ae payghumbar) un ko ek khaas waqt tak apni jahalat mein dooba rehne do .
Kiya yeh log us khayal mein hain ke hum un ko jo daulat aur aulad diye jarahe hain.
To un ko bhalaiyan pahunchane mein jaldi dkha rahe hain ? Nahin, bulke un ko haqeeqat ka shaoor nahin hai.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke jo log apne Parwardigar ke rob se dare rehte hain.
Aur jo apne Parwardigar ki aayaton par iman late hain.
Aur jo apne Parwardigar ke saath kisi ko shareek nahin maante.
Aur woh jo amal bhi karte hain, use karte waqt un ke dil us baat se shme hote hain ke unhein apne Parwardigar ke paas wapas jana hai.
Woh hain jo bhalaiyan hasil karne mein jaldi dkha rahe hain, aur woh hain jo un ki taraf tezi se aage barh rahe hain.
Aur hum kisi shaks ko us ki taqat se ziyada kisi kaam ki zma daari nahin dete, aur humare paas ek kitab hai jo (sab ka haal) theek theek bol de gi, aur un par koi zulm nahin hoga.
Lekin un ke dil us baat se gaflat mein doobe hue hain, aur us ke laoa un ki aur bhi karstanian hain jo woh karte rehte hain.
Yahan tak ke jab hum un ke daulat mand logon ko azab mein pakar len ge to woh ek dum blbla athin ge.
Aaj bilbilao nahin, hamari taraf se tumhein koi madad nahin mile gi.
Meri aayaten tum ko parh kar sunayi jati thin to tum ulte paon murr jate the.
Bare guroor se us (quran) ke bare mein raat ko majlisein jamaa kar behoda baatein karte the.
Bhala kya un logon ne us kalaam par gaur nahin kya, ya un ke paas koi aisi cheez aagaee hai jo un ke pichle baap dadon ke paas nahin aayi thi ?
Ya yeh apne payghumbar ko (pehle se) jante hi nahin the, us wajah se un ka inkar kar rahe hain ?

Ya un ka kehna hai ke un (payghumbar) ko junoon lahiq hogaya hai ? Nahin, bulke (asal wajah yeh hai ke) yeh payghumbar un ke paas haqq le kar aaye hain, aur un mein se aksar log haqq ko pasand nahin karte.

Aur agar haqq un ki khwahishat ke tabe hojata to aasman aur zameen aur un mein basne wale sab barbaad hojate. Nahin, bulke hum un ke paas khud un ke liye naseehat ka samaan le kar aaye hain, aur woh hain ke khud apni naseehat se moonh more hue hain.

Ya (un ke inkar ki wajah yeh hai ke) tum un se koi maoza maang rahe ho ? To (yeh baat bhi galat hai, us liye ke) tumhare Parwardigar ka diya hua maoza (tumhare liye) kahin behtar hai aur woh behtareen rizq dene wala hai.
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke tum to unhein seedhe raaste ki taraf bula rahe ho.
Aur jo log aakhirat par iman nahin rakhte, woh raaste se bilkul hate hue hain.
Aur agar hum un par reham karen aur us takleef ko door karden jis mein yeh mubtila hain tab bhi yeh bhatakte hue apni sarkashi par are rahen ge.
Waqa yeh hai ke hum ne un ko (ek martaba) azab mein pakra tha, to us waqt bhi yeh log apne Parwardigar ke samne nahin jhuke. Aur yeh to aajzi ki rawish ikhtiyar karte hi nahin hain.
Yahan tak ke jab hum un par sakht azab wala darwaza khol den ge, to yeh ek dum us mein mayous ho kar reh jayen ge.
Woh Allah hi to hai jis ne tumhare liye kaan aur aankhein aur dil paida kiye. (magar) tum log bohat kam shukar ada karte ho.
Aur wahi hai jis ne tumhein zameen mein philaia aur usi ki taraf tumhein aktha kar ke le jaya jaye ga.
Aur wahi hai jo zindagi aur maut deta hai aur usi ke qabze mein raat aur din ki tbdilian hain. Kya phir bhi tum aqal se kaam nahin lete ?
Us ke bajaye yeh log bhi waisi hi baatein karte hain jaisi pichle logon ne ki thin.
Kehte hain ke : kya jab hum mrjaiin ge aur mitti aur haddiyon mein tabdeel hojayen ge to kya waqayi humein dobara zinda kar ke utahaya jaye ga ?
Yeh woh yaqeen dihani hai jo hum se bhi ki gayi hai aur use pehle humare baap dadon se bhi ki gayi thi. Us ki koi haqeeqat us ke siwa nahin ke yeh pichle logon ke banaye hue afsane hain.
(ae payghumbar ! Zara un se) kaho ke : yeh saari zameen aur us mein basne wale kis ki milkiyat hain ? Batao agar jante ho.
Woh zaroor yehi kahin ge ke : yeh sab kuchh Allah ka hai. Kaho ke : kya phir bhi tum sabaq nahin lete ?
Kaho ke : saat aasmanon ka maalik aur aali shaan arsh ka maalik kaun hai ?
Woh zaroor yehi kahin ge ke : yeh sab kuchh Allah ka hai. Kaho ke : kya phir bhi tum Allah se nahin darte ?
Kaho ke : kaun hai jis ke haath mein har cheez ka mukammal ikhtiyar hai, aur jo panaah deta hai aur us ke muqable mein koi kisi ko panaah nahin de sakta ? Batao agar jante ho.
Woh zaroor yehi kahin ge ke : sara ikhtiyar Allah ka hai. Kaho ke : phir kahan se tum par koi jadoo chal jata hai ?
Nahin (yeh afsane nahin) bulke hum ne unhein haqq baat pahunchayi hai, aur yeh log yaqeenan jhoote hain.

Na to Allah ne koi beta banaya hai, aur na us ke saath koi aur khuda hai. Agar aisa hota to har khuda apni makhlooq ko le kar alag hojata, aur phir woh ek dusre par charhai kardete. Pak hai Allah un baaton se jo yeh log banate hain.
Woh Allah jise tamam chhpi aur khuli baaton ka mukammal ilm hai. Lihaza woh un ke shirk se bohat buland wbala hai.
(ae payghumbar) dua karo ke : mere Parwardigar ! Jis azab ki dhamki un (kafiron) ko di jarhi hai, agar aap use meri aankhon ke samne le aayein.
To ae mere Parwardigar ! Mujhe un zalim logon ke saath shamil na kijiye ga.
Aur yaqeen jaano ke hum jis cheez ki unhein dhamki de rahe hain use tumhari aankhon ke samne lane par poori tarah qadir hain.
(lekin jab tak woh waqt na aaye) tum buraee ka dfia aise tareeqe se karte raho jo behtareen ho. Jo baatein yeh log banate hain hum khoob jante hain.
Aur dua karo ke : mere Parwardigar ! Mein shetan ke lagaye hue chrkon se aap ki panaah maangta hon.
Aur mere Parwardigar ! Mein un ke apne qareeb aane se bhi aap ki panaah maangta hon.
Yahan tak ke jab un mein se kisi par maut aakhri hogi to woh kahe ga ke : mere Parwardigar ! Mujhe wapas bhej dijiye.

Taake jis duniya ko mein chhor kar aaya hon, us mein jakr nek amal karoon. Hargiz nahin ! Yeh to ek baat hi baat hai jo woh zubaan se keh raha hai, aur un (marne walon) ke samne aalam barzakh ki aarr hai. Jo us waqt tak qayam rahe gi jab tak un ko dobara zinda kar ke utahaya jaye.
Phir jab soor phonka jaye ga to us din na un ke darmiyan rishte naate baqi rahen ge, aur na koi kisi ko pochhe ga.
Us waqt jin ke palry bhari nikle to wahi hon ge jo falaah payen ge.
Aur jin ke palry halke prgie, to yeh woh log hon ge jinhon ne apne liye ghate ka sauda kiya tha, woh dozakh mein hamesha hamesha rahen ge.
Aag un ke chehron ko jhulas dale gi, aur us mein un ki soorten bigar jayen gi.
(un se kaha jaye ga ke) kya meri aayaten tumhein parh kar sunayi nahin jati thin ? Aur tum un ko jhutlaya karte the.
Woh kahin ge ke : humare Parwardigar ! Hum par hamari bad-bakhti chah gayi thi, aur hum gumraah log the.
Humare Parwardigar ! Humein yahan se bahar nikal dijiye, phir agar hum dobara wahi kaam karen to be-shak hum zalim hon ge.
Allah farmaye ga. Usi (dozakh) mein zaleel ho kar pare raho, aur mujh se baat bhi na karo.

Mere bandon mein se ek jamat yeh dua karti thi ke : ae humare Parwardigar ! Hum iman le aaye hain, pus humein baksh dijiye, aur hum par reham frmaie, aur aap sab reham karne walon se barh kar reham farmane wale hain.
To tum ne un logon ka mazaq banaya tha. Yahan tak ke un hi (ke saath chhir chhar) ne tumhein meri yaad tak se ghafil kardiya, aur tum un ki hansi urate rahe.
Unhon ne jis tarah sabar se kaam liya tha, aaj mein ne unhein us ka yeh badla diya hai ke unhon ne apni murad paali hai.
(phir) Allah (un dozakhiyon se) farmaye ga : tum zameen mein ginti ke kitne saal rahe ?
Woh kahin ge ke : hum ek din ya ek din se bhi kam rahe hon ge. (humein poori tarah yaad nahin) us liye jinhon ne (waqt ki) ginti ki ho, un se pochh lijiye.
Allah farmaye ga : tum thori muddat se ziyada nahin rahe. Kiya khoob hota agar yeh baat tum ne (us waqt) samajh li hoti
Bhala kya tum yeh samjhe bithe the ke hum ne tumhein yunhi bemqsd paida kardiya, , aur tumhein wapas humare paas nahin laya jaye ga ?
Garz bohat unchi shaan hai Allah ki jo sahih maani mein baadshah hai. Us ke siwa koi mabood nahin, woh izzat wale arsh ka maalik hai.
Aur jo shaks Allah ke saath kisi aur khuda ko pukarega, jis par us ke paas kisi qasam ki koi daleel nahin, to us ka hisab us ke Parwardigar ke paas hai. Yaqeen jaano ke kafir log falaah nahin sakte.
Aur tum (ae payghumbar) yeh kaho ke : mere Parwardigar ! Hamari khatayen baksh de, aur reham farma, to sare reham karne walon se barh kar reham karne wala hai.
Yeh ek surat hai jo hum ne nazil ki hai, aur jis (ke ehkaam) ko hum ne farz kiya hai, aur us mein khuli khuli aayaten nazil ki hain, taake tum naseehat hasil karo.

Zina karne wali aurat aur zina karne wale mard dono ko so so kore lagaye, aur agar tum Allah aur yaum aakhirat par iman rakhte ho, to Allah ke deen ke maamle mein un par tars khane ka koi jazba tum par ghalib na aaye. Aur yeh bhi chahiye ke momino ka ek majme un ki saza ko khuli aankhon dikhe.

Zaani mard nikah karta hai to zina ka ria mushrik aurat hi se nikah karta hai, aur zina kaar aurat se nikah karta hai to wahi mard jo khud zaani ho, ya mushrik ho aur yeh baat momino ke liye haram kardi gayi hai
Aur jo log pak daaman aurton par tohmat lagayein, phir char gawah le kar na aayein, to un ko usi kore lagao aur un ki gawahi kabhi qabool na karo, aur woh khud fasiq hain.
Haan jo log us ke baad toubah karlen, aur (apni) islaah karlen, to Allah bohat bakhshne wala, bara reham karne wala hai.

Aur jo log apni biwiyon par tohmat lagayein aur khud apne siwa un ke paas koi aur gawah na hon to aise kisi shaks ko jo gawahi deeni hogi woh yeh hai ke woh char martaba Allah ki qasam kha kar yeh biyan de ke woh (biwi par lagaye hue ilzam mein) yaqeenan sacha hai.
Aur panchwi martaba yeh kahe ke : agar mein (apne ilzam mein jhoota hon to mujh par Allah ki laanat ho.)
Aur aurat se (zina ki) saza door karne ka raasta yeh hai ke woh char martaba Allah ki qasam kha kar yeh gawahi de ke us ka shohar (us ilzam mein) jhoota hai.
Aur panchwi martaba yeh kahe ke : agar woh sacha ho to mujh par Allah ka gazab nazil ho.
Aur agar tum par Allah ka fazal aur us ki rehmat na hoti aur yeh baat na hoti ke Allah kasrat se toubah qabool karne wala hikmat wala hai (to khud soch lo ke tumhara kya banta ?)

Yaqeen jaano ke jo log yeh jhooti tohmat gahara kar laye hain woh tumhare andar hi ka ek tola hai tum us baat ko apne liye bura na samjho, bulke yeh tumhare liye behtar hi behtar hai. Un logon mein se har ek ke hisse mein apne kiye ka gunaah aaya hai. Aur un mein se jis shaks ne us (bohatan) ka bara hissa apne sar liya hai us ke liye to zabardast azab hai.
Jis waqt tum logon ne yeh baat suni thi to aisa kyun na hua ke momin mard bhi aur momin aurten bhi apne bare mein nek gumaan rakhte aur keh dete ke yeh khullam khla jhoot hai ?
Woh (bohatan lagane wale) us baat par char gawah kyun nahin le aaye ? Ab jabke woh gawah nahin laye to Allah ke nazdeek wahi jhoote hain.
Aur agar tum par duniya aur aakhirat mein Allah ka fazal aur us ki rehmat na hoti to jin baaton mein tum prgie the un ki wajah se tum par us waqt sakht azab aaprta.

Jab tum apni zubaano se us baat ko ek dusre se naqal kar rahe the aur apne moonh se woh baat keh rahe the jis ka tumhein koi ilm nahin tha, aur tum us baat ko mamooli samajh rahe the, halaanke Allah ke nazdeek woh bari sangeen baat thi.

Aur jis waqt tum ne yeh baat suni thi, usi waqt tum ne yeh kyun nahin kaha ke : humein koi haqq nahin pahunchta ke hum yeh baat moonh se nikalenge, ya Allah ! Aap ki zaat har aib se pak hai, yeh to bara zabardast bohatan hai.
Allah tumhein naseehat karta hai ke phir kabhi aisa na karna, agar waqayi tum momin ho.
Aur Allah tumhare samne hidayat ki baatein saaf saaf biyan krrha hai. Aur Allah ilm ka bhi maalik hai, hikmat ka bhi maalik.
Yaad rakho ke jo log yeh chahte hain ke iman walon mein behiaii phile, un ke liye duniya aur aakhirat mein dardnaak azab hai. Aur Allah jaanta hai aur tum nahin jante.
Aur agar yeh baat na hoti ke Allah ka fazal aur us ki rehmat tumhare shamil haal hai aur Allah bara shafeeq bara meharban hai (to tum bhi na bachte) .

Ae iman walo ! Tum shetan ke peechhe na chalo, aur agar koi shaks shetan ke peechhe chale, to shetan to hamesha behiaii aur badi ki talqeen kare ga. Aur agar tum par Allah ka fazal aur rehmat na hoti to tum mein se koi bhi kabhi pak saaf na hota, lekin Allah jis ko chahta hai pak saaf kardyta hai. Aur Allah har baat sunta, har cheez jaanta hai.

Aur tum mein se jo log ehle khair hain aur maali wusat rakhte hain, woh aisi qasam na kahyenge ke woh rishta daron, miskeeno aur Allah ke raaste mein hijrat karne walon ko kuchh nahin den ge, aur unhein chahiye ke maafi aur darguzar se kaam len. Kya tumhein yeh pasand nahin hai ke Allah tumhari khatayen baksh de ? Aur Allah bohat bakhshne wala, bara meharban hai.
Yaad rakho ke jo log pak daaman bhooli bhali musalman aurton par tohmat lagate hain un par duniya aur aakhirat mein phtkar prchki hai, aur un ko us din zabardast azab hoga.
Jis din khud un ki zubaanein un ke haath aur un ke paon un ke khilaf us kartoot ki gawahi den ge jo woh karte rahe hain.
Us din Allah un ko woh badla poora poora de ga jis ke woh mustahiq hain aur un ko pata chal jaye ga ke Allah hi haqq hai, aur wahi saari baat khol dene wala hai.

Gandi aurten gande mardon ke layaq hain, aur gande mard gandi aurton ke layaq. Aur paakbaaz aurten paakbaaz mardon ke layaq hain, aur paakbaaz mard paakbaaz aurton ke layaq . Yeh (paakbaaz mard aur aurten) un baaton se bilkul mbra hain jo yeh log bana rahe hain. Un (pakbazon) ke hisse mein to magfirat hai aur ba-izzat rizq.

Ae iman walo ! Apne gharon ke siwa dusre gharon mein us waqt tak dakhil na ho jab tak ijazat na le lo, aur un mein basne walon ko salam na karlo. Yehi tareeqa tumhare liye behtar hai, umeed hai ke tum khayal rakho ge.

Aur agar tum un gharon mein kisi ko na pao tab bhi un mein us waqt tak dakhil na ho jab tak tumhein ijazat na de di jaye. Aur agar tum se kaha jaye ke : wapas chale jao. To wapas chale jao. Yehi tumhare liye pakeeza tareen tareeqa hai, aur tum jo amal bhi karte ho Allah ko us ka poora poora ilm hai.

Tumhare liye us mein koi gunaah nahin hai ke tum aise gharon mein (ijazat liye baghair) dakhil ho jin mein koi rehta na ho, aur un se tumhein faida athane ka haqq ho. Aur tum jo kaam lania karte ho, aur jo cahahap kar karte ho, Allah un sab ko jaanta hai.

Momin mardon se keh do ke woh apni nigahen neechi rakhen, aur apni sharmgaahon ki hifazat karen. Yehi un ke liye pakeeza tareen tareeqa hai. Woh jo karoaiian karte hain Allah un sab se poori tarah bakhabar hai.

Aur momin aurton se keh do ke woh apni nigahen neechi rakhen, aur apni sharmgaahon ki hifazat karen, aur apni sjaot ko kisi par zaahir na karen, siwaye us ke jo khud hi zaahir hojaye. Aur apni aorhnion ke aanchal apne girbano par daal liya karen, aur apni sjaot aur kisi par zaahir na karen, siwaye apne shoharon ke, ya apne baap, ya apne shoharon ke baap ke, ya apne beton ya apne shoharon ke beton ke, ya apne bhaiyon ya apne bhaiyon ke beton, ya apni behno ke beton ke, ya apni aurton ke, ya un ke jo apne haathon ki milkiyat mein hain ya un khidmat guzaron ke jin ke dil mein koi (jnsi) taqaza nahin hota ya un bacchon ke jo abhi aurton ke chhpe hue hisson se aashna nahin hue aur musalman aurton ko chahiye ke woh apne paon zameen par us tarah na marenge ke unhon ne jo zeenat chhpa rkhi hai woh maloom hojaye. Aur ae momino ! Tum sab Allah ke samne toubah karo, taake tumhein falaah naseeb ho.

Tum mein se jin (mardon ya aurton) ka us waqt nikah na ho, un ka bhi nikah karao, aur tumhare ghulamon aur bandion mein se jo nikah ke qabil hon, un ka bhi. Agar woh tangg dast hon to Allah apne fazal se unhein bey-niaz karde ga. Aur Allah bohat wusat wala hai, sab kuchh jaanta hai.

Aur jin logon ko nikah ke mawaqe muyassar na hon, woh pak damni ke saath rahen, yahan tak ke Allah apne fazal se unhein bey-niaz karde. Aur tumhari milkiyat ke ghulam bandion mein se jo makatibat ka muhaida karna chahein, agar un mein bhalayi dekho to un se makatibat ka muhaida karliya karo aur (musalmano) Allah ne tumhein jo maal de rakhha hai us mein se aise ghulam bandion ko bhi diya karo, aur apni bandion ko dunyawi zindagi ka sazosaman hasil karne ke liye bad-kaari par majboor na karo jabke woh pak damni chahati hon, aur jo koi unhein majboor kare ga to un ko majboor karne ke baad Allah (un bandion ko) bohat bakhshne wala, bara meharban hai.

Aur hum ne woh aayaten bhi utaar kar tum tak pahuncha di hain jo har baat ko wazeh karne wali hain aur un logon ki misalen bhi jo tum se pehle guzar chuke hain, aur woh naseehat bhi jo Allah se darne walon ke liye karaamd hai.

Allah tamam aasmanon aur zameen ka noor hai us ke noor ki misal kuchh yun hai jaise ek taaq ho jis mein chiraag rakhha ho chiraag ek sheshe mein ho, shisha aisa ho jaise ek stara, moti ki tarah chamakta hua, woh chiraag aise barkat wale darakht yani zaitoon se roshan kiya jaye jo na (sirf) mashriqi ho na (sirf) maghribi aisa lagta ho ke us ka tel khud hi roshni de ga. Chahaye use aag bhi na lage, noor balaa noor, Allah apne noor tak jise chahta hai, pahuncha deta hai, aur Allah logon ke faiyde ke liye tamseelein biyan karta hai, aur Allah har cheez ko khoob janne wala hai.
Jin gharon ke bare mein Allah ne yeh hukum diya hai ke un ko buland muqaam diya jaye aur un mein us ka naam le kar zikr kiya jaye, un mein subah o shaam woh log tasbeeh karte hain

Jinhen koi tijarat ya koi khareed farokht na Allah ki yaad se ghafil karti hai na namaz qayam karne se aur na zakat dene se woh us din se darte rehte hain jis mein dil aur nigahen ulat palat kar reh jayen gi.
Nateeja yeh hai ke Allah un logon ko un ke aemaal ka behtareen badla de ga, aur apne fazal se mazeed kuchh aur bhi de ga aur Allah jis ko chahta hai hisab deta hai.

Aur (dusri taraf) jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai un ke aemaal ki misal aisi hai jaise ek chatiyal sehra mein ek saraab ho jise pyasa aadmi pani samajh bithta hai, yahan tak ke jab us ke paas pahunchta hai to maloom hota hai ke woh kuchh bhi nahin tha aur us ke paas Allah ko pata hai, chunanche Allah us ka poora poora hisab chuka deta hai. Aur Allah bohat jaldi hisab le leta hai.

Ya phir un (aemaal) ki misal aisi hai jaise kisi gehre samandar mein phile hue andhere, ke samandar ko ek mauj ne dhanp rakhha ho, jis ke upar ek aur mauj ho, aur us ke upar badal, garz upar tale andhere hi andhere. Agar koi apna haath bahar nikale to use bhi na dekh paye. Aur jis shaks ko Allah hi noor ata na kare, us ke naseeb mein koi noor nahin.

Kiya tum ne dekha nahin ke aasmanon aur zameen mein jo bhi hain Allah hi ki tasbeeh karte hain, aur woh parinde bhi jo par philaie hue urte hain. Har ek ko apni namaz aur apni tasbeeh ka tareeqa maloom hai. Aur Allah un ke sare kaamon se poori tarah bakhabar hai.
Aur aasmanon aur zameen ki baadshahi Allah hi ke liye hai, aur Allah hi ki taraf (sab ko) lot kar jana hai.

Kiya tum ne dekha nahin ke Allah baadalon ko hnkata hai, phir un ko ek dusre se jor deta hai, phir unhein teh bar teh ghta mein tabdeel kardyta hai, phir tum dekhte ho ke baarish us ke darmiyan se baras rahi hai. Aur aasman mein (baadalon ki shakal mein) jo pahar ke pahar hote hain, Allah un se aule barsata hai, phir jis ke liye chahta hai un ko museebat bana deta hai, aur jis se chahta hai un ka rukh phir deta hai. Aisa lagta hai ke us ki bijli ki chamak aankhon ki binayi uchak le jaye gi.
Wahi Allah raat aur din ka ulat phir karta hai. Yaqeenan un sab baaton mein un logon ke liye naseehat ka samaan hai jin ke paas dekhne wali aankhein hain.

Aur Allah ne zameen par chalne wale har jaandaar ko pani se paida kiya hai. Phir un mein se kuchh woh hain jo apne pait ke bal chalte hain, kuchh woh hain jo do paon par chalte hain, aur kuchh woh hain jo char (paon) par chalte hain. Allah jo chahta hai paida karta hai. Yaqeenan Allah har baat par qudrat rakhta hai.
Be-shak hum ne woh aayaten nazil ki hain jo haqeeqat ko khol khol kar biyan karne wali hain, aur Allah jis ko chahta hai seedhe raaste tak pahuncha deta hai.

Aur yeh (munafiq) log kehte hain ke hum Allah par aur Rasool par iman le aaye hain, aur hum farmanbardar hogaye hain, phir un mein se ek giroh us ke baad bhi moonh mor leta hai. Yeh log (haqeeqat mein) momin nahin hain.
Aur jab unhein Allah aur us ke Rasool ki taraf bulaya jata hai taake Rasool un ke darmiyan faisla karen to un mein se kuchh log ek dum rukh phir lete hain.
Aur agar khud unhein haqq wasool karna ho to woh bare farmanbardar bann kar Rasool ke paas chale aate hain.
Kya un ke dilon mein koi rog hai ya yeh shakk mein pare hue hain ya unhein yeh andesha hai ke Allah aur us ka Rasool un par zulm dhaie ga ? Nahin bulke zulm dhane wale to khud yeh log hain.

Momino ki baat to yeh hoti hai ke jab unhein Allah aur us ke Rasool ki taraf bulaya jata hai taake Rasool un ke darmiyan faisla karen to woh yeh kehte hain ke : hum ne (hukum) sunn liya, aur maan liya. Aur aise hi log hain jo falaah pane wale hain.
Aur jo log Allah aur us ke Rasool ki farmanbardari karen, Allah se darein, aur us ki nafarmani se bachenge to wahi log kaamyaab hain.

Aur yeh (munafiq log) bare zoron se Allah ki qasmen kahate hain ke agar (ae payghumbar) tum unhein hukum do ge to yeh nikal khre hon ge. (un se) kaho ke : qasmen na kha. (tumhari) farmanbardari ka sab ko pata hai. Yaqeen jaano ke tum jo kuchh karte ho Allah us se poori tarah bakhabar hai.

(un se) kaho ke : Allah ka hukum mano aur Rasool ke farmanbardar bano, phir bhi agar tum ne moonh phire rakhha to Rasool par to itna hi bojh hai jis ki zma daari un par daali gayi hai, aur jo bojh tum par dala gaya hai, us ke zma daari tum khud ho. Agar tum un ki farmanbardari karo ge to hidayat paja ge, aur Rasool ka farz us se ziyada nahin hai ke woh saaf saaf baat pahuncha den.

Tum mein se jo log iman le aaye hain aur jinhon ne nek amal kiye hain, un se Allah ne wada kiya hai ke woh unhein zaroor zameen mein apna khalifa banaye ga, jis tarah un se pehle logon ko banaya tha, aur un ke liye us deen ko zaroor iqtedar bakshe ga jise un ke liye pasand kiya hai, aur un ko jo khof lahiq raha hai, us ke badle unhein zaroor aman ata kare ga. (bas) woh meri ibadat karen, mere saath kisi cheez ko shareek na thehrayen. Aur jo log us ke baad bhi shukri karen ge to aise log nafarman hon ge.
Aur namaz qayam karo, aur zakat ada karo, aur Rasool ki farmanbardari karo, taake tumhare saath rehmat ka bartao kiya jaye.
Yeh hargiz na samajhna ke jin logon ne kufr ka raasta apna liya hai, woh zameen mein (kahin bhaag kar humein) bus karden ge. Un ka thikana dozakh hai, aur yaqeenan woh bohat hi bura thikana hai.

Ae iman walo ! Jo ghulam londiyan tumhari milkiyat mein hain, aur tum mein se jo bache abhi blogh tak nahin pahunche un ko chahiye ke woh teen auqat mein (tumhare paas aane ke liye) tum se ijazat liya karen. Namaz fajr se pehle, aur jab tum dopahar ke waqt apne kapre utaar kar rakhha karte ho, aur namaz ishaa ke baad yeh teen waqt tumhare parde ke auqat hain. Un auqat ke laoa na tum par koi tangi hai, na un par. Un ka bhi tumhare paas aana jana laga rehta hai, tumhara bhi ek dusre ke paas. Allah usi tarah aayaton ko tumhare samne khol khol kar biyan karta hai, aur Allah ilm ka bhi maalik hai, hikmat ka bhi maalik.

Aur jab tumhare bache blogh ko pahunch jayen, to woh bhi usi tarah ijazat liya karen jaise un se pehle baalig hone wale ijazat lete rahe hain. Allah usi tarah apni aayaten khol khol kar tumhare samne biyan karta hai, aur Allah ilm ka bhi maalik hai, hikmat ka bhi maalik.

Aur jin bari boorhi aurton ko nikah ki koi tawaqqu na rahi ho, un ke liye us mein koi gunaah nahin hai ke woh apne (zayid) kapre, (maslan chadarein, namhrmon ke samne) utaar kar rakaha den, ba-shart-e-ke zeenat ki numaish na karen aur agar woh ehtiyat hi rakhen to un ke liye aur ziyada behtar hai. Aur Allah sab kuchh sunta, har baat jaanta hai.

Na kisi nabina ke liye us mein koi gunaah hai, na kisi paon se mazoor-o shaks ke liye koi gunaah hai, na kisi beemar shaks ke liye koi gunaah hai, aur na khud tumhare liye ke tum apne gharon se kuchh khalo , ya apne baap dada ke gharon se, ya apni maaon ke gharon se, ya apne bhaiyon ke gharon se, ya apni behno ke gharon se, ya apne chachaon ke gharon se, ya apni phopion ke gharon se, ya apne mamuon ke gharon se, ya apni khalaon ke gharon se, ya un gharon se jin ki chabian tumhare ikhtiyar mein hon. Ya apne doston ke gharon se, us mein bhi tumhare liye koi gunaah nahin hai ke sab malakar kha, ya alag alag. Chunanche jab tum gharon mein dakhil ho to apne logon ko salam kiya karo, ke yeh mulaqat ki woh ba-barkat pakeeza dua hai jo Allah ki taraf se aayi hai. Allah usi tarah aayaton ko tumhare samne khol khol kar biyan karta hai, taake tum samajh jao.

Momin to woh log hain jo Allah aur us ke Rasool ko dil se maante hain aur jab Rasool ke saath kisi ijtimayi kaam mein shareek hote hain to un se ijazat liye baghair kahin nahin jate. (ae payghumbar) jo log tum se ijazat lete hain, yehi woh log hain jo Allah aur us ke Rasool ko dil se maante hain. Chunanche jab woh apne kisi kaam ke liye tum se ijazat maangein to un mein se jin ko chaho, ijazat de diya karo, aur un ke liye Allah se magfirat ki dua kiya karo. Yaqeenan Allah bohat bakhshne wala, bara meharban hai.

(ae logo) apne darmiyan Rasool ko bulane ko aisa (mamooli) na samjho jaise tum aapas mein ek dusre ko bulaya karte ho Allah tum mein se un logon ko khoob jaanta hai jo ek dusre ki aarr le kar chupke se kahasak jate hain. Lihaza jo log us ke hukum ki khilaf warzi karte hain, un ko us baat se darna chahiye ke kahin un par koi aafat na pare, ya unhein koi dardnaak azab na pakre.

Yaad rakho ke aasmanon aur zameen mein jo kuchh hai Allah hi ka hai. Tum jis halat par bhi ho, Allah use khoob jaanta hai, aur jis din sab ko us ke paas lotaya jaye ga, us din woh un ko btade ga ke unhon ne kiya amal kiya tha, aur Allah ko har baat ka poora poora ilm hai.
Bari shaan hai us zaat ki jis ne apne bande par haqq o baatil ka faisla kardene wali yeh kitab nazil ki, taake woh duniya jahaan ke logon ko khabardar karde.

Woh zaat jo aasmanon aur zameen ki badshaat ki tanha maalik hai aur jis ne na to koi beta banaya hai, aur na us ki badshaat mein koi shareek hai, aur jis ne har cheez ko paida kar ke us ko ek napa tula andaz ata kiya hai.

Aur logon ne use chhor kar aise khuda bana rkhe hain jo kuchh paida nahin karte, bulke khud paida kiye jate hain, aur jin ka khud apne nuksan ya faiyde par bhi koi bas nahin chalta, aur na kisi ka marna ya jeena un ke ikhtiyar mein hai, na kisi ko dobara zinda karna.

Aur jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai, woh kehte hain ke : yeh (quran) to kuchh bhi nahin, bas ek mann gharat cheez hai jo us shaks ne gahara li hai, aur us kaam mein kuchh aur log bhi us ke madadgar bane hain. Us tarah (yeh baat keh kar) yeh log bare zulm aur khle jhoot par utar aaye hain.
Aur kehte hain ke : yeh to pichle logon ki lkhi hui kahaniyan hain jo us shaks ne lkhoali hain, aur subah o shaam wahi us ke samne parh kar sunayi jati hain.
Keh do ke : yeh kalaam to us (Allah) ne nazil kiya hai jo har bhed ko poori tarah jaanta hai, aasmanon mein bhi, zameen mein bhi. Be-shak woh bohat bakhshne wala, bara meharban hai.
Aur yeh kehte hain ke yeh kaisa Rasool hai jo khana bhi khata hai, aur bazaaron mein bhi chalta phrta hai ? Us ke paas koi farishta kyun nahin bheja gaya jo us ke saath reh kar logon ko darata ?

Ya us ke upar koi khazana hi aaprta, ya us ke paas koi baagh hota jis mein se yeh khaia karta. Aur yeh zalim (musalmanon se) kehte hain ke : tum jis ke peechhe chal rahe ho, woh aur kuchh nahin, bas ek shaks hai jis par jadoo hogaya hai.
(ae payghumbar) dekho un logon ne tumhare bare mein kaisi kaisi baatein banaee hain. Chunanche aise bhatke hain ke raaste par aana un ke bas se bahar hai.

Bari shaan hai us (Allah) ki jo agar chahaye to tumhein un sab se kahin behtar cheez, (ek baagh ke bajaye) bohat se baghaat de jin ke niche nehrein behti hon, aur tumhein bohat se mehallaat ka maalik bana de.
Asal haqeeqat yeh hai ke un logon ne qayamat ki ghri ko jhutlaya hua hai, aur jo koi qayamat ki ghri ko jhutlaye, us ke liye hum ne bharakti hui aag tayyar kar rkhi hai.
Jab woh un ko door se dikhe gi to yeh log us ke bphrne aur phnkarne ki aawazen sunen ge.
Aur jab un ko achhi tarah bandh kar us ki ek tangg jagah mein phinka jaye ga to wahan yeh maut ki aawaz de kar pukaren ge.
(us waqt un se kaha jaye ga ke) aaj tum maut ko sirf ek baar na pukaro, bulke baar baar maut ko pukarte hi raho.
Kaho ke yeh anjaam behtar hai ya hamesha rehne wali jannat, jis ka wada muttaqi logon se kya gaya hai ? Woh un ke liye inam hogi, aur un ka aakhri anjaam
Wahan unhein hamesha hamesha baste hue har woh cheez mile gi jo woh chahein ge. Yeh woh zma darana wada hai jo tumhare rubb ne apne upar lazim karliya hai.

Aur woh din (unhein yaad dilao) jab Allah un (kafiron) ko bhi hashar mein jama kare ga aur un (maboodon) ko bhi jin ki yeh khuda ko chhor kar ibadat karte the, aur (un ke maboodon se) kahe ga ke : kya tum ne mere un bandon ko behkaya tha, ya yeh raaste se khud bhatke the ?

Woh kahin ge ke : aap ki zaat har aib se pak hai. Hamari majal nahin thi ke hum aap ko chhor kar dusre rkhoalon ke qaeel hon, lekin hua yeh ke aap ne un ko aur un ke baap dadon ko duniya ka sazosaman diya, yahan tak ke jo baat yaad rkhni thi yeh use bhala bithe, aur (us tarah) yeh khud barbaad ho kar rahe.

Lo (ae kafiron) unhon ne to tumhari woh saari baatein jhutla den jo tum kaha karte ho. Ab na (azab ko) talna tumhare bas mein hai na koi madad hasil karna. Aur tum mein se jo koi zulm ka murtakib hai, hum use bare bhari azab ka mza chakhayen ge.

Aur (ae payghumbar) hum ne tum se pehle jitne payghumbar bheje, woh sab aise the ke khana bhi kahate the aur bazaaron mein bhi chalte phrte the, aur hum ne tum logon ko ek dusre ki aazmaish ka zria banaya hai. Batao kya sabar karo ge ? Aur tumhara Parwardigar har baat dekh raha hai.

Jin logon ko yeh tawaqqu hi nahin hai ke woh (kisi waqt) hum se aamlin ge, woh yun kehte hain ke : hum par farishte kyun nahin utare jate ? Ya phir aisa kyun nahin hota ke hum khud apne Parwardigar ko dekh len ? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh apne dilon mein apne aap ko bohat bara samjhe hue hain. Aur unhon ne bari sarkashi ikhtiyar ki hui hai.
Jis din un ko farishte nazar aagaye, us din un mujreemon ke liye koi khushi ka mauqa nahin hoga, bulke yeh kehte phrin ge ke khudaya ! Humein aisi panaah de ke yeh hum se door hojayen.
Aur unhon ne (duniya mein) jo amal kiye hain, hum un ka faisla karne par aayein ge to unhein fiza mein bikhre hue gird o gubar (ki tarah beqimt) banadein ge.
Us din jannati log hon ge jin ka mustaqar bhi behtareen hoga, aur aaram gaah bhi khoob hogi.
Aur jis din aasman pahata kar ek badal ko raah de ga, aur farishte us tarah utare jayen ge ke un ka tara banadah jaye ga.
Us din sahih maani mein baadshahi khuda Rahman ki hogi, aur woh din kafiron par bohat sakht hoga.
Aur jis din zalim insan (hasrat se) apne haathon ko kaat kahe ga, aur kahe ga : kaash mein ne payghumbar ki hmrahi ikhtiyar karli hoti.
Haaye meri barbadi ! Kaash mein ne falaan shaks ko dost na banaya hota.
Mere paas naseehat chuki thi, magar us (dost) ne mujhe us se bhatka diya, aur shetan to hai hi aisa ke waqt parne par insan ko beks chhor jata hai.
Aur Rasool (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) kahin ge ke : ya rubb ! Meri qaum us quran ko bilkul chhor bithi thi.
Aur hum ne usi tarah mujrim logon ko har nabi ka dushman banaya hai. Aur tumhara Parwardigar hidayat dene aur madad karne ke liye kafi hai.

Aur yeh kafir log kehte hain ke : un par sara quran ek hi dfa mein kyun nazil nahin kardiya gaya ? (ae payghumbar) hum ne aisa us liye kya hai taake us ke zariye tumhara dil mazboot rakhen. Aur hum ne use thehar thehar kar prhoaia hai.
Aur jab kabhi yeh log tumhare paas koi anokhi baat le kar aate hain, hum tumhein (us ka) theek theek) jawab aur ziyada wazahat ke saath ata kardete hain.
Jin logon ko ghir kar na ke bal dozakh ki taraf le jaya jaye ga, woh badhtareen muqaam par hain, aur un ka raasta badhtareen gumrahi ka raasta hai.
Be-shak hum ne musa ko kitab di thi, aur un ke saath un ke bhai haroon ko madadgar ke tor par muqarrar kiya tha.
Chunanche hum ne kaha tha ke : tum dono un logon ke paas jao jinhon ne hamari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya hai. Aakhir nateeja yeh hua ke hum ne un ko tabaah kar ke nist o nabood kardiya.
Aur nooh ki qaum ne jab payghumbaron ko jhutlaya to hum ne unhein garq kardiya, aur un ko logon ke liye ibrat ka samaan banadiya. Aur hum ne un zalimon ke liye ek dardnaak azab tayyar kar rakhha hai.
Usi tarah hum ne aad wsmod aur ashab alrs ko aur un ke darmiyan bohat si nasalon ko tabaah kiya.
Un mein se har ek ko samjhane ke liye hum ne misalen den, aur (jab woh na maane to) har ek ko hum ne pees kar rakaha diya.

Aur yeh (kuffaar makkah) us basti se ho kar guzarte rahe hain jis par buri tarah (pathron ki) baarish barsayi gayi thi bhala kya yeh us basti ko dekhte nahin rahe ? (phir bhi unhein ibrat nahin hui) bulke un ke dil mein dusri zindagi ka andesha tak paida nahin hua.

Aur (ae payghumbar) jab yeh log tumhein dekhte hain to un ka koi kaam us ke siwa nahin hota ke yeh tumhara mazaq banate hain ke : kya yehi woh sahib hain jinhen Allah ne payghumbar bana kar bheja hai ?

Agar hum apne khudaon (ki aqeedat) par mazbooti se jame na rehte to un sahib ne to humein un se bhatkane mein koi kasar nahin chhori thi. (jo log yeh baatein keh rahe hain) jab unhein azab aankhon se nazar aajaye ga tab unhein pata chale ga ke kaun raaste se bilkul bhatka hua tha ?
Bhala batao jis shaks ne apna khuda apni nafsani khwahish ko bana liya ho, to (ae payghumbar) kya tum us ki zma daari le sakte ho ?
Ya tumhara khayal yeh hai ke un mein se aksar log sunte ya samajhte hain ? Nahin ! Un ki misal to bas char paon ke jaanwaron ki si hai, bulke yeh un se ziyada raah se bhatke hue hain.
Kya tum ne apne Parwardigar (ki qudrat) ko nahin dekha ke woh kis tarah saaye ko pehla ta hai ? Aur agar woh chahta to use ek jagah thehra deta. Phir hum ne suraj ko us ke liye rehnuma banadiya hai.
Phir hum use thora thora kar ke apni taraf sameit lete hain.
Aur wahi hai jis ne tumhare liye raat ko libas banaya, aur neend ko sarapa sukoon aur din ko dobara ath khre hone ka zria banadiya.
Aur wahi hai jis ne apni rehmat (yani baarish) se pehle hawayen bhejein jo (baarish ki) khushkhabri le kar aati hain, aur hum ne hi aasman se pakeeza pani utara hai.
Taake hum us ke zariye murda zameen ko zindagi bakshenge, aur apni makhlooq mein se bohat se maweshiyon aur insano ko us se sairaab karen.
Aur hum ne logon ke faiyde ke liye us (pani) ki ulat phir kar rkhi hai, taake woh sabaq hasil karen. Lekin aksar log shukri ke siwa har baat se inkari hain.
Aur agar hum chahte to har basti mein ek alag aagaah karne wala (payghumbar) bhej dete.
Lihaza (ae payghumbar) tum un kafiron ka kehna na mano, aur us quran ke zariye un ke khilaf poori qooat se jdojhd karo.

Aur wahi hai jis ne daryaon ko us tarah mila kar chalaya hai ke ek mitha hai jis se taskeen milti hai, aur ek nmkin hai, sakht karwa. Aur un dono ke darmiyan ek aarr aur aisi rukawat hayal kardi hai jis ko (dono mein se) koi bor nahin krskta.
Aur wahi hai jis ne pani se insan ko paida kiya, phir us ko nsbi aur susrali rishte ata kiye, aur tumhara Parwardigar bari qudrat wala hai.

Aur yeh log hain ke Allah ko chhor kar aisi cheezon ki ibadat kar rahe hain jo na un ko koi faida phnchati hain, na nuksan, aur kafir insan ne apne Parwardigar hi ki mukhalifat par kamar bandh rkhi hai.
Aur (ae payghumbar) hum ne tumhein kisi aur kaam ke liye nahin, bulke us liye bheja hai ke tum logon ko khushkhabri do , aur khabardar karo.
Keh do ke : mein us kaam par tum se koi ujrat nahin maangta haan jo shaks yeh chahaye ke apne rubb tak pahunchne ka raasta ikhtiyar karle (to yehi meri ujrat hai)
Aur tum us zaat par bharosa rakho jo zinda hai, jise kabhi maut nahin aaye gi, aur usi ki hamd ke saath tasbeeh karte raho, aur woh apne bandon ke gunahon ki khabar rakhne ke liye kafi hai.
Woh zaat jis ne cheh din mein sare aasman aur zameen aur un ke darmiyan ki cheezen paida kin, phir us ne arsh par astoa farmaya woh Rahman hai, us liye us ki shaan kisi janne wale se pochho.

Aur jab un logon se kaha jata hai ke Rahman ko sajda karo to yeh kehte hain ke : Rahman kya hota hai ? Kya jise bhi tum keh do , hum use sajda kya karen ? Aur us baat se woh aur ziyada bidakne lagte hain.
Bari shaan hai us ki jis ne aasman mein burj banaye aur us mein ek roshan chiraag aur noor philane wala chand paida kiya.

Aur wahi hai jis ne raat aur din ko aisa banaya ke woh ek dusre ke peechhe chale aate hain (magar yeh saari baatein) us shaks ke liye (karaamd hain) jo naseehat hasil karne ka arada rakhta ho ya shukar baja lana chahta ho.
Aur Rahman ke bande woh hain jo zameen par aajzi se chalte hain aur jab jahil log un se (jahilana) khitaab karte hain to woh salamati ki baat kehte hain.
Aur jo raatein us tarah guzarte hain ke apne Parwardigar ke aage (kabhi) sajde mein hote hain, aur (kabhi) qayam mein.
Aur jo yeh kehte hain ke : humare Parwardigar ! Jahannam ke azab ko hum se door rkhie. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke us ka azab woh tabahi hai jo chimat kar reh jati hai
Yaqeenan woh kisi ka mustaqar aur qayam gaah banne ke liye badhtareen jagah hai.
Aur jo kharch karte hain to na fizool kharchi karte hain, na tangi karte hain, bulke un ka tareeqa us (ifraat wtfrit) ke darmiyan aitadaal ka tareeqa hai.

Aur jo Allah ke saath kisi bhi dusre mabood ki ibadat nahin karte, aur jis jaan ko Allah ne hurmat bakshi hai, use na-haqq qatal nahin karte, aur na woh zina karte hain, aur jo shaks bhi yeh kaam kare ga, use apne gunaah ke wabal ka saamna karna pare ga.
Qayamat ke din us ka azab barha barha kar dugna kardiya jaye ga, aur woh zaleel ho kar us azab mein hamesha hamesha rahe ga.
Haan magar jo koi toubah karle, iman le aaye, aur nek amal kare to Allah aise logon ki buraiyon ko nekiyon mein tabdeel karde ga, aur Allah bohat bakhshne wala, bara meharban hai.
Aur jo koi toubah karta aur nek amal karta hai, to woh dar-haqeeqat Allah ki taraf theek theek lot aata hai.
Aur (Rahman ke bande woh hain) jo na-haqq kaamon mein shamil nahin hote aur jab kisi laghaw cheez ke paas se guzarte hain to waqar ke saath guzar jate hain.
Aur jab unhein apne rubb ki aayat ke zariye naseehat ki jati hai to woh un par behre aur andhe bann kar nahin girte.
Aur jo (dua karte hue) kehte hain ke : humare Parwardigar ! Humein apni biwi bacchon se aankhon ki thandak ata farma, aur humein perhezgaron ka srbraa bana de.
Yeh log hain jinhen un ke sabar ke badle jannat ke balakhane ata hon ge, aur wahan duaon aur salam se un ka isteqbal kiya jaye ga.
Woh wahan hamesha zinda rahen ge, kisi ka mustaqar aur qayam gaah banne ke liye woh behtareen jagah hai.

(ae payghumbar ! Logon se) keh do ke : mere Parwardigar ko tumhari zara bhi parwah na hoti, agar tum us ko na pukarega ab jabke (ae kafiron) tum ne haqq ko jhutla diya hai to yeh jhutlan tumhare gale parr kar rahe ga.
Taa Seen Meem
Yeh us kitab ki aayaten hain jo haqq ko wazeh karne wali hai.
(ae payghumbar) shayad tum us ghum mein apni jaan halaak kiye jar hai ho ke yeh log iman (kyun) nahin late.
Agar hum chahein to un par aasman se koi aisi nishani utaar den ke us ke aage un ki gardanein jhuk kar reh jayen.
(un ka haal to yeh hai ke) un ke paas khuda Rahman ki taraf se koi naee naseehat aati hai, yeh us se moonh mor lete hain.
Us tarah unhon ne haqq ko jhutla diya hai. Chunanche yeh log jin baaton ka mazaq urate rahe hain, ab anqareeb un ke theek theek haqaiq un ke samne aajayen ge.
Aur kya unhon ne zameen ko nahin dekha ke hum ne us mein har nafees qasam ki kitni cheezen ugayi hain ?
Yaqeenan un sab cheezon mein ibrat ka bara samaan hai, phir bhi un mein se aksar log iman nahin late
Aur yaqeen rakho ke tumhara Parwardigar sahib iqtedar bhi hai, bohat meharban bhi.
Aur us waqt ka haal suno jab tumhare Parwardigar ne musa ko aawaz de kar kaha tha ke : us zalim qaum ke paas jao
Yani Firaun ki qaum ke paas. Kya un ke dil mein khuda ka khof nahin hai ?
Musa ne kaha ke : mere Parwardigar ! Mujhe darr hai ke woh mujhe jhoota banayen ge.
Aur mera dil tangg hone lagta hai, aur meri zubaan nahin chalti. Us liye aap haroon ko bhi (nabuwat ka) paygham bhej dijiye.
Aur mere khilaf un logon ne ek jurm bhi aayad kar rakhha hai. Jis ki wajah se mujhe darr hai ke woh mujhe qatal na kar dalen
Allah ne farmaya ke : hargiz nahin. Tum dono hamari nishaniyan le kar jao. Yaqeen rakho ke hum tumhare saath hain, saari baatein sunte rahen ge.
Ab tum Firaun ke paas jao aur kaho ke : hum dono rubb aalameen ke payghumbar hain.
(aur yeh paygham laye hain) ke tum bano israel ko humare saath bhej do .

Firaun ne (jawab mein musa (alh alh-e-salam) se) kaha : kya hum ne tumhein us waqt apne paas rakaha kar nahin paala tha jab tum bilkul bache the ? Aur tum ne apni umar ke bohat se saal humare yahan reh kar guzare.
Aur jo harakat tum ne ki thi woh bhi kar guzre aur tum bare shukre aadmi ho.
Musa ne kaha : us waqt woh kaam mein aisi halat mein kar guzra tha ke mujhe pata nahin tha.
Chunanche jab mujhe tum logon se khof hua to mein tumhare paas se farar hogaya, phir Allah ne mujhe hikmat ata farmaee, aur payghumbaron mein shamil farma diya.
Aur woh ehsan jo tum mujh par rakaha rahe ho (us ki haqeeqat) yeh hai ke tum ne sare bano israel ko ghulam bana rakhha hai.
Firaun ne kaha : aur yeh rubb aalameen kya cheez hai ?
Musa ne kaha : woh sare aasmanon aur zameen ka, aur un saari cheezon ka Parwardigar hai jo un ke darmiyan payi jati hain, agar tum ko waqayi yaqeen karna ho.
Firaun ne apne ird-gird ke logon se kaha : sunn rahe ho ke nahin ?
Musa ne kaha : woh tumhara bhi Parwardigar hai aur tumhare pichle baap dadon ka bhi.
Firaun bola : tumhara yeh payghumbar jo tumhare paas bheja gaya hai yeh to bilkul hi dioana hai.
Musa ne kaha : woh mashriq o magrib ka bhi Parwardigar hai, aur un ke darmiyan saari cheezon ka bhi, agar tum aqal se kaam lo.
Kehne laga : yaad rakho, agar tum ne mere siwa kisi aur ko mabood maana to mein tumhein zaroor un logon mein shamil kardoon ga jo jail khane mein pare hue hain.
Musa bole : aur agar mein tumhein koi aisi cheez laa dikhaoon jo haqq ko wazeh kar de, phir ?
Firaun ne kaha : achha, agar waqayi sache ho to le aao woh cheez.
Chunanche musa ne apna asa phinka aur dekhte hi dekhte woh khla hua azdha bann gaya.
Aur unhon ne apna haath (bagal mein se) khench kar nikala to pil bhar mein woh sab dekhne walon ke samne safaid hogaya.
Firaun ne apne ird gird ke sardaron se kaha : yaqeenan yeh koi maahir jadoogar hai.
Yeh chahta hai ke apne jadoo ke zariye tumhein tumhari sar-zameen se nikal bahar kare. Ab batao kya raye hai ?
Unhon ne kaha : un ko aur un ke bhai ko kuchh mohlat dijiye, aur tamam shehron mein har kare bhej dijiye.
Jo maahir jadoogar ko aap ke paas le aayein (aur un jaadugaron ka muqable karen)
Chunanche ek din muqarrara waqt par sare jadoogar jama krlie gaye.
Aur logon se kaha gaya ke : kya tum log jama horahe ho ?
Shayad agar yeh jadoo gir hi ghalib aagaye to hum unhi ke raaste par chalen.
Phir jab jadoogar aaye to unhon ne Firaun se kaha : yeh baat to yaqeeni hai na ke agar hum ghalib aagaye to humein koi inam mile ga ?
Firaun ne kaha : haan haan, aur tumhein us surat mein muqarrab logon mein bhi zaroor shamil karliya jaye ga.
Musa ne un jaadugaron se kaha : jo kuchh tumhein phinkna hai, phinko
Us par un jaadugaron ne apni rassiyan aur laathiyan zameen par daal den aur kaha ke : Firaun ki izzat ki qasam ! Hum hi ghalib aayein ge.
Ab musa ne apna asa zameen par dala to achanak us ne (azdha bann kar) us tamashe ko nigalna shuroo kardiya jo woh jhoot moot bana rahe the.
Bas phir woh jadoogar sajde mein gira diye gaye.
Kehne lage ke : hum rubb aalameen par iman le aaye.
Jo musa aur haroon ka Parwardigar hai.

Firaun bola : tum mere ijazat dene se pehle hi musa par iman le aaye. Saabit hua ke yeh tum sab ka srghna hai jis ne tumhein jadoo skhaia hai. Achha abhi tumhein pata chal jaye ga. Mein tum sab ke ek taraf ke haath aur dusri taraf ke paon katwaunga, aur tum sab ko sooli par latka doon ga.
Jaadugaron ne kaha : hamara kuchh nahin bgre ga, humein yaqeen hai ke hum lot kar apne Parwardigar ke paas chale jayen ge.
Hum to shoq se amidlgaie hue hain ke hamara Parwardigar us wajah se hamari khatayen baksh de ga ke hum sab se pehle iman laye the.
Aur hum ne musa ke paas wahee bheji ke : mere bandon ko le kar raaton raat roana hojao, tumhara pichha yaqeenan kiya jaye ga.
Us par Firaun ne shehron mein har kare bhej diye.
(aur yeh kehla bheja ke) yeh (bani israel) ek chhoti si toli ke thore se log hain.
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke unhon ne humare dil jalaye hue hain.
Aur hum sab ehtiyati tadbeerein kiye hue hain. (lihaza sab malakar un ka taaqub karo.)
Us tarah hum unhein bahar nikal laye baaghon aur chashmon se bhi.
Aur khazano aur ba-izzat muqamaat se bhi.
Un ka mamla to usi tarah hua, aur (dusri taraf) un cheezon ka waris hum ne bani israel ko banadiya
Garz hua yeh ke yeh sab log suraj nikalte hi un ka pichha karne nikal khre hue.
Phir jab dono jthe ek dusre ko nazar aane lage to musa ke saathiyon ne kaha ke : ab to paki baat hai ke hum pakar hi liye gaye.
Musa ne kaha : hargiz nahin, mere saath yaqeeni tor se mera Parwardigar hai, woh mujhe raasta bataye ga.
Chunanche hum ne musa ke paas wahee bheji ke apni lathi samandar par maaro. Bas phir samandar pahata gaya, aur har hissa ek bare pahar ki tarah khra hogaya.
Aur dusre fareeq ko bhi hum us jagah ke nazdeek le aaye.
Aur musa aur un ke tamam saathiyon ko hum ne bchalia.
Phir dusron ko garq krdala.
Yaqeenan us sare waqiye mein ibrat ka bara samaan hai, phir bhi un mein se aksar log iman nahin late.
Aur yaqeen rakho ke tumhara Parwardigar sahib iqtedar bhi hai, bara meharban bhi.
Aur (ae payghumbar) un ko Ibrahim ka waqa sunao
Jab unhon ne apne baap aur apni qaum se kaha tha ke : tum kis cheez ki ibadat karte ho ?
Unhon ne kaha ke : hum buthon ki ibadat karte hain, aur unhi ke aage dhrna diye rehte hain.
Ibrahim ne kaha : jab tum un ko pukarte ho to kya yeh tumhari baat sunte hain ?
Ya tumhein koi faida ya nuksan pahunchate hain ?
Unhon ne kaha : asal baat yeh hai ke hum ne apne baap dadon ko aisa hi karte hue paya hai.
Ibrahim ne kaha : bhala kabhi tum ne un cheezon ko gaur se dekha bhi jin ki tum ibadat karte rahe ho ?
Tum bhi aur tumhare purane baap dade bhi.
Mere liye to yeh sab dushman hain, siwaye ek rubb aalameen ke
Jis ne mujhe paida kiya hai, phir wahi meri rehnumayi farmata hai.
Aur jo mujhe khilata pilata hai.
Aur jab mein beemar hota hon to mujhe shifa deta hai
Aur jo mujhe maut de ga, phir zinda kare ga.
Aur jis se mein yeh umeed lagaye hue hon ke woh hisab o kitab ke din meri khata baksh de ga.
Mere Parwardigar ! Mujhe hikmat ata farma, aur mujhe nek logon mein shamil frmale.
Aur aane wali nasalon mein mere liye woh zubaanein paida farma jo meri sacchayi ki gawahi den.
Aur mujhe un logon mein se bana de jo nematon wali jannat ke waris hon ge.
Aur mere baap ki magfirat farma, yaqeenan woh gumraah logon mein se hai.
Aur us din mujhe ruswa na karna jis din logon ko dobara zinda kiya jaye ga.
Jis din na koi maal kaam aaye ga, na aulad
Haan jo shaks Allah ke paas salamati wala dil le kar aaye ga (us ko nijat mile gi)
Aur jannat muttaqi logon ke liye qareeb kardi jaye gi
Aur dozakh khle tor par gumraahon ke samne kardi jaye gi.
Aur un se kaha jaye ga ke : kahan hain woh jin ki tum ibadat kya karte the ?
Allah ko chhor kar , kya woh tumhari madad karen ge ya khud apna bachao karlen ge ?
Phir un ko aur gumraahon ko bhi ondhe moonh dozakh mein daal diya jaye ga.
Aur iblees ke sare lashkaron ko bhi.
Wahan yeh sab aapas mein jhagarte hue (apne maboodon se) kahin ge.
Ke : Allah ki qasam hum to us zamane mein khuli gumrahi mein mubtila the.
Jab hum ne tumhein rubb aalameen ke barabar qarar de rakhha tha.
Aur humein to un bare bare mujreemon ne hi gumraah kiya tha.
Nateeja yeh hai ke na to humein kisi qasam ki sifarish karne wale muyassar hain.
Aur na koi aisa dost jo humdardi karsake.
Ab kaash ke humein ek martaba duniya mein wapas jane ka mauqa mill jaye to hum momin bann jayen.
Yaqeenan us sare waqiye mein ibrat ka bara samaan hai, phir bhi un mein se aksar log iman nahin late.
Aur yaqeen rakho ke tumhara Parwardigar sahib iqtedar bhi hai, bohat meharban bhi.
Nooh ki qaum ne payghumbaron ko jhutlaya.
Jabke un ke bhai nooh ne un se kaha ke : kya tum Allah se darte nahin ho ?
Yaqeen jaano ke mein tumhare liye ek amanat daar payghumbar hon.
Lihaza tum Allah se daro, aur meri baat mano
Aur mein tum se us kaam par kisi qasam ki koi ujrat nahin maangta. Mera ajar to sirf us zaat ne apne zimme le rakhha hai jo sare duniya jahaan ki perwerish karti hai.
Lihaza tum Allah se daro, aur meri baat mano.
Woh log bole : kya hum tum par iman le aayein, halaanke bare niche darje ke log tumhare peechhe lage hue hain ?
Nooh ne kaha : mein kya janon ke woh kya kaam karte hain ?
Un ka hisab lena kisi aur ka nahin, mere Parwardigar ka kaam hai. Kaash ! Tum samajh se kaam lo.
Aur mein un momino ko dhutkaar kar apne se door nahin krskta.
Mein to bas ek khabardar karne wala hon jo (tumhare samne) haqeeqat khol kar rakaha raha hai.
Woh kehne lage : ae nooh agar tum baaz na aaye to tumhein pathar maar maar kar halaak kardiya jaye ga.
Nooh ne kaha : mere Parwardigar ! Meri qaum ne mujhe jhutla diya hai.
Ab aap mere aur un ke dar mian do tok faisla krdijie, aur mujhe aur mere momin saathiyon ko bacha lijiye.
Chunanche hum ne unhein aur un ke saathiyon ko bhari hui kashti mein bacha liya.
Phir us ke baad baqi logon ko garq kardiya
Yaqeenan us sare waqiye mein ibrat ka bara samaan hai, phir bhi un mein se aksar log iman nahin late.
Aur yaqeen rakho ke tumhara Parwardigar sahib iqtedar bhi hai, bohat meharban bhi.
Aad ki qaum ne payghumbaron ko jhutlaya.
Jabke un ke bhai hood ne un se kaha ke : kya tum Allah se darte nahin ho ?
Yaqeen jaano ke mein tumhare liye ek amanat daar payghumbar hon.
Lihaza tum Allah se daro, aur meri baat mano.
Aur mein tum se us kaam par kisi qasam ki koi ujrat nahin maangta, mera ajar to sirf us zaat ne apne zimme le rakhha hai jo sare duniya jahaan ki perwerish karti hai.
Kya tum har unchi jagah par koi yaad gar bana kar fizool harkatein karte ho ?
Aur tum ne bari karigari se banaee hui imaratein us tarah rakaha chhori hain jaise tumhein hamesha zinda rehna hai ?
Aur jab kisi ki pakar karte ho to pakke zalim o jabr bann kar pakar karte ho.
Ab Allah se daro, aur meri baat mano.
Aur us zaat se daro jis ne un cheezon se nawaz kar tumhari qooat mein azafa kiya hai jo tum khud jante ho.
Us ne tumhein maweshiyon aur aulad se bhi nawaza hai.
Aur baaghon aur chashmon se bhi.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke mujhe tum par ek zabardast din ke azab ka andesha hai.
Woh kehne lage : chahaye tum naseehat karo, ya na karo, humare liye sab barabar hai.
Yeh baatein to wahi hain jo pichle logon ki aadat rahi hai.
Aur hum azab ka nishana banne wale nahin hain.
Garz un logon ne hood ko jhutlaya, jis ke natije mein hum ne un ko halaak kardiya. Yaqeenan us sare waqiye mein ibrat ka bara samaan hai, phir bhi un mein se aksar log iman nahin late.
Aur yaqeen rakho ke tumhara Parwardigar sahib iqtedar bhi hai, bara meharban bhi.
Qaum samood ne payghumbaron ko jhutlaya
Jabke un ke bhai saleh ne un se kaha ke : kya tum Allah se darte nahin ho ?
Yaqeen jaano ke mein tumhare liye ek amanat daar payghumbar hon.
Lihaza tum Allah se daro, aur meri baat mano.
Aur mein tum se us kaam par kisi qasam ki koi ujrat nahin maangta. Mera ajar to sirf us zaat ne apne zimme le rakhha hai jo sare duniya jahaan ki perwerish karti hai.
Kya tumhein itminaan ke saath un saari nematon mein hamesha rehne diya jaye ga jo yahan maujood hain ?
Un baaghon aur chashmon mein ?
Aur un kheton aur un nakhlistano mein jin ke khoshe ek dusre mein piost hain ?
Aur kya paharon ko bare naaz ke saath tarash kar tum (hamesha) ghar banate raho ge ?
Ab Allah se daro, aur meri baat mano.
Aur un hadd se guzre hue logon ka kehna mat mano
Jo zameen mein fasaad philate hain, aur islaah ka kaam nahin karte.
Woh kehne lage ke : tum par to kisi ne bara bhari jadoo kardiya hai.
Tumhari haqeeqat us ke siwa kuchh bhi nahin ke tum hum jaise hi ek insan ho. Lihaza agar sache ho to koi nishani le kar aao.
Saleh ne kaha : (lo) yeh ountni hai. Pani peene ke liye ek bari us ki hogi, aur ek moyyen din mein ek bari tumhari.
Aur us ko buri niyat se haath bhi na lagana, wrna ek zabardast din ka azab tumhein pakre ga.
Phir hua yeh ke unhon ne us ountni ki konchin kaat dalen, aur aakhir kaar pashemaan hue.
Chunanche azab ne unhein pakra, yaqeenan us sare waqiye mein ibrat ka bara samaan hai, phir bhi un mein se aksar log iman nahin late.
Aur yaqeen rakho ke tumhara Parwardigar sahib iqtedar bhi hai, bara meharban bhi.
Loot ki qaum ne payghumbaron ko jhutlaya.
Jabke un ke bhai loot ne un se kaha ke : kya tum Allah se darte nahin ho ?
Yaqeen jaano ke mein tumhare liye ek amanat daar payghumbar hon.
Lihaza tum Allah se daro, aur meri baat mano.
Aur mein tum se us kaam par kisi qasam ki koi ujrat nahin maangta, mera ajar to sirf us zaat ne apne zimme le rakhha hai jo sare duniya jahaan ki perwerish karti hai.
Kiya duniya ke sare logon mein tum ho jo mardon ke paas jate ho.
Aur tumhari biwiyan jo tumhare rubb ne tumhare liye paida ki hain, un ko chhore bithe ho ? Haqeeqat to yeh hai ke tum hadd se bilkul guzre hue log ho.
Kehne lage : loot ! Agar tum baaz na aaye to tum bhi un logon mein shamil hojao ge jinhen (basti se) nikal bahar kiya jata hai.
Loot ne kaha : yaqeen jaano, mein un logon mein se hon jo tumhare us kaam se bilkul bezaar hain.
Mere Parwardigar ! Jo harkatein yeh log kar rahe hain, mujhe aur mere ghar walon ko un se nijat de.
Chunanche hum ne un ko aur un ke sab ghar walon ko nijat di.
Siwaye ek burhiya ke jo peechhe rehne walon mein shamil rahi.
Phir aur sab ko hum ne tabaah kardiya.
Aur un par ek zabardast baarish barsa di. Garz bohat buri baarish thi jo un par brsi jinhen pehle se dara diya gaya tha.
Yaqeenan us sare waqiye mein ibrat ka bara samaan hai, phir bhi un mein se aksar log iman nahin late.
Aur yaqeen rakho ke tumhara Parwardigar sahib iqtedar bhi hai, bara meharban bhi.
Aikah ke bashindon ne payghumbaron ko jhutlaya.
Jabke shoaib ne un se kaha ke : kya tum Allah se darte nahin ho ?
Yaqeen jaano ke mein tumhare liye ek amanat daar payghumbar hon.
Lihaza tum Allah se daro, aur meri baat mano.
Aur mein tum se us kaam par kisi qasam ki koi ujrat nahin maangta. Mera ajar to sirf us zaat ne apne zimme le rakhha hai jo sare duniya jahaan ki perwerish karti hai.
Poora poora naap diya karo, aur un logon mein se na bano jo dusron ko ghate mein daalte hain.
Aur seedhi tarazoo se tola karo.
Aur logon ko un ki cheezen ghta kar na diya karo, aur zameen mein fasaad machate mat phro.
Aur us zaat se daro jis ne tumhein bhi paida kiya hai, aur pichli khalqat ko bhi.
Kehne lage : tum par to kisi ne bara bhari jadoo kardiya hai.
Tumhari haqeeqat us ke siwa kuchh bhi nahin ke tum hum jaise hi ek insan ho aur hum tumhein poore yaqeen ke saath jhoota samajhte hain.
Lihaza agar tum sache ho to hum par aasman ka koi tukra gira do .
Shoaib ne kaha : mera Parwardigar khoob jaanta hai ke tum kiya krrhe ho.
Garz un logon ne shoaib ko jhutlaya jis ka nateeja yeh hua ke unhein sayebaan wale din ke azab ne pakra . Be-shak woh ek zabardast din ka azab tha.
Yaqeenan us sare waqiye mein ibrat ka bara samaan hai, phir bhi un mein se aksar log iman nahin late.
Aur yaqeen rakho ke tumhara Parwardigar sahib iqtedar bhi hai, bara meharban bhi.
Be-shak yeh quran rubb aalameen ka nazil kiya hua hai.
Amanat daar farishta use le kar itra hai.
(ae payghumbar) tumhare qalb par itra hai taake tum un (payghumbaron) mein shamil hojao jo logon ko khabardar karte hain.
Aisi arabi zubaan mein itra hai jo paygham ko wazeh kardene wali hai.
Aur us (quran) ka tzkra pichli (aasmani) kitabon mein bhi maujood hai.
Bhala kya un logon ke liye yeh koi daleel nahin hai ke bano israel ke ulema us se waqif hain ?
Aur agar hum yeh kitab ajami logon mein se kisi par nazil kardete.
Aur woh un ke samne parh bhi deta to yeh log tab bhi us par iman na late.
Mujreemon ke dilon mein to hum ne us ko usi tarah dakhil kiya hai.
Yeh log us par us waqt tak iman nahin layein ge jab tak dardnaak azab aankhon se na dekh len.
Aur woh un ke paas us tarah achanak aakhra ho ke un ko pata bhi na chale.
Phir yeh keh athin ke kya humein kuchh mohlat mill sakti hai ?
To kya yeh log humare azab ke liye jaldi macha rahe hain ?
Bhala batao agar hum kaee saal tak unhein aish ka samaan muhaiyya karte rahen.
Phir woh (azab) un ke upar aakhra ho jis se unhein daraya jaraha hai.
To aish ka jo samaan un ko diya jata raha woh unhein (azab ke waqt) kya faida pahuncha sakta hai ?
Aur hum ne kisi basti ko us ke baghair halaak nahin kiya ke (pehle) us ke liye khabardar karne wale maujood the.
Taake woh naseehat karen aur hum aise to nahin hain ke zulm karen.
Aur us quran ko shayateen le kar nahin utre.
Na yeh quran un ke matlab ka hai aur na woh aisa krskte hain.
Unhein to (wahee ke) sunne se bhi rok diya gaya hai.
Lihaza Allah ke saath koi mabood na mano, kabhi tum bhi un logon mein shamil hojao jinhen azab hoga.
Aur (ae payghumbar) tum apne qareeb tareen khandaan ko khabardar karo
Aur jo momin tumhare peechhe chalen, un ke liye anksari ke saath apni shafqat ka bazu jhuka do .
Aur agar woh tumhari nafarmani karen to keh do ke : jo kuchh tum kar rahe ho, us se mera koi talluq nahin.
Aur us (Allah) par bharosa rakho jo bara iqtedar wala, bohat meharban hai.
Jo tumhein us waqt bhi dekhta hai jab tum (ibadat ke liye) khre hote ho.
Aur sajda karne walon ke darmiyan tumhari aamad o rafata ko bhi dekhta hai.
Yaqeen rakho ke wahi hai jo har baat sunta har cheez jaanta hai.
Kya mein tumhein bataon ke shayateen kin logon par utarte hain ?
Woh har aise shaks par utarte hain jo parle darje ka jhoota gunehgar ho.
Woh suni sunayi baat laa daalte hain, aur un mein se aksar jhoote hote hain.
Rahe shayar log, to un ke peechhe to beraa log chalte hain.
Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke woh har wadi mein bhatakte phrte hain ?
Aur yeh ke woh aisi baatein kehte hain jo karte nahin hain.

Haan magar woh log mstsni hain jo iman laye, aur unhon ne nek amal kiye, aur Allah ko kasrat se yaad kiya, aur apne upar zulm hone ke baad us ka badla liya. Aur zulm karne walon ko anqareeb pata chal jaye ga ke woh kis anjaam ki taraf palat rahe hain.
Taa Seen
Yeh un momino ke liye sarapa hidayat aur khushkhabri bann kar aayi hai.
Jo namaz qayam karte hain, aur zakat ada karte hain. Aur wahi hain jo aakhirat par yaqeen rakhte hain.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke jo log aakhirat par iman nahin rakhte, hum ne un ke aemaal ko un ki nazron mein khushnuma banadiya hai. Us liye woh bhatakte phir rahe hain.
Yehi woh log hain jin ke liye bura azab hai aur wahi hain jo aakhirat mein sab se ziyada nuksan athane wale hain.
Aur (ae payghumbar) bula shubha tumhein yeh quran us (Allah) ki taraf se ata kiya jaraha hai jo hikmat ka bhi maalik hai ilm ka bhi maalik.

Us waqt ko yaad karo jab musa ne apne ghar walon se kaha tha ke : mujhe ek aag nazar aayi hai. Mein abhi tumhare paas wahan se koi khabar le kar aata hon, ya phir tumhare paas aag ka koi shla atha karle aaon ga, taake tum aag se garmi hasil krsko.

Chunanche jab woh us aag ke paas pahunche to unhein aawaz di gayi ke : barkat ho un par jo us aag ke andar hain, aur us par bhejo us ke aas paas hai aur pak hai Allah jo sare jahano ka Parwardigar hai.
Ae musa : baat yeh hai ke mein Allah hon, bare iqtedar wala, bari hikmat wala.

Aur zara apni lathi ko niche phinko. Phir jab unhon ne lathi ko dekha ke woh us tarah harakat kar rahi hai jaise woh koi saanp ho to woh pith phir kar bhaage, aur peechhe murr kar bhi na dekha. (irshad hua) musa ! Daro nahin, jin ko payghumbar banaya jata hai un ko mere huzoor koi andesha nahin hota.
Illa yeh ke kisi ne koi zyadati ki ho. Phir woh buraee ke baad use badal kar achhe kaam karle, to mein bohat bakhshne wala, bara meharban hon.

Aur apna haath girbaan mein dakhil karo, to woh kisi beemari ke baghair safaid ho kar nikle ga. Yeh dono baatein un no nishaniyon mein se hain jo Firaun aur us ki qaum ki taraf (tumhare zariye) bheji jarhi hain. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke woh nafarman log hain.
Phir hua yeh ke jab un ke paas hamari nishaniyan us tarah pahunchenge ke woh aankhein kholne wali thin to unhon ne kaha ke : yeh to khla hua jadoo hai.
Aur agarche un ke dilon ko un (ki sacchayi) ka yaqeen hochka tha, magar unhon ne zulm aur takabbur ki wajah se un ka inkar kya. Ab dekh lo un fasaad machane walon ka anjaam kaisa hua ? .
Aur hum dad aur suliman ko ilm ata kiya. Aur unhon ne kaha : tamam tareefen Allah ki hain jis ne humein apne bohat se momin bandon par fazilat ata farmaee hai.

Aur suliman ko dad ki virasat mili aur unhon ne kaha : ae logo ! Humein parindon ki boli skhaii gayi hai, aur humein har (zaroorat ki) cheez ata ki gayi hai. Yaqeenan yeh (Allah taalaa ka) khla hua fazal hai.
Aur suliman ke liye un ke sare lashkar jama krdie gaye the jo jinnat, insano aur parindon par mushtamil the, chunanche unhein qaabu mein rakhha jata tha.

Yahan tak ke ek din jab yeh sab chuntiyon ki wadi mein pahunche to ek chunti ne kaha : chunityon ! Apne apne gharon mein gahasa jao, kahin aisa na ho ke suliman aur un ka lashkar tumhein pees dale, aur unhein pata bhi na chale.

Us ki baat par suliman muskura kar hnse, aur kehne lage : mere par wrgar ! Mujhe us baat ka paband bana dijiye ke mein un nematon ka shukar ada karoon jo aap ne mujhe aur mere walidain ko ata farmaee hain, aur woh nek amal karoon jo aap ko pasand ho, aur apni rehmat se mujhe apne nek bandon mein shamil frmalijie.
Aur unhon ne (ek martaba) parindon ki hazri li to kaha : kya baat hai, mujhe hadahad nazar nahin aaraha, kya woh kahin gayab hogaya hai ?
Mein use sakht saza doon ga, ya use zibah kar dalon ga, illa yeh ke woh mere samne koi wazeh wajah pesh kare.
Phir hadahad ne ziyada dair nahin lagayi aur (aaker) kaha ke : mein ne aisi maloomaat hasil ki hain jin ka aap ko ilm nahin hai, aur mein mulk sheba se aap ke paas ek yaqeeni khabar le kar aaya hon.
Mein ne wahan ek aurat ko paya jo un logon par badshaat kar rahi hai, aur us ko har tarah ka sazosaman diya gaya hai, aur us ka ek shaandaar takht bhi hai.

Mein ne us aurat aur us ki qaum ko paya hai ke woh Allah ko chhor kar suraj ke aage sajde karte hain, aur shetan ne un ko yeh samjha diya hai ke un ke aemaal bohat achhe hain, chunanche us ne unhein sahih raaste se rok rakhha hai aur us tarah woh hidayat se itne door hain.
Ke Allah ko sajda nahin karte, jo aasmanon aur zameen ki chhpi hui cheezon ko bahar nikal laata hai, aur tum jo kuchh chhpa aur jo kuchh zaahir karo, sab ko jaanta hai.
Allah to woh hai jis ke siwa koi ibadat ke layaq nahin (aur) jo arsh azeem ka maalik hai.
Suliman ne kaha : hum abhi dekh lete hain ke tum ne sach kaha hai ya jhoot bolne walon mein tum bhi shamil hogaye ho.
Mera yeh khat le kar jao aur un ke paas daal dena, phir alag hatt jana, aur dekhna ke woh jawab mein kiya karte hain.
(chunanche hadahad ne aisa hi kiya aur) malika ne (apne darbariyon se) kaha : qaum ke sardaro ! Mere samne ek baq-waqar khat dala gaya hai.
Woh suliman ki taraf se aaya hai aur woh Allah ke naam se shuroo kiya gaya hai jo Rahman o raheem hai.
(us mein lkha hai) ke : mere muqable mein sarkashi na karo, aur mere paas tabe daar bann kar chale aao
Malika ne kaha : qaum ke sardaro ! Jo masla mere samne aaya hai us mein mujhe faisla kin mashwara do. Mein kisi msile ka htmi faisla us waqt tak nahin karti jab tak tum mere paas maujood na ho.
Unhon ne kaha : hum taaqatwar aur data kar larne wale log hain, aage mamla aap ke supurd hai, ab aap dekh len ke kiya hukum deti hain.

Malika boli : haqeeqat yeh hai ke baadshah log jab kisi basti mein gahasa aate hain to use kharab kar daalte hain, aur us ke ba-izzat bashindon ko zaleel kar ke chorte hain, aur yehi kuchh yeh log bhi karen ge.
Aur mein un ke paas ek tohfa bhejti hon, phir dekhun gi ke elchi kya jawab le kar wapas aate hain ?

Chunanche jab elchi suliman ke paas pahuncha to unhon ne kaha : kya tum maal se meri imdad karna chahte ho ? Us ka jawab yeh hai ke Allah ne jo kuchh mujhe diya hai woh us se kahin behtar hai jo tumhein diya hai, albatta tum hi log apne tohfe par khush hote ho.

Un ke paas wapas jao, kyunke ab hum un ke paas aise lashkar le kar pahunchenge jin ke muqable ki un mein tab nahin hogi, aur unhein wahan se us tarah nikalenge ke woh zaleel hon ge, aur ma-tehat bann kar rahen ge.
Suliman ne kaha : ae ehle darbaar ! Tum mein se kaun hai jo us aurat ka takht un ke tabe daar bann kar aane se pehle hi mere paas le aaye ?

Ek koi haykal jin ne kaha : aap apni jagah se utahe bhi na hon ge ke mein us se pehle hi use aap ke paas le aaon ga, aur yaqeen rkhie ke mein us kaam ki poori taqat rakhta hon (aur) amanat daar bhi hon.

Jis ke paas kitab ka ilm tha, woh bol atha : mein aap ki aankh jhapakne se pehle hi use aap ke paas le aata hon. Chunanche jab suliman ne woh takht apne paas rakhha hua dekha to kaha : yeh mere Parwardigar ka fazal hai, taake woh mujhe aazmaye ke mein shukar karta hon ya shukri ? Aur jo koi shukar karta hai to apne hi faiyde ke liye shukar karta hai, aur agar koi shukri kare to mera Parwardigar bey-niaz hai, kareem hai.
Suliman ne (apne khdam se) kaha ke : us malika ke takht ko us ke liye ajnabi bnado . Dekhen woh use phchanti hai, ya woh un logon mein se hai jo haqeeqat tak nahin pahunchte ?

Garz jab woh aayi to us se pochha gaya : kya tumhara takht aisa hi hai ? Kehne lagi : aisa lagta hai ke yeh to bilkul wahi hai. Humein to us se pehle hi (aap ki sacchayi ka) ilm ata hogaya tha, aur hum sar jhuka chuke the.
Aur (ab tak) us ko (iman lane se) us baat ne rok rakhha tha ke woh Allah ke bajaye dusron ki ibadat karti thi, aur ek kafir qaum se talluq rakhti thi.

Us se kaha gaya ke : us mehal mein dakhil hojao us ne jo dekha to yeh samjhi ke yeh pani hai, us liye us ne (paiinche charha kar) apni pindliyan khol den. Suliman ne kaha ke : yeh to mehal hai jo shishon ki wajah se shafaaf nazar aaraha hai. Malika bol athi : mere Parwardigar ! Haqeeqat yeh hai ke mein ne (ab tak) apni jaan par zulm kiya hai aur ab mein ne suliman ke saath rubb aalameen ki farmanbardari qabool karli hai.
Aur hum ne qaum samood ke paas un ke bhai saleh ko yeh paygham de kar bheja ke tum Allah ki ibadat karo to achanak woh do giroh bann gaye jo aapas mein jhagre lage.
Saleh ne kaha : meri qaum ke logo ! Achhaii se pehle buraee ko kyun jaldi maangte ho. Tum Allah se maafi kyun nahin maangte taake tum par reham farmaya jaye ?
Unhon ne kaha : hum ne to tum se aur tumhare saathiyon se bura shagun liya hai, . Saleh ne kaha tumhara shagun to Allah ke qabze mein hai, albatta tum logon ki aazmaish horhi hai.
Aur shehar mein no aadmi aise the jo zameen mein fasaad machate the, aur islaah ka kaam nahin karte the.

Unhon ne (aapas mein ek dusre se) kaha : sab malakar Allah ki qasam kha ke hum saleh aur us ke ghar walon par raat ke waqt hamla karen ge, phir us ke waris se keh den ge ke hum un ghar walon ki halakat ke waqt maujood hi na the. Aur yaqeen jaano hum bilkul sache hain.
Unhon ne yeh chaal chali aur hum ne bhi ek chaal us tarah chali ke un ko pata bhi na lag saka.
Ab dekho ke un ki chaal baazi ka anjaam kaisa hua ke hum ne unhein aur un ki saari qaum ko tabaah kar ke rakaha diya.
Chunanche woh rahe un ke ghar jo un ke zulm ki wajah se weeran pare hain. Yaqeenan us waqiye mein un logon ke liye ibrat ka samaan hai jo ilm se kaam lete hain.
Aur jo log iman laye the aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiye hue the un sab ko hum ne bacha liya.
Aur hum ne loot ko payghumbar bana kar bheja jabke unhon ne apni qaum se kaha tha ke : kya tum khuli aankhon dekhte hue bhi behiaii ka yeh kaam karte ho ?
Kya yeh koi yaqeen karne ki baat hai ke tum apni jnsi khwahish ke liye aurton ko chhor kar mardon ke paas jate ho ? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke tum bari jahalat ke kaam karne wale log ho.
Us par yeh kehne ke siwa un ki qaum ka koi jawab nahin tha ke : loot ke ghar walon ko apni basti se nikal bahar karo, yeh bare paakbaaz bante hain.
Phir hua yeh ke hum ne loot aur us ke ghar walon ko bacha liya, siwaye un ki biwi ke jis ke bare mein hum ne yeh tai kardiya tha ke woh peechhe reh jane walon mein shamil rahe gi.
Aur hum ne un par ek zabardast baarish barsayi, chunanche bohat buri baarish thi jo un logon par brsi jinhen pehle se khabardar kardiya gaya tha.

(ae payghumbar) kaho : tamam tareefen Allah ke liye hain aur salam ho us ke un bandon par jin ko us ne muntakhab farmaya hai batao kya Allah behtar hai ya woh jin ko un logon ne Allah ki khudayi mein shareek bana rakhha hai ?

Bhala woh kaun hai jis ne aasmanon aur zameen ko paida kya, aur tumhare liye aasman se pani utara ? Phir hum ne us pani se ba-ronaq baagh ugaye, tumhare bas mein nahin tha ke tum un ke darakhton ko uga sakte. Kya (phir bhi tum kehte ho ke) Allah ke saath koi aur khuda hai ? Nahin ! Bulke un logon ne raaste se moonh mor rakhha hai.

Bhala woh kaun hai jis ne zameen ko qarar ki jagah banaya, aur us ke bech bech mein darya paida kiye, aur us (ko thhrane) ke liye (paharon ki) mekhein gaar den, aur do samandaron ke darmiyan ek aarr rakaha di ? Kya (phir bhi tum kehte ho ke) Allah ke saath koi aur khuda hai ? Nahin ! Bulke un mein se aksar log haqeeqat se nawaqif hain.

Bhala woh kaun hai ke jab koi beqrar use pukarta hai to woh us ki dua qabool karta hai, aur takleef door kardyta hai aur jo tumhein zameen ka khalifa banata hai ? Kya (phir bhi tum kehte ho ke) Allah ke saath koi aur khuda hai ? Nahin ! Bulke tum bohat kam naseehat qabool karte ho.

Bhala woh kaun hai jo khushki aur samandar ke andheron mein tumhein raasta dikhata hai aur jo apni rehmat (ki baarish) se pehle hawayen bhejta hai jo tumhein (baarish ki) khushkhabri deti hain ? Kya (phir bhi tum kehte ho ke) Allah ke saath koi aur khuda hai ? (nahin ! Bulke) Allah us shirk se bohat baala o bartar hai jis ka irteqab yeh log kar rahe hain.

Bhala woh kaun hai jis ne saari makhlooq ko pehli baar paida kya, phir woh us ko dobara paida kare ga, aur jo tumhein aasman aur zameen se rizq faraham karta hai ? Kya (phir bhi tum kehte ho ke) Allah ke saath koi aur khuda hai ? Kaho : lao apni koi daleel, agar tum sache ho.
Keh do ke : Allah ke siwa aasmanon aur zameen mein kisi ko bhi gaib ka ilm nahin hai. Aur logon ko yeh bhi pata nahin hai ke unhein kab dobara zinda kiya jaye ga.
Bulke aakhirat ke bare mein un (kafiron) ka ilm bus ho kar reh gaya hai, bulke woh us ke bare mein shakk mein mubtila hain, bulke us se andhe hochke hain.
Jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai, woh kehte hain ke : kya jab hum aur humare baap dade mitti hochke hon ge to kya us waqt waqayi humein (qabron se) nikala jaye ga ?

Hum se aur humare baap dadon se us qasam ke wade pehle bhi kiye gaye the, (lekin) un ki haqeeqat us ke siwa kuchh nahin ke yeh qsa kahaniyan hain jo purane zamane ke logon se naqal hoti chali aarahi hain.
Kaho ke : zara zameen mein safar kar ke dekho ke mujreemon ka anjaam kaisa hua hai.
Aur (ae payghumbar) tum un logon par ghum na karo, aur yeh jis makkari ka mzahra kar rahe hain, un ki wajah se ghuttan mehsoos na karo.
Yeh (tum se) yun kehte hain ke : yeh wada kab poora hoga, agar tum sache ho ?
Keh do ke : kuchh baeed nahin hai ke jis azab ki tum jaldi macha rahe ho, us ka kuchh hissa tumhare bilkul paas aalga ho.
