Us ka subah ka safar bhi ek mahine ki msaft ka hota tha, aur shaam ka safar bhi ek mahine ki msaft ka aur hum ne un ke liye taanbe ka chashma baha diya tha. Aur jinnat mein se kuchh woh the jo apne Parwardigar ke hukum se un ke aage kaam karte the aur (hum ne un par yeh baat wazeh kardi thi ke) un mein se koi humare hukum se hatt kar tairhaa raasta ikhtiyar kare ga, use hum bharakti hui aag ka mza chakhayen ge.

Woh jinnat suliman ke liye jo woh chahte banadiya karte the, unchi unchi imaratein, tasvirein hauz jaise bare bare lagan aur zameen mein jami hui degein. Ae dad ke khandaan walo ! Tum aise amal kiya karo jin se shukar zaahir ho. Aur mere bandon mein kam log hain jo shukar guzar hon.

Phir jab hum ne suliman ki maut ka faisla kiya to un jinnat ko un ki maut ka pata kisi aur ne nahin bulke zameen ke keere ne diya jo un ke asa ko kha raha tha. Chunanche jab woh grpre to jinnat ko maloom hua ke agar woh gaib ka ilm jante hote to us zillat wali takleef mein mubtila na rehte.

Haqeeqat yeh hai ke qaum sheba ke liye khud us jagah ek nishani maujood thi jahan woh raha karte the. Dayen aur bayein dono taraf baaghon ke do silsile the. Apne Parwardigar ka diya hua rizq kha aur us ka shukar baja lao, ek to shehar behtareen, dusre Parwardigar bakhshne wala.

Phir bhi unhon ne (hidayat se) moonh mor liya, us liye hum ne un par bandon illa sailaab chhor diya, aur un ke dono taraf ke baaghon ko aise do baaghon mein tabdeel kardiya jo bdmza phlon, jhaao ke darakhton aur thori si beriyon par mushtamil the.
Yeh saza hum ne un ko us liye di ke unhon ne shukri ki rawish ikhtiyar ki thi, aur aisi saza hum kisi aur ko nahin, bare bare na-shukron hi ko diya karte hain.

Aur hum ne un ke aur un bastiyon ke darmiyan jin par hum ne barkatein nazil ki hain, aisi bastiyan basa rkhi thin jo door se nazar aati thin, aur un mein safar ko npe tale mrhlon mein bant diya tha (aur kaha tha ke) un (bastiyon) ke darmiyan raatein hon ya din, aman mein ke saath safar karo.

Us par woh kehne lage ke : humare Parwardigar ! Humare safar ki mnzlon ke darmiyan door door ke faasle paida karde, aur yun unhon ne apni janon par sitam dhaya, jis ke natije mein hum ne unhein afsana hi afsana banadiya, aur unhein tukre tukre kar ke bilkul tatara batara kardiya. Yaqeenan us waqiye mein har us shaks ke liye bari nishaniyan hain jo sabar o shukar ka khugar ho.
Aur waqayi un logon ke bare mein iblees ne apna khayal durust paya chunanche yeh usi ke peechhe chal pare, siwaye us giroh ke jo momin tha.

Aur iblees ko un par koi tasallut nahin tha, albatta hum (ne us ko behkane ki salahiyat us liye di thi ke) hum yeh dekhna chahte the ke kaun hai jo aakhirat par iman laata hai aur kaun hai jo us ke bare mein shakk mein para hua hai. Aur tumhara Parwardigar har cheez par nigraan hai.

(ae payghumbar ! Un kafiron se) kaho ke pukaro un ko jinhen tum ne Allah ke siwa khuda samjha hua hai. Woh aasmanon aur zameen mein zra barabar kisi cheez ke maalik nahin hain, na un ko aasman o zameen ke maamlaat mein (Allah ke saath) koi shirkat hasil hai, aur na un mein se koi Allah ka madadgar hai.

Aur Allah ke samne koi sifarish karaamd nahin hai, siwaye us shaks ke jis ke liye khud us ne (sifarish ki) ijazat de di ho, yahan tak ke jab un ke dilon se ghabrahat door kardi jati hai to woh kehte hain ke : tumhare rubb ne kya farmaya ? Woh jawab dete hain ke : haqq baat irshad farmaee aur wahi hai jo bara alishan hai.
Kaho ke kaun hai jo tumhein aasmanon se aur zameen se rizq deta hai ? Kaho : woh Allah hai ! Aur hum hon ya tum, ya to hidayat par hain ya khuli gumrahi mein mubtila hain.
Kaho ke : hum ne jo jurm kiya ho, us ke bare mein tum se nahin pochha jaye ga, aur tum jo amal karte ho, us ke bare mein hum se sawal nahin hoga.
Kaho ke : hamara Parwardigar hum sab ko jama kare ga, phir humare darmiyan barhaqq faisla kare ga, aur wahi hai jo khoob faisle karne wala, mukammal ilm ka maalik hai.

Kaho ke : zara mujhe dkha woh kaun hain jinhen tum ne shareek bana kar Allah se jor rakhha hai. Hargiz nahin ! (us ka koi shareek nahin hai) bulke woh Allah hai jis ka iqtedar bhi kamil hai, jis ki hikmat bhi kamil
Aur (ae payghumbar) hum ne tumhein sare hi insano ke liye aisa Rasool bana kar bheja hai jo khushkhabri bhi sunaye aur khabardar bhi kare, lekin aksar log samajh nahin rahe hain.
Aur (tum se) kehte hain ke : agar tum sache ho to yeh (qayamat ka) wada kab poora hoga ?
Keh do ke : tumhare liye ek aise din ki miyad muqarrar hai jis se tum ghri barabar na peechhe hatt sakte ho na aage sakte ho.

Aur jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai woh kehte hain ke : hum na to us quran par kabhi iman layein ge aur na un (aasmani kitabon) par jo us se pehle hui hain. Aur agar tum us waqt ka manzar dekho jab yeh zalim log apne Parwardigar ke samne khre kiie jayen ge to yeh ek dusre par baat daal rahe hon ge. Jin logon ko (duniya mein) kamzor samjha gaya tha woh un se kahin ge jo bare bane hue the ke : agar tum na hote to hum zaroor momin bann jate.
Jo bare bane hue the un se kahin ge jinhen kamzor samjha gaya tha ke : kya hum ne tumhein hidayat se roka tha jabke woh tumhare paas chuki thi ? Asal baat yeh hai ke tum khud mujrim the.

Aur jinhen kamzor samjha gaya tha woh un se kahin ge jo bare bane hue the ke : nahin, yeh tumhari raat din ki makkari hi to thi (jis ne humein roka tha) jab tum humein takeed karte the ke hum Allah se kufr ka mamla karen, aur us ke saath (dusron ko) shareek manen. Aur yeh sab jab azab ko dekh len ge to apna pchhtaoa chhpa rahe hon ge. Aur jin jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyar kiya tha hum un sab ke galon mein toq daal den ge. Un ko kisi aur baat ka nahin, unhi aemaal ka badla diya jaye ga jo woh kiya karte the.
Aur jis kisi basti mein hum ne koi khabardar karne wala payghumbar bheja, us ke khush haal logon ne yehi kaha ke : jis paygham ke saath tumhein bheja gaya hai hum us ko maanne se inkar karte hain.
Aur kaha ke : hum maal aur aulad mein tum se ziyada hain aur humein azab hone wala nahin hai.
Keh do ke : mera Parwardigar ! Jis ke liye chahta hai rizq ki farawani kardyta hai aur (jis ke liye chahta hai) tangi kardyta hai, lekin aksar log us baat ko samajhte nahin hain.

Aur na tumhare maal tumhein Allah ka qurb ata karte hain aur na tumhari aulad. Haan magar jo iman laye aur nek amal kare to aise logon ko un ke amal ka dohra sawab mile ga, aur woh (jannat ke) balakhanon mein chain karen ge.
Aur jo log hamari aayaton ke bare mein yeh koshish karte hain ke un ko nakaam banayen, un ko azab mein dhar liya jaye ga.

Keh do ke : mera Parwardigar apne bandon mein se jis ke liye chahta hai rizq ki farawani kardyta hai, aur (jis ke liye chahta hai) tangi kardyta hai. Aur tum jo cheez bhi kharch karte ho woh us ki jagah aur cheez de deta hai, aur wahi sab se behtar rizq dene wala hai.
Aur woh din na bhoolo jab Allah un sab ko jama kare ga, phir farishton se kahe ga ke : kya yeh log waqayi tumhari ibadat kya karte the ?
Woh kahin ge ke : hum to aap ki zaat ki paki biyan karte hain, hamara talluq aap se hai, un logon se nahin. Dar-asal yeh to jinnat ki ibadat kiya karte the. Un mein se aksar log unhi ke mataqad the.

Lihaza aaj tum mein se koi na kisi ko koi faida pahunchane ka ikhtiyar rakhta hai, na nuksan pahunchane ka. Aur jin logon ne zulm ki rawish ikhtiyar ki thi, un se hum kahin ge ke : us aag ka mza chkho jis ko tum jhutlaya karte the.

Aur jab hamari aayaten jo mukammal wazahat ki haamil hain un ko parh kar sunayi jati hain to yeh (humare payghumbar ke bare mein) kehte hain ke : kuchh nahin, yeh shaks bas yeh chahta hai ke tum logon ko un maboodon se bargashta karde jinhen tumhare baap dade poojhte aaye hain. Aur kehte hain ke : yeh (quran) kuchh bhi nahin, ek mann gharat jhoot hai. Aur jab un kafiron ke paas haqq ka paygham aaya to unhon ne us ke bare mein yeh kaha ke : yeh to ek khle jadoo ke siwa kuchh nahin hai.
Halaanke hum ne unhein pehle na aisi kitabein di thin jo yeh parhte prhate hon aur na (ae payghumbar) tum se pehle hum ne un ke paas koi khabardar karne wala (nabi) bheja tha.

Aur un se pehle logon ne bhi (payghumbaron) ko jhutlaya tha, aur yeh (arab ke mushrikeen) to us sazosaman ke daswen hisse ko bhi nahin pahunche hain jo hum ne un (pehle logon) ko de rakhha tha, phir bhi unhon ne mere payghumbaron ko jhutlaya, to (dekh lo ke) meri di hui saza kaisi (sakht) thi.

(ae payghumbar) un se kaho ke : mein tumhein sirf ek baat ki naseehat karta hon aur woh yeh ke tum chahaye do do mill kar aur chahaye akele akele Allah ki khatir ath khre ho. Phir (insaf se) socho (tofora samajh mein aajaye ga ke) tumhare us sathi (yani Muhammad (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) mein junoon ki koi baat bhi to nahin hai. Woh to ek sakht azab ke aane se pehle tumhein khabardar krrhe hain.
Kaho : mein ne agar us baat par tum se koi ujrat maangi ho to woh tumhari hai. Mera ajar to Allah ke siwa kisi ke zimme nahin hai, aur woh har cheez ka mushahida karne wala hai.
Keh do ke : mera Parwardigar haqq ko upar se bhej raha hai. Woh gaib ki saari baaton ko khoob janne wala hai.
Keh do ke : haqq chuka hai aur baatil mein na kuchh shuroo karne ka dum hai na dobara karne ka.

Keh do ke : agar mein raaste se bhatka hon to mere bhatakne ka nuksan mujhi ko hoga, aur agar mein ne seedha raasta palia hai to yeh us wahee ki badaulat hai jo mera rubb mujh par nazil kar raha hai. Woh yaqeenan sab kuchh sunne wala, har ek se qareeb hai.

(ae payghumbar tumhein un ki halat ajeeb nazar aaye gi) agar tum woh manzar dekho jab yeh ghabraye phrte hon ge, aur bhaag nikalne ka koi raasta nahin hoga, aur unhein qareeb hi se pakar liya jaye ga.
Aur (us waqt) yeh kahin ge ke : hum us par iman le aaye hain. Halaanke itni door jagah se un ko koi cheez kaise haath sakti hai ?
Jabke unhon ne pehle us ka inkar kiya tha, aur door door se atk pchon teer phinka karte the.

Aur us waqt yeh jis (iman) ki aarzoo karen ge us ke aur un ke darmiyan ek aarr kardi jaye gi, jaisa ke un jaise jo log un se pehle hue hain un ke saath bhi yehi mamla hoga. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh sab aise shakk mein pare hue the jis ne unhein dhoke mein daal rakhha tha.

Tamam tar tareef Allah ki hai jo aasmanon aur zameen ka paida karne wala hai, jis ne un farishton ko paygham le jane ke liye muqarrar kiya hai, jo do do, teen teen aur char char paron wale hain. Woh pedaeesh mein jitna chahta hai azafa kardyta hai. Be-shak Allah har cheez ki qudrat rakhne wala hai.

Jis rehmat ko Allah logon ke liye khol de, koi nahin hai jo use rok sake aur jise woh rok le to koi nahin hai jo us ke baad use chhra sake. Aur wahi hai jo iqtedar ka bhi maalik hai, hikmat ka bhi maalik.

Ae logo ! Yaad karo un nematon ko jo Allah ne tum par nazil ki hain. Kya Allah ke siwa koi aur khaliq hai jo tumhein aasman aur zameen se rizq deta ho ? Us ke siwa koi mabood nahin hai. Phir aakhir tum kahan ondhe chale jarahe ho ?
Aur (ae payghumbar) agar yeh log tumhein jhutla rahe hain to tum se pehle bhi payghumbaron ko jhutlaya gaya hai. Aur tamam maamlaat aakhir kaar Allah hi ki taraf lotaye jayen ge.

Ae logo ! Yaqeen jaano ke Allah ka wada sacha hai, lihaza tumhein yeh dunyawi zindagi hargiz dhoke mein na dale, aur na Allah ke maamle mein tumhein woh (shetan) dhoke mein daalne paye jo bara dhoke baaz hai.
Yaqeen jaano ke shetan tumhara dushman hai, us liye us ko dushman hi samajhte raho. Woh to apne maanne walon ko jo dawat deta hai woh us liye deta hai taake woh dozakh ke basi bann jayen.
Jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai, un ke liye shadeed azab hai aur jo log iman le aaye hain, aur unhon ne nek amal kiye hain, un ke liye magfirat hai aur bara ajar.

Bhala batao ke jis shaks ki nazron mein us ki bdmli hi khushnuma bana kar pesh ki gayi ho, jis ki bana par woh us bdmli ko achha samajhta ho (woh nek aadmi ke barabar kaise sakta hai ?) kyunke Allah jis ko chahta hai raaste se bhatka deta hai, aur jis ko chahta hai theek raaste par pahuncha deta hai. Lihaza (ae payghumbar) aisa na ho ke un (kafiron) par afsos ke maare tumhari jaan hi jati rahe. Yaqeen rakho ke jo kuchh yeh kar rahe hain Allah use khoob jaanta hai.

Aur Allah hi hai jo hawayen bhejta hai phir woh baadalon ko athati hain, phir hum unhein hanka kar ek aise shehar ki taraf le jate hain jo (qehat se) murda hochka hota hai, phir hum us (baarish) ke zariye murda zameen ko naee zindagi ata karte hain. Bas usi tarah insano ki dusri zindagi hogi.

Jo shaks izzat hasil karna chahta ho, to tamam tar izzat Allah ke qabze mein hai. Pakeeza kalma usi ki taraf charhta hai aur nek amal us ko upar athata hai. Aur jo log buri buri makkariyan kar rahe hain, un ko sakht azab hoga, aur un ki makkari hi hai jo mill ya mait hojaye gi.

Aur Allah ne tumhein mitti se paida kiya, phir nutfe se, phir tumhein jore jore banadiya. Aur kisi mada ko jo koi hamal hota hai, aur jo kuchh woh jannati hai woh sab Allah ke ilm se hota hai. Aur kisi umar raseeda ko jitni umar di jati hai, aur us ki umar mein jo koi kami hoti hai, woh sab ek kitab mein darj hai. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh sab kuchh Allah ke liye bohat aasan hai.

Aur do darya barabar nahin hote. Ek aisa mitha hai ke us se pyas bjhti hai, jo peene mein khushgawar hai aur dusra karwa nmkin. Aur har ek se tum (mchhlion ka) taza gosht kahate ho, aur woh zewar nikalte ho jo tumhare pehanne ke kaam aata hai. Aur tum kashtiyon ko dekhte ho ke woh us (darya) mein pani ko pharti hui chalti hain, taake tum Allah ka fazal talash karo, aur taake shukar guzar bano.

Woh raat ko din mein dakhil kardyta hai aur din ko raat mein dakhil kardyta hai aur us ne suraj aur chand ko kaam par laga diya hai. (un mein se) har ek kisi muqarrara miyad tak ke liye rawan doan hai. Yeh hai Allah jo tumhara Parwardigar hai, saari baadshahi usi ki hai. Aur use chhor kar jin (jhoote khudaon) ko tum pukarte ho, woh khajoor ki guthli ke chilke ke barabar bhi koi ikhtiyar nahin rakhte.

Agar tum un ko pukaro ge to woh tumhari pukar sunen ge hi nahin, aur agar sunn bhi len to tumhein koi jawab nahin de saken ge. Aur qayamat ke din woh khud tumhare shirk ki tardeed karen ge. Aur jis zaat ko tamam baaton ki mukammal khabar hai us ki barabar tumhein koi aur sahih baat nahin bataye ga.
Ae logo ! Tum sab Allah ke mohtaj ho, aur Allah bey-niaz hai, har tareef ka bzat khud mustahiq
Agar woh chahaye to tum sab ko fana karde, aur ek naee makhlooq wajood mein le aaye.
Aur yeh kaam Allah ke liye kuchh bhi mushkil nahin hai.

Aur koi bojh athane wala kisi dusre ka bojh nahin athaie ga aur jis kisi par bara bojh lada hua ho, woh agar kisi aur ko us ke athane ki dawat de ga to us mein se kuchh bhi utahaya nahin jaye ga, chahaye woh (jise bojh athane ki dawat di gayi thi) koi qareebi rishta daar hi kyun na ho. (ae payghumbar) tum unhi logon ko khabardar krskte ho jo apne Parwardigar ko dikhe baghair us se darte hon. Aur jinhon ne namaz qayam ki ho, aur jo shaks pak hota hai woh apne hi faiyde ke liye pak hota hai. Aur aakhir-e-kaar sab ko Allah hi ki taraf lot kar jana hai.
Aur andha aur dekhne wala barabar nahin sakte.
Aur na andhere aur roshni
Aur na saia aur dhoop
Aur zinda log aur murde barabar nahin sakte, aur Allah to jis ko chahta hai baat suna deta hai, aur tum un ko baat nahin suna sakte jo qabron mein pare hain.
Tum to bas ek khabardar karne wale ho.
Hum ne tumhein haqq baat de kar us tarah bheja hai ke tum khushkhabri do aur khabardar karo, aur koi ummat aisi nahin hai jis mein koi khabar daar karne wala na aaya ho.

Aur agar yeh log tumhein jhutla rahe hain to jo (kafir) un se pehle the, unhon ne bhi (rasoolon ko) jhutlaya tha. Un ke payghumbar un ke paas khuli khuli nishaniyan le kar, saheefe le kar aur roshni philane wali kitab le kar aaye the.
Phir jin logon ne inkar ki rawish apnaii thi mein ne unhein pakar mein le liya. Ab dekho ke meri saza kaisi (haulnaak) thi.

Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke Allah ne aasman se pani utara, phir hum ne us ke zariye rang rang ke pahala ugaye ? Aur paharon mein bhi aise tukre hain jo rang rang ke safaid aur surkh hain, aur kale siyah bhi.

Aur insano aur jaanwaron aur chopayon mein bhi aise hain jin ke rang mukhtalif hain. Allah se us ke bandon mein se wahi darte hain jo ilm rakhne wale hain. Yaqeenan Allah sahib iqtedar bhi hai, bohat bakhshne wala bhi.

Jo log Allah ki kitab ki tilawat karte hain, aur jinhon ne namaz ki pabandi kar rkhi hai, aur hum ne unhein jo rizq diya hai us mein se woh (nek kaamon mein) khfia aur lania kharch karte hain, woh aisi tijarat ke umeedwaar hain jo kabhi nuksan nahin athaie gi.
Taake Allah un ke poore ajar un ko de, aur apne fazal se aur ziyada bhi de. Yaqeenan woh bohat bakhshne wala, bara qadar daan hai.

Aur (ae payghumbar) hum ne tumhare paas wahee ke zariye jo kitab bheji hai woh sachi hai jo apne se pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq karti hui aayi hai. Yaqeenan Allah apne bandon se poori tarah bakhabar, har cheez ko dekhne wala hai.

Phir hum ne us kitab ka waris apne bandon mein se un ko banaya jinhen hum ne chun liya tha phir un mein se kuchh woh hain jo apni jaan par zulm karne wale hain, aur unhi mein se kuchh aise hain jo drmiane darje ke hain, aur kuchh woh hain jo Allah ki tofiq se nekiyon mein barhe chale jate hain. Aur yeh (Allah ka) bohat bara fazal hai.
Hamesha basne ke baghaat hain jin mein woh log dakhil hon ge wahan un ko sone ke kangano aur motiyon se aarasta kiya jaye ga aur un ka libas wahan par resham hoga.
Aur woh kahin ge ke : tamam tar tareef Allah ki hai jis ne hum se har ghum door kardiya. Be-shak hamara Parwardigar bohat bakhshne wala, bara qadardaan hai.
Jis ne apne fazal se hum ko abadi thikane ke ghar mein laa utara hai jis mein na humein kabhi koi kalafat chhokr guzre gi, aur na kabhi koi tahakan pesh aaye gi.

Aur jin logon ne kufr ki rawish apna li hai un ke liye dozakh ki aag hai, na to un ka kaam tamam kiya jaye ga ke woh marr hi jayen, aur na un se dozakh ka azab halka kiya jaye ga. Har shukre kafir ko hum aisi hi saza dete hain.

Aur woh us dozakh mein cheekh pukar machayein ge ke : ae humare Parwardigar ! Humein bahar nikal de taake hum jo kaam pehle kya karte the unhein chhor kar nek amal karen. (un se jawab mein kaha jaye ga ke) bhala kya hum ne tumhein itni umar nahin di thi ke jis kisi ko us mein sochna samajhna hota, woh samajh leta ? Aur tumhare paas khabardar karne wala bhi aaya tha. Ab maza chkho, kyunke koi nahin hai jo aise zalimon ka madadgar bane.
Be-shak Allah aasmanon aur zameen ki posheeda cheezon ka ilm rakhta hai. Be-shak woh seeno mein chhpi hui baaton ko khoob jaanta hai.

Wahi hai jis ne tumhein zameen mein (pichle logon ka) janasheen banaya. Ab jo shaks kufr kare ga to us ka kufr usi par pare ga. Aur kafiron ke liye un ka kufr un ke Parwardigar ke paas gazab ke siwa kisi aur cheez mein azafa nahin karta, aur kafiron ko un ke kufr se khasare ke siwa kisi cheez mein taraqqi hasil nahin hoti.

(ae payghumbar) un se kaho ke : bhala batao tum Allah ko chhor kar apne jin mann gharat shareekon ko pooja karte ho, zara mujhe dkha ke unhon ne zameen ka kaunsa hissa paida kya hai ? Ya aasmanon (ki pedaeesh mein) un ki kaunsi shirkat hai ? Ya phir hum ne unhein koi kitab de rkhi hai jis ki kisi wazeh hidayat par yeh log qayam hain ? Nahin, bulke yeh zalim log ek dusre ko khalis dhoke ki yaqeen dihani karte aaye hain.

Haqeeqat yeh hai ke Allah ne aasmanon aur zameen ko tham rakhha hai ke woh apni jagah se tlin nahin, aur agar woh tal jayen to us ke siwa koi nahin hai jo unhein tham sake. Yaqeenan Allah bara burdbaar, bohat bakhshne wala hai.

Aur unhon ne pehle Allah ki bare zoron mein qasmen khaii thin ke agar un ke paas koi khabardar karne wala (payghumbar) aaya to woh har dusri ummat se ziyada hidayat qabool karne wale hon ge. Magar jab un ke paas ek khabardar karne wala aagaya to us ke aane se un ki halat mein aur koi taraqqi nahin hui, siwaye us ke ke yeh (haqq ke raaste se) aur ziyada bhagne lage.

Us liye ke unhein zameen mein apni baraee ka ghamand tha, aur unhon ne (haqq ki mukhalifat mein) buri buri chalein chlni shuroo karden. Halaanke buri chalein kisi aur ko nahin khud apne chalne walon hi ko ghire mein le leti hain. Ab yeh log us dastoor ke siwa kis baat ke muntazir hain jis par pichle logon ke saath amal hota aaya hai ? (agar yeh baat hai) to tum Allah ke tai shda dastoor mein kabhi koi tabdili nahin pao ge, aur na tum Allah ke tai shda dastoor ko kabhi tlta hua pao ge.

Aur kya un logon ne zameen mein kabhi safar nahin kya jis se woh yeh dekhte ke jo log un se pehle guzre hain, un ka anjaam kaisa hua, jabke woh taqat mein un se bohat ziyada mazboot the ? Aur Allah aisa nahin hai ke aasmanon ya zameen ki koi cheez use aajiz karsake. Be-shak woh ilm ka bhi maalik hai, qudrat ka bhi maalik.

Aur agar Allah logon ke har kartoot par un ki pakar karne lagta to us zameen ki pusht par kisi chalne wale ko na chorta, lekin woh ek moyyen muddat tak ke liye un ko mohlat de raha hai. Phir jab un ka muqarrara waqt aajaye ga to Allah apne bandon ko khud dekh le ga.
Yaa Seen
Hikmat bhare quran ki qasam
Tum yaqeenan payghumbaron mein se ho.
Bilkul seedhe raaste par.
Yeh quran us zaat ki taraf se utara jaraha hai jis ka iqtedar bhi kamil hai, jis ki rehmat bhi kamil.
Taake tum un logon ko khabardar karo jin ke baap dadon ko pehle khabardar nahin kiya gaya tha, us liye woh gaflat mein pare hue hain.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke un mein se aksar logon ke bare mein baat poori hochuki hai. Us liye woh iman nahin late.
Hum ne un ke galon mein toq daal rkhe hain, jo thoriyon tak pahunche hue hain, aur us wajah se un ke sar upar ko utahe reh gaye hain.
Aur hum ne ek aarr un ke aage khri kardi hai, aur ek aarr un ke peechhe khri kardi hai, aur us tarah unhein har taraf se dhank liya hai jis ke natije mein unhein kuchh sujhayi nahin deta.
Aur un ke liye dono baatein barabar hain, chahaye tum unhein khabardar karo, ya khabardar na karo, woh iman nahin layein ge.
Tum to sirf aise shaks ko khabardar krskte ho jo naseehat par chale, aur khuda Rahman ko dikhe baghair us se dare. Chunanche aise shaks ko tum magfirat aur ba-izzat ajar ki khushkhabri suna do .

Yaqeenan hum hi mardon ko zinda karen ge, aur jo kuchh amal unhon ne aage bheje hain hum un ko bhi likhte jate hain aur un ke kaamon ke jo asraat hain un ko bhi. Aur hum ne ek wazeh kitab mein har har cheez ka poora ahata kar rakhha hai.
Aur (ae payghumbar) tum un ke samne ek basti walon ki misal pesh karo, jab un ke paas Rasool aaye the

Jab hum ne un ke paas (shuroo mein) do Rasool bheje, to unhon ne dono ko jhutla diya, phir hum ne ek teesre ke zariye un ki taeed ki, aur un sab ne kaha ke : yaqeen jaano humein tumhare paas Rasool bana kar bheja gaya hai.
Unhon ne kaha : tumhari haqeeqat us ke siwa kuchh bhi nahin ke tum hum jaise hi aadmi ho. Aur khuda Rahman ne koi cheez nazil nahin ki hai, aur tum sarasar jhoot bol rahe ho.
Un (rasoolon) ne kaha : hamara Parwardigar khoob jaanta hai ke humein waqayi tumhare paas Rasool bana kar bheja gaya hai.
Aur hamari zma daari us se ziyada nahin hai ke saaf saaf paygham pahuncha den.
Basti walon ne kaha : hum ne to tumhare andar nahoosat mehsoos ki hai. Yaqeen jaano agar tum baaz na aaye to hum tum par pathar barsayi ge, aur humare haathon tumhein bari dardnaak saza mile gi.

Rasoolon ne kaha : tumhari nahoosat khud tumhare saath lagi hui hai. Kya yeh baatein us liye kar rahe ho ke tumhein naseehat ki baat pahunchayi gayi hai ? Asal baat yeh hai ke tum khud hadd se guzre hue log ho.
Aur shehar ke parle ilaqe se ek shaks dorta hua aaya. Us ne kaha : ae meri qaum ke logo ! Un rasoolon ka kehna maan lo.
Un logon ka kehna maan lo jo tum se koi ujrat nahin maang rahe, aur woh sahih raaste par hain.
Aur bhala mein us zaat ki ibadat kyun na karoon jis ne mujhe paida kya hai ? Aur usi ki taraf tum sab ko wapas bheja jaye ga.
Bhala kya use chhor kar mein aison ko mabood manon ke agar khuda Rahman mujhe koi nuksan pahunchane ka arada karle to un ki sifarish mere kisi kaam na aaye, aur na woh mujhe chhra saken ?
Agar mein aisa karoon ga to yaqeenan mein khuli gumrahi mein mubtila hojaoon ga.
Mein to tumhare Parwardigar par iman lachka. Ab tum bhi meri baat sunn lo.

(aakhir kaar basti walon ne us ko qatal kardiya aur Allah taalaa ki taraf se us se) kaha gaya ke : jannat mein dakhil hojao us ne (jannat ki nematen dekh kar) kaha ke : kaash ! Meri qaum ko maloom hojaye.
Ke Allah ne kis tarah meri bakhsish ki hai, aur mujhe ba-izzat logon mein shamil kiya hai.
Aur us shaks ke baad hum ne us ki qaum par aasman se koi lashkar nahin utara, aur na humein utaarne ki zaroorat thi.
Woh to bas ek hi chinghar thi jis se woh ek dum bujh kar reh gaye.
Afsos hai aise bandon ke haal par. Un ke paas koi Rasool aisa nahin aaya jis ka woh mazaq na urate rahe hon.
Kya unhon ne nahin dekha ke un se pehle hum kitni qaumon ko us tarah halaak krchke hain ke woh un ke paas lot kar nahin aate ?
Aur yeh jitne log hain un sabhi ko aktha kar ke humare samne hazir kiya jaye ga.
Aur un ke liye ek nishani woh zameen hai jo murda pari hui thi, hum ne use zindagi ata ki, aur us ne ghla nikala, jis ki khuraak yeh kahate hain.
Aur hum ne us zameen mein khajooron aur angooron ke baagh paida kiye, aur aisa intezam kiya ke us mein se pani ke chashme phot nikle.
Taake yeh us ki paidawaar mein se kahyenge, halaanke us ko un ke haathon ne nahin banaya tha. Kya phir bhi yeh shukar nahin karen ge ?
Pak hai woh zaat jis ne har cheez ke jore jore paida kiye hain, us paidawaar ke bhi jo zameen ugati hai, aur khud insano ke bhi, aur un cheezon ke bhi jinhen yeh log (abhi) jante tak nahin hain.
Aur un ke liye ek aur nishani raat hai. Hum us par se din ka chhlka utaar lete hain to woh yakayak andhere mein reh jate hain.
Aur suraj apne thikane ki taraf chala jaraha hai. Yeh sab us zaat ka muqarrar kiya hua nizam hai jis ka iqtedar bhi kamil hai, jis ka ilm bhi kamil.
Aur chand hai ke hum ne us ki manzilen naap tol kar muqarrar kardi hain, yahan tak ke woh jab (un mnzlon ke dore se) lot kar aata hai to khajoor ki purani tehni ki tarah (putla) ho kar reh jata hai.
Na to suraj ki yeh majal hai ke woh chand ko japkre, aur na raat din se aage nikal sakti hai, aur yeh sab apne apne madaar mein teer rahe hain.
Aur un ke liye ek aur nishani yeh hai ke hum ne un ki aulad ko bhari hui kashti mein sawar kiya
Aur hum ne un ke liye usi jaisi aur cheezen bhi paida kin jin par yeh sawari karte hain.
Aur agar hum chahein to unhein garq kar dalen, jis ke baad na to koi un ki faryad ko pahunche aur na un ki jaan bachayi jaske.
Lekin yeh sab hamari taraf se ek rehmat hai, aur ek moyyen waqt tak (zindagi ka) mza athane ka mauqa hai. (jo unhein diya jaraha hai)
Aur jab un se kaha jata hai ke : bacho us (azab) se jo tumhare samne hai, aur jo tumhare (marne ke) ke baad aaye ga taake tum par reham kiya jaye. (to woh zara kaan nahin dharte)
Aur un ke Parwardigar ki nishaniyon mein se koi nishani aisi nahin aati jis se woh moonh na mor lete hon.

Aur jab un se kaha jata hai ke : Allah ne tumhein jo rizq diya hai us mein se (ghribon par bhi) kharch karo, to yeh kafir log musalmanon se kehte hain ke : kya hum un logon ko khana khlaii jinhen agar Allah chahta to khud khla deta ? (musalmano) tumhari haqeeqat us ke siwa kuchh bhi nahin ke tum khuli gumrahi mein pare hue ho.
Aur kehte hain ke : yeh (qayamat ka) wada kab poora hoga ? (musalmano) batao, agar tum sache ho.
(dar-asal) yeh log bas ek chinghar ka intezar kar rahe hain jo un ki hujjat baazi ke ain darmiyan unhein pakre gi.
Phir na yeh koi wasiyat krskin ge, aur na apne ghar walon ke paas lot kar jaskin ge.
Aur soor phonka jaye ga to yakayak yeh apni qabron se nikal kar apne Parwardigar ki taraf tezi se roana hojayen ge.

Kahin ge ke : haaye hamari kam bakhti ! Humein kis ne humare maraqad se atha khra kya hai ? (jawab mile ga ke) yeh wahi cheez hai jis ka khuda Rahman ne wada kya tha, aur payghumbaron ne sachi baat kahi thi.
Aur kuchh nahin, bas ek zoar ki aawaz hogi, jis ke baad yeh sab ke sab humare samne hazir krdie jayen ge.
Chunanche us din kisi shaks par koi zulm nahin hoga, aur tumhein kisi aur cheez ka nahin, bulke unhein kaamon ka badla mile ga jo tum kiya karte the.
Jannat wale log us din yaqeenan apne mashghale mein magan hon ge.
Aur woh un ki biwiyan ghne sayon mein aaram da nshston par take lagaye hue hon ge.
Wahan un ke liye mewe hon ge, aur unhein har woh cheez mile gi jo woh mngoaiin ge.
Rehmat wale Parwardigar ki taraf se unhein salam kaha jaye ga.
(aur kafiron se kaha jaye ga ke) ae mujrimon ! Aaj tum (momino se) alag hojao.
Ae adam ke bito ! Kiya mein ne tumhein yeh takeed nahin kardi thi ke tum shetan ki ibadat na karna, woh tumhara khla dushman hai.
Aur yeh ke tum meri ibadat karna, yehi seedha raasta hai.
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke shetan ne tum mein se ek bari khalqat ko gumraah kar dala. To kya tum samajhte nahin the. ?
Yeh hai woh jahannam jis se tumhein daraya jata tha.
Aaj us mein dakhil hojao, kyunke tum kufr kiya karte the.
Aaj ke din hum un ke moonh par mehar lgadin ge, aur un ke haath hum se baat karen ge, aur un ke paon gawahi den ge ke woh kiya kamayi kiya karte the.
Aur agar hum chahein to (yahin duniya mein un ki aankhein mill ya mait karden, phir yeh raaste (ki talash) mein bhaage phrin, lekin unhein kahan kuchh sujhayi de ga. ?
Aur agar hum chahein to un ki apni jagah par bithe bithe un ki soorten us tarah maskh karden ke yeh na aage barh saken, aur na peechhe lot saken.
Aur hum jis shaks ko lambi umar dete hain use tkhliqi aitbaar se ulat hi dete hain. Kya phir bhi unhein aqal nahin aati ?
Aur hum ne (apne) un (payghumbar) ko na shayari skhaii hai, aur na woh un ke shayaan shaan hai. Yeh to bas ek naseehat ki baat hai, aur aisa quran jo haqeeqat ko khol khol kar biyan karta hai.
Taake har us shaks ko khabardar kare jo zinda ho, aur taake kufr karne walon par hujjat poori hojaye.
Aur kya unhon ne yeh nahin dekha ke hum ne apne haathon ki banaee hui cheezon mein se un ke liye maweshi paida kiye, aur yeh un ke maalik bane hue hain ?
Aur hum ne un maweshiyon ko un ke qaabu mein de diya hai, chunanche un mein se kuchh woh hain jo un ki sawari bane hue hain, aur kuchh woh hain jinhen yeh kahate hain.
Neiz un ko un maweshiyon se aur bhi fawaid hasil hote hain, aur peene ki cheezen milti hain. Kya phir bhi yeh shukar nahin baja layein ge ?
Aur unhon ne Allah ko chhor kar us umeed par dusre khuda bana rkhe hain ke unhein (un se) madad mile.
(halaanke) un mein yeh taqat hi nahin hai ke un ki madad krskin, bulke woh un ke liye ek aisa (mukhalif) lashkar banein ge jise (qayamat mein un ke samne) hazir karliya jaye ga.
Garz (ae payghumbar) un ki baatein tumhein ranjeeda na karen. Yaqeen jaano humein sab maloom hai ke yeh kiya kuchh chupate, aur kiya kuchh zaahir karte hain.
Aur kya insan ne yeh nahin dekha ke hum ne use nutfe se paida kya tha ? Phir achanak woh khullam khla jhagra karne wala bann gaya.
Humare bare mein to woh baatein banata hai, aur khud apni pedaeesh ko bhala bitha hai, kehta hai ke : un haddiyon ko kaun zindagi de ga jabke woh gal chuki hon gi ?
Keh do ke : un ko wahi zindagi de ga jis ne unhein pehli baar paida kiya tha, aur woh paida karne ka har kaam jaanta hai.
Wahi hai jis ne tumhare liye sar-sabz darakht se aag paida kardi hai. Phir tum zara si dair mein us se slgane ka kaam lete ho.

Bhala jis zaat ne aasmanon aur zameen ko paida kya hai, kya woh us baat par qadir nahin hai ke un jaison ko (dobara) paida karsake ? Kyun nahin ? Jabke woh sab kuchh paida karne ki poori mhart rakhta hai.
Us ka mamla to yeh hai ke jab woh kisi cheez ka arada karle to sirf itna kehta hai ke : hoja. Bas woh hojati hai.
Garz pak hai woh zaat jis ke haath mein har cheez ki hukumat hai aur usi ki taraf tum sab ko aakhir kaar le jaya jaye ga.
Qasam un ki jo pare bandh kar saff banate hain,
Phir un ki jo rok tok karte hain,
Phir un ki jo zikr ki tilawat karte hain.
Tumhara mabood ek hi hai.
Jo tamam aasmanon aur zameen ka aur un ke darmiyan ki har cheez ka maalik hai, aur un tamam muqamaat ka maalik jahan se sitare tulu hote hain.
Be-shak hum ne nazdeek wale aasman ko sitaron ki shakal mein ek sjaot ata ki hai.
Aur har shrir shetan se hifazat ka zria banaya hai.
Woh upar ke jahaan ki baatein nahin sunn sakte, aur har taraf se un par maar parti hai.
Unhein dhakke diye jate hain aur un ko (aakhirat mein) daeemi azab hoga.
Albatta jo koi kuchh uchak le jaye to ek roshan shla us ka pichha karta hai.
Ab zara un (kafiron) se pochho ke un ki takhleeq ziyada mushkil hai ya hamari paida ki hui dusri makhlooqat ki ? Un ko to hum ne leis daar gaare se paida kya hai.
(ae payghumbar) haqeeqat to yeh hai ke tum (un ki baaton par) tajjub karte ho, aur yeh hansi urate hain.
Aur jab unhein naseehat ki jati hai to naseehat maante nahin.
Aur jab koi nishani dekhte hain to mazaq urate hain.
Aur kehte hain ke : yeh ek khle jadoo ke siwa kuchh bhi nahin hai.
Bhala jab hum marr kar mitti aur haddiyon ki surat ikhtiyar karlen ge, to kya humein dobara zinda kya jaye ga ?
Aur bhala kya humare pichle baap dadon ko bhi ?
Keh do ke : haan ! Aur tum zaleel bhi hoge.
Bas woh to ek hi zoar daar aawaz hogi, jis ke baad woh achanak (sare haulnaak mnazr) dekhne lagen ge.
Aur kahin ge ke : haaye hamari shamat ! Yeh to hisab o kitab ka din hai.
(ji haan) yehi woh faisle ka din hai jise tum jhutlaya karte the.
(farishton se kaha jaye ga ke) ghir lao un sab ko jinhon ne zulm kiya tha, aur un ke saathiyon ko bhi aur un ko bhi
Jin ki yeh Allah ko chhor kar ibadat kiya karte the, phir unhein dozakh ka raasta dkha.
Aur zara unhein thehrao, un se kuchh pochha jaye ga.
Kyun ji ? Tumhein kya hua ke tum ek dusre ki madad nahin kar rahe ?
Us ke bajaye yeh to aaj sar jhukaye khre hain.
Aur woh ek dusre ki taraf rukh kar ke aapas mein sawal jawab karen ge.
(ma-tehat log apne baron se) kahin ge ke tum the jo hum par bare zoron se charh charh kar aate the.
Woh kahin ge ke : nahin bulke tum khud iman lane wale nahin the.
Aur tum par hamara koi zoar nahin tha, asal baat yeh hai ke tum khud sirkash log the.
Ab to humare Parwardigar ki yeh baat hum par saabit hogaee hai ke hum sab ko yeh mza chakhna hai.
Kyunke hum ne tumhein behkaya hum khud behke hue the.
Garz us din yeh sab azab mein ek dusre ke saath shareek hon ge.
Hum mujreemon ke saath aisa hi karte hain.
Un ka haal yeh tha ke jab un se yeh kaha jata ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin to yeh akar dikhate the.
Aur kaha karte the ke : kya hum aise hain ke ek deewane shayar ki wajah se apne maboodon ko chhor bethen ?
Halaanke woh (payghumbar (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) haqq le kar aaye the, aur unhon ne dusre payghumbaron ki tasdeeq ki thi.
Chunanche (un se kaha jaye ga ke) tum sab ko dardnaak azab ka mza chakhna hoga.
Aur tumhein kisi aur baat ka nahin, khud tumhare aemaal ka badla diya jaye ga.
Albatta jo Allah ke barguzida bande hain.
Un ke liye tai shda rizq hai.
Mewe hain, un ki poori poori izzat hogi.
Aur niyamat bhare baghaat mein
Woh unchi nshston par aamne samne bithe hon ge.
Aisi lateef sharab ke jaam un ke liye gardish mein aayein ge.
Jo safaid rang ki hogi, peene walon ke liye sarapa lazzat.
Na us se sar mein khmar hoga aur na un ki aqal behke gi.
Aur un ke paas woh bari bari aankhon wali khoatin hongi jin ki nigahen (apne shoharon par) mrkoz hon gi.
(un ka bedagh wajood) aisa lage ga jaise woh (gird o gubar se) chhpa kar rkhe hue ande hon.
Phir jannati log ek dusre ki taraf mutawajja ho kar aapas mein sawalaat karen ge.
Un mein se ek kehne wala kahe ga ke mera ek sathi tha.
Jo (mujh se) kaha karta tha ke : kya tum waqayi un logon mein se ho jo (aakhirat ki zindagi ko) sach maante hain ?
Kya jab hum mitti aur haddiyon mein tabdeel hojayen ge to kya waqayi humein (apne kaamon ka) badla diya jaye ga ?
Woh jannati (dusre jannatiyon se) kahe ga ke : kya tum (mere us sathi) ko jhaank kar dekhna chahte ho ?
Phir woh khud (dozakh mein) jhaank kar dikhe ga to use dozakh ke beechon bech nazar aaye ga.
Woh jannati (us se) kahe ga ke : Allah ki qasam ! Tum to mujhe bilkul hi barbaad karne lage the.
Aur agar mere Parwardigar ka fazal shamil haal na hota to aur logon ke saath bhi mujhe dhar liya jata.
(phir woh khushi ke aalam mein apne jannati saathiyon se kahe ga) achha to kya ab humein maut nahin aaye gi ?
Siwaye us maut ke jo humein pehle chuki ? Aur humein azab bhi nahin hoga ?
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke zabardast kamiyabi yehi hai.
Usi jaisi kamiyabi ke liye amal karne walon ko amal karna chahaye.
Bhala yeh mehmani achhi hai, ya zakkhum ka darakht ?
Hum ne us darakht ko un zalimon ke liye ek aazmaish banadiya hai.
Dar-asal woh darakht hi aisa hai jo darazakh ki teh se nikalta hai.
Us ka khosha aisa hai jaise shetanon ke sar.
Chunanche dozakhi log usi mein se khuraak hasil karen ge, aur usi se pait bharein ge.
Phir unhein us ke upar se khaulte hue pani ka aamiza mile ga.
Phir woh loten ge to usi dozakh ki taraf loten ge.
Unhon ne apne baap dadon ko gumrahi ki halat mein paya tha.
Chunanche yeh unhi ke nakshe qadam par lapak lapak kar dorte rahe.
Aur un se pehle jo log guzar chuke hain, un mein se aksar log bhi gumraah hue.
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke hum ne un ke darmiyan khabardar karne wale (payghumbar) bheje the.
Ab dekh lo ke jin ko khabardar kya gaya tha, un ka anjaam kaisa hua ?
Albatta jo Allah ke barguzida bande the (woh mehfooz rahe)
Aur nooh ne humein pukara tha to (dekh lo ke) hum pukar ka kitna achha jawab dene wale hain.
Aur hum ne unhein aur un ke ghar walon ko bare karb se nijat di.
Aur hum ne un ki nasal hi ko baqi rakhha.
Aur jo log un ke baad aaye un mein yeh roait qayam ki.
(ke woh yeh kaha karen ke) salam ho nooh par duniya jahaan ke logon mein.
Hum nek amal karne walon ko usi tarah sla dete hain.
Be-shak woh humare momin bandon mein se the.
Phir hum ne dusre logon ko pani mein garq kardiya.
Aur unhi ke tareeqe par chalne walon mein yaqeenan Ibrahim bhi the.
Jab woh apne Parwardigar ke paas saaf sthra dil le kar aaye.
Jab unhon ne apne baap aur apni qaum se kaha ke : tum kin cheezon ki ibadat karte ho ?
Kya Allah ko chhor kar jhoot moot ke khuda chahte ho ?
To phir jo zaat sare jahano ko paalne wali hai, us ke bare mein tumhara kya khayal hai ?
Us ke (kuchh rse) baad unhon ne sitaron ki taraf ek nigaah daal kar dekha.
Aur kaha ke : meri tabiyat kharab hai.
Chunanche woh log pith mor kar un ke paas se chale gaye.
Us ke baad yeh un ke banaye hue maboodon (yani buthon) mein jaa ghse (aur un se) kaha : kya tum kahate nahin ho ?
Tumhein kya hogaya ke tum bolte nahin ?
Phir woh poori qooat se maarte hue un (buthon) par pil pare.
Us par un ki qaum ke log un ke paas dore hue aaye.
Ibrahim ne kaha : kya tum un (buthon) ko poojhte ho jinhen khud tarashte ho ?
Halaanke Allah ne tumhein bhi paida kiya hai aur jo kuchh tum banate ho us ko bhi.
Un logon ne kaha : Ibrahim ke liye ek imarat banao, aur use dehakti hui aagi mein phink do .
Us tarah unhon ne Ibrahim ke khilaf ek bura mansuba banana chaha, lekin hum ne unhein nicha dkha diya.
Aur Ibrahim ne kaha : mein apne rubb ke paas jaraha hon, wahi meri rehnumayi farmaye ga.
Mere Parwardigar ! Mujhe ek aisa beta de jo nek logon mein se ho.
Chunanche hum ne unhein ek burdbaar larke ki khushkhabri di.

Phir jab woh larka Ibrahim ke saath chalne phrne ke qabil hogaya to unhon ne kaha : bete ! Mein khuwab mein dekhta hon ke tumhein zibah kar raha hon, ab soch kar batao, tumhari kya raye hai ? Bete ne kaha : abba jaan ! Aap wahi kijiye jis ka aap ko hukum diya jaraha hai. Ansha Allah aap mujhe sabar karne walon mein se payen ge.
Chunanche (woh ajeeb manzar tha) jab dono ne sar jhuka diya, aur baap ne bete ko peshani ke bal graia.
Aur hum ne unhein aawaz di ke : ae Ibrahim
Tum ne khuwab ko sach kar dkhaia. Yaqeenan hum neki karne walon ko usi tarah sla dete hain.
Yaqeenan yeh ek khla hua imtehan tha.
Aur hum ne ek azeem zabeeha ka fdia de kar us bache ko bacha liya.
Aur jo log un ke baad aaye un mein yeh roait qayam ki
(ke woh yeh kaha karen ke) salam ho Ibrahim par.
Hum neki karne walon ko usi tarah sla dete hain.
Yaqeenan woh humare momin bandon mein se the.
Aur hum ne unhein ashaq ki khushkhabri di, ke woh saliheen mein se ek nabi hon ge.
Aur hum ne un par bhi barkatein nazil kin. Aur ashaq par bhi, aur un ki aulad mein se kuchh log nek amal karne wale hain, aur kuchh apni jaan par khla zulm karne wale.
Aur be-shak hum ne musa aur haroon par bhi ehsan kiya.
Aur hum ne unhein aur un ki qaum ko ek bare karb se nijat di
Aur hum ne un ki madad ki jis ke natije mein wahi ghalib rahe.
Aur hum ne un dono ko aisi kitab ata ki jo bilkul wazeh thi.
Aur un dono ko seedhe raaste ki hidayat di.
Aur jo log un ke baad aaye, un mein yeh roait qayam ki.
(ke woh yeh kaha karen ke) salam ho musa aur haroon par
Yaqeenan hum neki karne walon ko usi tarah sla dete hain.
Be-shak woh dono humare momin bandon mein se the.
Aur ilyas bhi yaqeenan payghumbaron mein se the.
Jab unhon ne apni qaum se kaha tha ke : kya tum log Allah se darte nahin ho ?
Kya tum baal (naami butt) ko poojhte ho, aur us ko chhor dete ho jo sab se behtar takhleeq karne wala hai ?
Us Allah ko jo tumhara bhi Parwardigar hai, aur tumhare baap dadon ka bhi jo pehle guzar chuke hain ?
Phir hua yeh ke unhon ne ilyas ko jhutlaya, us liye woh zaroor (azab mein) dhar liye jayen ge.
Albatta Allah ke barguzida bande (mehfooz rahen ge)
Aur jo log un ke baad aaye un mein hum ne yeh roait qayam ki.
(ke woh yeh kaha karen ke) salam ho aliasin par
Yaqeenan hum neki karne walon ko usi tarah sla dete hain.
Be-shak woh humare momin bandon mein se the.
Aur yaqeenan loot bhi payghumbaron mein se the.
Jab hum ne un ko aur un ke sare ghar walon ko (azab se) nijat di thi.
Siwaye ek burhiya ke jo peechhe reh jane walon mein shamil rahi.
Phir hum ne dusre logon ko mill ya mait kardiya.
Aur (ae makkah walo !) tum un (ki bastiyon) par se guzra karte ho, (kabhi) subah hote.
Aur (kabhi) raat ke waqt kya phir bhi tumhein aqal nahin aati ?
Aur yaqeenan younus bhi payghumbaron mein se the.
Jab woh bhaag kar bhari hui kashti mein pahunche.
Phir woh qra andazi mein shareek hue, aur qre mein magloob hue.
Phir machli ne unhein nigal liya, jabke woh apne aap ko malamat kar rahe the.
Chunanche agar woh tasbeeh karne walon mein se na hote.
To woh us din tak usi machli ke pait mein rehte jis din mardon ko zinda kiya jaye ga.
Phir hum ne unhein aisi halat mein ek khle maidan mein lakr daal diya ke woh beemar the.
Aur un ke upar ek bail daar darakht uga diya.
Aur hum ne unhein ek lakh, bulke us se bhi ziyada logon ke paas payghumbar bana kar bheja tha.
Phir woh iman le aaye the us liye hum ne unhein ek zamane tak zindagi se faida athane ka mauqa diya.
Ab un (makkah ke mushrikon) se pochho ke : kya (ae payghumbar) tumhare rubb ke hisse mein to betiyan aayi hain aur khud un ke hisse mein bete ?
Ya phir jab hum ne farishton ko aurat banaya tha to kya yeh dekh rahe the ?
Yaad rakho ! Yeh apni mann gharat baat ki wajah se kehte hain.
Ke Allah ke koi aulad hai, aur yeh log yaqeeni tor par jhoote hain.
Kya Allah ne beton ke bajaye betiyan pasand ki hain ?
Tumhein kya hogaya hai ? Tum kaisa insaf karte ho ?
Bhala kya tum itna bhi dhyaan nahin dete ?
Ya agar tumhare paas koi wazeh daleel hai.
To lao apni woh kitab agar tum sache ho.
Aur unhon ne Allah aur jinnat ke darmiyan bhi nsbi rishta daari bana rkhi hai. Halaanke khud jinnat ko yeh baat maloom hai ke yeh log mujrim bann kar pesh hon ge.
(kyunke) jo baatein yeh banate hain, Allah un sab se pak hai.
Albatta Allah ke barguzida bande (mehfooz rahen ge)
Kyunke tum aur jin jin ki tum bat karte ho.
Woh kisi ko Allah ke bare mein gumraah nahin krskte.
Siwaye aise shaks ke jo dozakh mein jalne wala ho.
Aur (farishte to yeh kehte hain ke) hum mein se har ek ka ek moyyen muqaam hai.
Aur hum to (Allah taalaa ki itaat mein) saff bandhe rehte hain.
Aur hum to Allah ki paki biyan karte rehte hain.
Aur yeh (kafir) log pehle to yeh kaha karte the.
Ke agar humare paas pichle logon ki tarah koi naseehat ki kitab hoti.
To hum bhi zaroor Allah ke barguzida bandon mein shamil hote.
Phir bhi unhon ne kufr ki rawish apnaii hai. Us liye unhein sab pata chala jaye ga.
Aur hum pehle hi apne payghumbar bandon ke bare mein yeh baat tai krchke hain.
Ke yaqeeni tor par un ki madad ki jaye gi.
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke humare lashkar ke log hi ghalib rehte hain.
Lihaza (ae payghumbar) tum kuchh waqt tak un logon se beproaa hojao.
Aur unhein dekhte raho, anqareeb yeh khud bhi dekh len ge.
Bhala kya yeh humare azab ke liye jaldi macha rahe hain ?
So jab woh un ke sehan mein aa utre ga to jin logon ko khabardar kiya jachka tha, un ki woh subah bohat buri subah hogi.
Aur tum kuchh waqt tak un logon se beproaa hojao.
Aur dekhte raho anqareeb yeh khud bhi dekh len ge.
Tumhara Parwardigar izzat ka maalik, un sab baaton se pak hai jo yeh log banate hain.
Aur salam ho payghumbaron par.
Aur tamam tar tareef Allah ki hai jo sare jahano ka Parwardigar hai.
Saad
Ke jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai, woh kisi aur wajah se nahin, bulke us liye apnaia hai ke woh baraee ke ghamand aur hatt dharmi mein mubtila hain.
Aur un se pehle hum ne kitni qaumon ko halaak kiya, to unhon ne us waqt aawazen den jab chutkare ka waqt raha hi nahin tha.
Aur un (quresh ke) logon ko us baat par tajjub hua hai ke ek khabardar karne wala unhi mein se aagaya. Aur un kafiron ne yeh keh diya ke : woh jhoota jadoogar hai.
Kya us ne sare maboodon ko ek hi mabood mein tabdeel kardiya hai ? Yeh to bari ajeeb baat hai.
Aur un mein ke sardar log yeh keh kar chalte bane ke : chalo aur apne khudaon (ki ibadat) par dat-te raho yeh baat to aisi hai ke us ke peechhe kuchh aur hi irade hain.
Hum ne to yeh baat pichle deen mein kabhi nahin suni. Aur kuchh nahin, yeh mann gharat baat hai.

Kya yeh naseehat ki baat hum sab ko chhor kar usi shaks par nazil ki gayi hai ? Asal baat yeh hai ke yeh log meri naseehat ke bare mein shakk mein mubtila hain, bulke unhon ne abhi mere azab ka mza nahin chkha.
Tumhara rubb jo bara daata, bara sahib iqtedar hai, kya us ki rehmat ke sare khazane unhi ke paas hain ?
Ya phir aasmanon aur zameen aur un ke darmiyan har cheez ki badshaat un ke qabze mein hai ? Phir to unhein chahiye ke rassiyan taan kar upar charh jayen.
(un ki haqeeqat to yeh hai ke) yeh mukhalif girohon ka ek lashkar sa hai jo yahin par shikast khajaie ga.
Un se pehle nooh ki qaum, qaum aad aur mekhon wale Firaun ne bhi payghumbaron ko jhutlaya tha.
Aur qaum samood, aur loot ki qaum aur aikah walon ne bhi. Woh the mukhalif giroh ke log.
Un mein se koi aisa nahin tha jis ne payghumbaron ko na jhutlaya ho, us liye mera azab baja tor par nazil ho kar raha.
Aur (ke) yeh log (bhi) bas ek aisi chinghar ka intezar kar rahe hain jis mein koi wqfa nahin hoga.
Aur kehte hain ke : ae humare Parwardigar ! Hmar ahsa humein roz hisab se pehle hi jaldi de.
(ae payghumbar) yeh jo kuchh kehte hain us par sabar karo, aur humare bande dad (alh alh-e-salam) ko yaad karo jo bare taaqatwar the. Woh be-shak Allah se bohat lo lagaye hue the.
Hum ne paharon ko us kaam par laga diya tha ke woh shaam ke waqt aur suraj ke nikalte waqt un ke saath tasbeeh kiya karen.
Aur parindon ko bhi, jinhen aktha karliya jata tha. Yeh sab un ke saath malakar Allah ka khoob zikr karte the.
Aur hum ne un ki sultanat ko istehkam baksha tha, aur unhein danaee aur faisla kin guftagu ka sliqa ata kiya tha.
Aur kya tumhein un muqaddama walon ki khabar pahunchi hai jab woh deewar par charh kar ibadat gaah mein gahasa aaye the ?

Jab woh dad ke paas pahunche to dad un se ghabra gaye. Unhon ne kaha dariye nahin, hum ek jhagre ke do fareeq hain, hum mein se ek ne dusre ke saath zyadati ki hai. Ab aap humare darmiyan theek theek faisla krdijie aur zyadati na kijiye, aur humein theek theek raasta bata dijiye.
Yeh mera bhai hai, us ke paas nine dunbiyan hain, aur mere paas ek hi dunbi hai, ab yeh kehta hai ke woh bhi mere hawale karo, aur us ne zoar biyan se mujhe daba liya hai.

Dad ne kaha : us ne apni dunbiyon mein shamil karne ke liye tumhari dunbi ka jo mutalaba kiya hai us mein yaqeenan tum par zulm kiya hai. Aur bohat se log jin ke darmiyan shirkat hoti hai woh ek dusre ke saath zyadati karte hain, siwaye un ke jo iman laye hain, aur jinhon ne nek amal kiye hain, aur woh bohat kam hain. Aur dad ko khayal aaya ke hum ne dar-asal un ki aazmaish ki hai, us liye unhon ne apne Parwardigar se maafi maangi, jhuk kar sajde mein grgie aur Allah se lo lagayi.
Chunanche hum ne us mamla mein unhein maafi de di. Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke un ko humare paas khaas taqarrub hasil hai aur behtareen thikana.

Ae dad ! Hum ne tumhein zameen mein khalifa banaya hai, lihaza tum logon ke darmiyan barhaqq faisle karo, aur nafsani khwahish ke peechhe na chalo, wrna woh tumhein Allah ke raaste se bhatka de gi. Yaqeen rakho ke jo log Allah ke raaste se bhatak jate hain, un ke liye sakht azab hai, kyunke unhon ne hisab ke din ko bhala diya tha.

Aur hum ne aasman o zameen aur un ke darmiyan jo cheezen hain un ko fizool hi paida nahin kardiya. Yeh to un logon ka gumaan hai jinhon ne kufr ikhtiyar karliya hai, chunanche un kafiron ke liye dozakh ki shakal mein bari tabahi hai.
Jo log iman laye hain, aur jinhon ne nek amal kiye hain kya hum un ko aise logon ke barabar karden jo zameen mein fasaad machate hain ? Ya hum perhezgaron ko badkaron ke barabar karden ge ?
(ae payghumbar) yeh ek ba-barkat kitab hai jo hum ne tum par us liye utari hai ke log us ki aayaton par gaur o fikr karen, aur taake aqal rakhne wale naseehat hasil karen.
Aur hum ne dad ko suliman (jaisa beta) ata kiya, woh behtareen bande the, waqayi woh Allah se khoob lo lagaye hue the.
(woh ek yaadgaar waqt tha) jab un ke samne shaam ke waqt achhi nasal ke umdah ghore pesh kiye gaye.
To unhon ne kaha : mein ne us daulat ki mohabbat apne Parwardigar ki yaad hi ki wajah se ikhtiyar ki hai. Yahan tak ke woh oat mein cahahap gaye.
(us par unhon ne kaha) un ko mere paas wapas le aao, chunanche woh (un ki) pindliyon aur gardano par haath phirne lage.
Aur yeh bhi waqa hai ke hum ne suliman ki ek aazmaish ki thi aur un ki kursi par ek dahara laa kar daal diya tha. Phir unhon ne (Allah se) rujoo kiya.

Kehne lage ke : mere Parwardigar ! Meri bakhsish farma de, aur mujhe aisi sultanat baksh de jo mere baad kisi aur ke liye munasib na ho. Be-shak teri, aur sirf teri hi zaat woh hai jo itni skhi daata hai.
Chunanche hum ne hua ko un ke qaabu mein kardiya jo un ke hukum se jahan woh chahte humwaar ho kar chala karti thi.
Aur shrir jinnat bhi un ke qaabu mein de diye the, jin mein har tarah ke meimaar aur ghota khor shamil the.
Aur kuchh woh jinnat jo zanjeeron mein jakre hue the.
(aur un se kaha tha ke) yeh hamara tia hai, ab tumhein ikhtiyar hai ke ehsan kar ke kisi ko kuchh do , ya apne paas rakho, tum par kisi hisab ki zma daari nahin hai.
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke un ko humare paas khaas taqarrub hasil hai, aur behtareen thikana.
Aur humare bande ayub ko yaad karo, jab unhon ne apne Parwardigar ko pukara tha ke : shetan mujhe dakaha aur azar laga gaya hai.
(hum ne un se kaha) apna paon zameen par maaro, lo ! Yeh thanda pani hai nahane ke liye bhi aur peene ke liye bhi.
Aur (us tarah) hum ne unhein un ke ghar wale bhi ata krdie. Aur un ke saath itne hi aur bhi. Taake un par hamari rehmat ho, aur aqal walon ke liye ek yaadgaar naseehat.

Aur (hum ne un se yeh bhi kaha ke) apne haath mein tinkon ka ek mtha lo, aur us se maar do , aur apni qasam mat toro. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke hum ne unhein bara sabar karne wala paya, woh behtareen bande the, waqa woh Allah se khoob lo lagaye hue the.
Aur humare bandon Ibrahim, ashaq aur yaqoob ko yaad karo jo (nek amal karne wale) haath aur (dekhne wali) aankhein rakhte the.
Hum ne unhein ek khaas wasf ke liye chun liya tha, jo (aakhirat ke) haqeeqi ghar ki yaad thi.
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke humare nazdeek woh chune hue behtareen logon mein se the.
Aur ismail aur elisha aur zulkifl ko yaad karo. Aur yeh sab behtareen logon mein se the.
Yeh sab kuchh ek naseehat ka paygham hai, aur yaqeen jaano ke jo log taqwa ikhtiyar karte hain, aakhri thikane ki behtareen unhi ke hisse mein aaye gi.
Yani hamesha base rehne ke liye jannaten jin ke darwaze un ke liye poori tarah khle hon ge.
Jahan woh tkia lagaye hue bohat se mewe aur mashrubaat mangwa rahe hon ge.
Aur un ke paas woh hum umar khoatin hon gi jin ki nigahen (apne shoharon par) mrkoz hon gi.
Yeh hai woh (nematon se bhar por zindagi) jis ka tum se aur waza hisab mein wada kiya gaya hai.
Be-shak yeh hamari ata hai jo kabhi khatam hone wali nahin.
Ek taraf to yeh hai aur (dusri taraf) jin logon ne sarkashi ikhtiyar ki hai, yaqeen jaano, un ka aakhri thikana bohat bura hoga.
Yani dozakh jis mein woh dakhil hon ge. Phir woh un ka badhtareen basatar bane gi.
Yeh hai kholta hua pani aur peep, ab woh us ka mza chakkhein.
Aur un tarah tarah ki cheezon ka jo usi jaisi (takleef da) hon gi.
(jab woh apne pirokaron ko aata dekhen ge to ek dusre se kahin ge) yeh ek aur lashkar hai jo tumhare saath ghsa chala aaraha hai, phtkar ho un par, yeh sab aag mein jalne wale hain.
Woh (aane wale) kahin ge : nahin, bulke phtkar tum par ho, tum hi to yeh museebat humare aage laye ho, ab to yehi badhtareen jagah hai jis mein rehna hoga.
(phir woh Allah taalaa se kahin ge ke) ae humare Parwardigar ! Jo shaks bhi yeh museebat humare aage laya hai, use dozakh mein dugna azab dijiye.
Aur woh (ek dusre se) kahin ge : kya baat hai ke humein woh log (yahan dozakh mein) nazar nahin aarahe jinhen hum bure logon mein shumar karte the ?
Kya hum ne un ka (na-haqq) mazaq uraya tha, ya unhein dekhne se nigahon ki ghalati lag rahi hai ?
Yaqeenan dozakhiyon ke aapas mein jhagre ki yeh saari baatein bilkul sachi hain jo ho kar rahen gi.
(ae payghumbar) keh do ke : mein to ek khabardar karne wala hon, aur us Allah ke siwa koi ibadat ke layaq nahin jo ek hai, jo sab par ghalib hai.
Jo tamam aasmanon aur zameen aur un ke darmiyan har cheez ka maalik hai, jis ka iqtedar sab par chhaia hua hai, jo bohat bakhshne wala hai.
Keh do ke : yeh ek azeem haqeeqat ka izhar hai.
Jis se tum moonh more hue ho.
Mujhe aalam baala ki baaton ka kuchh ilm nahin tha jab woh (farishte) sawal o jawab kar rahe the.
Mere paas wahee sirf us liye aati hai ke mein saaf saaf khabardar karne wala hon.
Yaad karo jab tumhare Parwardigar ne farishton se kaha ke mein gaare se ek insan paida karne wala hon.
Chunanche jab mein use poori tarah bana doon aur us mein apni rooh phonk doon to tum us ke aage sajde mein gir jana.
Phir hua yeh ke sare ke sare farishton ne to sajda kiya.
Albatta iblees ne na kiya, us ne takabbur se kaam liya aur kafiron mein shamil hogaya.
Allah ne kaha : iblees ! Jis ko mein ne apne haathon se paida kya, us ko sajda karne se tujhe kis cheez ne roka hai ? Kya to ne takabbur se kaam liya hai, ya to koi bohat unchi hastiyon mein se hai ?
Kehne laga : mein us (adam) se behtar hon. To ne mujhe aag se paida kiya hai aur us ko gaare se paida kiya hai.
Allah ne farmaya ke achha to nikal jaa yahan se. Kyunke to mardood hai.
Aur yaqeen jaan qayamat ke din tak tujh par meri phtkar rahe gi.
Us ne kaha : mere Parwardigar ! Phir to mujhe us din tak ke liye (jeene ki) mohlat de jis din logon ko dobara zinda kiya jaye ga.
Allah ne farmaya : chal tujhe un logon mein shamil karliya gaya hai jinhen mohlat di jaye gi.
(lekin) ek mutayin waqt ke din tak.
Kehne laga : bas to mein teri izzat ki qasam khata hon ke mein un sab ko behkaunga.
Siwaye tere barguzida bandon ke.
Allah ne farmaya : to phir sachi baat yeh hai aur mein sachi baat hi kaha karta hon.
Ke mein tujh se aur un sab se jo un mein se tere peechhe chalen ge, jahannam ko bhar kar rahoon ga.
(ae payghumbar ! Logon se) keh do ke : mein tum se us (islam ki dawat) par koi ujrat nahin maangta, aur na mein banawati logon mein se hon.
Yeh to duniya jahaan ke logon ke liye bas ek naseehat hai.
Aur thore se waqt ke baad tumhein us ka haal maloom hojaye ga.
Yeh kitab Allah ki taraf se nazil ki jarhi hai, jo bare iqtedar ka maalik hai, bohat hikmat wala hai.
(ae payghumbar) be-shak yeh kitab hum ne tum par barhaqq nazil ki hai, aslie Allah ki us tarah ibadat karo ke bandagi khalis usi ke liye ho.

Yaad rakho ke khalis bandagi Allah hi ka haqq hai. Aur jin logon ne us ke bajaye dusre rkhoale bana liye hain. (yeh keh kar ke) hum un ki ibadat sirf us liye karte hain ke yeh humein Allah se qareeb karden. Un ke darmiyan Allah un baaton ka faisla kare ga jin mein woh ikhtilaf kar rahe hain. Yaqeen rakho ke Allah kisi aise shaks ko raaste par nahin laata jo jhoota ho, kufr par jamaa hua ho.

Agar Allah yeh chahta ke kisi ko aulad banaye to woh apni makhlooq mein se jis ko chahta muntakhab krlita, (lekin) woh pak hai (us baat se ke us ki koi aulad ho) woh to Allah hai, ek, aur zabardast iqtedar ka maalik.

Us ne sare aasman aur zameen barhaqq paida kiye hain. Woh raat ko din par lapet deta hai aur din ko raat par lapet deta, aur us ne suraj aur chand ko kaam par laga ya hua hai. Har ek kisi moyyen muddat tak ke liye rawan doan hai. Yaad rakho woh bare iqtedar ka maalik, bohat bakhshne wala hai.

Us ne tum sab ko ek shaks se paida kya phir usi se us ka jor banaya, aur tumhare liye maweshiyon mein se aath jore paida kiye woh tumhari takhleeq tumhari maaon ke pait mein us tarah karta hai ke teen andhirion ke darmiyan tum banawat ke ek mrhle ke baad dusre mrhle se guzarte ho. Woh hai Allah jo tumhara Parwardigar hai. Saari baadshahi usi ki hai, us ke siwa koi ibadat ke layaq nahin hai. Phir bhi tumhara moonh aakhir koi kahan se mor deta hai ?

Agar tum kufr ikhtiyar karo ge to yaqeen rakho ke Allah tum se bey-niaz hai, aur woh apne bandon ke liye kufr pasand nahin karta, aur agar tum shukar karo ge to woh use tumhare liye pasand kare ga, aur koi bojh athane wala kisi dusre ka bojh nahin athaie ga, phir tum sab ko apne Parwardigar hi ke paas lot kar jana hai, us waqt woh tumhein bataye ga ke tum kiya kuchh kiya karte the. Yaqeenan woh dilon ki baatein bhi khoob jaanta hai.

Aur jab insan ko koi takleef chho jati hai to woh apne Parwardigar ko usi se lo laga kar pukarta hai, phir jab woh insan ko apni taraf se koi niyamat baksh deta hai to woh us (takleef) ko bhool jata hai jis ke liye pehle Allah ko pukar raha tha, aur Allah ke liye shareek gahara leta hai, jis ke natije mein dusron ko bhi Allah ke raaste se bhtkata hai. Keh do ke : kuchh din apne kufr ke maze arale, yaqeenan to dozakh walon mein shamil hai.

Bhala (kya aisa shaks us ke barabar sakta hai) jo raat ki ghrion mein ibadat karta hai, kabhi sajde mein, kabhi qayam mein, aakhirat se darta hai, aur apne Parwardigar ki rehmat ka umeedwaar hai ? Kaho ke : kya woh jo jante hain aur jo nahin jante sab barabar hain ? (magar) naseehat to wahi log qabool karte hain jo aqal wale hain.

Keh do ke : ae mere iman wale bandon ! Apne Parwardigar ka khof dil mein rakho. Bhalayi unhi ki hai jinhon ne us duniya mein bhalayi ki hai, aur Allah ki zameen bohat wasee hai. Jo log sabar se kaam lete hain, un ka sawab unhein hisab diya jaye ga.
Keh do ke : mujhe to hukum diya gaya hai ke mein Allah ki us tarah ibadat karoon ke meri bandagi khalis usi ke liye ho.
Aur mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke sab se pehla farmanbardar mein banoon.
Keh do ke : agar mein apne Parwardigar ki nafarmani karoon to mujhe ek zabardast din ke azab ka andesha hai.
Keh do ke : mein to Allah ki ibadat us tarah karta hon ke mein ne apni bandagi sirf usi ke liye khalis karli hai.

Ab tum use chhor kar jis ki chaho, ibadat karo. Keh do ke : ghate ka sauda karne wale to woh hain jo qayamat ke din apni janon aur apne ghar walon sab ko hara bethen ge. Yaad rakho ke khla hua ghata yehi hai.
Aise logon ke liye un ke upar bhi aag ke badal hain aur un ke niche bhi waise hi badal. Yeh wahi cheez hai jis se Allah apne bandon ko darata hai. Lihaza ae mere bandon. Mera khof dil mein rakho.

Aur jin logon ne us baat se parheiz kiya hai ke woh taghut ki ibadat karne lagen aur unhon ne Allah se log lagayi hai khushi ki khabar unhi ke liye, lihaza mere un bandon ko khushi ki khabar suna do .
Jo baat ko gaur se sunte hain to us mein jo behtareen hoti hai us ki pairwi karte hain. Yehi woh log hain jinhen Allah ne hidayat di hai aur yehi hain jo aqal wale hain.
Bhala jis shaks par azab ki baat tai hochuki, to kya tum use bacha lo ge jo aag ke andar pahunch chuka hai ?

Albatta jinhon ne apne Parwardigar ka khof dil mein rakhha hai un ke liye upar tale bani hui unchi unchi imaratein hain, jin ke niche nehrein behti hain. Yeh Allah ka wada hai. Allah kabhi wade ki khilaf warzi nahin karta.

Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke Allah ne aasman se pani utara, phir use zameen ke soton mein pro diya ? Phir woh us pani se aisi khetiyan wajood mein laata hai jin ke rang mukhtalif hain, phir woh khetiyan so kaha jati hain to tum unhein dekhte ho ke peeli prgii hain, phir woh unhein choora choora kardyta hai. Yaqeenan un baaton mein un logon ke liye bara sabaq hai jo aqal rakhte hain.

Bhala kya woh shaks jis ka sina Allah ne islam ke liye khol diya hai, jis ke natije mein woh apne Parwardigar ki ata ki hui roshni mein chuka hai, (sangh dilon ke barabar sakta hai ?) haan, barbadi un ki hai jin ke dil Allah ke zikr se sakht hochke hain. Yeh log khuli gumrahi mein pare hue hain.

Allah ne behtareen kalaam nazil farmaya hai, ek aisi kitab jis ke mazameen ek dusre se milte julte hain, jis ki baatein baar baar dohraee gayi hain. Woh log jin ke dilon mein apne Parwardigar ka rob hai un ki khaalen us se kaanp athti hain, phir un ke jism aur un ke dil naram ho kar Allah ki yaad ki taraf mutawajja hojate hain. Yeh Allah ki hidayat hai jis ke zariye woh jis ko chahta hai raah raast par le aata hai, aur jise Allah raaste se bhatka de, use koi raaste par lane wala nahin.
Bhala (us shaks ka kaisa bura haal hoga) jo qayamat ke din apne chehre hi se badhtareen azab ko rokna chahaye ga ? Aur zalimon se kaha jaye ga ke : chkho mza us kamayi ka jo tum ne kar rkhi thi.
Jo log un se pehle the, unhon ne bhi (payghumbaron ko) jhutlaya tha, jis ke natije mein un par azab aisi jagah se aaya jis ki taraf un ka gumaan bhi nahin sakta tha.
Chunanche Allah ne un ko usi dunyawi zindagi mein ruswayi ka mza chkhaia, aur aakhirat ka azab to aur bhi bara hai, kaash yeh log jante.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke hum ne us quran mein logon ki khatir har qasam ki misalen biyan ki hain, taake log sabaq hasil karen.
Yeh arabi quran jis mein koi terh nahin, taake log taqwa ikhtiyar karen.

Allah ne ek misal yeh di hai ke ek (ghulam) shaks hai jis ki milkiyat mein kaee log shareek hain jin ke darmiyan aapas mein khench taan bhi hai aur dusra (ghulam) shaks woh hai jo poore ka poora ek hi aadmi ki milkiyat hai. Kya un dono ki halat aisi jaisi sakti hai ? Alhamdulillah (us misal se baat bilkul wazeh hogaee) lekin un mein se aksar log samajhte nahin.
(ae payghumbar) maut tumhein bhi aani hai aur maut unhein bhi aani hai.
Phir tum sab qayamat ke din apne Parwardigar ke paas apna muqaddama pesh karo ge.
Ab batao ke us shaks se bara zalim kaun hoga jo Allah par jhoot bandhe, aur jab sachi baat us ke paas aaye to woh us ko jhutla de ? Kya jahannam mein aise kafiron ka thikana nahin hoga ?
Aur jo log sachi baat le kar aayein aur khud bhi use sach manen woh hain jo muttaqi hain
Un ko apne Parwardigar ke paas har woh cheez mile gi jo woh chahein ge. Yeh hai nek logon ka badla
Taake unhon ne jo badhtareen kaam kiye the Allah un ka kaffara karde, aur jo behtareen kaam karte rahe the un ka sawab unhein ata farmaye.
(ae payghumbar !) kya Allah apne bande ke liye kafi nahin hai ? Aur yeh log tumhein us ke siwa dusron se darate hain, aur jise Allah raaste se bhatka de, use koi raaste par lane wala nahin
Aur jise Allah raah raast par le aaye use koi raaste se bhatkane wala nahin. Kya Allah zabardast, intiqam lene wala nahin ?

Aur agar tum un se pochho ke aasmanon aur zameen ko kis ne paida kya hai ? To woh zaroor yehi kahin ge ke Allah ne (un se) kaho ke : ” zara mujhe yeh batao ke tum Allah ko chhor kar jin (buthon) ko pukarte ho, agar Allah mujhe koi nuksan pahunchane ka arada karle to kya yeh us ke pahunchaye hue nuksan ko door krskte hain ? Ya agar Allah mujh par meharbani farmana chahaye to kya yeh us ki rehmat ko rok sakte hain ? “ kaho ke ” mere liye Allah hi kafi hai. Bharosa rakhne wale usi par bharosa rakhte hain. “
Keh do ke : ” ae meri qaum ke logo ! Tum apne tareeqe par amal kiye jao, mein (apne tareeqe par) amal kar raha hon, phir anqareeb tumhein pata chal jaye ga
Ke kis par woh azab aata hai jo use ruswa kar ke rakaha de ga, aur kis par woh azab nazil hota hai jo hamesha jamm kar rahe ga. “

(ae payghumbar !) hum ne logon ke faiyde ke liye tum par yeh kitab barhaqq nazil ki hai. Ab jo shaks raah raast par aajaye ga. Woh apni hi bhalayi ke liye aaye ga, aur jo gumrahi ikhtiyar kare ga, woh apni gumrahi se apna hi nuksan kare ga, aur tum us ke zma daar nahin ho.

Allah tamam rooh ko un ki maut ke waqt qabz krlita hai, aur jin ko abhi maut nahin aayi hoti, un ko bhi un ki neend ki halat mein (qabz krlita hai,) phir jin ke bare mein us ne maut ka faisla karliya. Unhein apne paas rok leta hai, aur dusri roohon ko ek moyyen waqt tak ke liye chhor deta hai yaqeenan us baat mein un logon ke liye bari nishaniyan hain jo gaur wafakar se kaam lete hain.

Bhala kya un logon ne Allah (ki ijazat) ke baghair kuchh sifarshi gahara rkhe hain ? (un se) kaho ke : chahaye yeh na koi ikhtiyar rakhte hon, na kuchh samajhte hon (phir bhi tum unhein sifarshi maante raho ge ?)
Kaho ke : ” sifarish to saari ki saari Allah hi ke ikhtiyar mein hai. Usi ke qabze mein aasmanon aur zameen ki baadshahi hai, phir usi ki taraf tumhein lotaya jaye ga.

Aur jab kabhi tanha Allah ka zikr kiya jata hai to jo log aakhirat par iman nahin rakhte un ke dil bezaar hojate hain aur jab us ke siwa dusron ka zikr kiya jata hai to yeh log khushi se kahala athte hain.
Kaho :” ae Allah ! Ae aasmanon aur zameen ko paida karne wale, har gayab o hazir ke janne wale ! To hi apne bandon ke darmiyan un baaton ka faisla kare ga jin mein woh ikhtilaf karte rahe hain “.

Aur jin logon ne zulm ka irteqab kiya hai, agar un ke paas woh sab kuchh ho jo zameen mein hai, aur us ke saath itna hi aur bhi, to qayamat ke din bad tareen azab se bachne ke liye woh sab fdia ke tor par dene lagen ge, aur Allah ki taraf se woh kuchh un ke samne aajaye ga jis ka unhein gumaan bhi nahin tha.
Unhon ne jo kamayi ki thi, us ki buraiyan un ke samne zaahir hojayen gi, aur jin baaton ka woh mazaq uraya karte the, woh unhein charon taraf se ghir len gi.

Phir insan (ka haal yeh hai ke jab us) ko koi takleef chho jati hai to woh humein pukarta hai, us ke baad jab hum use apni taraf se kisi niyamat se nawazte hain to woh kehta hai ke : ” yeh to mujhe (apne) hanara ki wajah se mili hai “. Nahin ! Bulke yeh aazmaish hai, lekin un mein se aksar log nahin jante
Yehi baat un se pehle (kuchh) logon ne bhi kahi thi nateeja yeh hua ke jo kuchh woh kamate the, woh un ke kaam nahin aaya.

Aur unhon ne jo kamayi ki thi, us ki buraiyan unhi par aaprin, aur un (arab ke) logon mein jinhon ne zulm ka irteqab kiya hai, un ki kamayi ki buraiyan bhi anqareeb un par aaprin gi, aur yeh (Allah) ko aajiz nahin krskte.

Aur kya unhein yeh maloom nahin hai ke Allah jis ke liye chahta hai, rizq mein wusat kardyta hai, aur wahi tangi bhi kardyta hai ? Yaqeenan us mein un logon ke liye bari nishaniyan hain jo iman late hain.

Keh do ke : ” ae mere woh bandon ! Jinhon ne apni janon par zyadati kar rkhi hai, Allah ki rehmat se mayous na ho. Yaqeen jaano Allah sare ke sare gunaah maaf kardyta hai. Yaqeenan woh bohat bakhshne wala bara meharban hai.
Aur tum apne Parwardigar se lo lagao, aur us ke farma bardaar bann jao qabl us ke ke tumhare paas azab aaphnche, phir tumhari madad nahin ki jaye gi.
Aur tumhare Parwardigar ki taraf se tumhare paas jo behtareen baatein nazil ki gayi hain, un ki pairwi karo, qabl us ke ke tum par achanak azab aajaye, aur tumhein pata bhi na chale.

Kahin aisa na ho ke kisi shaks ko yeh kehna pare ke : ” haaye afsos meri us kotahi par jo mein ne Allah ke maamle mein barti ! Aur si baat yeh ke mein to (Allah taalaa ke ehkaam ka) mazaq urane walon mein shamil hogaya tha. “
Ya koi yeh kahe ke : agar mujhe Allah hidayat deta to mein bhi muttaqi logon mein shamil hota.
Ya jab azab aankhon se dekh le to yeh kahe ke : ” kaash mujhe ek martaba wapas jane ka mauqa mill jaye to mein nek logon mein shamil hojaoon ! “
(tujhe hidayat) kyun nahin (di gayi ?) meri aayaten tere paas chuki thin, phir to ne unhein jhutla diya, aur baraee ke ghamand mein prgia, aur kafiron mein shamil raha.
Aur qayamat ke din tum dekho ge ke jin logon ne Allah par jhoot bandha hai, un ke chehre siyah pare hue hain. Kya jahannam mein aise mutakabbiron ka thikana nahin hoga ?
Aur jin logon ne taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai, Allah un ko nijat de kar un ki murad ko pahuncha de ga, unhein koi takleef chhoe gi bhi nahin, aur na unhein kisi baat ka ghum hoga
Allah har cheez ka paida karne wala hai, aur wahi har cheez ka rkhoala hai
Sare aasmanon aur zameen ki kunjiyan usi ke paas hain, aur jinhon ne Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya hai ghate mein rehne wale wahi hain.
Keh da ke kya phir bhi ae jaahilon ! Tum mujh se kehte ho ke Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki ibadat karo ?.

Aur yeh haqeeqat hai ke tum se aur tum se pehle tamam payghumbaron se wahee ke zariye yeh baat keh di gayi thi ke agar tum ne shirk ka irteqab kiya to tumhara kiya karaya sab ghaarat hojaye ga. Aur tum yaqeen tor par sakht nuksan athane walon mein shamil hojao ge.
Lihaza us ke bajaye tum Allah hi ki ibadat karo aur shukar guzar logon mein shamil hojao

Aur un logon ne Allah taalaa ki qadar hi nahin pehchani jaisa ke us ki qadar pehchanne ka haqq tha, halaanke poori ki poori zameen qayamat ke din us ki mthi mein hogi, aur sare ke sare aasman us ke dayen haath mein lipte hue hon ge. Woh pak hai aur bohat baala o bartar us shirk se jis ka irteqab yeh log kar rahe hain.

Aur soor phonka jaye ga to aasmanon aur zameen mein jitne hain woh sab behosh hojayen ge, siwaye us ke jise Allah chahaye, phir dusri baar phonka jaye to woh sab log pil bhar mein khre ho kar dekhne lagen ge.

Aur zameen apne Parwardigar ke noor se chamak utahe gi aur nama aemaal samne rakaha diya jaye ga. Aur anbiya aur sab gawahon ko hazir kardiya jaye ga aur logon ke darmiyan bilkul barhaqq faisla kiya jaye ga. Aur un par koi zulm nahin hoga.
Aur har shaks ko us ke amal ka poora poora badla diya jaye ga. Aur jo kuchh log karte hain. Allah use khoob jaanta hai.

Aur jin logon ne kufr apnaia tha unhein jahannam ki taraf girohon ki shakal mein hanka jaye ga, yahan tak ke jab woh us ke paas pahunch jayen ge to us ke darwaze khole jayen ge aur us ke muhafiz un se kahin ge ke kya tumhare paas tumhare apne logon mein se payghumbar nahin aaye the jo tumhein tumhare rubb ki aayaten parh kar sunate hon, aur tumhein us din ka saamna karne se khabar daar karte hon ? Woh kahin ge ke be-shak aaye the, lekin azab ki baat kafiron par sachi ho kar rahi.
Kaha jaye ga ke jahannam ke darwazon mein hamesha hamesha rehne ke liye dakhil hojao kyunke bohat bura thikana hai un ka jo takabbur se kaam lete hain.

Aur jinhon ne apne Parwardigar se taqwa ka mamla rakhha tha unhein jannat ki taraf girohon ki shakal mein le jaya jaye ga yahan tak ke jab woh us ke paas pahunchenge jabke us ke darwaze un ke liye pehle se khole jaa chuke hon ge (to woh ajeeb aalam hoga.) aur us ke muhafiz un se kahin ge ke : salam ho aap par, khoob rahe aap log ! Ab us jannat mein hamesha hamesha rehne ke liye aa jaiye.

Aur woh (jannati) kahin ge ke tamam tar shukar Allah ka hai jis ne hum se apne wade ko sacha kar dkhaia aur humein us sar-zameen ka aisa waris banadiya ke hum jannat mein jahan chahein apna thikana bnalin. Saabit hua ke behtareen inam (nek) amal karne walon ka hai.

Aur tum farishton ko dekho ge ke arsh ke gird halqa banaye hue apne Parwardigar ki hamd ke saath us ki tasbeeh kar rahe hon ge, aur logon ke darmiyan barhaqq faisla kardiya jaye ga, aur kehne wale kahin ge ke : tamam tar tareef Allah ki hai jo sare jahano ka Parwardigar hai.
Haa Meem
Yeh kitab Allah ki taraf se utari jaa rahi hai jo bara sahib aqdar, bare ilm ka maalik hai
Jo gunaah ko maaf karne wala, toubah qabool karne wala, sakht saza dene wala, bari taqat ka maalik hai. Us ke siwa koi ibadat ke layaq nahin usi ki taraf sab ko lot kar jana hai.
Allah ki aayaton mein jhagre wahi log paida karte hain jinhon ne kufr apna liya hai lihaza un logon ka shehron mein dndnate phrna tumhein dhoke mein na dale

Un se pehle nooh ki qaum aur un ke baad bohat se girohon ne bhi (payghumbaron ko) jhutlaya tha aur har qaum ne apne payghumbar ke bare mein yeh arada kiya tha ke unhein giraftar karle, aur unhon ne baatil ka sahara le kar jhagre kiye the taake us ke zariye haqq ko mita den. Nateeja yeh hua ke mein ne un ko pakar mein le liya. Ab (dekh lo ke) meri saza kisi (sakht) thi.
Aur usi tarah jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai, un ke bare mein tumhare Parwardigar ki yeh baat bhi paki hochuki hai ke woh dozakhi log hain.

Woh (farishte) jo arsh ko athaie hue hain, aur jo us ke gird maujood hain, woh sab apne Parwardigar ki hamd ke saath us ki tasbeeh karte rehte hain, aur us par iman rakhte hain, aur jo log iman le aayein hain un ke liye magfirat ki dua karte hain (ke): ae humare Parwardigar ! Teri rehmat aur ilm har cheez par haawi hai, us liye jin logon ne toubah karli hai aur tere raaste par chal pare hain, un ki bakhsish farma de aur unhein dozakh ke azab se bacha le.

Aur ae Parwardigar ! Unhein hamesha rehne wali jannaton mein dakhil farma. Jis ka to ne un se wada kiya hai. Neiz un ke man baap aur biwi bacchon mein se jo nek hon, unhein bhi, yaqeenan teri aur sirf teri zaat woh hai jis ka iqtedar bhi kamil hai, jis ki hikmat bhi kamil
Aur un ko har tarah ki buraiyon se mehfooz rakaha aur us din jise to ne buraiyon se mehfooz karliya us par to ne bara reham farmaya. Aur yehi zabardast kamiyabi hai.

Jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai, un se pukar kar kaha jaye ga ke : (aaj) tumhein jitni bezaar apne aap se ho rahi hai us se ziyada bezari Allah ko us waqt hoti thi jab tumhein iman dawat di jati thi aur tum inkar karte the.
Woh kahin ge ke ae humare Parwardigar ! To ne humein do martaba maut aur do martaba zindagi di, ab hum apne gunahon ka aitraaf karte hain, to kya (humare dozakh se) nikalne ka koi raasta hai ?

(jawab diya jaye ga ke :) tumhari yeh halat us liye hai ke Allah ko tanha pukara jata tha to tum inkar karte the, aur agar us ke saath kisi aur ko shareek thehraya jata tha to tum maan lete the. Ab to faisla Allah hi ka hai jis ki shaan bohat unchi, jis ki zaat bohat bari hai.
Wahi hai jo tumhein apni nishaniyan dikhata aur tumhare liye aasman se rizq utaarta hai. Aur naseehat to wahi maana karta hai jo (hidayat ke liye dil se rujoo ho.)
Lihaza (ae logo !) Allah ko us tarah pukaro ke tumhari tabeydaari khalis usi ke liye ho chahaye kafiron ko kitna bura lage
Woh unche darjon wala, arsh ka maalik hai. Woh apne bandon se jis par chahta hai apne hukum se rooh (yani wahee) nazil kardyta hai taake mulaqat ke us din se (logon ko) khabardar kare
Jis din woh sab kahala kar samne aajayen ge, Allah se un ki koi cheez posheeda nahin hogi. (kaha jaye ga :) kis ki baadshahi hai aaj ? (jawab ek hi hoga ke :) sirf Allah ki jo wahid wqhar hai
Aaj ke din har shaks ko us ke kiye ka badla diya jaye ga aaj koi zulm nahin ho ga. Yaqeenan Allah bohat jald hisab lene wala hai.

(ae payghumbar !) un logon ko ek aisi museebat ke din se darao jo qareeb aane wali hai, jab logon ke kaleje gahata gahata kar moonh ko aajayen ge, zalimon ka na koi dost hoga aur na koi aisa sifarshi jis ki baat maani jaye
Allah aankhon ki chori ko bhi jaanta hai, aur un baaton ko bhi jin ko seeno ne chhpa rakhha hai
Aur Allah barhaqq faisle karta hai aur use chhor kar jin (jhoote khudaon) ko yeh pukarte hain, woh kisi cheez ka faisla nahin krskte. Yaqeenan Allah hi hai jo har baat sunta, sab kuchh dekhta hai

Aur kiya un logon ne zameen mein chal phir kar yeh nahin dekha ke jo log un se pehle the, un ka kaisa anjaam hochka hai. Woh taqat mein bhi un se ziyada mazboot the, aur zameen mein chhori hui yaadgaron ke aitbaar se bhi. Phir Allah ne un ke gunahon ki wajah se unhein pakar mein le liya. Aur koi nahin tha jo unhein Allah se bachaye.

Yeh sab kuchh us liye hua ke un ke paas un ke payghumbar khuli khuli daleelen le kar aate the to yeh inkar karte the, us liye Allah ne unhein pakar mein liya. Yaqeenan woh bari qooat wala saza dene mein bara sakht hai
Aur hum ne musa ko apni nishaniyon aur bari wazeh daleel de kar bheja tha
Firaun, haamaan aur qaroon ke paas, to unhon ne kaha ke yeh jhoota jadoogar hai

Phir jab woh logon ke paas woh haqq baat le kar gaye jo hamari taraf se aayi thi to unhon ne kaha ke jo log un ke saath iman le aaye hain un ke beton ko qatal kar dalo aur un ki aurton ko zinda rakho. Halaanke kafiron ki chaal ka anajm us ke siwa kuchh nahin woh maqsad tak na pahunch saken
Aur Firaun ne kaha : lao mein musa ko qatal hi kar dalon, aur use chahiye ke apne rubb ko pukar le. Mujhe darr hai ke yeh tumhara deen badal dale ga, ya zameen mein fasaad barpa karde ga.
Aur musa ne kaha : mein ne to har us mutakabbir se jo yaum hisab par iman nahin rakhta, us ki panaah le li hai jo mera bhi Parwardigar hai aur tumhara bhi Parwardigar.

Aur Firaun ke khandaan mein se ek momin shaks jo abhi tak apna iman chhpaie hue tha bol atha ke kya tum ek shaks ko sirf us liye qatal kar rahe ho ke woh kehta hai mera Parwardigar Allah hai ? Halaanke woh tumhare paas tumhare Parwardigar ki taraf se roshan daleelen le kar aaya hai. Aur agar woh jhoota hi ho to us ka jhoot usi par pare ga aur agar sacha ho to jis cheez se woh tumhein dara raha hai us mein kuchh to tum par aa hi pare gi Allah kisi aise shaks ko hidayat nahin deta jo hadd se gazara jane wala (aur) jhoot bolne ka aadi ho.

Ae meri qaum ! Aaj to tumhein aisi sultanat hasil hai ke zameen mein tumhara raaj hai, lekin agar Allah ka azab hum par aagaya to kaun hai jo us ke muqable mein hamari madad kare ?. Firaun ne kaha mein to tumhein wahi raye doon ga jise mein durust samajhta hon, aur mein tumhari jo rehnumayi kar raha hon woh bilkul theek raaste ki taraf kar raha hon
Aur jo shaks iman le aaya tha us ne kaha : ae meri qaum ! Mujhe darr hai ke tum par waisa hi din na aajaye jaisa bohat se girohon par chuka hai.
(aur tumhara haal bhi waisa na ho) jaisa haal nooh (alh alh-e-salam) ki qaum ka, aur aad wsmod ka aur un ke baad ke logon ka hua tha. Aur Allah bandon par zulm karna nahin chahta.
Aur ae meri qaum ! Mujhe tum par us din ka khof hai jis mein cheekh pukar mchi hogi.
Jis dum tum pith phir kar us tarah bhago ge ke koi bhi tumhein Allah se bachane wala nahin hoga aur jise Allah bhatka de use koi raasta dikhane wala muyassar nahin aata.

Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke us se pehle yousuf (alh alh-e-salam) tumhare paas roshan daleelen le kar aaye the tab bhi tum un ki layi hui baaton ke mutaaliq shakk mein pare rahe. Phir jab woh wafaat paa gaye to tum ne kaha ke un ke baad Allah ab koi payghumbar nahin bheje ga . Usi tarah Allah un tamam logon ko gumrahi mein dale rakhta hai jo hadd se gzre hue, shakki hote hain.

Jo apne paas kisi wazeh daleel ke aaye baghair Allah ki aayaton mein jhagre nikala karte hain. Yeh baat Allah ke nazdeek bhi qabil nafrat hai aur un logon ke nazdeek bhi jo iman le aaye hain. Usi tarah Allah har mutakabbir jabr shaks ke dil par mehar laga deta hai.
Aur Firaun ne (apne wazir se) kaha ke ae haamaan ! Mere liye ek unchi imarat bnado taake mein un raaston tak phnchon

Jo aasmanon ke raaste hain phir mein musa ke khuda ko jhaank kar dekhun aur yaqeen rakho ke mein to use jhoota hi samajhta hon. Usi tarah Firaun ki bad krdari us ki nazar mein khushnuma bnadi gayi thi aur use raaste se rok diya gaya tha. Aur Firaun ki koi chaal aisi nahin thi jo barbadi mein gayi ho
Aur jo shaks iman le aaya tha us ne kaha ae meri qaum meri baat mano, mein tumhein hidayat ke raaste par le jaon ga.
Ae meri qaum ! Yeh dunyawi zindagi to bas thora sa mza hai. Aur yaqeen jaano ke aakhirat hi rehne basne ka asal ghar hai

Aur jis shaks ne koi buraee ki hogi, use usi ke barabar badla diya jaye ga, aur jis ne nek kaam kiya hoga, chahaye woh mard ho ya aurat jabke woh momin ho to aise log jannat mein dakhil hon ge wahan unhein hisab rizq diya jaye ga.
Aur ae meri qaum ! Yeh kiya baat hai ke mein tumhein nijat ki taraf dawat de raha hon. Aur tum mujhe aag ki taraf bula rahe ho.

Tum mujhe yeh dawat de rahe ho ke Allah ka inkar karoon, aur us ke saath aisi cheezon ko shareek manon jin ke bare mein mujhe koi ilm nahin hai. Aur mein tumhein us zaat ki taraf bula raha hon jo bari sahib iqtedar, bohat bakhshne wali hai.
