Sach to yeh hai ke jin cheezon ki taraf tum mujhe bula rahe ho, woh dawat ke ehle nahin hain, na duniya mein, na aakhirat mein aur hqit yeh hai ke hum sab ko Allah ki taraf palat kar jana hai aur yeh ke jo log hadd se gzrne wale hain woh aag ke basi hain.
Garz tum anqareeb meri yeh baatein yaad karo ge jo mein tum se keh raha hon, aur mein apna mamla Allah ke supurd karta hon. Yaqeenan Allah sare bandon ko khoob dekhne wala hai
Nateeja yeh hua ke un logon ne jo bure bure mansoobe bana rkhe the, Allah ne us (mard momin) ko un sab se mehfooz rakhha aur Firaun ke logon ko bad tareen azab ne aaghira.
Aag hai jis ke samne unhein subah o shaam pesh kiya jata hai aur jis din qayamat aajaye gi (us din hukum hoga ke) Firaun ke logon ko sakht tareen azab mein dakhil kardo.

Aur us waqt (ka dhyaan rakho) jab yeh log dozakh mein ek dusre se jhagar rahe hon ge, chunanche jo (duniya mein) kamzor the woh un logon se kahin ge jo bare bane hue the ke hum to tumhare peechhe chalne wale log the to kiya tum aag ka kuchh hissa humare badle khud le lo ge.
Woh jo bare bane hue the kahin ge ke hum sab hi us dozakh mein hain Allah tamam bandon ke darmiyan faisla krchka hai
Aur yeh sab jo aag mein pare hon ge, dozakh ke ngranon se kahin ge ke : apne Parwardigar se dua karo ke woh kisi din hum se azab ko halka karde

Woh kahin ge ke kya tumhare paas tumhare payghumbar khuli khuli nishaniyan le kar aate nahin rahe the ?. Dozakhi jawab den ge. Ke be-shak (aate to rahe the) woh kahin ge. Phir to tum hi dua karo, aur kafiron ki dua ka koi anjaam akarat jane ke siwa nahin hai.
Yaqeen rakho ke hum apne payghumbaron aur iman lane walon ki dunyawi zindagi mein bhi madad karte hi, aur us din bhi karen ge jab gawahi dene wale khre hon ge
Jis din zalimon ko un ki maazrat kuchh bhi faida nahin de gi, aur un ke hisse mein phtkar hogi, aur un ke liye rhish ki badhtareen jagah
Aur hum ne musa ko hidayat ata ki, aur bani israel ko us kitab ka waris banadiya
Jo aqal walon ke liye sarapa hidayat aur naseehat thi
Lihaza (ae payghumbar !) sabar se kaam lo, yaqeen rakho ke Allah ka wada sacha hai, aur apne kasoor par istaghfaar karte raho. Aur subah o shaam apne Parwardigar ki hamd ke saath tasbeeh karte raho.

Yaqeen jaano ke jo log Allah ki aayaton ke bare mein jhagre nikalte hain, jabke un ke paas (apne dawe ki) koi sanad nahin aayi, un ke seeno mein aur kuchh nahin, bulke us baraee ka ek ghamand hai jis tak woh kabhi pahunchne wale nahin hain. Lihaza tum Allah ki panaah maango. Yaqeenan wahi hai jo har baat sunne wala, sab kuchh dekhne wala hai
Yaqeeni baat hai ke aasmanon aur zameen ka paida karna insano ke paida karne se ziyada bara kaam hai, lekin aksar log (itni si baat) nahin samajhte
Aur andha aur binayi rakhne wala dono barabar nahin hote, aur na woh log jo iman laye aur unhon ne nek amal kiye, woh aur badhkaar barabar hain, (lekin) tum log bohat kam dhyaan dete ho
Yaqeen rakho ke qayamat ki ghri zaroor aane wali hai, jis mein kisi shakk ki gunjaish nahin hai, lekin aksar log iman nahin late.

Aur tumhare Parwardigar ne kaha hai ke mujhe pukaro, mein tumhari duaein qabool karoon ga be-shak jo log takabbur ki bana par meri ibadat se moonh morte hain, woh zaleel ho kar jahannam mein dakhil hon ge.

Allah hi to hai jis ne tumhare liye raat banaee taake tum us mein sukoon hasil karo, aur din ko dekhne wala banaya. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke Allah logon par fazal farmane wala hai, lekin aksar log shukar ada nahin karte.
Woh hai Allah jo tumhara Parwardigar hai, har cheez ka paida karne wala, us ke siwa koi mabood nahin hai. Phir kahan se koi cheez tumhein ondha chala deti hai
Usi tarah woh log bhi ondhe chale the jo (pehle) Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kiya karte the

Allah hi to hai jis ne tumhare liye zameen ko qarar ki jagah banaya, aur aasman ko ek ganabad, aur tumhari surat giri ki, aur tumhari suraton ko achha banaya, aur pakeeza cheezon mein se tumhein rizq ata kiya. Woh hai Allah jo tumhara Parwardigar hai. Garz bari barkat wala hai Allah, sare jahano ka Parwardigar
Wahi sada zinda hai, us ke siwa koi mabood nahin, us liye us ko us tarah pukaro ke tumhari tabe daari khalis usi ke liye ho. Tamam tareefen Allah ke liye hain jo sare jahano ka Parwardigar hai.

(ae payghumbar ! Kafiron se) keh do ke : mujhe us baat se mana kardiya gaya hai ke jab mere paas mere rubb ki taraf se khuli khuli nishaniyan chuki hain, to phir bhi mein un ki ibadat karoon jinhen tum Allah ke bajaye pukarte ho. Aur mujhe yeh hukum diya gaya hai ke mein tamam jahano ke Parwardigar ke aage sar jhuka doon

Wahi hai jis ne tumhein mitti se paida kiya, phir nutfe se, phir jame hue khoon se. Phir woh tumhein bache ki shakal mein bahar laata hai, phir (woh tumhari perwerish karta hai) taake tum apni bhar por taqat ko pahunch jao aur phir boorhe hojao aur tum mein se kuchh woh bhi hain jo us se pehle hi wafaat paa jate hain aur taake tum ek muqarrar miyad tak pahuncho aur taake tum aqal se kaam lo
Wahi hai jo zindagi deta aur maut deta hai aur jab woh kisi kaam ka faisla krlita hai to us se sirf itna kehta hai ke hoja, bas woh hojata hai
Kya tum ne un logon ko dekha jo Allah ki aayaton mein jhagre nikalte hain ? Koi kahan se un ka rukh phir deta hai ?
Yeh log woh hain jinhon ne us kitab ko bhi jhutlaya hai, aur us (taleem) ko bhi jis ka haamil bana kar hum ne apne payghumbar bheje the. Chunanche unhein anqareeb pata lag jaye ga
Jab un ke galon mein toq aur zanjeerein hon gi, unhein ghasita jaye ga,
Garum pani mein, phir aag mein jhonk diya jaye ga.
Phir un se kaha jaye ga : kahan hain woh (tumhare mabood) jinhen tum khudayi mein us ka shareek maana karte the ?
Allah ke siwa. Yeh kahin ge woh sab to hum se khoie gaye bulke hum pehle kisi cheez ko nhi pukara karte the us tarah Allah kafiron ko bad hawaas kardyta hai.
Un se yeh pehle hi keh diya gaya hoga ke : yeh sab kuchh us liye hua ke tum zameen mein na-haqq baat par atraia karte the aur us liye ke tum zameen mein akar dikhate the.
Jao, jahannam ke darwazon mein hamesha rehne ke liye dakhil hojao, kyunke takabbur karne walon ka thikana bohat hi bura hai

Lihaza (ae payghumbar !) tum sabar se kaam lo. Yaqeen rakho ke Allah ka wada sacha hai. Ab hum un (kafiron ko) jis (azab) se dara rahe hain, chahaye us ka kuchh hissa hum tumhein bhi (tumhari zindagi mein) dikhla den, ya tumhein duniya se athalin, bahar surat un ko humare paas hi wapas laya jaye ga.

Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke hum ne tum se pehle bhi bohat se payghumbar bheje hain. Un mein se kuchh woh hain jin ke waqiyaat hum ne tumhein bata diie hain aur kuchh woh hain jin ke waqiyaat hum ne tumhein nahin bataye aur kisi payghumbar ko yeh ikhtiyar nahin hai ke woh Allah ki ijazat ke baghair koi moajiza le aaye phir jab Allah ka hukum aaye ga to sacchayi ka faisla hojaye ga, aur jo log baatil ki pairwi kar rahe hain, woh us mauqa par sakht nuksan athaiin ge
Allah woh hai jis ne tumhare liye maweshi paida kiye taake un mein se kuchh par tum sawari karo aur unhi mein se woh bhi hain jinhen tum kahate ho

Aur tumhare liye un mein bohat se faiyde hain. Aur un ka maqsad yeh bhi hai ke tumhare dilon mein (kahin jane ki) jo haajat ho us tak pahunch sako. Aur tumhein un jaanwaron par aur kashtiyon par atha karle jaya jata hai
Aur Allah tumhein apni nishaniyan dkha raha hai phir tum Allah ki kin kin nishaniyon ka inkar karo ge

Bhala kiya unhon ne zameen mein chal phir kar nahin dekha ke un se pehle jo log the, un ka anjaam kaisa hua woh un se tadaad mein ziyada the, aur taqat mein bhi un se barhe hue the, aur un yaadgaron mein bhi jo woh zameen mein chhor kar gaye hain. Phir bhi jo kuchh woh kamate the, woh un ke kuchh kaam nahin aaya

Chunanche jab un ke payghumbar un ke paas khuli khuli daleelen le kar aaye tab bhi woh apne us ilm par hi naaz karte rahe jo un ke paas tha, aur jis cheez ka woh mazaq uraya karte the, usi ne un ko aaghira.
Phir jab unhon ne hamara azab aankhon se dekh liya to us waqt kaha ke : hum khuda wahid par iman le aaye, aur un sab ka hum ne inkar kardiya jin ko hum Allah ke saath shareek thehraya karte the.

Lekin jab hamara azab unhon ne dekh liya tha to us ke baad un ka iman lana unhein faida nahin pahuncha sakta tha, khabar daar raho ke Allah taalaa ka yehi mamool hai jo us ke bandon mein pehle se chala aata hai. Aur us mauqa par kafiron ne sakht nuksan utahaya
Haa Meem
Yeh kalaam us zaat ki taraf se nazil kiya jaraha hai jo sab par meharban hai, bohat meharban hai
Arabi quran ki shakal mein yeh woh kitab hai jis ki aayaten ilm hasil karne walon ke liye tafseel se biyan ki gayi hain
Yeh quran khushkhabri dene wala bhi hai, aur khabardar karne wala bhi phir bhi un mein se aksar logon ne moonh mor rakhha hai jis ke natije mein woh sunte nahin hain

Aur (payghumbar (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) se) kehte hain ke jis cheez ki taraf tum humein bula rahe ho us ke liye humare dil gilafon mein lipte hue hain humare kaan behre hain, aur humare aur tumhare darmiyan ek purda hayal hai. Lihaza tum apna kaam karte raho. Hum apna kaam kar rahe hain.

(ae payghumbar) keh do ke mein to tum hi jaisa ek insan hon. (albatta) mujh par yeh wahee nazil hoti hai ke tumhara khuda bas ek hi khuda hai. Lihaza tum apna rukh seedha usi ki taraf rakho, aur usi se magfirat maango. Aur bari tabahi hai un mushrikon ke liye.
Jo zakat ada nahin karte un ka haal yeh hai ke aakhirat ke woh bilkul hi munkir hain
(albatta) jo log iman le aaye hain, aur unhon ne nek amal kiye hain, un ke liye be-shak aisa ajar hai jis ka silsila kabhi tootne wala nahin hai.

Keh do ke : kya tum waqayi us zaat ke saath kufr ka mamla karte ho jis ne zameen ko do din mein paida kya aur us ke saath dusron ko shareek thehrate ho ? Woh zaat to sare jahano ki perwerish karne wali hai

Aur us ne zameen mein jame hue pahar paida kiye jo us ke upar abhre hue hain aur us mein barkat daal di aur us mein tawazun ke saath us ki ghizayen paida kin. Sab kuchh char din mein tamam sawal karne walon ke liye barabar
Phir woh aasman ki taraf mutawajja hua jabke woh us waqt dhoin ki shakal mein tha aur us se aur zameen se kaha : chale aao chahaye khushi se ya zabardasti. Dono ne kaha : hum khushi khushi aate hain

Chunanche us ne do din mein apne faisle ke tahata un ke saat aasman bana diie aur har aasman mein us ke munasib hukum bhej diya aur hum ne us qareeb wale aasman ko chiraagon se sjaia aur use khoob mhfot kardiya. Yeh us zaat ki napi tuli mansuba bandi hai jis ka iqtedar bhi kamil hai, jis ka ilm bhi mukammal
Phir bhi agar yeh log moonh moren to keh do ke mein tumhein us krke se khabar daar kardiya hai jaisa krka aad aur samood par nazil hua tha

Yeh us waqt ki baat hai jab un ke paas payghumbar (kabhi) un ke aage se aur (kabhi) un ke peechhe se yeh paygham le kar aaye ke Allah ke siwa kisi cheez ki ibadat na karo. Unhon ne kaha ke : agar hamara Parwardigar chahta to farishte bhejta. Lihaza jis baat ke saath tumhein bheja gaya hai. Hum us ko maanne se inkar karte hain.

Phir aad ka qsa to yeh hua ke unhon ne zameen mein na-haqq takabbur ka roia ikhtiyar kiya, aur kaha ke : kaun hai jo taqat mein hum se ziyada ho. Bhala kiya un ko yeh nahin soojha ke jis Allah ne un ko paida kiya hai woh taqat mein un se kahin ziyada hai aur woh hamari aayaton ka inkar karte rahe

Chunanche hum ne kuchh manhoos dino mein un par aandhi ki shakal mein hua bheji taake unhein dunyawi zindagi mein ruswayi ke azab ka mza chakhayen aur aakhirat ka azab us se bhi ziyada ruswa karne wala hai. Aur un ko koi madad muyassar nahin aaye gi.

Rahe samood, to hum ne unhein seedha raasta dkhaia tha. Lekin unhon ne seedha raasta ikhtiyar karne ke muqable mein andha rehne ko ziyada pasand kiya, chunanche unhon ne jo kamayi kar rkhi thi, us ki wajah se un ko aise azab ke kara ke ne pakra jo sarapa zillat tha
Aur jo log iman le aaye the aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiye hue the un ko hum ne nijat de di
Aur us din ka dhyaan rakho jab Allah ke dushmano ko jama kar ke aag ki taraf le jaya jaye ga, chunanche unhein tolion mein bant diya jaye ga.
Yahan tak ke jab woh us (aag) ke paas pahunch jayen ge to un ke kaan, un ki aankhein aur un ki khaalen un ke khilaf gawahi den gi ke woh kiya kuchh karte rahe hain

Woh apni khaalon se kahin ge ke tum ne humare khilaf kyun gawahi di. Woh kahin gi ke humein usi zaat ne bolne ki taqat de di hai jis ne har cheez ko goyaii ata farmaee hai. Aur wahi hai jis ne tumhein pehli baar paida kiya tha, aur usi ki taraf tumhein wapas le jaya jaa raha hai.

Aur tum (gunaah karte waqt) us baat se to cahahap hi nahin sakte the ke tumhare kaan, tumhari aankhein aur tumhari khaalen tumhare khilaf gawahi den lekin tumhara gumaan yeh tha ke Allah ko tumhare bohat se aemaal ka ilm nahin hai
Apne Parwardigar ke bare mein tumhara yehi gumaan tha jis ne tumhein barbaad kiya, aur usi ke natije mein tum un logon mein shamil hogaye jo sarasar khasare mein hain.
Ab un logon ka haal yeh hai ke agar yeh sabar karen tab bhi aag hi un ka thikana hai aur agar yeh maazrat chahein to yeh un logon mein se nahin hain jin ki maazrat qabool ki jati hai

Aur hum ne (duniya mein) un par kuchh sathi musallat krdiie the jinhon ne un ke aage peechhe ke sare kaamon ko khushnuma banadiya tha chunanche jo dusre jinnat aur insan un se pehle gazara chuke hain un ke saath mill kar azab ki baat un par bhi sachi hui. Yaqeenan woh sab khasara athane walon mein se hain
Aur yeh kafir (ek dusre se) kehte hain ke : us quran ko suno hi nahin, aur us ke bech mein gul macha diya karo taake tum hi ghalib raho
Us liye hum un kafiron ko sakht azab ka mza chakhayen ge aur yeh (duniya mein) jo badhtareen kaam kiya karte the, us ka poora poora badla den ge
Yehi hai saza Allah ke dushmano ki jo aag ki surat mein hogi, usi mein un ka daeemi thikana hoga jo us baat ka badla hoga ke woh hamari aayaton ka inkar kiya karte the.

Aur yeh kafir log kahin ge ke : ae humare Parwardigar ! Humein un jinnat aur insano dono ki surat dkhaiie jinhon ne humein gumraah kiya tha, taake hum unhein apne paon tale aisa rondin ke woh khoob zaleel hon .

(dusri taraf) jin logon ne kaha hai ke hamara rubb Allah hai, aur phir woh us par saabit qadam rahe to un par be-shak farishte (yeh kehte hue) atrin ge ke : na koi khof dil mein lao, na kisi baat ka ghum karo, aur us jannat se khush hojao jis ka tum se wada kiya jata tha

Hum duniya wali zindagi mein bhi tumhare sathi the, aur aakhirat mein bhi rahen ge. Aur us jannat mein har woh cheez tumhare hi liye hai jis ko tumhara dil chahaye, aur us mein har woh cheez tumhare hi liye jo tum mngoana chaho
Yeh sab kuchh us zaat ki taraf se pehli pahala mezbani hai jis ki bakhsish bhi bohat hai jis ki rehmat bhi kamil
Aur us shaks se behtar baat kis ki hogi jo Allah ki taraf dawat de, aur nek amal kare, aur yeh kahe ke mein farma brdaron mein shamil hon.

Aur neki aur badi barabar nahin hoti, tum badi ka dfa aise tareeqe se karo jo behtareen ho nateeja yeh hoga ke jis ke aur tumhare darmiyan dushmani thi, woh dekhte hi dekhte aisa hojaye ga jaise woh (tumhara) jigri dost ho
Aur yeh baat sirf unhi ko ata hoti hai jo sabar se kaam lete hain aur yeh baat usi ko ata hoti hai jo bare naseeb wala ho
Aur agar tumhein shetan ki taraf se kabhi koi kchoka lage to shetan mardood se Allah ki panaah maang liya karo be-shak woh har baat sunne wala, har baat janne wala hai

Aur usi ki nishaniyon mein se hain yeh raat aur din aur suraj aur chand. Na suraj ko sajda karo na chand ko aur sajda us Allah ko karo jis ne unhein paida kiya hai. Agar waqayi tumhein usi ki ibadat karte ho
Phir bhi agar yeh (kafir) takabbur se kaam len, to (karte rahen) kyunke jo (farishte) tumhare rubb ke paas hain. Woh din raat us ki tasbeeh karte hain aur woh uktate nahin hain

Aur us ki nishaniyon mein se yeh bhi hai ke tum zameen ko dekhte ho ke woh mujahee pari hai. Phir junhi hum ne us par pani utara, woh harakat mein aagaee, aur us mein brhotri paida hogaee, haqeeqat yeh hai ke jis ne us zameen ko zinda kiya wahi mardon ko bhi zinda karne wala hai. Yaqeenan woh har cheez par qadir hai

Jo log hamari aayaton ke bare mein tairhaa raasta ikhtiyar karte hain woh hum se cahahap nahin sakte. Bhala batao ke jis shaks ko aag mein daal diya jaye, woh behtar hai, ya woh shaks jo qayamat ke din bekhof o khatar aaye ga (achha) jo chaho karlo yaqeen jaano ke woh tumhare har kaam ko khoob dekh raha hai
Be-shak (un logon ne bohat bura kiya hai) jinhon ne naseehat ki us kitab ka inkar kiya jabke woh un ke paas chuki thi, halaanke woh bari izzat wali kitab hai
Jis tak baatil ki koi rasayi nahin hai na us ke aage se na us ke peechhe se yeh us zaat ki taraf se utari jaa rahi hai jo hikmat ka maalik hai, tamam tareefen usi ki taraf lotti hain

(ae payghumbar !) tum se jo baatein kahi jaa rahi hain, woh wahi hain jo tum se pehle payghumbaron se kahi gayi thin, yaqeen rakho tumhara Parwardigar magfirat karne wala bhi hai, aur dardnaak saza dene wala bhi

Aur agar hum us (quran) ko ajami quran banate to yeh log kehte ke : us ki aayaten khol khol kar kyun nahin biyan ki gaeen ? Yeh kya baat hai ke quran ajami hai aur payghumbar arabi ? Keh do ke jo log iman layein, un ke liye yeh hidayat aur shifa ka samaan hai aur jo iman nahin late, un ke kaano mein daat lagi hui hai aur yeh (quran) un ke liye andhere mein bhatakne ka samaan hai. Aise logon ko kisi door daraz jagah se pukara jaa raha hai

Aur hum ne musa ko bhi kitab di thi, phir us mein bhi ikhtilaf hua. Aur agar tumhare Parwardigar ki taraf se ek baat pehle hi tai na kardi gayi hoti, to un logon ka mamla chuka hi diya gaya hota. Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh log aise shakk mein pare hue hain jis ne un ko khaljaan mein daal rakhha hai
Jo koi nek amal karta hai, woh apne hai faiyde ke liye karta hai aur jo koi buraee karta hai, woh apne hi nuksan ke liye karta hai aur tumhara Parwardigar bandon par zulm karne wala nahin hai

Qayamat ke ka ilm usi ki taraf lotaya jata hai. Aur Allah ke ilm ke baghair na phlon mein se koi pahala apne shagufon se nikalta hai aur na kisi mada ko hamal thhrta hai, aur na us ke koi bcha paida hota hai, aur jis din woh un (mushrikon) ko pukarega, kahan hain mere woh shareek ? To woh kahin ge ke : hum to aap se yehi arz karte hain ke hum mein se koi ab us baat ka gawah nahin hai (ke aap ka koi shareek hai)
Aur pehle yeh log jin (jhoote khudaon) ko pukara karte the un ko ab un ka koi sragh nahin mile ga, aur woh samajh jayen ge ke un ke liye ab bachao ka koi raasta nahin hai.
Insan ka haal yeh hai ke woh bhalayi maangne se nahin thakta aur agar use koi buraee chho jaye to aisa mayous hojata hai ke har umeed chhor bithta hai

Aur jo takleef use pahunchti thi agar us ke baad hum use apni taraf se kisi rehmat ka mza chkha den to woh lazim yeh kahe ga ke : yeh to mera haqq tha aur mein nahin samajhta ke qayamat aane wali hai, aur agar mujhe apne rubb ke paas wapas bheja bhi gaya to mujhe yaqeen hai ke us ke paas bhi mujhe khush haali hi zaroor mile gi. Ab hum un kafiron ko yeh zaroor jtlaiin ge ke unhon ne kiya amal kiye hain aur unhein ek sakht azab ka mza zaroor chakhayen ge.
Aur jab hum insan par koi inam karte hain to woh moonh mor leta aur pehlu badal kar door chala jata hai, aur jab use koi buraee chho jati hai to woh lambi chori duaein karne lagta hai.

(ae payghumbar un kafiron se) kaho ke : zara mujhe batao ke agar yeh (quran) Allah ki taraf se aaya hai, phir bhi tum ne us ka inkar kya to us shaks se ziyada gumraah kaun hoga jo (us ki) mukhalifat mein bohat door nikal gaya ho ?

Hum unhein apni nishaniyan qayinaat mein bhi dikhayen ge aur khud un ke apne wajood mein bhi, yahan tak ke un par yeh baat kahala kar samne aajaye ke yehi haqq hai. Kya tumhare rubb ki yeh baat kafi nahin hai ke woh har cheez ka gawah hai ?
Yaad rakho ke yeh log apne rubb ka saamna karne ke maamle mein shakk mein pare hue hain. Yaad rakho ke woh har cheez ko ahate mein liye hue hai.
Haa Meem
Ain Seen Qaaf
(ae payghumbar) Allah jo aziz o hakeem hai, tum par aur tum se pehle jo (payghumbar) hue hain, un par usi tarah wahee nazil karta hai.
Jo kuchh aasmanon mein hai aur jo kuchh zameen mein hai, sab usi ka hai, aur wahi hai jo bartari aur azmat ka maalik hai.

Aisa lagta hai ke aasman upar se pahata paren ge, aur farishte apne Parwardigar ki hamd ke saath us ki tasbeeh kar rahe hain, aur zameen walon ke liye istaghfaar kar rahe hain. Yaad rakho ke Allah hi hai jo bohat bakhshne wala, bara meharban hai.
Aur jin logon ne us ke siwa dusre rkhoale bana rkhe hain, Allah un par nigrani rkhe hue hai, aur tum un ke zma daar nahin ho.

Aur usi tarah hum ne yeh arabi quran tum par wahee ke zariye bheja hai, taake tum mrkzi basti (makkah) aur us ke ird gird walon ko us din se khabardar karo jis mein sab ko jama kiya jaye ga, jis ke aane mein koi shakk nahin hai. Ek giroh jannat mein jaye ga aur ek giroh bharakti hui aag mein.
Aur agar Allah chahta to un sab ko ek hi jamat bana deta, lekin woh jis ko chahta hai, apni rehmat mein dakhil karta hai, aur jo zalim log hain un ka na koi rkhoala hai, na koi madadgar hai.
Kya un logon ne us ko chhor kar dusre rkhoale bana liye hain ? Sach to yeh hai ke rkhoala Allah hi hai, aur wahi mardon ko zinda karta hai aur wahi har cheez par qadir hai.
Aur tum jis baat mein bhi ikhtilaf karte ho, us ka faisla Allah hi ke supurd hai, logo ! Wahi Allah hai jo mera Parwardigar hai, usi par mein ne bharosa kiya hai, aur usi se mein lo lagata hon.

Woh aasmanon aur zameen ka paida karne wala hai. Us ne tumhare liye tumhari hi jins se jore paida kiye hain, aur maweshiyon ke bhi jore banaye hain. Usi zariye se woh tumhari nasal chalata hai. Koi cheez us ke misil nahin hai, aur wahi hai jo har baat sunta, sab kuchh dekhta hai.
Aasmanon aur zameen ki saari kunjiyan usi ke qabze mein hain, woh jis ke liye chahta hai rizq mein wusat aur tangi karta hai, yaqeenan woh har cheez ka janne wala hai.

Us ne tumhare liye deen ka wahi tareeqa tai kiya hai jis ka hukum us ne nooh ko diya tha, aur jo (ae payghumbar) hum ne tumhare paas wahee ke zariye bheja hai aur jis ka hukum hum ne Ibrahim, musa aur essa ko diya tha ke tum deen ko qayam karo, aur us mein tafarqa na daalna. (phir bhi) mushrikeen ko woh baat bohat giran guzarti hai jis ki taraf tum unhein dawat de rahe ho. Allah jis ko chahta hai chun kar apni taraf khench leta hai aur jo koi us se lo lagata hai use apne paas pahuncha deta hai.

Aur logon ne aapas ki daoton ki wajah se (deen mein) jo tafarqa dala hai woh us ke baad hi dala hai jab un ke paas yaqeeni ilm chuka tha. Aur agar tumhare Parwardigar ki taraf se ek moyyen muddat tak ke liye ek baat pehle se tai na hoti to un ka faisla hochka hota. Aur un logon ke baad jin ko kitab ka waris banaya gaya hai woh us ke bare mein aise shakk mein pare hue hain jis ne unhein khaljaan mein daal rakhha hai.

Lihaza (ae payghumbar) tum usi baat ki taraf logon ko dawat dete raho aur jis tarah tumhein hukum diya gaya hai, (usi deen par) jame raho, aur un logon ki khwahishat ke peechhe na chalo, aur keh do ke : mein to us kitab par iman laya hon jo Allah ne nazil ki hai, aur mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke mein tumhare darmiyan insaf karoon. Allah hamara bhi rubb hai aur tumhara bhi rubb. Humare aemaal humare liye hain aur tumhare aemaal tumhare liye. Humare aur tumhare darmiyan (ab) koi behas nahin. Allah hum sab ko jama kare ga, aur usi ke paas aakhir sab ko lotna hai.

Aur jo log Allah ke bare mein behasein nikalte hain jabke log us ki baat maan chuke hain, un ki behas un ke Parwardigar ke nazdeek baatil hai, aur un par (Allah ka) gazab hai, aur un ke liye sakht azab hai.
Allah woh hai jis ne haqq par mushtamil yeh kitab aur insaf ki tarazoo utari hai. Aur tumhein kiya pata, shayad ke qayamat ki ghri qareeb hi ho.

Jo log us par iman nahin rakhte woh us ke aane ki jaldi machate hain, aur jo log iman laye hain, woh us se shme rehte hain, aur jante hain ke woh barhaqq hai. Are jo log qayamat ke bare mein behasein kar rahe hain, woh gumrahi mein bohat door chale gaye hain.
Allah apne bandon par bohat meharban hai, woh jis ko chahta hai rizq deta hai, aur wahi hai jo qooat ka bhi maalik hai, iqtedar ka bhi maalik hai.
Jo shaks aakhirat ki khiti chahta ho, hum us ki khiti mein azafa karen ge, aur jo shaks (sirf) duniya ki khiti chahta ho, hum use usi mein se de den ge, aur aakhirat mein us ka koi hissa nahin.

Kya un (kafiron) ke kuchh aise shareek hain jinhon ne un ke liye aisa deen tai kardiya hai jis ki Allah ne ijazat nahin di hai ? Aur agar (Allah ki taraf se) faisla kin baat tai shda na hoti to un ka mamla chuka diya gaya hota. Aur yaqeen rakho ke un zalimon ke liye bara dardnaak azab hai.

(us waqt) tum un zalimon ko dekho ge ke unhon ne jo kamayi ki hai, us (ke wabal) se shme hue hon ge, aur woh un par parr kar rahe ga, aur jo log iman laye hain, aur unhon ne nek amal kiye hain woh jannaton ki kiya rion mein hon ge. Unhein apne Parwardigar ke paas woh sab kuchh mile ga jo woh chahein ge. Yehi bara fazal hai.

Yehi woh cheez hai jis ki khushkhabri Allah apne un bandon ko deta hai jo iman laye hain, aur jinhon ne nek amal kiye hain. (ae payghumbar ! Kafiron se) keh do ke : mein tum se us (tableeg) par koi ujrat nahin maangta, siwaye rishta daari ki mohabbat ke. Aur jo shaks koi bhalayi kare ga, hum us ki khatir us bhalayi mein mazeed khoobi ka azafa karden ge. Yaqeen jaano Allah bohat bakhshne wala, bara qadardaan hai.

Bhala kya yeh log yun kehte hain ke us shaks ne yeh kalaam khud gahara kar jhoot moot Allah ke zimme laga diya hai ? Halaanke agar Allah chahaye to tumhare dil par mehar laga de, aur Allah to baatil ko mitata hai, aur haqq ko apne kalmaat ke zariye saabit karta hai, yaqeenan woh seeno mein chhpi hui baaton tak ko jaanta hai.
Aur wahi hai jo apne bandon ki toubah qabool karta hai, aur gunahon ko maaf karta hai, aur jo kuchh tum karte ho, us ka poora ilm rakhta hai.
Aur jo log iman laye hain aur jinhon ne nek amal kiye hain, woh un ki dua sunta hai aur unhein apne fazal se aur ziyada deta hai, aur kafiron ke liye sakht azab hai.

Aur agar Allah apne tamam bandon ke liye rizq ko khle tor par pehla deta to woh zameen mein sarkashi karne lagte, magar woh ek khaas andaze se jitna chahta hai (rizq) utaarta hai. Yaqeenan woh apne bandon se poori tarah bakhabar, un par nazar rakhne wala hai.
Aur wahi hai jo logon ke na-umeed hone ke baad baarish barsata aur apni rehmat pehla deta hai, aur wahi hai jo (sab ka) qabil tareef rkhoala hai.
Aur us ki nishaniyon mein se hai aasmanon aur zameen ki pedaeesh aur woh jaandaar jo us ne un dono mein pehla rkhe hain, aur woh jab chahaye un ko jama karne par poori qudrat rakhta hai.
Aur tumhein jo koi museebat pahunchti hai woh tumhare apne haathon kiye hue kaamon ki wajah se pahunchti hai, aur bohat se kaamon se to woh darguzar hi karta hai.
Aur tumhari majal nahin hai ke zameen mein (Allah ko) aajiz krsko, aur Allah ke siwa tumhara na koi rkhoala hai, na madadgar.
Aur us ki nishaniyon mein se hain samandar mein yeh paharon jaise jahaaz.
Agar woh chahaye to hua ko thehra de, jis se yeh samandar ki pusht par khre ke khre reh jayen, yaqeenan us mein har us shaks ke liye bari nishaniyan hain jo sabar ka bhi khugar aur shukar ka bhi.
Ya (agar Allah chahaye) to un jhazon ko logon ke baaz aemaal ki wajah se tabaah hi karde, aur bohat son se darguzar kar jaye.
Aur jo log hamari aayaton mein jhagre daalte hain, unhein pata chal jaye ke un ke liye koi bachao ki jagah nahin hai.

Garz tumhein jo koi cheez di gayi hai woh dunyawi zindagi ki poonji hai, aur jo kuchh Allah ke paas hai woh un logon ke liye kahin behtar aur payedaar hai jo iman laye hain, aur apne Parwardigar par bharosa karte hain.
Aur jo bare bare gunahon aur behiaii ke kaamon se parheiz karte hain aur jab un ko ghsa aata hai to woh darguzar se kaam lete hain.

Aur jinhon ne apne Parwardigar ki baat maani hai aur namaz qayam ki hai aur un ke maamlaat aapas ke mashware se tai hote hain, aur hum ne unhein jo rizq diya hai ,. Us mein se woh (neki ke kaamon mein) kharch karte hain.
Aur jab un par koi zyadati hoti hai to woh apna dfa karte hain.
Aur kisi buraee ka badla usi jaisi buraee hai. Phir bhi jo koi maaf karde, aur islaah se kaam le to us ka sawab Allah ne zimme liya hai. Yaqeenan woh zalimon ko pasand nahin karta.
Aur jo shaks apne upar zulm hone ke baad (barabar ka) badla le to aise logon par koi ilzam nahin hai.
Ilzam to un par hai jo logon par zulm karte hain aur zameen mein na-haqq zyadatiyan karte hain. Aise logon ke liye dardnaak azab hai.
Aur yeh haqeeqat hai ke jo koi sabar se kaam le, aur darguzar kar jaye to yeh bari himmat ki baat hai.
Aur jise Allah gumraah karde to us ke baad koi nahin hai jo us ka madadgar bane. Aur jab zalimon ko azab nazar aajaye to tum unhein yeh kehta hua dekhen ge ke : kya wapas jane ka bhi koi raasta hai ?

Aur tum unhein dekho ge ke dozakh ke samne unhein us tarah pesh kiya jaye ga ke woh zillat ke maare jhuke hue kin ankhion se dekh rahe hon ge, aur jo log iman lachke hain woh keh rahe hon ge ke : waqayi asal khasare mein woh log hain jinhon ne qayamat ke din apne aap ko aur apne ghar walon ko khasare mein daal diya. Yaad rakho ke zalim log aise azab mein hon ge jo hamesha qayam rahe ga.
Aur un ko aise koi madadgar muyassar nahin aayein ge jo Allah ko chhor kar un ki koi madad karen. Aur jise Allah gumraah karde, us ke liye bachao ka koi raasta nahin hota.

(logo) apne Parwardigar ki baat us din ke aane se pehle pehle maan lo jise Allah ki taraf se taala nahin jaye ga, us din tumhare liye koi jaye panaah nahin hogi, aur na tumhare liye pochh gacahah ka koi mauqa hoga,

(ae payghumbar) yeh log agar phir bhi moonh moren to hum ne tumhein un par nigraan bana kar nahin bheja hai, tum par baat pahuncha dene ke siwa koi zma daari nahin hai, aur (insan ka haal yeh hai ke) jab hum insan ko apni taraf se kisi rehmat ka mza chkha dete hain to woh us par itra jata hai, aur agar khud apne haathon ke kartoot ki wajah se aise logon ko koi museebat pesh aajati hai to wahi insan pakka shukra bann jata hai.
Sare aasmanon aur zameen ki sultanat Allah hi ki hai, woh jo chahta hai, paida karta hai, woh jis ko chahta hai, larkiyan deta hai aur jis ko chahta hai larke deta hai.
Ya phir un ko mila jila kar larke bhi deta aur larkiyan bhi aur jis ko chahta hai baanjh bana deta hai. Yaqeenan woh ilm ka bhi maalik hai qudrat ka bhi maalik.

Aur kisi insan mein yeh taqat nahin hai ke Allah us se (roo-baroo) baat kare. Siwaye us ke ke woh wahee ke zariye ho, ya kisi parde ke peechhe se, ya phir woh koi paygham lane wala (farishta) bhej de, aur woh us ke hukum se jo woh chahaye wahee ka paygham pahuncha de. Yaqeenan woh bohat unchi shaan wala, bari hikmat ka maalik hai.

Aur usi tarah hum ne tumhare paas apne hukum se ek rooh bator wahee nazil ki hai. Tumhein us se pehle na yeh maloom tha ke kitab kiya hoti hai aur na yeh ke iman kiya hai, lekin hum ne us (quran) ko ek noor banaya hai jis ke zariye hum apne bandon mein se jis ko chahte hain, hidayat dete hain. Aur us mein koi shakk nahin ke tum logon ko woh seedha raasta dkha rahe ho.
Jo Allah ka raasta hai, woh Allah jis ki milkiyat mein woh sab kuchh jo aasmanon mein hai aur woh sab kuchh jo zameen mein hai. Yaad rakho ke sare maamlaat aakhir kaar Allah hi ki taraf loten ge.
Haa Meem
Qasam hai us wazeh kitab ki.
Hum ne use arabi zubaan ka quran banaya hai, taake tum samjho.
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke woh humare paas loah mehfooz mein bare unche darje ki hikmat se bhari hui kitab hai.
Bhala kya hum moonh mor kar us naseehat name ko tum se us bana par htalin ke tum hadd se guzre hue log ho ?
Aur kitne hi nabi hum ne pichle logon mein bhi bheje hain.
Aur un logon ke paas koi nabi aisa nahin aaya jis ka woh mazaq na urate hon.
Phir jo log un (makkah walon) se kahin ziyada zoar aawar the hum ne unhein halaak kardiya, aur un pichle logon ka haal peechhe guzar chuka hai.

Aur agar tum un (mushrikon) se pochho ke sare aasman aur zameen kis ne paida kiye hain, to woh zaroor yehi kahin ge ke : unhein us zaat ne paida kiya hai jo iqtedar ki bhi maalik hai, ilm ki bhi maalik.
Yeh woh zaat hai jis ne tumhare liye zameen ko bichona banaya, aur us mein tumhare liye raaste banaye, taake tum manzil tak pahunch sako.
Aur jis ne aasman se ek khaas andaze se pani utara, phir hum ne us ke zariye ek murda ilaqe ko naee zindagi de di, usi tarah tumhein (qabron se) nikal kar naee zindagi di jaye gi.
Aur jis ne har tarah ke jore paida kiye aur tumhari woh kashtiyan aur chopaye banaye jin par tum sawari karte ho.

Taake tum un ki pusht par chrho, phir jab un par charh kar bith jao to apne Parwardigar ki niyamat ko yaad karo, aur yeh kaho ke : pak hai woh zaat jis ne us sawari ko humare bas mein de diya, wrna hum mein se yeh taqat nahin thi ke us ko qaabu mein laskte.
Aur be-shak hum apne Parwardigar ki taraf lot kar jane wale hain.
Aur un (mushrik) logon ne yeh baat banaee hai ke Allah ka khud us ke bandon mein se koi jaza hai. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke insan khullam khla shukra hai.
Bhala kya Allah ne apni makhlooq mein se apne liye to betiyan pasand ki hain, aur tumhein beton ke liye muntakhab kya hai ?

Halaanke un mein se kisi ko jab us (beti) ki (wiladat) khushkhabri di jati hai jo us ne khuda Rahman ki taraf mansoob kar rkhi hai to us ka chhra siyah prjata hai, aur woh dil hi dil mein ghtta rehta hai.
Aur kya (Allah ne aisi aulad pasand ki hai) jo zewaron mein paali posi jati hai aur jo behas mbahse mein apni baat kahala kar bhi nahin keh sakti ?
Us ke laoa unhon ne farishton ko jo khuda Rahman ke bande hain, manasa banadiya hai. Kya yeh log un ki takhleeq ke waqt maujood the ? Un ka yeh doi lakaha liya jaye ga aur un se baaz purs hogi.

Aur yeh kehte hain ke : agar khuda Rahman chahta to hum un (farishton) ki ibadat na karte. Un ko us baat ki haqeeqat ka zara bhi ilm nahin hai aur un ka kaam us ke siwa kuchh nahin ke andazon ke teer chalate hain.
Bhala kya hum ne unhein us se pehle koi kitab di thi jise yeh thame bithe hain ?
Nahin, bulke un ka kehna yeh hai ke hum ne apne baap dadon ko ek tareeqe par paya hai aur hum unhi ke nakshe qadam ke mutabiq theek theek raaste par jarahe hain.

Aur (ae payghumbar) hum ne tum se pehle jab bhi kisi basti mein koi khabardar karne wala (payghumbar) bheja to wahan ke daulat mand logon ne yehi kaha ke : hum ne apne baap dadon ko ek tareeqe par paya hai, aur hum unhi ke nakshe qadam ke peechhe chal rahe hain.

Payghumbar ne kaha ke : tum ne apne baap dadon ko jis tareeqe par paya hai, agar mein tumhare paas us se ziyada hidayat ki baat le kar aaya hon to kya phir bhi (tum apne tareeqe par chale jao ge ?) unhon ne jawab diya ke : tum jo paygham de kar bheje gaye ho hum to us ko maanne wale nahin hain.
Nateeja yeh hua ke hum ne un se intiqam liya, ab dekh lo ke jhutlane walon ka anjaam kaisa hua ?
Aur woh waqt yaad karo jab Ibrahim ne apne baap aur apni qaum se kaha tha ke : mein un cheezon se bezaar hon jin ki tum ibadat karte ho.
Siwaye us zaat ke jis ne mujhe paida kiya hai, chunanche wahi meri rehnumayi karta hai.
Aur Ibrahim ne us (aqeede) ko aisi baat banadiya jo un ki aulad mein baqi rahi, taake log (shirk se) baaz aayein.
(phir bhi bohat se log baaz na aaye) us ke bawajood mein ne un ko aur un ke baap dadon ko zindagi ke faiyde diye, yahan tak ke un ke paas haqq aur saaf saaf hidayat dene wala payghumbar aagaya.
Aur jab woh haqq un ke paas aaya to woh kehne lage ke : yeh to jadoo hai aur hum us ka inkar karte hain.
Aur kehne lage ke : yeh quran dobstion mein se kisi bare aadmi par kyun nazil nahin kya gaya ?

Bhala kya yeh log hain jo tumhare Parwardigar ki rehmat taqseem karen ge ? Dunyawi zindagi mein un ki rozi ke zaraye bhi hum ne hi un ke darmiyan taqseem kar rkhe hain aur hum ne hi un mein se ek ko dusre par drjat mein foqiyat di hai, taake woh ek dusre se kaam le saken. Aur tumhare Parwardigar ki rehmat to us (daulat) se kahin behtar cheez hai jo yeh jama kar rahe hain.

Aur agar yeh andesha na hota ke tamam insan ek hi tareeqe ke (yani kafir) hojayen ge to jo log khuda Rahman ke munkir hain, hum un ke liye un gharon ki chatein bhi chandi ki bana dete, aur woh sirhian bhi jin par woh charhte hain.
Aur un ke gharon ke darwaze bhi, aur woh takht bhi jin par woh tkia laga kar bithte hain.
Bulke unhein sona bana dete, aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh sab kuchh bhi nahin, sirf dunyawi zindagi ka samaan hai. Aur aakhirat tumhare Parwardigar ke nazdeek perhezgaron ke liye hai.
Aur jo shaks khuda Rahman ke zikr se andha bann jaye, hum us par ek shetan musallat kardete hain jo us ka sathi bann jata hai.
Aise shayateen un ko raaste se rokte rehte hain, aur woh samajhte hi ke hum theek raaste par hain.
Yahan tak ke jab aisa shaks humare paas aaye ga to (apne shetan sathi se) kahe ga ke : kaash mere aur tere darmiyan mashriq o magrib ka faasla hota, kyunke to bohat bura sathi tha.
Aur aaj jab tum zulm krchke ho to tumhein yeh baat hargiz koi faida nahin pahunchaye gi ke tum azab mein ek dusre ke shareek ho.
To phir (ae payghumbar) kya tum behron ko sunao ge, ya andhon ko aur un logon ko raaste par lao ge jo khuli gumrahi mein pare hue hain ?
Ab to yehi hoga ke agar hum tumhein duniya se athalin, tab bhi hum un se badla lene wale hain.
Ya agar tumhein bhi woh (azab) dkha den jis ka hum ne un se wada kiya hai, tab bhi humein un par har tarah ki qudrat hasil hai.
Lihaza tum par jo wahee nazil ki gayi hai, use mazbooti se thame rakho. Yaqeenan tum seedhe raaste par ho.
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh wahee tumhare liye aur tumhari qaum ke liye ek nek naami ka zria hai, aur tum sab se pochha jaye ga (ke tum ne us ka kya haqq ada kya ?)
Aur tum se pehle hum ne apne jo payghumbar bheje hain, un se pochh lo ke kya hum ne khuda Rahman ke siwa koi aur mabood bhi muqarrar kiye the jin ki ibadat ki jaye ?
Aur hum ne musa ko apni nishaniyan de kar Firaun aur us ke sardaron ke paas bheja tha, chunanche musa ne kaha ke : mein rubb aalameen ka bheja hua payghumbar hon.
Phir jab unhon ne hamari nishaniyan un ke samne pesh kin to woh un ka mazaq urane lage.
Aur hum unhein jo nishani bhi dikhate, woh pehli nishani se barh charh kar hoti thi, aur hum ne unhein azab mein bhi pakra taake woh baaz aajayen.
Aur woh yeh kehne lage ke : ae jadoogar ! Tum se tumhare Parwardigar ne jo ahad kar rakhha hai us ka wasta de kar us se humare liye dua karo, hum yaqeenan raah raast par aajayen ge.
Phir jab hum un se azab ko door kardete hain to pil bhar mein woh apna wada tor daalte the.
Aur Firaun ne apni qaum ke darmiyan pukar kar kaha ke : ae meri qaum ! Kya misr ki sultanat mere qabze mein nahin hai ? Aur (dekho) yeh darya mere niche beh rahe hain. Kya tumhein dkhaii nahin deta ?
Ya phir mano ke mein us shaks se kahin behtar hon jo bara hakeer qasam ka hai, aur apni baat kahala kar kehna bhi us ke liye mushkil hai.
Bhala (agar yeh pighbr hai to) us par sone ke kangan kyun nahin dale gaye ? Ya phir us ke saath farishte par bandhe hue kyun na aaye ?
Us tarah us ne apni qaum ko bewaqoof banaya aur unhon ne us ka kehna maan liya. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke woh sab gunehgar log the.
Chunanche jab unhon ne humein naraaz kardiya to hum ne un se intiqam liya aur un sab ko garq kardiya.
Aur hum ne unhein ek gayi guzri qaum aur baad walon ke liye ibrat ka namuna banadiya.
Aur jab (essa) ibne marium ki misal di gayi to tumhari qaum ke log yakayak shur machane lage.
Aur kehne lage ke : humare mbodbhtr hain ya woh ? Unhon ne tumhare samne yeh misal mehaz kat hujjati ke liye di hai, bulke yeh log hain hi jhagraloo.
Woh (yani essa (alh alh-e-salam)) to bas humare ek bande the jin par hum ne inam kiya tha, aur bani israel ke liye un ko ek namuna banaya tha.
Aur agar hum chahein to tum se farishte paida karden jo zameen mein ek dusre ke janasheen bann kar raha karen.
Aur yaqeen rakho ke woh (yani essa (alh alh-e-salam)) qayamat ki ek nishani hain. Us liye tum us mein shakk na karo, aur meri baat mano, yehi seedha raasta hai.
Aur aisa hargiz na hone paye ke shetan tumhein us raaste se rok de. Yaqeen jaano woh tumhara khla dushman hai.

Aur jab essa khuli hui nishaniyan le kar aaye the to unhon ne (logon se) kaha tha ke : mein tumhare paas danaee ki baat le kar aaya hon, aur us liye laya hon ke tumhare samne kuchh woh cheezen wazeh kardoon jin mein tum ikhtilaf karte ho. Lihaza tum Allah se daro, aur meri baat maan lo.
Yaqeenan Allah hi mera bhi rubb hai aur tumhara bhi rubb hai, us liye us ki ibadat karo. Yehi seedha raasta hai.
Phir bhi un mein se kaee girohon ne ikhtilaf paida kiya, chunanche un zalimon ke liye ek dardnaak din ke azab ki wajah se bari kharabi hogi.
Yeh log bas us baat ka intezar kar rahe hain ke qayamat un ke samne achanak aakhri ho, aur unhein khabar bhi na ho.
Us din tamam dost ek dusre ke dushman hon ge, siwaye muttaqi logon ke.
(jin se kaha jaye ga ke) ae mere bandon ! Aaj tum par na koi khof taari hoga aur na tum ghumgeen hoge.
Ae mere woh bandon jo hamari aayaton par iman laye the aur farmanbardar rahe the.
Tum bhi aur tumhari biwiyan bhi, khushi se chamakte chehron ke saath jannat mein dakhil hojao.

Un ke aage sone ke pyale aur glas gardish mein laye jayen ge. Aur us jannat mein har woh cheez hogi jis ki dilon ko khwahish hogi aur jis se aankhon ko lazzat hasil hogi. (un se kaha jaye ga ke) us jannat mein tum hamesha raho ge.
Aur yeh woh jannat hai jis ka tumhein apne aemaal ke badle waris banadiya gaya hai.
Us mein tumhare liye khoob ifraat ke saath mewe hain jin mein se tum kha ge.
Albatta jo log mujrim the woh dozakh ke azab mein hamesha rahen ge.
Woh azab un ke liye halka nahin parne diya jaye ga, aur woh us mein mayous pare hon ge.
Aur hum ne un par koi zulm nahin kiya, lekin woh khud hi zalim log the.
Aur woh (dozakh ke farishte se) pukar kar kahin ge ke : ae maalik ! Tumhara Parwardigar hamara kaam hi tamam karde. Woh kahe ga ke tumhein usi haal mein rehna hai.
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke hum tumhare paas haqq baat le kar aaye the lekin tum mein se aksar log haqq baat hi ko bura samajhte hain.
Haan kya un logon ne kuchh karne ka faisla karliya hai ? Achha to hum bhi kuchh karne ka faisla karne wale hain.
Kya unhon ne yeh samajh rakhha hai ke hum un ki khfia baatein aur un ki sargoshiyan nahin sunte ? Kaise nahin sunte ? Neiz humare farishte un ke paas hain, woh sab kuchh likhte rehte hain.
(ae payghumbar) keh do ke : agar khuda Rahman ki koi aulad hoti to sab se pehla ibadat karne wala mein hota.
Woh jo aasmanon aur zameen ka bhi maalik hai, arsh ka bhi maalik, woh un saari baaton se pak hai jo yeh banaya karte hain.
Lihaza (ae payghumbar) unhein apne haal par chhor do ke yeh un baaton mein doobe rahen, aur hansi khil karte rahen, yahan tak ke woh apne us din se jamilein jis ka un se wada kiya jaraha hai.
Wahi (Allah) hai jo aasman mein bhi mabood hai aur zameen mein bhi mabood hai. Aur wahi hai jo hikmat ka bhi maalik hai, ilm ka bhi maalik.
Aur bari shaan hai us ki jis ke qabze mein aasmanon aur zameen aur un ke darmiyan tamam cheezon ki sultanat hai aur usi ke paas qayamat ka ilm hai, aur usi ke paas tum sab ko wapas le jaya jaye ga.
Aur yeh log use chhor kar jin maboodon ko pukarte hain, unhein koi sifarish karne ka ikhtiyar nahin hoga, haan albatta jin logon ne haqq baat ki gawahi di ho, aur unhein us ka ilm bhi ho.
Aur agar tum un logon se pochho ke un ko kis ne paida kya hai to woh zaroor yehi kahin ge ke Allah ne. Us ke bawajood koi unhein kahan se ondha chala deta hai ?
Aur Allah ko payghumbar ki us baat ka bhi ilm hai ke : ya rubb ! Yeh aise log hain jo iman nahin late.
Lihaza (ae payghumbar) tum un ki parwah na karo, aur keh do : salam. Kyunke anqareeb unhein khud sab pata chal jaye ga.
Haa Meem
Qasam hai us kitab ki jo haqq ko wazeh karne wali hai.
Ke hum ne use ek mubarak raat mein utara hai. (kyunke) hum logon ko khabardar karne wale the.
Usi raat mein har hakeimana mamla humare hukum se tai kiya jata hai.
(neiz) hum ek payghumbar bhejne wale the.
Taake tumhare rubb ki taraf se rehmat ka mamla ho. Yaqeenan wahi hai jo har baat sunne wala, har cheez janne wala hai.
Jo sare aasmanon aur zameen ka aur un ke darmiyan har cheez ka rubb hai, agar tum waqayi yaqeen karne wale ho.
Us ke siwa koi mabood nahin hai, woh zindagi bhi deta hai, aur maut bhi, woh tumhara bhi rubb hai aur tumhare pehle guzre hue baap dadon ka bhi rubb
(phir bhi kafir iman nahin late) bulke woh shakk mein pare hue khil kar rahe hain.
Lihaza us din ka intezar karo jab aasman ek wazeh dhuwan le kar namudaar hoga.
Jo logon par chah jaye ga. Yeh ek dardnaak saza hai
(us waqt yeh log kahin ge ke) ae humare Parwardigar hum se yeh azab door kar dijiye, hum zaroor iman le aayein ge.
Un ko naseehat kahan hoti hai ? Halaanke un ke paas aisa payghumbar aaya hai jis ne haqeeqat ko khol kar rakaha diya hai.
Phir bhi yeh log us se moonh more rahe, aur kehne lage ke : yeh skhaia parhaya hua hai, dioana hai.
(achha) hum azab ko kuchh rse tak hata dete hain. Yaqeen hai ke tum phir usi halat par lot aao ge.
Jis din hamari taraf se sab se bari pakar hogi, us din hum poora intezam le len ge.
Aur un se pehle hum ne Firaun ki qaum ko aazmaya tha aur un ke paas ek muazzaz payghumbar aaye the.
(aur unhon ne kaha tha ke) Allah ke bandon ko mere hawale kardo. Mein tumhari taraf ek amanat daar payghumbar bann kar aaya hon.
Aur yeh ke : Allah ke aage sarkashi mat karo, mein tumhare paas ek khuli hui daleel pesh karta hon.
Aur mein us baat se apne Parwardigar aur tumhare Parwardigar ki panaah leta hon ke tum mujhe sangsaar karo.
Aur agar tum mujh par iman nahin late to mujh se alag hojao
Phir unhon ne apne Parwardigar ko pukara ke yeh mujrim log hain.
(Allah taalaa ne farmaya ke) achha tum mere bandon ko le kar raaton raat roana hojao. Tumhara pichha zaroor kiya jaye ga.
Aur tum samandar ko thehra hua chhor dena yaqeenan yeh lashkar dboia jaye ga.
Kitne baghaat aur chashme the jo yeh log chhor gaye.
Aur kitne khit aur shaandaar makanaat.
Aur aish ke kitne samaan jin mein woh maze kar rahe the.
Un ka anjaam usi tarah hua, aur hum ne un sab cheezon ka waris ek dusri qaum ko banadiya.
Phir na un par aasman roya na zameen, aur na un ko kuchh mohlat di gayi.
Aur bani israel ko hum ne zillat ke azab se nijat de di,
Yani Firaun se. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke woh bara sirkash, hadd se guzre hue logon mein se tha.
Aur hum ne un ko apne ilm ke mutabiq jahaan walon par foqiyat di.
Aur un ko aisi nishaniyan den jin mein khla hua inam tha.
Yeh log saaf kehte hain.
Ke : aur kuchh nahin hai, bas hamari wahi pehli maut hogi aur humein dobara zinda nahin kiya jaye ga.
Agar tum sache ho to humare baap dadon ko atha lao.
Bhala yeh log behtar hain ya tubba ki qaum aur woh log jo un se pehle the ? Hum ne un sab ko halaak kardiya. (kyunke) woh yaqeeni tor par mujrim log the.
Aur hum ne aasmanon aur zameen aur un ke darmiyan ki cheezen befaida khil karne ke liye paida nahin kardi hain.
Hum ne unhein barhaqq maqsad hi ke liye paida kiya hai, lekin un mein se aksar log samajhte nahin hain.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke faisle ka din un sab ki muqarrara miyad hai.
Jis din koi himayati kisi himayati ke zara bhi kaam nahin aaye ga aur un mein se kisi ki koi madad nahin ki jaye gi.
Siwaye us ke jis par Allah reham farmaye. Yaqeenan woh mukammal iqtedar ka maalik bhi hai aur bohat meharban hai.
Yaqeen jaano ke zakkhum ka darakht,.
Gunehgar ka khana hoga.
Tel ki talchat jaisa. Woh logon ke pait mein us tarah josh maare ga.
Jaise kholta hua pani.
(farishton se kaha jaye ga) us ko pakro, aur ghsit kar dozakh ke beechon bech tak le jao.
Phir us ke sar ke upar khaulte hue pani ka azab undhail do .
(kaha jaye ga ke) le cahakah. To hi hai woh bara sahib iqtedar, bara izzat wala.
Yeh wahi cheez hai jis ke bare mein tum log shakk kiya karte the.
(dusri taraf) perhezgar log yaqeenan aman mein wali jagah mein hon ge.
Baghaat mein aur chashmon mein.
Woh aamne samne bithe hue sanadas aur astbrq ka libas pehne hon ge.
Un ke saath yehi mamla hoga aur hum bari bari aankhon wali hooron ka un se biyah karden ge.
Woh wahan bare itminaan se har qasam ke mewe mngoate hon ge.
Jo maut un ko pehli chuki thi, us ke laoa wahan woh kisi aur maut ka mza nahin chakkhein ge, aur Allah unhein dozakh ke azab se mehfooz rkhe ga.
Yeh sab tumhare Parwardigar ki taraf se fazal hoga. (insan ke liye) zabardast kamiyabi yehi hai.
Garz (ae payghumbar) hum ne us (quran) ko tumhari zubaan mein aasan banadiya hai taake log naseehat hasil karen
Ab tum bhi intezar karo, yeh log bhi intezar kar rahe hain.
Haa Meem
Yeh kitab Allah ki taraf se utari jarhi hai jo bara sahib iqtedar, bara sahib hikmat hai.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke aasmanon aur zameen mein maanne walon ke liye bohat si nishaniyan hain.
Aur khud tumhari pedaeesh mein, aur un jaanwaron mein jo us ne (zameen mein) pehla rkhe hain, un logon ke liye bari nishaniyan hain jo yaqeen karen.

Neiz raat aur din ke aane jane mein aur Allah ne aasman se rizq ka jo zria utara, phir us se zameen ko us ke murda hojane ke baad naee zindagi di, us mein aur hawaon ki gardish mein un logon ke liye bari nishaniyan hain jo aqal se kaam len.
Yeh Allah ki aayaten hain jo hum tumhein theek theek parh kar suna rahe hain. Ab Allah aur us ki aayaton ke baad kaun si baat hai jis par yeh log iman layein ge ?
Bura ho us jhoote gunehgar ka.

Jo Allah ki aayaten sunta hai jabke woh use parh kar sunayi jarhi hoti hain, phir bhi woh takabbur ke aalam mein us tarah (kufr par) ura rehta hai jaise us ne woh aayaten suni hi nahin. Lihaza aise shaks ko dardnaak azab ki khushkhabri suna do .
Aur jab hamari aayaton mein se koi aayat aise shaks ke ilm mein aati hai to woh us ka mazaq banata hai, aise logon ko woh azab hoga jo zaleel kar ke rakaha de ga.

Un ke aage jahannam hai aur jo kuchh unhon ne kamaya hai na woh un ke kuchh kaam aaye ga aur na woh kaam aayein ge jin ko unhon ne Allah ke bajaye apna rkhoala bana rakhha hai. Aur un ke hisse mein ek zabardast azab aaye ga.
Yeh (quran) sarapa hidayat hai aur jin logon ne apne Parwardigar ki aayaton ka inkar kiya hai, un ke liye bula ka dardnaak azab hai.
Allah woh hai jis ne samandar ko tumhare kaam mein laga diya hai, taake us ke hukum se us mein kashtiyan chalen, aur taake tum us ka fazal talash karo. Aur taake tum shukar ada karo.
Aur aasmanon aur zameen mein jo kuchh hai us sab ko us ne apni taraf se tumhare kaam mein laga rakhha hai. Yaqeenan us mein un logon ke liye bari nishaniyan hain jo gaur o fikr se kaam len.
(ae payghumbar) jo log iman le aaye hain un se kaho ke jo log Allah ke dino ka andesha nahin rakhte, un se darguzar karen taake Allah logon ko un kaamon ka badla de jo woh kiya karte the.
Jo shaks bhi nek kaam karta hai woh apne hi faiyde ke liye karta hai aur jo bura kaam karta hai woh apna hi nuksan karta hai, phir tum sab ko apne Parwardigar hi ke paas wapas laya jaye ga.
Aur hum ne bano israel ko kitab aur hukumat aur nabuwat ata ki thi, aur unhein pakeeza cheezon ka rizq diya tha, aur unhein duniya jahaan ke logon par foqiyat bakshi thi.

Aur unhein khle khle ehkaam diye the, us ke baad un mein jo ikhtilaf paida hua woh un ke paas ilm aajane ke baad hi hua, sirf us liye ke un ko ek dusre se zidd hogaee thi. Yaqeenan tumhara Parwardigar un ke darmiyan qayamat ke din un baaton ka faisla karde ga jin mein woh ikhtilaf kiya karte the.
Phir (ae payghumbar) hum ne tumhein deen ki ek khaas shariyat par rakhha hai, lihaza tum usi ki pairwi karo, aur un logon ki khwahishat ke peechhe na chalna jo haqeeqat ka ilm nahin rakhte.
Woh Allah ke muqable mein tumhare zara bhi kaam nahin sakte. Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke zalim log ek dusre ke dost hain, aur Allah muttaqi logon ka dost hai.
Yeh (quran) tamam logon ke liye baseeraton ka majmooa hai, aur jo log yaqeen karen un ke liye manzil tak pahunchane ka zria aur sarapa rehmat hai.

Jin logon ne bure bure kaamon ka irteqab kya hai, kya woh yeh samjhe hue hain ke unhein hum un logon ke barabar karden ge jo iman laye hain aur jinhon ne nek amal kiye hain jis ke natije mein un ka jeena aur marna ek hi jaisa hojaye ? Kitni buri baat hai jo yeh tai kiye hue hain.
Allah ne sare aasmanon aur zameen ko barhaqq maqsad ke liye paida kiya hai, aur us liye kiya hai ke har shaks ko us ke kiye hue kaamon ka badla diya jaye, aur dete waqt un par koi zulm na kiya jaye.

Phir kya tum ne use bhi dekha jis ne apna khuda apni nafsani khwahish ko bana liya hai, aur ilm ke bawajood Allah ne use gumrahi mein daal diya, aur us ke kaan aur dil par mehar laga di, aur us ki aankh par purda daal diya. Ab Allah ke baad kaun hai jo use raaste par laye ? Kya phir bhi tum log sabaq nahin lete ?

Aur yeh log kehte hain ke : jo kuchh zindagi hai bas yehi hamari dunyawi zindagi hai, (usi mein) hum marte aur jeete hain aur humein koi aur nahin, zamana hi halaak kardyta hai. Halaanke us baat ka unhein kuchh bhi ilm nahin hai, bas whmi andaze lagate hain.
Aur jab hamari aayaten poori wazahat ke saath un ko parh kar sunayi jati hain to yeh kehne ke siwa un ki koi daleel nahin hoti ke : agar tum sache ho to humare baap dadon ko (zinda kar ke) le aao.
Keh do ke Allah hi tumhein zindagi deta hai, phir woh tumhein maut de ga phir tum sab ko qayamat ke din jama kare ga, jis mein kisi qasam ka koi shakk nahin hai, lekin aksar log samajhte nahin hain.
Aur aasmanon aur zameen ki sultanat Allah hi ki hai, aur jis din qayamat aakhri hogi, us din jo log baatil par hain, woh sakht nuksan athaiin ge.

Aur tum har giroh ko dekho ge ke woh ghutno ke bal gira hua hai. Har giroh ko us ke aemaal name ki taraf bulaya jaye ga, (aur kaha jaye ga ke) aaj tumhein un aemaal ka badla diya jaye ga jo tum kiya karte the.
Yeh hamara (lkhoaia hua) daftar hai jo tumhare bare mein theek theek bol raha hai. Tum jo kuchh karte the, hum us sab ko lkhoa liya karte the.
Chunanche jo log iman laye hain aur unhon ne nek amal kiye hain un ko to un ka Parwardigar apni rehmat mein dakhil kare ga. Yehi khuli hui kamiyabi hai.
Rahe woh log jinhon ne kufr apna liya tha, (un se kaha jaye ga ke) bhala kya tumhare samne meri aayaten nahin parhi jati thin ? Phir bhi tum ne takabbur se kaam liya, aur mujrim bane rahe.

Aur jab tum se kaha jata tha ke Allah ka wada sacha hai, aur qayamat woh haqeeqat hai jis mein koi bhi shakk nahin hai, to tum yeh kehte the ke : hum nahin jante ke qayamat kya hoti hai ? Us ke bare mein hum jo kuchh khayal karte hain, bas ek gumaan sa hota hai, aur humein yaqeen bilkul nahin hai.
Aur (us mauqa par) unhon ne jo aemaal kiye the, un ki buraiyan kahala kar un ke samne aajayen gi, aur jis cheez ka woh mazaq urate the, wahi un ko aaghire gi,

Aur un se kaha jaye ga ke : aaj hum tumhein usi tarah bhala den ge jaise tum ne yeh baat bhala daali thi ke tumhein apne us din ka saamna karna hoga aur tumhara thikana aag hai, aur tumhein kisi qasam ke madadgar muyassar nahin aayein ge.

Yeh sab us liye ke tum ne Allah ki aayaton ko mazaq banaya tha aur dunyawi zindagi ne tumhein dhoke mein daal diya tha. Chunanche aaj aise logon ko na wahan se nikala jaye ga, aur na un se maafi maangne ko kaha jaye ga.
Garz tareef tamam tar Allah ki hai jo sare aasmanon ka bhi maalik hai, zameen ka bhi maalik, aur tamam jahano ka bhi maalik.
Aur tamam tar baraee usi ko hasil hai, aasmanon mein bhi aur zameen mein bhi, aur wahi hai jis ka iqtedar bhi kamil hai, jis ki hikmat bhi kamil.
Haa Meem
Yeh kitab Allah ki taraf se utari jarhi hai jo bara sahib iqtedar, bara sahib hikmat hai.

Hum ne aasmanon aur zameen ko aur un ke darmiyan ki cheezon ko kisi barhaqq maqsad ke baghair aur kisi mutayin miyad ke baghair paida nahin kardiya. Aur jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai woh us cheez se moonh more hue hain jis se unhein khabardar kiya gaya hai.

Tum un se kaho ke : kya tum ne un cheezon par kabhi gaur kya hai jin ko tum Allah ke siwa pukarte ho ? Mujhe dkha to sahi ke unhon ne zameen ki kaunsi cheez paida ki hai ? Ya aasmanon (ki takhleeq) mein un ka koi hissa hai ? Mere paas koi aisi kitab lao jo us quran se pehle ki ho, ya phir koi roait jis ki bunyaad ilm par ho. Agar tum waqayi sache ho.
Us shaks se bara gumraah kaun hoga jo Allah ko chhor kar un (mann gharat diotan) ko pukarega jo qayamat ke din tak us ki pukar ka jawab nahin de sakte, aur jin ko un ki pukar ki khabar tak nahin hai.
Aur jab logon ko mahasahr mein jama kiya jaye ga to woh un ke dushman bann jayen ge aur un ki ibadat hi se munkir hon ge.

Aur jab un ke samne hamari aayaten apni poori wazahat ke saath parh kar sunayi jati hain, to yeh kafir log haqq baat ke un tak pahunch jane ke baad bhi us ke bare mein yun keh dete hain ke yeh to khla hua jadoo hai.

Kya un ka kehna yeh hai ke use payghumbar ne apni taraf se gahara liya hai ? Keh do ke : agar mein ne use apni taraf se gahara liya hai to tum mujhe Allah ki pakar se zara bhi nahin bacha sako ge. Jo baatein tum banate ho woh unhein khoob jaanta hai. Mere aur tumhare darmiyan gawah banne ke liye woh kafi hai aur wahi hai jo bohat bakhshne wala bara meharban hai.

Kaho ke : mein payghumbaron mein koi anokha payghumbar nahin hon, mujhe maloom nahin hai ke mere saath kya kya jaye ga aur na yeh maloom hai ke tumhare saath kya hoga ? Mein kisi aur cheez ki nahin, sirf us wahee ki pairwi karta hon jo mujhe bheji jati hai. Aur mein to sirf ek wazeh andaz se khabardar karne wala hon.

Kaho ke : zara mujhe yeh batao ke agar yeh (quran) Allah ki taraf se ho, aur tum ne us ka inkar kardiya, aur bano israel mein se ek gawah ne us jaisi baat ke haqq mein gawahi bhi de di, aur us par iman bhi le aaya aur tum apne ghamand mein mubtila rahe (to yeh kitne zulm ki baat hai ?) yaqeen jaano ke Allah aise logon ko hidayat tak nahin pahunchata jo zalim hon.

Aur jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai, woh iman lane walon ke bare mein yun kehte hain ke : agar yeh (iman lana) koi achhi baat hoti to yeh log us bare mein hum se sabaqat na le sakte. Aur jab un kafiron ne us se khud hidayat hasil nahin ki to woh to yehi kahin ge ke yeh wahi purane zamane ka jhoot hai.

Aur us se pehle musa ki kitab rehnuma aur rehmat bann kar chuki hai, aur yeh (quran) woh kitab hai jo arabi zubaan mein hote hue us ko sacha btarhi hai taake un zalimon ko khabardar kare, aur nek kaam karne walon ke liye khushkhabri bann jaye.
Yaqeenan jin logon ne yeh keh diya hai ke : hamara Parwardigar Allah hai, phir woh us par saabit qadam rahe to un par na koi khof taari hoga aur na woh ghumgeen hon ge.
Woh jannat wale log hain jo hamesha us mein rahen ge, yeh un aemaal ka badla hoga jo woh kiya karte the.

Aur hum ne insan ko apne walidain se achha bartao karne ka hukum diya hai. Us ki man ne bari mushakkat se use (pait mein) athaie rakhha, aur bari mushakkat se us ko jana, aur us ko athaie rakhne aur us ke doodh churane ki muddat tees mahine hoti hai yahan tak ke jab woh apni poori tawanaee ko pahunch gaya, aur chalees saal ki umar tak pahuncha to woh kehta hai ke yaar rubb ! Mujhe tofiq dijiye ke mein aap ki us niyamat ka shukar ada karoon jo aap ne mujhe aur mere man baap ko ata farmaee, aur aise nek amal karoon jin se aap razi hojayen, aur mere liye meri aulad ko bhi salahiyat de dijiye, mein aap ke huzoor toubah karta hon aur mein frmanbrdaron mein shamil hon.

Yeh woh log hain jin se hum un ke behtareen aemaal qabool karen ge, aur un ki khataon se darguzar karen ge (jis ke natije mein) woh jannat walon mein shamil hon ge, us sache wade ki badaulat jo un se kiya jata tha.

Aur ek woh shaks hai jis ne apne walidain se kaha hai ke : tuff hai tum par. Kiya tum mujh se yeh wada karte ho ke mujhe zinda kar ke qabar se nikala jaye ga, halaanke mujh se pehle bohat si nasalein guzar chuki hain. Aur walidain Allah se faryad karte hain. (aur bete se kehte hain ke) afsos hai tujh par. Iman le aa. Yaqeen jaan ke Allah ka wada sacha hai. To woh kehta hai ke : un baaton ki us ke siwa koi haqeeqat nahin hai ke yeh mehaz afsane hain jo pichle logon se naqal hote chale aarahe hain.
Yeh woh log hain jin ke bare mein jinnat aur insano ke un girohon samet jo un se pehle guzre hain, (azab ki) baat tai hochuki hai. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh sab bara nuksan athane wale hain.
Aur har ek (giroh) ke apne aemaal ki wajah se mukhtalif darje hain, aur us liye hain taake Allah un ko un ke aemaal ka poora poora badla de. Aur un par koi zulm nahin hoga.

Aur us din ko yaad karo jab un kafiron ko aag ke samne pesh kiya jaye ga (aur kaha jaye ga ke) tum ne apne hisse ki achhi cheezen apni dunyawi zindagi mein khatam kar dalen aur un se khoob mza le liya, lihaza aaj tumhein badle mein zillat ki saza mile gi, kyunke tum zameen mein na-haqq takabbur kiya karte the, aur kyunke tum nafarmani ke aadi the.

Aur qaum aad ke bhai (hazrat hood (alh alh-e-salam)) ka tzkra karo, jab unhon ne apni qaum ko kham daar telon ki sar-zameen mein khabardar kiya tha. Aur aise khabardar karne wale un se pehle guzar chuke hain, aur un ke baad bhi, ke : Allah ke siwa kisi ki ibadat na karo, mujhe tum par ek zabardast din ke azab ka andesha hai.
Unhon ne kaha : kya tum humare paas us liye aaye ho ke humare khudaon se humein bargashta karo ? Achha agar tum sache ho to le aao hum par woh (azab) jis ki dhamki de rahe ho.

Unhon ne farmaya : theek theek ilm to Allah ke paas hai (ke woh azab kab aaye ga ?) mujhe jo paygham de kar bheja gaya hai mein to tumhein wahi paygham pahuncha raha hon, albatta mein yeh zaroor dekh raha hon ke tum aise log ho jo nadaani ki baatein kar rahe ho.

Phir hua yeh ke jab unhon ne us (azab) ko ek badal ki shakal mein aata dekha jo un ki waadiyon ka rukh kar raha tha to unhon ne kaha ke : yeh badal hai jo hum par baarish barsaye ga. Nahin ! Bulke yeh woh cheez hai jis ki tum ne jaldi mchaii thi. Ek aandhi jis mein dardnaak azab hai.
Jo apne Parwardigar ke hukum se har cheez ko tehas nehas kar dale gi, garz un ki halat yeh hogaee ke un ke gharon ke siwa kuchh nazar nahin aata tha. Aise mujrim logon ko hum aisi hi saza dete hain.

Aur (ae arab ke logo) hum ne un logon ko un baaton ki taqat di thi jin ki taqat tumhein nahin di, aur hum ne un ko kaan, aankhein aur dil sab kuchh de rkhe the, lekin na un ke kaan aur un ki aankhein un ke kuchh kaam aayein aur na un ke dil, kyunke Allah ki aayaton ka inkar karte the, aur jis cheez ka woh mazaq uraya karte the usi ne unhein aaghira.
Aur hum ne aur bastiyon ko bhi halaak kiya hai jo tumhare ird-gird waqe thin, jabke hum tarah tarah ki nishaniyan (un ke) samne lachke the, taake woh baaz aajayen.

Phir unhon ne Allah ka taqarrub hasil karne ke liye jin cheezon ko Allah ke siwa mabood bana rakhha tha, unhon ne un ki kyun madad na karli ? Us ke bajaye woh sab un ke liye benshan hogaye. Yeh to un ka sarasar jhoot tha, aur bohatan tha jo unhon ne tarash rakhha tha.

Aur (ae payghumbar) yaad karo jab hum ne jinnat mein se ek giroh ko tumhari taraf mutawajja kiya ke woh quran sunen. Chunanche jab woh wahan pahunche to unhon ne (ek dusre se) kaha ke : khamosh hojao, phir jab woh parha jachka to woh apni qaum ke paas unhein khabardar karte hue wapas pahunche.

Unhon ne kaha : ae hamari qaum ke logo ! Yaqeen jaano hum ne ek aisi kitab suni hai jo musa (alh alh-e-salam) ke baad nazil ki gayi hai, apne se pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq karti hai, haqq baat aur seedhe raaste ki taraf rehnumayi karti hai.
Ae hamari qaum ke logo ! Allah ke daai ki baat maan lo, aur us par iman le aao, Allah tumhare gunahon ko maaf karde ga, aur tumhein ek dardnaak azab se panaah de de ga.

Aur jo koi Allah ke daai ki baat na maane to woh saari zameen mein kahin bhi jakr Allah ko aajiz nahin krskta, aur Allah ke siwa us ko kisi qasam ke rkhoale bhi nahin milen ge. Aise log khuli gumrahi mein mubtila hain.

Kya un ko yeh sujhayi nahin diya ke woh Allah jis ne sare aasmanon aur zameen ko paida kya aur un ko paida karne se us ko zara bhi tahakan nahin hui, woh yaqeenan us baat par poori tarah qadir hai ke mardon ko zinda karde ? Aur kyun na ho ? Woh be-shak har cheez ki poori qudrat rakhne wala hai.

Aur jis din kafiron ko aag ke samne pesh kya jaye ga, us din (un se pochha jaye ga) ke kya yeh (dozakh) sach nahin hai ? Woh kahin ge ke : humare rubb ki qasam ! Yeh waqayi sach hai. Allah irshad farmaye ga ke : phir chkho mza azab ka, us kufr ke badle mein jo tum ne ikhtiyar kar rakhha tha.

Garz (ae payghumbar) tum usi tarah sabar kiye jao jaise aoloalzm payghumbaron ne sabar kiya hai, aur un ke maamle mein jaldi na karo. Jis din yeh log woh cheez dekh len ge jis se unhein daraya jaraha hai us din (unhein) yun mehsoos hoga jaise woh (duniya mein) din ki ek ghri se ziyada nahin rahe. Yeh hai woh paygham jo pahuncha diya gaya hai. Ab barbaad to wahi log hon ge jo nafarman hain.
Jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyar karliya hai aur dusron ko Allah ke raaste se roka hai, Allah ne un ke aemaal akarat krdie hain.

Aur jo log iman le aaye hain aur unhon ne nek amal kiye hain, aur har us baat ko dil se maana hai jo Muhammad (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) par nazil ki gayi hai. Aur wahi haqq hai jo un ke Parwardigar ki taraf se aaya hai. Allah ne un ki buraiyon ko maaf kardiya hai aur un ki halat sanwaar di hai.

Yeh us liye ke jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai woh baatil ke peechhe chale hain, aur jo log iman laye hain woh us haqq ke peechhe chale hain jo un ke Parwardigar ki taraf se aaya hai, usi tarah Allah logon ko btarha hai ke un ke halaat kiya kiya hain.

Aur jab un logon se tumhara muqable ho jinhon ne kufr ikhtiyar kar rakhha hai, to gardanein maaro, yahan tak ke jab tum un ki taqat kuchal chuke ho, to mazbooti se giraftar karlo, phir chahaye ehsan kar ke chhor do , ya fdia le kar yahan tak ke jung apne hathyaar phink kar khatam hojaye. Tumhein to yehi hukum hai aur agar Allah chahta to khud un se intiqam le leta, lekin (tumhein yeh hukum us liye diya hai) taake tumhara ek dusre ke zariye imtehan le. Aur jo log Allah ke raaste mein qatal hue, Allah un ke aemaal ko hargiz akarat nahin kare ga.
Woh unhein manzil tak pahuncha de ga, aur un ki halat sanwaar de ga.
Aur unhein jannat mein dakhil kare ga jis ki unhein khoob pehchan kradi hogi.
Ae iman walo ! Agar tum Allah (ke deen) ki madad karo ge to woh tumhari madad kare ga, aur tumhare qadam jamaa de ga.
Aur jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai, un ke liye tabahi hai, aur Allah ne un ke aemaal akarat krdie hain.
Yeh us liye ke unhon ne us baat ko pasand kiya jo Allah ne nazil ki thi, chunanche Allah ne un ke aemaal zaya krdie.

Bhala kya un logon ne zameen mein chal phir kar nahin dekha ke un logon ka anjaam kaisa hua jo un se pehle guzre hain ? Allah ne un par tabahi daali, aur kafiron ke liye usi jaise anjaam muqaddar hain.
Yeh us liye ke Allah un logon ka rkhoala hai jo iman layein aur kafiron ka koi rkhoala nahin hai.

Yaqeen rakho ke jo log iman laye hain aur unhon ne nek amal kiye hain, Allah un ko aise baghaat mein dakhil kare ga jin ke niche nehrein behti hon gi. Aur jinhon ne kufr apna liya hai woh (yahan to) maze ura rahe hain, aur usi tarah kha rahe hain jaise chopaye kahate hain, aur jahannam un ka aakhri thikana hai.
Aur kitni bastiyan hain jo taqat mein tumhari us basti se ziyada mazboot thin jis ne (ae payghumbar) tumhein nikala hai. Un sab ko hum ne halaak kardiya, aur un ka koi madadgar na hua.

Ab batao ke jo log apne Parwardigar ki taraf se ek roshan raaste par hon, kya woh un jaise sakte hain jin ki bad-kaari hi un ke liye khushnuma bnadi gayi ho, aur woh apni nafsani khwahishat ke peechhe chalte hon ?

Muttaqi logon se jis jannat ka wada kya gaya hai, us ka haal yeh hai ke us mein aise pani ki nehrein hain jo kharab hone wala nahin, aise doodh ki nehrein hain jis ka zaiqa nahin badle ga, aisi sharab ki nehrein hain jo peene walon ke liye sarapa lazzat hogi, aur aise shehad ki nehrein hain jo nithra hua hoga, aur un jannatiyon ke liye wahan har qasam ke pahala hon ge, aur un ke Parwardigar ki taraf se magfirat ! Kya yeh log un jaise sakte hain jo hamesha dozakh mein rahen ge, aur unhein garum pani pilaya jaye ga, chunanche woh un ki anthon ko tukre tukre karde ga ?

Aur (ae payghumbar) un mein se kuchh log woh hain jo tumhari baatein kaano se to sunte hain, lekin jab tumhare paas se nikal kar jate hain to jinhen ilm ata hua hai un se puchte hain ke : abhi abhi aap (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) ne kya kaha tha ? Yeh woh log hain jin ke dilon par Allah ne mehar laga di hai, aur jo apni nafsani khwahishat ke peechhe lag gaye hain.
Aur jin logon ne hidayat ka raasta ikhtiyar kiya hai Allah ne unhein hidayat mein aur taraqqi di hai, aur unhein un ke hisse ka taqwa ata farmaya hai.

Ab kya yeh (kafir) log qayamat hi ka intezar kar rahe hain ke woh yakayak un par aan pare ? (agar aisa hai) to us ki alamatein to chuki hain. Phir jab woh hi jaye gi to us waqt un ke liye naseehat maanne ka mauqa kahan se aaye ga ?

Lihaza (ae payghumbar) yaqeen jaano ke Allah ke siwa koi ibadat ke layaq nahin hai, aur apne kasoor par bhi bakhsish ki dua maangte raho, aur musalman mardon aur aurton ki bakhsish ki bhi, aur Allah tum sab ki naqal o harakat aur tumhari qayam gaah ko khoob jaanta hai.

Aur jo log iman laye hain, woh kehte hain ke : kya achha ho ke koi (naee) surat nazil hojaye ? Phir jab koi jachi tuli surat nazil hojaye, aur us mein laraee ka zikr ho to jin logon ke dilon mein rog hai, tum unhein dekho ge ke woh tumhari taraf us tarah nazrein athaie hue hain jaise kisi par maut ki gashi taari ho. Bari kharabi hai aise logon ki.
Yeh farmanbardari ka izhar aur achhi achhi baatein karte hain, lekin jab (jihad ka) hukum pakka hojaye us waqt agar yeh Allah ke saath sache niklen to un ke haqq mein achha ho.
Phir agar tum ne (jihad se) moonh mora to tum se kya tawaqqu rkhi jaye ? Yehi ke tum zameen mein fasaad machao, aur apne khoni rishte kaat dalo.
Yeh woh log hain jin ko Allah ne apni rehmat se door kardiya hai, chunanche unhein behra banadiya hai aur un ki aankhein andhi kardi hain.
Bhala kya yeh log quran par gaur nahin karte, ya dilon par woh tale pare hue hain jo dilon par para karte hain ?

Haqeeqat yeh hai ke jo log haqq baat se pith phir kar murr gaye hain, baojodika hidayat un ke samne khoob wazeh hochuki thi, unhein shetan ne patti prhaii hai aur unhein door daraz ki umeeden dlaii hain.

Yeh sab us liye hua ke jo log Allah ki nazil ki hui baaton ko pasand karte hain, un (munafiqon) ne un se yeh kaha hai ke : baaz maamlaat mein hum tumhari baat manen ge. Aur Allah un ki khfia baaton ko khoob jaanta hai.
Phir us waqt un ka kya haal bane ga jab farishte un ki rooh us tarah qabz karen ge ke un ke chehron par aur peethon par maarte jate hon ge ?
Yeh sab us liye ke yeh us tareeqe par chale jis ne Allah ko naraaz kiya, aur us ki raza mandi hasil karne ko khud unhon ne pasand kiya, us liye Allah ne un ke aemaal akarat krdie.
Jin logon ke dilon mein (nifaq ka) rog hai, kya woh yeh samajhte hain ke un ke chhpe hue keeno ko Allah kabhi zaahir nahin kare ga ?

Aur (musalmano) agar hum chahein to tumhein yeh log us tarah dkha den ke tum un ki alamat se unhein pehchan jao, aur (ab bhi) tum unhein baat karne ke dahapa se zaroor pehchan hi jao ge, aur Allah tum sab ke aemaal ko khoob jaanta hai.
Aur hum zaroor tumhein aazmaish mein dalen ge, taake hum yeh dekh len ke tum mein se kaun hain jo mujahid aur saabit qadam rehne wale hain, aur taake tumhare halaat ki jaanch partal karlen.

Yaqeen rakho ke jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai, aur dusron ko Allah ke raaste se roka hai, aur payghumbar se dushmani thani hai baojodika un ke samne hidayat wazeh ho kar aagaee thi, woh Allah ko hargiz koi nuksan nahin pahuncha sakte, aur anqareeb Allah un ka sara kiya dhara ghaarat karde ga.
Ae iman walo ! Allah ki itaat karo, aur Rasool ki itaat karo, aur apne aemaal ko barbaad na karo.
Jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai aur dusron ko Allah ke raaste se roka hai, phir kufr hi ki halat mein mrgie hain, Allah kabhi un ko nahin bakshe ga.
Lihaza (ae musalmano) tum kamzor parr kar sulah ki dawat na do . Tum hi sarabalnd raho ge, Allah tumhare saath hai, aur woh tumhare aemaal ko hargiz barbaad nahin kare ga.
Yeh dunyawi zindagi to bas khil tamasha hai, aur agar tum iman lao aur taqwa ikhtiyar karo to Allah tumhare ajar tumhein de ga, aur tumhare maal tum se nahin maange ga.
Agar woh tum se tumhare maal talab kare, aur tum se sab kuchh sameit le to tum bukhl se kaam lo ge, aur woh tumhare dil ki narazion ko zaahir karde ga.

Dekho ! Tum aise ho ke tumhein Allah ke raaste mein kharch karne ke liye bulaya jata hai to tum mein se kuchh log hain jo bukhl se kaam lete hain, aur jo shaks bhi bukhl karta hai woh khud apne aap hi se bukhl karta hai. Aur Allah bey-niaz hai, aur tum ho jo mohtaj ho. Aur agar tum moonh moro ge to woh tumhari jagah dusri qaum paida karde ga, phir woh tum jaise nahin hon ge.
Ae payghumbar ! Yaqeen jaano hum ne tumhein khuli hui fatah ata kardi hai.
Taake Allah tumhari agli pichli tamam kotahiyon ko maaf karde, aur taake apni niyamat tum par mukammal karde, aur tumhein seedhe raaste par le chale,
Aur (taake) Allah tumhari aisi madad kare jo sab par ghalib aajaye.

Wahi hai jis ne iman walon ke dilon mein sakinat utaar di, taake un ke iman mein mazeed iman ka azafa ho. Aur aasmanon aur zameen ke tamam lashkar Allah hi ke hain, aur Allah ilm ka bhi maalik hai, hikmat ka bhi maalik.

Taake woh momin mardon aur aurton ko aise baghaat mein dakhil kare jin ke niche nehrein behti hain, jahan woh hamesha base rahen ge, aur un ki buraiyon ko un se door karde, aur Allah ke nazdeek yeh bari zabardast kamiyabi hai.

Aur taake un munafiq mardon aur munafiq aurton aur mushrik mardon aur mushrik aurton ko azab de jo Allah ke saath bad-gumaniyan rakhte hain, buraee ka phira unhi par para hua hai, aur Allah un se naraaz hai us ne un ko apni rehmat se door kardiya hai, aur un ke liye jahannam tayyar kar rkhi hai, aur woh bohat hi bura thikana hai.
Aur aasmanon aur zameen ke tamam lashkar Allah hi ke hain, aur Allah iqtedar ka bhi maalik hai, hikmat ka bhi maalik.
(ae payghumbar) hum ne tumhein gawahi dene wala, khushkhabri dene wala aur khabardar karne wala bana kar bheja hai.
Taake (ae logo) tum Allah aur us ke Rasool par iman lao, aur us ki madad karo, aur us ki tazeem karo, aur subah o shaam Allah ki tasbeeh kar rahe hain.

(ae payghumbar !) jo log aap se bayt kar rahe hain dar-haqeeqat woh Allah se bayt krrhe hain . Allah ka haath un ke haathon par hai, us ke baad jo koi ahad tore ga, us ke ahad ko toryne ka wabal usi par pare ga, aur jo koi us ahad ko poora kare ga, jo us ne Allah se kiya hai to Allah us ko zabardast sawab ata kare ga.

Woh dehaati jo (hdibia ke safar mein) peechhe reh gaye the, ab woh tum se zaroor yeh kahin ge ke : humare maal o daulat aur humare ehle o ayal ne humein mashgul karliya tha, us liye humare liye magfirat ki dua krdijie. Woh apni zubaano se woh baatein kehte hain jo un ke dilon mein nahin hotin. (un se) kaho ke : achha to agar Allah tumhein koi nuksan pahunchana chahaye ya faida pahunchana chahaye to kaun hai jo Allah ke samne tumhare maamle mein kuchh bhi karne ki taqat rakhta ho ? Bulke jo kuchh tum karte ho, Allah us se poori tarah bakhabar hai.

Haqeeqat to yeh hai ke tum ne yeh samjha tha ke Rasool (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) aur dusre musalman kabhi apne ghar walon ke paas lot kar nahin aayein ge, aur yehi baat tumhare dilon ko achhi maloom hoti thi, aur tum ne bure bure gumaan kiye the, aur tum aise log bann gaye the jinhen barbaad hona tha.
Aur jo shaks Allah aur us ke Rasool par iman na laye to (woh yaad rkhe ke) hum ne kafiron ke liye bharakti hui aag tayyar kar rkhi hai.
Aur aasmanon aur zameen ki sultanat tamam tar Allah hi ki hai, woh jis ko chahaye baksh de, aur jis ko chahaye azab de, aur Allah bohat bakhshne wala, bohat meharban hai.

(musalmano) jab tum ghanimat ke maal lene ke liye chalo ge to yeh (hdibia ke safar se) peechhe rehne wale tum se kahin ge ke : humein bhi apne saath chalne do . Woh chahein ge ke Allah ki baat ko badal den. Tum keh dena ke : tum hargiz humare saath nahin chalo ge. Allah ne pehle se yun hi farma rakhha hai. Us par woh kahin ge ke : dar-asal aap log hum se hasad rakhte hain. Nahin ! Bulke haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh log khud hi aise hain ke bohat kam baat samajhte hain.

Un peechhe rehne wale dehatiyon se keh dena ke : anqareeb tumhein aise logon ke paas (larne ke liye) bulaya jaye ga jo bare sakht jangjoo hon ge, ke ya to un se larte raho, ya woh itaat qabool karlen. Us waqt agar tum (jihad ke us hukum ki) itaat karo ge to Allah tumhein achha ajar de ga, aur agar tum moonh moro ge jaisa ke tum ne pehle moonh mora tha to Allah tumhein dardnaak azab de ga.

Andhe aadmi par (jihad na karne ka) koi gunaah nahin hai, na langre aadmi par koi gunaah hai, aur na beemar aadmi par gunaah hai. Aur jo shaks bhi Allah aur us ke Rasool ka kehna maane, Allah us ko aisi jannaton mein dakhil kare ga jin ke niche nehrein behti hon gi. Aur jo koi moonh more ga, use dardnaak azab de ga.

Yaqeenan Allah un momino se bara khush hua jab woh darakht ke niche tum se bayt kar rahe the aur un ke dilon mein jo kuchh tha woh bhi Allah ko maloom tha. Us liye us ne un par sakinat utaar di, aur un ko inam mein ek qareebi fatah ata farma di.
Aur ghanimat mein milne wale bohat se maal bhi jo un ke haath aayein ge, aur Allah iqtedar ka bhi maalik hai, hikmat ka bhi maalik.

Allah ne tum se bohat se maal ghanimat ka wada kar rakhha hai jo tum hasil karo ge, ab fori tor par us ne tumhein yeh fatah de di hai, aur logon ke haathon ko tum se rok diya, taake yeh momino ke liye ek nishani bann jaye, aur tumhein Allah seedhe raaste par daal de.
Aur ek fatah aur bhi hai jo abhi tumhare qaabu mein nahin aayi, lekin Allah ne us ko apne ahate mein le rakhha hai aur Allah har cheez par poori qudrat tarah qadir hai.
Aur yeh kafir log tum se larte to yaqeenan pith phir kar bhaag jate, phir unhein koi yaar o madadgar bhi na milta.
Jaisa ke Allah ka yehi dastoor hai jo pehle se chala aata hai aur tum Allah ke dastoor mein hargiz tabdili nahin pao ge.

Aur wahi Allah hai jis ne makkah ki wadi mein un ke haathon ko tum tak pahunchne se aur tumhare haathon ko un tak pahunchne se rok diya, jabke woh tumhein un par qaabu de chuka tha, aur jo kuchh tum kar rahe the Allah use dekh raha tha.

Yehi log to hain jinhon ne kufr ikhtiyar kiya, aur tumhein masjid haram se roka, aur qurbani ke jaanwaron ko jo thehre hue khre the, apni jagah pahunchne se rok diya, aur agar kuchh musalman mard aur musalman aurten (makkah mein) na hotin jin ke bare mein tumhein khabar bhi na hoti ke tum unhein pees dalo ge, aur us ki wajah se bikhbr yaa mein tum ko nuksan pahunch jata (to hum un kafiron se tumhari sulah ke bajaye jung karwa dete, lekin hum ne jung ko us liye roka) taake Allah jis ko chahaye, apni rehmat mein dakhil karde. (albatta) agar woh musalman wahan se hatt jate to hum un (ehle makkah) mein se jo kafir the, unhein dardnaak saza dete.

(chunanche) jab un kafiron ne apne dilon mein us hamiyat ko jagah di jo jahiliyat ki hamiyat thi to Allah ne apni taraf se apne payghumbar aur musalmanon par sakinat nazil farmaee. Aur un ko taqwa ki baat par jamaye rakhha, aur woh usi ke ziyada haqq daar aur us ke ehle the aur Allah har cheez ko khoob janne wala hai.

Haqeeqat yeh hai ke Allah ne apne Rasool ko sacha khuwab dkhaia hai jo waqiye ke bilkul mutabiq hai. Tum log ansha Allah zaroor masjid haram mein us tarah aman mein ke saath dakhil hoge ke tum (mein se kuchh) ne apne siron ko bekhof o khatar mndoaia hoga aur (kuchh ne) baal trashy hon ge. Allah woh baatein jaanta hai jo tumhein maloom nahin hain. Chunanche us ne woh khuwab poora hone se pehle ek qareebi fatah tai kardi hai.
Wahi hai jis ne apne Rasool ko hidayat aur sacha deen de kar bheja hai, taake use har dusre deen par ghalib karde. Aur (us ki) gawahi dene ke liye Allah kafi hai.

Muhammad (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) Allah ke Rasool hain. Aur jo log un ke saath hain, woh kafiron ke muqable mein sakht hain (aur) aapas mein ek dusre ke liye reham dil hain. Tum unhein dekho ge ke kabhi rukoo mein hain, kabhi sajde mein, (garz) Allah ke fazal aur khushnudi ki talash mein lage hue hain. Un ki alamatein sajde ke asar se un ke chehron par numayan hain. Yeh hain un ke woh awsaf jo toraat mein mzkor hain. Aur injeel mein un ki misal yeh hai ke jaise ek khiti ho jis ne apni kopal nikali, phir us ko mazboot kiya, phir woh moti hogaee, phir apne tane par us tarah seedhi khri hogaee ke kashtkar us se khush hote hain. Taake Allah un (ki us taraqqi) se kafiron ka dil jalaye. Yeh log jo iman laye hain aur unhon ne nek amal kiye hain, Allah ne un se magfirat aur zabardast sawab ka wada karliya hai.
Ae iman walo ! Allah aur us ke Rasool ke aage na barha karo. Aur Allah se darte raho. Allah yaqeenan sab kuchh sunta, sab kuchh jaanta hai.
