Ae iman walo ! Apni aawazen nabi ki aawaz se buland mat kiya karo, aur na un se baat karte hue us tarah zoar se bola karo jaise tum ek dusre se zoar se bolte ho, kahin aisa na ho ke tumhare aemaal barbaad hojayen, aur tumhein pata bhi na chale.

Yaqeen jaano jo log Allah ke Rasool (sli Allah alh waala wasalam) ke paas apni aawazen neechi rakhte hain, yeh wahi log hain jin ke dilon ko Allah ne khoob jaanch kar taqwa ke liye muntakhab karliya hai, un ko magfirat bhi hasil hai aur zabardast ajar bhi.
(ae payghumbar) jo log tumhein hujron ke peechhe se aawaz dete hain un mein se aksar ko aqal nahin hai.
Aur agar yeh log us waqt tak sabar karte jab tak tum khud bahar nikal kar un ke paas aajate, to un ke liye behtar hua aur Allah bohat bakhshne wala, bohat meharban hai.

Ae iman walo ! Agar koi fasiq tumhare paas koi khabar le kar aaye, to achhi tarah tehqeeq karliya karo, kahin aisa na ho ke tum nadaani se kuchh logon ko nuksan pahuncha bitho, aur phir apne kiye par pchhta.

Aur yeh baat achhi tarah samajh lo ke tumhare darmiyan Allah ke Rasool maujood hain. Bohat si baatein hain jin mein woh agar tumhari baat maan len to khud tum mushkil mein prja. Lekin Allah ne tumhare dil mein iman ki mohabbat daal di hai, aur use tumhare dilon mein parakashsh banadiya hai, aur tumhare andar kufr ki aur gunahon aur nafarmani ki nafrat btha di hai. Aise hi log hain jo theek theek raaste par chuke hain.
Jo Allah ki taraf se fazal aur niyamat ka nateeja hai, aur Allah ilm ka bhi maalik hai, hikmat ka bhi maalik.

Aur agar musalmanon ke do giroh aapas mein larr paren to un ke darmiyan sulah karao. Phir agar un mein se ek giroh dusre ke saath zyadati kare to us giroh se laro jo zyadati kar raha ho, yahan tak ke woh Allah ke hukum ki taraf lot aaye. Chunanche agar woh lot aaye, to un ke darmiyan insaf ke saath sulah krado, aur (har maamle mein) insaf se kaam liya karo, be-shak Allah insaf karne walon se mohabbat karta hai.
Haqeeqat to yeh hai ke tamam musalman bhai bhai hain, us liye apne do bhaiyon ke darmiyan taaluqaat achhe banao, aur Allah se daro taake tumhare saath rehmat ka mamla kiya jaye.

Ae iman walo ! Na to mard dusre mardon ka mazaq urayen, sakta hai ke woh (jin ka mazaq ura rahe hain) khud un se behtar hon, aur na dusri aurten dusri aurton ka mazaq urayen, sakta hai ke woh (jin ka mazaq ura rahi hain) khud un se behtar hon. Aur tum ek dusre ko tna na diya karo, aur na ek dusre ko bure alaqab se pukaro. Iman lane ke baad gunaah ka naam lgna bohat buri baat hai. Aur jo log un baaton se baaz na aayein to woh zalim log hain.

Ae iman walo ! Bohat se gmanon se bacho, baaz gumaan gunaah hote hain, aur kisi ki tohh mein na lago aur ek dusre ki geebat na karo. Kya tum mein se koi yeh pasand kare ga ke woh apne murde bhai ka gosht kahe ? Us se to khud tum nafrat karte ho, aur Allah se daro, be-shak Allah bara toubah qabool karne wala, bohat meharban hai.

Ae logo ! Haqeeqat yeh hai ke hum ne tum sab ko ek mard aur ek aurat se paida kiya hai, aur tumhein mukhtalif qaumon aur khaandanon mein us liye taqseem kiya hai taake tum ek dusre ki pehchan krsko, dar-haqeeqat Allah ke nazdeek tum mein sab se ziyada izzat wala woh hai jo tum mein sab se ziyada muttaqi ho. Yaqeen rakho ke Allah sab kuchh janne wala, har cheez se bakhabar hai.

Yeh dehaati kehte hain ke : hum iman le aaye hain. Un se kaho ke : tum iman to nahin laye, albatta yeh kaho ke hum ne hathyaar daal diye hain, aur iman abhi tumhare dilon mein dakhil nahin hua. Aur agar tum waqayi Allah aur us ke Rasool ki itaat karo ge to Allah tumhare aemaal (ke sawab) mein zara bhi kami nahin kare ga. Yaqeenan Allah bohat bakhshne wala, bohat meharban hai.

Iman lane wale to woh hain jinhon ne Allah aur us ke Rasool ko dil se maana hai, phir kisi shakk mein nahin pare, aur jinhon ne apne maal o daulat aur apni janon se Allah ke raaste mein jihad kiya hai. Wahi log hain jo sache hain.

(ae payghumbar ! Un dehatiyon se) kaho ke : kya tum Allah ko apne deen ki itlaa de rahe ho ? Halaanke Allah un tamam cheezon ko khoob jaanta hai jo aasmanon mein hain aur jo zameen mein hain, aur Allah har cheez ka poora poora ilm rakhta hai.

Yeh log tum par ehsan rakhte hain ke yeh islam le aaye hain. Un se kaho ke : mujh par apne islam lane ka ehsan na jtla. Bulke agar tum waqayi (apne dawe mein) sache ho to yeh Allah ka tum par ehsan hai ke us ne tumhein iman ki hidayat di.
Waqa yeh hai ke Allah aasmanon aur zameen ki har posheeda baat ko khoob jaanta hai, aur jo kuchh tum karte ho Allah use achhi tarah dekh raha hai.
Qaaf
Bulke unhon ne us baat par heyrat ka izhar kiya hai ke koi (aakhirat se) darane wala khud unhi mein se (kaise) aagaya, chunanche un kafiron ne yeh kaha hai ke : yeh to bari ajeeb baat hai.
Bhala kya hum marr kahapa jayen aur mitti hojayen ge, (us waqt humein phir zinda kya jaye ga ?) yeh wapsi to hamari samajh se door hai.
Waqa to yeh hai ke zameen un ke jin hisson ko (kha kar) ghta deti hai humein un ka poora ilm hai aur humare paas ek kitab hai jo sab kuchh mehfooz rakhti hai.
Dar-asal unhon ne sach ko usi waqt jhutla diya tha jab woh un ke paas aaya tha, chunanche woh mtzad baaton mein pare hue hain.
Bhala kya unhon ne apne upar aasman ko nahin dekha ke hum ne use kaise banaya hai ? Aur hum ne use khobsorti bakshi hai, aur us mein kisi qasam ke rkhne nahin hain.
Aur zameen hai ke hum ne use pehla diya hai aur us mein paharon ke lanagar daal diye hain, aur us mein har tarah ki khushnuma cheezen ugayi hain.
Taake woh Allah se lo lagane wale har bande ke liye baseerat aur naseehat ka samaan ho.
Aur hum ne aasman se barkaton wala pani utara, phir us ke zariye baghaat aur woh anaj ke daane ugaye jin ki ktaii hoti hai.
Aur khajoor ke unche unche darakht jin mein teh bar teh khoshe hote hain.
Taake hum bandon ko rizq ata karen aur (us tarah) hum ne us pani se ek murda pare hue shehar ko zindagi de di, bas usi tarah (insano ka qabron se) nikalna bhi hoga.
Un se pehle nooh ki qaum aur ashab alrs aur samood ke logon ne bhi (us baat ko) jhutlaya tha.
Neiz qaum aad aur qaum Firaun aur loot ke bhaiyon ne bhi.
Aur ashab alaika aur tubba qaum ne bhi. Un sab ne payghumbaron ko jhutlaya tha, us liye mein ne jis azab se daraya tha, woh sach ho kar raha.
Bhala kya hum pehli baat paida karne se tahaka gaye the ? Nahin ! Lekin yeh log az sar no paida karne ke bare mein dhoke mein pare hue hain.
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke hum ne insan ko paida kiya hai, aur us ke dil mein jo khayalat aate hain, un (tak) se hum khoob waqif hain, aur hum us ki sha raga se bhi ziyada us ke qareeb hain.
Us waqt bhi jab (aemaal ko) likhne wale do farishte lakaha rahe hote hain. Ek dayen janib aur dusra bayein janib bitha hota hai.
Insan koi lafz zubaan se nikal nahin pata, magar us par ek nigraan muqarrar hota hai, har waqt (likhne ke liye) tayyar.
Aur maut ki sakhti sach much aane hi wali hai. (ae insan) yeh woh cheez hai jis se to bidakta tha.
Aur surat phonka jane wala hai. Yeh woh din hoga jis se daraya jata tha.
Aur har shaks us tarah aaye ga ke us ke saath ek hankne wala hoga, aur ek gawahi dene wala
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke to us waqiye ki taraf se gaflat mein para hua tha, ab hum ne tujh se woh purda hata diya hai jo tujh par para hua tha. Chunanche aaj teri nigaah khoob tez hogaee hai.
Aur us ka sathi kahe ga ke : yeh hai woh (aemaal nama) jo mere paas tayyar hai.
(hukum diya jaye ga ke) tum dono har us shaks ko jahannam mein daal do jo katara kafir aur haqq ka pakka dushman tha.
Jo dusron ko bhalayi se roakne ka aadi, behd zyadati karne wala aur (haqq baat mein) shakk daalne wala tha.
Jis ne Allah ke saath kisi aur ko mabood bana rakhha tha. Lihaza ab tum dono use sakht azab mein daal do .
Us ka sathi kahe ga ke : ae humare Parwardigar ! Mein ne use gumraah nahin kiya tha, bulke yeh khud hi parle darje ki gumrahi mein para hua tha.
Allah taalaa kahe ga ke : tum mere samne jhagre na karo, aur mein to pehle hi tumhare paas azab ki dhamki bhej chuka tha.
Mere samne woh baat badli nahin sakti aur mein bandon par koi zulm karne wala nahin hon.
Woh waqt (yaad rakho) jab hum jahannam se kahin ge ke : kya to bhar gayi ? Aur woh kahe gi ke : kya kuchh aur bhi hai ?
Aur perhezgaron ke liye jannat itni qareeb kardi jaye gi ke kuchh bhi door nahin rahe gi.
(aur kaha jaye ga ke) yeh hai woh cheez jis ka tum se yeh wada kiya jata tha ke woh har us shaks ke liye hai jo Allah se khoob lo lagaye hue ho, (aur) apni nigrani rakhne wala ho.
Jo khuda Rahman se use dikhe baghair darta ho, aur Allah ki taraf rujoo hone wala dil le kar aaye.
Tum sab us mein salamati ke saath dakhil hojao. Woh din abadi zindagi ka din hoga.
Un (jannatiyon) ko woh sab ko kuchh mile ga jo wahan woh chahein ge, aur humare paas kuchh aur ziyada bhi hai.

Aur un (makkah ke kafiron) se pehle hum kitni hi qaumon ko halaak krchke hain jin ki taqat par giraft un se ziyada sakht thi, chunanche unhon ne sare shehar chhan maare the. Kya un ke liye bhagne ki koi jagah thi ?
Yaqeenan us mein us shaks ke liye bari naseehat ka samaan hai jis ke paas dil ho, ya jo hazir dimaag bann kar kaan dhare.
Aur hum ne sare aasmanon aur zameen ko aur un ke darmiyan ki cheezon ko cheh din mein paida kiya, aur humein zara si thkaot bhi chho kar nahin guzri.
Lihaza (ae payghumbar) jo kuchh yeh log keh rahe hain tum us par sabar karo, aur apne Parwardigar ki hamd ke saath tasbeeh karte raho, suraj nikalne se pehle bhi, aur suraj doobne se pehle bhi.
Aur raat ke hisson mein bhi us ki tasbeeh karo. Aur sajdon ke baad bhi.
Aur zara tawajjuh se suno ! Jis din ek pukarne wala ek qareebi jagah se pukarega.
Jis din log sach much us pukar ki aawaz sunen ge, woh qabron se nikalne ka din hoga.
Yaqeen rakho hum hi hain jo zindagi bhi dete hain aur maut bhi aur aakhir kaar sab ko humare paas hi lotna hai.
Us din jab zameen pahata kar un ko us tarah bahar karde gi ke woh jaldi jaldi nikal rahe hon ge. Us tarah sab ko jama krlina humare liye bohat aasan hai.

Jo kuchh yeh log kehte hain humein khoob maloom hai aur (ae payghumbar) tum un par zabardasti karne wale nahin ho. Lihaza quran ke zariye har us shaks ko naseehat karte raho jo meri waeed se darta ho.
Qasam hai un (hawaon) ki jo gird ura kar bikhair deti hain.
Phir un ki jo (baadalon ka) bojh athati hain.
Phir un ki jo aasani se rawan doan hojati hain.
Phir un ki jo cheezen taqseem karti hain.
Ke jo wada tum se kiya jaraha hai woh yaqeeni tor par sacha hai.
Aur aemaal ka badla yaqeenan mill kar rahe ga.
Qasam hai raaston wale aasman ki.
Ke tum mtzad baaton mein pare hue ho.
Us (aakhirat ki haqeeqat) se wahi moonh morta hai jo haqq se bilkul hi mra hua hai.
Khuda ki maar ho un par jo (aqeede ke maamle mein) atkal pichon baatein banaya karte hain.
Jo gaflat mein aise doobe hain ke sab kuchh bhulaye bithe hain.
Puchte hain ke : jza o saza ka din kab hoga ?
Us din hoga jab unhein aag par tapaya jaye ga.
Ke chkho mza apni shararat ka. Yehi hai woh cheez jis ke bare mein tum yeh mutalaba karte the ke woh jaldi aajaye.
Muttaqi log be-shak baaghon aur chashmon mein us tarah rahen ge.
Ke un ka Parwardigar unhein jo kuchh de ga, use wasool kar rahe hon ge. Woh log us se pehle hi nek amal karne wale the.
Woh raat ke o qata kam sote the.
Aur shri ke auqat mein woh istaghfaar karte the.
Aur un ke maal o daulat mein sailon aur mehroom logon ka (baqada) haqq hota tha.
Aur un ke liye jo yaqeen karne wale hon, zameen mein bohat si nishaniyan hain.
Aur khud tumhare apne wajood mein bhi. Kya phir bhi tumhein dkhaii nahin deta ?
Aur aasman hi mein tumhara rizq bhi hai aur woh cheez bhi jis ka tum se wada kiya jaraha hai.
Lihaza aasman aur zameen ke Parwardigar ki qasam ! Yeh baat yaqeenan aisi hi sachi hai jaise yeh baat ke tum bolte ho.
(ae payghumbar) kya Ibrahim ke muazzaz mehmano ka waqa tumhein pahuncha hai ?
Jab woh Ibrahim ke paas aaye to unhon ne salam kaha. Ibrahim ne bhi salam kaha. (aur dil mein socha ke) yeh kuchh anjan log hain.
Phir chupke se apne ghar walon ke paas gaye aur ek mota sa bachra le aaye.
Aur use un mehmano ke samne rakhha. Kehne lage : kya aap log kahate nahin ?
Us se Ibrahim ne un ki taraf se apne dil mein darr mehsoos kiya. Unhon ne kaha : driie nahin, aur unhein ek larke ki khushkhabri di jo bara aalam hoga.
Us par un ki biwi zoar se bolti hui aayein, aur unhon ne apna chhra pait liya aur kehne lagen (kya) ek baanjh burhiya (bcha jne gi ?)
Mehmano ne kaha : tumhare Parwardigar ne aisa hi farmaya hai. Yaqeen jaano wahi hai jo bari hikmat ka, bare ilm ka maalik hai.
Ibrahim ne kaha : Allah ke bheje hue farishto ! Tum kis mohim par ho ?
Unhon ne kaha : humein kuchh mujrim logon ke paas bheja gaya hai.
Taake hum un par paki mitti ke pathar barsayi.
Jin par hadd se guzre hue logon ke liye tumhare Parwardigar ke paas se khaas nishan bhi laga hoga.
Phir hua yeh ke us basti mein jo koi momin tha us ko hum ne wahan se nikal liya.
Aur us mein ek ghar ke siwa hum ne kisi aur ghar ko momin nahin paya.
Aur hum ne us basti mein un logon ke liye (ibrat ki) ek nishani chhor di jo dardnaak azab se darte hon.
Aur musa (ke waqiye) mein bhi (hum ne aisi hi nishani chhori thi) jab hum ne unhein ek khuli hui daleel ke saath Firaun ke paas bheja tha.
To Firaun ne apni qooat bazu ke bal par moonh mora, aur kaha ke : yeh jadoogar hai ya dioana hai.
Chunanche hum ne use aur us ke lashkar ko pakra aur sab ko samandar mein phink diya, aur woh tha hi malamat ke layaq.
Neiz qaum aad mein (bhi hum ne aisi hi nishani chhori thi) jab hum ne un par ek aisi aandhi bheji jo har behtri se baanjh di.
Woh jis cheez par bhi guzarti, use aisa kar chorti, jaise woh gal kar choora choora hogaee ho.
Aur samood mein bhi (aisi hi nishani thi) jab un se kaha gaya tha ke : thore waqt tak maze ura lo. (phir seedhe na hue to azab aaye ga)
Us par bhi unhon ne apne Parwardigar ka hukum maanne se sarkashi ikhtiyar ki to unhein karak ne pakra aur woh dekhte reh gaye.
Nateeja yeh ke na to un mein yeh sakat rahi ke khre hoskin aur na woh us qabil the ke apna bachao karte.
Aur us se bhi pehle nooh ki qaum ko bhi hum ne pakar mein liya tha. Yaqeen jaano woh bare nafarman log the.
Aur aasman ko hum ne qooat se banaya hai, aur hum yaqeenan wusat paida karne wale hain.
Aur zameen ko hum ne farsh banaya, chunanche hum kiya khoob bichane wale hain.
Aur har cheez ke hum ne jore paida kiye hain, taake tum naseehat hasil karo.
Lihaza doro Allah ki taraf yaqeen jaano, mein us ki taraf se tumhare liye saaf saaf khabardar karne wala (bann kar aaya) hon.
Aur Allah ke saath koi aur mabood na banao. Yaqeen jaano mein us ki taraf se tumhare liye saaf saaf khabardar karne wala (bann kar aaya) hon.
Usi tarah un se pehle jo log the un ke paas bhi koi payghumbar aisa nahin aaya jis ke bare mein unhon ne yeh na kaha ho ke : jadoogar hai, ya dioana hai.
Kya yeh ek dusre ko us baat ki wasiyat karte chale aaye hain ? Nahin, bulke yeh sirkash log hain.
Lihaza (ae payghumbar) tum un se byrukhi ikhtiyar karo, kyunke tum qabil malamat nahin ho.
Aur naseehat karte raho, kyunke naseehat iman lane walon ko faida deti hai.
Aur mein ne jinnat aur insano ko us ke siwa kisi aur kaam ke liye paida nahin kiya ke woh meri ibadat karen.
Mein un se kisi qasam ka rizq nahin chahta, aur na yeh chahta hon ke woh mujhe khilayein.
Allah to khud hi razzak hai, mustehkum qooat wala.
Ab to jin logon ne zulm kiya hai un ki bhi aisi hi bari aaye gi jaise un ke (pichle) saathiyon ki bari aayi thi, us liye woh mujh se jaldi (azab lane) ka mutalaba na karen.
Garz jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai, un ki us din ki wajah se bari kharabi hogi jis ka un se wada kiya jaraha hai.
Qasam hai koh tor ki.
Aur us kitab ki jo ek khle hue
Saheefe mein lkhi hui hai.
Aur qasam hai bayt mmor ki.
Aur buland ki hui chhat ki.
Aur bhare hue samandar ki
Ke tumhare Parwardigar ka azab zaroor waqe hone wala hai.
Koi hain hai jo use rok sake.
Jis din aasman tahara thra kar laraz utahe ga.
Aur pahar haulnaak tareeqe se chal paren ge.
To us din bari kharabi hogi un ki jo haqq ko jhutlate hain.
Jo behoda baaton mein doobe hue khil rahe hain
Us din jab unhein dhakke de de kar jahannam ki aag ki taraf dhkila jaye ga.
(ke) yeh hai woh aag jis ko tum jhutlaya karte the
Bhala kya yeh jadoo hai ya tumhein (ab bhi) kuchh nazar nahin aaraha ?
Dakhil hojao us mein, phir tum sabar karo, ya na karo, tumhare liye barabar hai. Tumhein unhi kaamon ka badla diya jaye ga jo tum kiya karte the
Muttaqi log be-shak baaghon aur nematon mein hon ge.
Un ke Parwardigar ne unhein jis tarah nawaza aur un ke Parwardigar hi ne unhein dozakh ke azab se jis tarah bachaya, us ka lutf atha rahe hon ge.
(un se kaha jaye ga ke) khoob maze se kha piyo, un aemaal ke sile mein jo tum kiya karte the.
Woh ek qataar mein lagi hui unchi nshston par tkia lagaye hue hon ge, aur hum bari bari aankhon wali hooron se un ka biyah karden ge.

Aur jo log iman laye hain aur un ki aulad ne bhi iman mein un ki pairwi ki hai to un ki aulad ko hum unhi ke saath shamil karden ge, aur un ke amal mein se kisi cheez ki kami nahin karen ge. Har insan ki jaan apni kamayi ke badle rehan rkhi hui hai.
Aur hum unhein ek ke baad ek pahala aur gosht, jo bhi un ka dil chahaye ga, diye chale jayen ge.
Wahan woh aise jaam sharab par (dostana) chhina jhapti kar rahe hon ge jis mein na koi behodgi hogi, aur na koi gunaah hoga.
Aur un ke ird-gird no-jawan phir rahe hon ge jo unhi (ki khidmat) ke liye makhsoos hon ge, aise (khoobsurat) jaise chhpa kar rkhe hue moti.
Aur woh ek dusre ki taraf mutawajja ho kar halaat poochen ge.
Kahin ge ke : hum pehle jab apne ghar walon (yani duniya) mein the to dare shme rehte the.
Aakhir Allah ne hum par bara ehsan farmaya, aur humein jhlsane wali hua ke azab se bacha liya.
Hum us se pehle us se duaein maanga karte the. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke wahi hai jo bara mohsin, bohat meharban hai.
Lihaza (ae payghumbar) tum naseehat karte raho, kyunke tum apne Parwardigar ke fazal se na kaahin ho, na majnoon.
Bhala kya yeh log yun kehte hain ke : yeh sahib shayar hain jin ke bare mein hum zamane ki gardish ka intezar kar rahe hain ?
Keh do ke : karlo intezar, mein bhi tumhare saath intezar krrha hon.
Kya un ki aqalein un ko yehi kuchh karne ko kehti hain, ya woh hain hi sirkash log ?
Haan kya woh yeh kehte hain ke : un sahib ne yeh (quran) khud gahara liya hai ? Nahin, bulke yeh (zidd mein) iman nahin larhe.
Agar yeh waqiye sache hain to us jaisa koi kalaam (gahara kar) le aayein.
Kya yeh log baghair kisi ke aap se aap paida hogaye, ya yeh khud (apne) khaliq hain ?
Ya kya aasman aur zameen unhon ne paida kiye hain ? Nahin, bulke asal baat yeh hai ke yeh yaqeen nahin rakhte.
Kya tumhare Parwardigar ke khazane un ke paas hain, ya woh darogha bane hue hain ?
Ya un ke liye koi seerhi hai jis par charh kar yeh (aalam baala ki baatein) sunn lete hain. Agar aisa hai to un mein se jo sunta ho woh koi wazeh saboot to laye.
Kya Allah ke hisse mein to betiyan hain aur bete tumhare hisse mein aaye hain ?
Aur kya tum un se koi ujrat maang rahe ho jis ki wajah se yeh tawaan ke bojh mein dabe jarahe hain ?
Ya un ke paas gaib ka ilm hai jise yeh lakaha lete hon ?
Kya yeh koi makar karna chahte hain ? To dar-haqeeqat jo kafir hain, makar to unhi par pare ga.
Kya Allah ke siwa un ka koi aur khuda hai ? Pak hai Allah us shirk se jo yeh kar rahe hain.
Aur agar yeh aasman ka koi tukra girte hue bhi dekh len to yeh kahin ge ke yeh koi ghra badal hai.
Lihaza (ae payghumbar) tum unhein (un ke haal par) chhor do , yahan tak ke yeh apne us din se jaa milen jis mein un ke hosh jate rahen ge.
Jis din un ki makkari un ke kuchh kaam nahin aaye gi, aur na unhein koi madad mill sake gi.
Aur us se pehle bhi un zalimon ke liye ek azab hai. Lekin un mein se aksar logon ko pata nahin hai.
Aur tum apne Parwardigar ke hukum par jame raho, kyunke tum hamari nigahon mein ho, aur jab tum athte ho us waqt apne Parwardigar ki hamd ke saath us ki tasbeeh kiya karo.
Aur kuchh raat ko bhi us ki tasbeeh karo, aur us waqt bhi jab sitare doobte hain.
Qasam hai sitare ki jab woh gire.
(ae makkah ke bashndo) yeh tumhare saath rehne wale sahib na raasta bhoole hain, na bhatke hain,
Aur yeh apni khwahish se kuchh nahin bolte.
Yeh to khalis wahee hai jo un ke paas bheji jati hai.
Unhein ek aise mazboot taqat wale (farishte) ne taleem di hai.
Jo qooat ka haamil hai, chunanche woh samne aagaya.
Jabke woh buland ufuq par tha.
Phir woh qareeb aaya, aur jhuk para.
Yahan tak ke woh do kamano ke faasle ke barabar aagaya, bulke us se bhi ziyada nazdeek
Us tarah Allah ko apne bande par jo wahee nazil nafarmani thi, woh nazil farmaee.
Jo kuchh unhon ne dekha, dil ne us mein koi ghalati nahin ki.
Kya phir bhi tum un se us cheez ke bare mein jhagarte ho jise woh dekhte hain ?
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke unhon ne us (farishte) ko ek aur martaba dekha hai.
Us bair ke darakht ke paas jis ka naam sadara almnthi hai.
Usi ke paas jannat almaoi hai.
Us waqt us bair ke darakht par woh cheezen chhaii hui thin jo bhi us par chhaii hui thin.
(payghumbar ki) aankh na to chkraii aur na hadd se aage barhi.
Sach to yeh hai ke unhon ne apne Parwardigar ki bari bari nishaniyon mein se bohat kuchh dekha.
Bhala kya tum ne laat aur zi (ki haqeeqat) par bhi gaur kya hai ?
Aur us ek aur teesre par jis ka naam manaat hai ?
Kya tumhare liye to bete hon, aur Allah ke liye betiyan ?
Phir to yeh bari bhondi taqseem hui.

Un ki haqeeqat us ke siwa kuchh nahin hai ke yeh kuchh naam hain jo tum ne aur tumhare baap dadon ne rakaha liye hain, Allah ne un ke haqq mein koi saboot nazil nahin kiya, dar-haqeeqat yeh (kafir) log mehaz weham o gumaan aur nafsani khwahishat ke peechhe chal rahe hain, halaanke un ke Parwardigar ki taraf se un ke paas hidayat chuki hai.
Kya insan ko har us cheez ka haqq pahunchta hai jis ki woh tamanna kare ?
(nahin) kyunke aakhirat aur duniya to tamam tar Allah hi ke ikhtiyar mein hain.
Aur aasmanon mein kitne hi farishte hain jin ki sifarish kisi ke kuchh bhi kaam nahin sakti, albatta us ke baad hi kaam sakti hai ke Allah jis ke liye chahaye ijazat de, aur us par razi hojaye.
Jo log aakhirat par iman nahin rakhte, woh farishton ko znane naamon se yaad karte hain.
Halaanke unhein us baat ka zara bhi ilm nahin hai, woh mehaz weham o gumaan ke peechhe chal rahe hain, aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke weham o gumaan haqq ke maamle mein bilkul kaar aamad nahin.
Lihaza (ae payghumbar) tum aise aadmi ki fikr na karo jis ne hamari naseehat se moonh mor liya hai, aur dunyawi zindagi ke siwa woh kuchh aur chahta hi nahin.
Aise logon ke ilm ki pahunch bas yahin tak hai. Tumhara Parwardigar hi khoob jaanta hai ke kaun us ke raaste se bhatak chuka hai, aur wahi khoob jaanta hai kaun raah paa gaya hai.

Aur aasmanon mein jo kuchh hai woh bhi aur zameen mein jo kuchh hai woh bhi Allah hi ka hai. Nateeja yeh hai ke jinhon ne bure kaam kiye hain, woh un ko un ke amal ka bhi badla de ga, aur jinhon ne nek kaam kiye hain, un ko behtareen badla ata kare ga.

Un logon ko jo bare bare gunahon aur behiaii ke kaamon se bachte hain, albatta kabhi kbhar pahasal jane ki baat aur hai. Yaqeen rakho tumhara Parwardigar bohat wasee magfirat wala hai, woh tumhein khoob jaanta hai jab us ne tumhein zameen se paida kiya, aur jab tum apni maaon ke pait mein bache the, lihaza tum apne aap ko pakeeza na thehrao, woh khoob jaanta hai ke kaun muttaqi hai.
(ae payghumbar) bhala tum ne us shaks ko bhi dekha jo (haqq se) moonh mor gaya.
Aur jis ne thora sa diya, phir ruk gaya ?
Kya us ke paas gaib ka ilm hai jo woh dekh raha ho ?
Kiya use un baaton ki khabar nahin mili jo musa ke saheefon mein darj hai.
Aur Ibrahim ke saheefon mein bhi, jo mukammal wafadaar rahe ?
Yani yeh ke koi bojh athane wala kisi dusre (ke gunaah) ka bojh nahin athaskta,
Aur yeh ke insan ko khud apni koshish ke siwa kisi aur cheez ka (badla lene ka) haqq nahin pahunchta.
Aur yeh ke us ki koshish anqareeb dikhi jaye gi.
Phir us ka badla use poora poora diya jaye ga.
Aur yeh ke aakhir kaar (sab ko) tumhare Parwardigar hi ke paas pahunchna hai.
Aur yeh ke wahi hai jo hansata aur rlata hai.
Aur yeh ke wahi hai jo maut bhi deta hai aur zindagi bhi.
Aur yeh ke usi ne narr aur mada ke do jore paida kiye hain.
(woh bhi sirf) ek boondh se jab woh tapkayi jati hai.
Aur yeh ke dusri zindagi dene ka bhi usi ne zma liya hai.
Aur yeh ke wahi hai jo maal daar banata aur daulat ko mehfooz krata hai.
Aur yeh ke wahi hai jo shri sitare ka Parwardigar hai.
Aur yeh ke wahi hai jis ne pichle zamane ki qaum aad ko halaak kiya.
Aur samood ko bhi, aur kisi ko baqi na chhora.
Aur us se pehle nooh ki qaum ko bhi (halaak kiya) . Be-shak woh sab se ziyada zalim aur sirkash the.
Aur jo bastiyan aundhi giri thin. Un ko bhi usi ne atha phinka tha.
Phir jis (khaufnaak) cheez ne unhein dhanpa, woh unhein dhanp kar hi rahi.
Lihaza (ae insan) to apne Parwardigar ki kaun kaunsi nematon mein shakk kare ga ?
Yeh (payghumbar) bhi pehle khabardar karne wale payghumbaron ki tarah ek khabardar karne wale hain.
Jo ghri jald aane wali hai, woh qareeb aaphnchi hai.
Allah ke siwa koi nahin hai jo use hata sake.
To kya tum usi baat par heyrat karte ho ?
Aur (us ka mazaq bana kar) haste ho, aur rote nahin ho.
Jabke tum takabbur ke saath khil kood mein pare hue ho ?
Ab (bhi) jhuk jao Allah ke samne aur us ki bandagi karlo.
Qayamat qareeb aalgi hai aur chand pahata gaya hai.
Aur un logon ka haal yeh hai ke agar woh koi nishani dekhte hain to moonh mor lete hain, aur kehte hain ke yeh to ek chalta hua jadoo hai.
Unhon ne haqq ko jhutlaya, aur apni khwahishat ke peechhe chal nikle. Aur har kaam ko aakhir kisi thikane par tik kar rehna hai.
Aur un logon ko (pichli qaumon ke) waqiyaat ki itni khabren pahunch chuki hain jin mein tanbeeh ka bara samaan tha.
Dil mein utar jane wali danaee ki baatein thin, phir bhi yeh tnbihat (un par) kuchh kaargar nahin ho rahen.
Lihaza (ae payghumbar) tum bhi un ki parwah mat karo. Jis din pukarne wala ek nagawaar cheez ki taraf bulaye ga.
Us din yeh apni aankhein jhukaye qabron se us tarah nikal khre hon ge jaise har taraf phili hui tiddiyan.
Dore jarahe hon ge usi pukarega wale ki taraf. Yehi kafir (jo qayamat ka inkar karte the) kahin ge ke yeh to bohat hi kathin din hai.
Un se pehle nooh ki qaum ne bhi jhutlane ka roia ikhtiyar kiya tha. Unhon ne humare bande ko jhutlaya, aur kaha ke : yeh deewane hain, aur unhein dhamkiyan di gaeen.
Us par unhon ne apne Parwardigar ko pukara ke : mein bus hochka hon, ab aap hi badla lijiye.
Chunanche hum ne toot kar barasne wale pani se aasman ke darwaze khol diye.
Aur zameen ko phar kar chashmon mein tabdeel kardiya. Aur us tarah (dono qasam ka) sara pani us kaam ke liye mill gaya jo muqaddar hochka tha.
Aur nooh ko hum ne ek takhaton aur mekhon wali (kashti) par sawar kardiya.
Jo hamari nigrani mein rawan doan thi, taake us (payghumbar) ka badla liya jaye jis ki qadri ki gayi thi.
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke hum ne us ko (ibrat ki) ek nishani banadiya. To kya koi hai jo naseehat hasil kare ?
Ab socho ke mera azab aur meri tnbihat kaisi thin ?
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke hum ne quran ko naseehat hasil karne ke liye aasan banadiya hai. Ab kya koi hai jo naseehat hasil kare ?
Aad ki qaum ne bhi tanbeeh karne walon ko jhutlane ka roia ikhtiyar kya, phir dekh lo ke mera azab aur meri tnbihat kaisi thin ?
Hum ne ek musalsal nahoosat ke din mein un par tez aandhi wali hua chhor di thi.
Jo logon ko us tarah akhar phink deti thi jaise woh khajoor ke akhre hue darakht ke tane hon.
Ab socho ke mera azab aur meri tnbihat kaisi thin ?
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke hum ne quran ko naseehat hasil karne ke liye aasan banadiya hai. Ab kya koi hai jo naseehat hasil kare ?
Samood ki qaum ne bhi tanbeeh karne walon ko jhutlane ka roia ikhtiyar kiya.
Chunanche kehne lage ke : kya hum apne hi mein se ek tanha aadmi ke peechhe chal paren ? Aisa karen ge to yaqeenan hum bari gumrahi aur deewangi mein japrin ge.
Bhala kya hum sare logon ke darmiyan yehi ek shaks reh gaya tha jis par naseehat nazil ki gayi ? Nahin, bulke dar-asal yeh parle darje ka jhoota shekhi baaz hai.
Hum ne payghumbar saleh (alh alh-e-salam) se kaha ke) kal hi unhein pata chal jaye ga ke parle darje ka jhoota shekhi baaz kaun tha ?
Hum un ke paas un ki aazmaish ke tor par ountni bhej rahe hain, us liye tum unhein dekhte raho, aur sabar se kaam lo.
Aur un ko btado ke (kuwein ka) pani un ke darmiyan taqseem kardiya gaya hai. Har pani ka haqq daar apni bari mein hazir hoga.
Phir unhon ne apne aadmi ko bulaya, chunanche us ne haath barhaya, aur (ountni ko) qatal kar dala.
Ab socho ke mera azab aur meri tnbihat kaisi thin ?
Hum ne un par bas ek hi chinghar bheji, jis se woh aise ho kar reh gaye jaise kanton ki rondhi hui barh hoti hai.
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke hum ne quran ko naseehat hasil karne ke liye aasan banadiya hai. Ab kya koi hai jo naseehat hasil kare ?
Loot ki qaum ne (bhi) tanbeeh karne walon ko jhutlaya.
Hum ne un par pathron ka meenh barsaya, siwaye loot ke ghar walon ke jinhen hum ne shri ke waqt bacha liya tha.
Yeh hamari taraf se ek niyamat thi. Jo log shukar guzar hote hain, un ko hum aisa hi sla dete hain.
Aur loot ne logon ko hamari pakar se daraya tha, lekin woh saari tnbihat mein mikh nikalte rahe.
Aur unhon ne loot ko un ke mehmano ke bare mein phslane ki koshish ki. Jis par hum ne un ki aankhon ko andha kardiya ke : chkho mere azab aur meri tnbihat ka mza.
Aur subah sawere un par aisa azab hamla aawar hua jo kam kar reh gaya.
Ke : chkho mere azab aur meri tnbihat ka mza.
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke hum ne quran ko naseehat hasil karne ke liye aasan banadiya hai. Ab kya koi hai jo naseehat hasil kare ?
Aur Firaun ke khandaan ke paas bhi tnbihat aayein.

Bara ba-barkat naam hai tumhare Parwardigar ka jo azmat wala bhi hai, karam wala bhi.
Jab woh hone wala waqa pesh aajaye ga.
To us ke pesh aane ko koi jhutlane wala nahin hoga.
Woh ek teh wbala karne wali cheez hogi.
Jab zameen ek bhonchal se jhnjor di jaye gi.
Aur paharon ko pees kar choora kardiya jaye ga.
Yahan tak ke woh bkhra hua gubar bann kar reh jayen ge.
Aur (logo) tum teen qasmon mein batt jao ge.
Chunanche jo dayen haath wale hain, kiya kehna un dayen haath walon ka.
Aur jo bayein haath wale hain, kya batayein woh bayein haath wale kya hain ?
Aur jo sabaqat le jane wale hain, woh to hain hi sabaqat le jane wale
Wahi hain jo Allah ke khaas muqarrab bande hain.
Woh nematon ke baghaat mein hon ge.
Shuroo ke logon mein se bohat se.
Aur baad ke logon mein se thore.
Sone ke taaron se bani hui unchi nshston par.
Ek dusre ke samne un par tkia lagaye hue.
Sada rehne wale larke un ke samne gardish mein hon ge.
Aisi sharab ke pyale, jug aur jaam le kar.
Jis se na un ke sar mein dard hoga, aur na un ke hosh arin ge.
Aur woh pahala le kar jo woh pasand karen.
Aur parindon ka woh gosht le kar jis ko un ka dil chahaye.
Aur woh bari bari aankhon wali hooren.
Aisi jaise chhpa kar rkhe hue moti.
Yeh sab badla hoga un kaamon ka jo woh kiya karte the.
Woh us jannat mein na koi behoda baat sunen ge. Aur na koi gunaah ki baat.
Haan jo baat hogi, salamati hi salamati ki hogi.
Aur woh jo dayen haath wale hon ge, kiya kehna un dayen haath walon ka.
(woh aish karen ge) kanton se pak beriyon mein.
Aur upar tale lade hue kile ke darakhton mein.
Aur door tak phile hue saaye mein.
Aur behte hue pani mein.
Aur dhair sare phlon mein.
Jo na kabhi khatam hon ge aur na un par koi rok tok hogi.
Aur unche rkhe hue farshon mein.
Yaqeen jaano, hum ne un aurton ko naee athan di hai.
Chunanche unhein kanwariyan banaya hai.
(shoharon ke liye) mohabbat se bhari hui, umar mein barabar
Sab kuchh dayen haath walon ke liye.
(jin mein se) bohat se shuroo ke logon mein se hon ge.
Aur bohat se baad walon mein se.
Aur jo bayein haath wale hain, kya batayein bayein haath wale kya hain ?
Woh hon ge tpti hui lo mein, aur khaulte hue pani mein.

Jo na thanda hoga, na koi faida pahunchane wala.
Yeh log us se pehle bare aish mein the.
Aur bare bhari gunaah par are rehte the.
Aur kaha karte the ke : kya jab hum mrjaiin ge aur mitti aur haddiyan bann kar reh jayen ge, to kya humein dobara zinda kya jaye ga ?
Aur kya humare pehle guzre hue baap dadon ko bhi ?
Keh do ke : yaqeenan sab agle aur pichle.
Ek mutayin din ke tai shda waqt par zaroor akthe kiye jayen ge.
