Ek aise darakht mein se khana pare ga jis ka naam zakkhum hai.
Phir usi se pait bharne hon ge.
Phir us ke upar se kholta hua pani pina pare ga.
Aur pina bhi us tarah jaise pyas ki beemari wale ount peete hain.
Yeh hogi jza o saza ke din un logon ki mehmani.
Hum ne tumhein paida kya hai, phir tum tasdeeq kyun nahin karte ?
Zara yeh batlao ke jo nutfa tum tapkate ho.
Kya use tum paida karte ho ya paida karne wale hum hain ?
Hum ne hi tumhare darmiyan maut ke faisle kar rkhe hain aur koi nahin hai jo humein us baat se aajiz karsake.
Ke hum tumhari jagah tum jaise aur log le aayein, aur tumhein phir se kisi aisi halat mein paida karden jise tum nahin jante.
Aur tumhein apni pehli pedaeesh ka poora pata hai, phir kyun sabaq nahin lete ?
Achha yeh batao ke jo kuchh tum zameen mein bote ho,
Kya use tum ugate ho ya ugane wale hum hain ?
Agar hum chahein to use choora choora kar dalen, jis par tum bhonchke reh jao.
Ke hum par to tawaan prgia.
Bulke hum hain hi badnaseeb.
Achha yeh batao ke yeh pani jo tum peete ho.
Kya use baadalon se tum ne utara hai, ya utaarne wale hum hain ?
Agar hum chahein to use karwa bana kar rakaha den, phir tum kyun shukar ada nahin karte ?
Achha yeh batao ke yeh aag jo tum sulgate ho.
Kya us ka darakht tum ne paida kya hai, ya paida karne wale hum hain ?
Hum ne hi us ko naseehat ka samaan aur shraii musafiron ke liye faiyde ki cheez banaya hai.
Lihaza (ae payghumbar) tum apne azeem Parwardigar ka naam le kar us ki tasbeeh karo.
Ab mein un jaghon ki qasam kha kar kehta hon jahan sitare girte hain.
Aur agar tum samjho to yeh bari zabardast qasam hai.
Ke yeh bara baq-waqar quran hai ?
Jo ek mehfooz kitab mein (pehle se) darj hai.
Us ko wahi log chhote hain jo khoob pak hain.
Yeh tamam jahano ke Parwardigar ki taraf se thora thora kar ke utara jaraha hai.
Kya phir bhi tum us kalaam se beproaii baratte ho ?
Aur tum ne usi ko apna rozgar bana liya hai ke (us ko) jhutlate raho ?
Phir aisa kyun nahin hota hai ke jab (kisi ki) jaan gale tak pahunch jati hai.
Aur us waqt tum (hasrat se us ko) dekh rahe hote ho.
Aur tum se ziyada hum us ke qareeb hote hain, magar tumhein nazar nahin aata.
Agar tumhara hisab kitab hone wala nahin hai to aisa kyun nahin hota.
Ke tum us jaan ko wapas le aao, agar tum sache ho ?
Phir agar woh (marne wala) Allah ke muqarrab bandon mein se ho.
To (us ke liye) aaram hi aaram hai, khusboo hi khusboo hai, aur nematon se bhara baagh hai.
Aur agar woh dayen haath walon mein se ho.
To (us se kaha jaye ga ke) tumhare liye salamati hi salamati hai ke tum dayen haath walon mein se ho.
Aur agar woh un gumraahon mein se ho jo haqq ko jhutlane wale the.
To (us ke liye) khaulte hue pani ki mehmani hai.
Aur dozakh ka daakhila hai.
Us mein koi shakk nahin ke bilkul sahih maani mein yehi yaqeeni baat hai.
Lihaza (ae payghumbar) tum apne azeem Parwardigar ka naam le kar us ki tasbeeh karo.
Aasmanon aur zameen mein jo cheez bhi hai, woh Allah ki tasbeeh karti hai. Aur wahi hai jo iqtedar ka bhi maalik hai, hikmat ka bhi maalik.
Aasmanon aur zameen ki badshaat usi ki hai, wahi zindagi bakshta aur maut deta hai aur woh har cheez par poori qudrat rakhne wala hai.
Wahi awwal bhi hai aur aakhir bhi, zaahir bhi aur chhpa hua bhi, aur woh har cheez ko poori tarah janne wala hai.

Wahi hai jis ne aasmanon aur zameen ko cheh din mein paida kiya, phir arsh par astoa farmaya, woh har us cheez ko jaanta hai jo zameen mein dakhil hoti hai aur jo us se nikalti hai aur har us cheez ko jo aasman se utarti hai aur jo us mein charhti hai aur tum jahan kahin ho, woh tumhare saath hai. Aur jo kaam bhi tum karte ho Allah us ko dekhta hai.
Aasmanon aur zameen ki badshaat usi ki hai, aur tamam maamlaat Allah hi ki taraf lotaye jate hain.
Woh raat ko din mein dakhil krdtia hai, aur din ko raat mein dakhil kardyta hai, aur woh seeno mein chhpi hui baaton ko khoob jaanta hai.

Allah aur us ke Rasool par iman rakho, aur jis (maal) mein Allah ne tumhein qayam muqaam banaya hai, us mein se (Allah ke raaste mein) kharch karo. Chunanche tum mein se jo log iman laye hain, aur unhon ne (Allah ke raaste mein) kharch kiya hai, un ke liye bara ajar hai.

Aur tumhare liye kaunsi wajah hai ke tum Allah par iman na rakho, halaanke Rasool tumhein dawat de rahe hain ke tum apne Parwardigar par iman rakho, aur woh tum se ahad le chuke hain, agar tum waqayi momin ho.
Allah wahi to hai jo apne bande par khuli khuli aayaten nazil farmata hai, taake tumhein andhirion se nikal kar roshni mein laye. Aur yaqeen jaano Allah tum par bohat shafeeq, bohat meharban hai.

Aur tumhare liye kaunsi wajah hai ke tum Allah ke raaste mein kharch na karo, halaanke aasmanon aur zameen ki saari miras Allah hi ke liye hai. Tum mein se jinhon ne (makkah ki) fatah se pehle kharch kiya, aur laraee lari, woh (baad walon ke) barabar nahin hain. Woh darje mein un logon se barhe hue hain jinhon ne (fatah makkah ke) baad kharch kiya, aur laraee lari. Yun Allah ne bhalayi ka wada un sab se kar rakhha hai, aur tum jo kuchh karte ho Allah us se poori tarah bakhabar hai.
Kaun hai jo Allah ko qarz de ? Achha qarz jis ke natije mein Allah use dene wale ke liye kaee gunaa barha de ? Aur aise shaks ko bara ba-izzat ajar mile ga.

Us din jab tum momin mardon aur momin aurton ko dekho ge ke un ka noor un ke samne aur un ke dayen janib dor raha hoga (aur un se kaha jaye ga ke) aaj tumhein khushkhabri hai un baghaat ki jin ke niche nehrein behti hain, jin mein tum hamesha hamesha raho ge. Yehi hai jo bari zabardast kamiyabi hai.

Us din jab munafiq mard aur munafiq aurten iman walon se kahin ge ke : zara hamara intezar karlo ke tumhare noor se hum bhi kuchh roshni hasil karlen. Un se kaha jaye ga ke : tum apne peechhe lot jao, phir noor talash karo. Phir un ke darmiyan ek deewar hayal kardi jaye gi jis mein ek darwaza hoga jis ke andar ki taraf rehmat hogi, aur bahar ki taraf azab hoga.

Woh momino ko pukaren ge ke : kya hum tumhare saath nahin the ? Momin kahin ge ke : haan the to sahi, lekin tum ne khud apne aap ko fitne mein daal liya, aur intezar mein rahe, shakk mein pare rahe, aur jhooti aarzuon ne tumhein dhoke mein dale rakhha, yahan tak ke Allah ka hukum aagaya aur woh bara dhoke baaz (yani shetan) tumhein Allah ke bare mein dhoka hi deta raha.

Chunanche aaj na tum se koi fdia qabool kiya jaye ga aur na un logon se jinhon ne (khle bandon) kufr ikhtiyar kiya tha. Tumhara thikana dozakh hai, wahi tumhari rkhoali hai aur yeh bohat bura anjaam hai.

Jo log iman le aaye hain, kya un ke liye ab bhi waqt nahin aaya ke un ke dil Allah ke zikr ke liye aur jo haqq itra hai us ke liye psij jayen ? Aur woh un logon ki tarah na banein jin ko pehle kitab di gayi thi, phir un par ek lambi muddat guzar gayi, aur un ke dil sakht hogaye, aur (aaj) un mein se bohat se nafarman hain ?
Khoob samajh lo ke Allah zameen ko us ke murda hojane ke baad zindagi bakshta hai. Hum ne tumhare liye nishaniyan khol khol kar wazeh kardi hain, taake tum samajh se kaam lo.

Yaqeenan woh jo sadqa dene wale mard aur sadqa dene wali aurten hain, aur unhon ne Allah ko qarz diya hai achha qarz, un ke liye us (sadqe) ko kaee gunaa barha diya jaye ga, aur un ke liye ba-izzat ajar hai.

Aur jo log Allah par aur us ke rasoolon par iman laye hain, wahi apne rubb ke nazdeek siddiq aur shaheed hain. Un ke liye un ka ajar aur un ka noor hai. Aur jin logon ne kufr apna liya aur hamari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya, woh dozakhi log hain.

Khoob samajh lo ke us duniya wali zindagi ki haqeeqat bas yeh hai ke woh naam hai khil kood ka, zaahiri sjaot ka, tumhare ek dusre par fakr jatane ka, aur maal aur aulad mein ek dusre se barhne ki koshish karne ka. Us ki misal aisi hai jaise ek baarish jis se agne wali cheezen kisano ko bohat achhi lagti hain, phir woh apna zoar dikhati hain, phir tum us ko dekhte ho ke zard prgii hai, phir woh choora choora hojati hai. Aur aakhirat mein (ek to) sakht azab hai, aur (dusre) Allah ki taraf se bakhsish hai, aur khushnudi, ao duniya wali zindagi dhakke ke samaan ke siwa kuchh bhi nahin hai.

Ek dusre se aage barhne ki koshish karo apne Parwardigar ki bakhsish ki taraf aur us jannat ki taraf jis ki choraii aasman aur zameen ki choraii jaisi hai, yeh un logon ke liye tayyar ki gayi hai jo Allah aur us ke rasoolon par iman laye hain, yeh Allah ka fazal hai jo woh jis ko chahta hai deta hai. Aur Allah bare fazal wala hai.

Koi museebat aisi nahin hai jo zameen mein nazil hoti ya tumhari janon ko lahiq hoti ho, magar woh ek kitab mein us waqt se darj hai jab hum ne un janon ko paida bhi nahin kiya tha, yaqeen jaano yeh baat Allah ke liye bohat aasan hai.

Yeh us liye taake jo cheez tum se jati rahe, us par tum ghum mein na paro, aur jo cheez Allah tumhein ata farma, us par tum atra nahin, aur Allah kisi aise shaks ko pasand nahin karta jo atraht mein mubtila ho, shekhi bgharne wala ho.

Woh aise log hain jo kanjoosi karte hain, aur dusre logon ko bhi kanjoosi ki talqeen karte hain. Aur jo shaks moonh mor le to yaad rakho ke Allah hi hai jo sab se bey-niaz hai, bzat khud qabil tareef.

Haqeeqat yeh hai ke hum ne apne payghumbaron ko khuli hui nishaniyan de kar bheja, aur un ke saath kitab bhi utari, aur tarazoo bhi, taake log insaf par qayam rahen, aur hum ne loha utara jis mein jungi taqat bhi hai aur logon ke liye dusre faiyde bhi, aur yeh us liye taake Allah jaan le ke kaun hai jo us ko dikhe baghair us (ke deen) ki aur us ke payghumbaron ki madad karta hai. Yaqeen rakho ke Allah bari qooat ka, bare iqtedar ka maalik hai.

Aur hum ne nooh ko aur Ibrahim ko payghumbar bana kar bheja, aur un dono ki aulad mein nabuwat aur kitab ka silsila jari kiya. Phir un mein se kuchh to hidayat par aagaye, aur un mein se bohat se log nafarman rahe.

Phir hum ne un ke peechhe unhi ke nakshe qadam par apne aur payghumbar bheje, aur un ke peechhe essa ibne marium ko bheja aur unhein injeel ata ki, aur jin logon ne un ki pairwi ki un ke dilon mein hum ne shafqat aur reham dili paida kardi. Aur jahan tak rahbaniyat ka talluq hai woh unhon ne khud ijaad karli thi, hum ne us ko un ke zimme wajib nahin kiya tha. Lekin unhon ne Allah ki khushnudi hasil karni chahi, phir us ki waisi riayat na karsake jaise us ka haqq tha. Garz un mein se jo iman laye the, un ko hum ne un ka ajar diya, aur un mein se bohat log nafarman hi rahe.

Ae iman walo ! Allah se daro, aur us ke payghumbar par iman lao taake woh tumhein apni rehmat ke do hisse ata farmaye, aur tumhare liye woh noor paida kare jis ke zariye tum chal sako, aur tumhari bakhsish farma. Aur Allah bohat bakhshne wala, bohat meharban hai.

Taake ehle kitab ko maloom hojaye ke Allah ke fazal mein se kisi cheez par unhein koi ikhtiyar nahin hai, aur yeh ke fazal tamam tar Allah ke haath mein hai jo woh jis ko chahta hai ata farmata hai, aur Allah fazal azeem ka maalik hai.

(ae payghumbar) Allah ne us aurat ki baat sunn li hai jo tum se apne shohar ke bare mein behas kar rahi hai, aur Allah se faryad karti jati hai. Aur Allah tum dono ki guftagu sunn raha hai. Yaqeenan Allah sab kuchh sunne dekhne wala hai.

Tum mein se jo log apni biwiyon se zihar karte hain (un ke us amal se) woh biwiyan un ki maayen nahin hojatin. Un ki maayen to wahi hain jinhon ne un ko janum diya hai. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh log aisi baat kehte hain jo bohat buri hai, aur jhoot hai. Aur Allah bohat maaf karne wala, bohat bakhshne wala hai.

Aur jo log apni biwiyon se zihar karte hain phir unhon ne jo kuchh kaha hai, us se rujoo karte hain, to un ke zimme ek ghulam aazad karna hai, qabl us ke ke woh (miyan biwi) ek dusre ko haath lagayein. Yeh hai woh baat jis ki tumhein naseehat ki jarhi hai, aur jo kuchh tum karte ho, Allah us se poori tarah bakhabar hai.

Phir jis shaks ko ghulam muyassar na ho, us ke zimme do mtoatr maheenon ke roze hain, qabl us ke ke woh (miyan biwi) ek dusre ko haath lagayein. Phir jis ko us ki bhi istitaat na ho us ke zimme saathh miskeeno ko khana khilana hai. Yeh us liye taake tum Allah aur us ke Rasool par iman lao, aur yeh Allah ki muqarrar ki hui hadein hain aur kafiron ke liye dardnaak azab hai.

Yaqeen rakho ke jo log Allah aur us ke Rasool ki mukhalifat karte hain, woh aise hi zaleel hon ge jaise un se pehle log zaleel hue the aur hum ne khuli khuli aayaten nazil kardi hain aur kafiron ke liye aisa azab hai jo khwar kar ke rakaha de ga.

Us din jab Allah un sab ko dobara zinda kare ga, phir unhein bataye ga ke unhon ne kiya kuchh kiya tha. Allah ne use gin gin kar mehfooz rakhha hai, aur yeh use bhool gaye hain. Aur Allah har cheez ka gawah hai.

Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke aasmanon aur zameen mein jo kuchh hai Allah use jaanta hai ? Kabhi teen aadmiyon mein koi sirgoshi aisi nahin hoti jis mein chotha woh na ho, aur na paanch aadmiyon ki koi sirgoshi aisi hoti hai jis mein chhta woh na ho, aur chahaye sirgoshi karne wale us se kam hon ya ziyada, woh jahan bhi hon, Allah un ke saath hota hai. Phir woh qayamat ke din unhein bataye ga ke unhon ne kya kuchh kya tha. Be-shak Allah har cheez ko janne wala hai.

Kya tum ne un logon ko nahin dekha jinhen sirgoshi karne se mana kardiya gaya tha, phir bhi woh wahi kaam karte hain jis se unhein mana kya gaya tha ? Aur woh ek dusre ke saath aisi sargoshiyan karte hain jo gunaah, zyadati aur Rasool ki nafarmani par mushtamil hoti hain. Aur (ae payghumbar) jab woh tumhare paas aate hain to tumhein aise tareeqe se salam karte hain jis se Allah ne tumhein salam nahin kya, aur apne dilon mein kehte hain ke : hum jo kuchh keh rahe hain us par Allah humein saza kyun nahin de deta ? Jahannam hi un (ki khabar lene) ke liye kafi hai, woh usi mein jaa pahunchenge, aur woh pahunchne ki bohat buri jagah hai.

Ae iman walo ! Jab tum aapas mein ek dusre se sirgoshi karo to aisi sirgoshi na karo jo gunaah, zyadati aur Rasool ki nafarmani par mushtamil ho, haan aisi sirgoshi karo jo nek kaamon aur taqwa par mushtamil ho, aur Allah se darte raho, jis ke paas tum sab ko jama kar ke le jaya jaye ga.

Aisi sirgoshi to shetan ki taraf se hoti hai taake woh iman walon ko ghum mein mubtila kare aur woh Allah ke hukum ke baghair unhein zara bhi nuksan nahin pahuncha sakta. Aur momino ko Allah hi par bharosa rakhna chahiye.

Ae iman walo ! Jab tum se kaha jaye ke majlison mein dusron ke liye gunjaish paida karo, to gunjaish paida kardiya karo, Allah tumhare liye wusat paida kare ga, aur jab kaha jaye ke ath jao, to ath jao, tum mein se jo log iman laye hain aur jin ko ilm ata kiya gaya hai Allah un ko darjon mein buland kare ga, aur jo kuchh tum karte ho Allah us se poori tarah bakhabar hai.

Ae iman walo ! Jab tum Rasool se tanahi mein koi baat karna chaho to apni us tanahi ki baat se pehle kuchh sadqa kardiya karo. Yeh tareeqa tumhare haqq mein behtar aur ziyada sthra tareeqa hai. Haan agar tumhare paas (sadqa karne ke liye) kuchh na ho to Allah bohat bakhshne wala, bohat meharban hai.

Kya tum us baat se darr gaye ke apni tanahi ki baat se pehle sadaqaat diya karo ? Ab jabke tum aisa nahin karsake, aur Allah ne tumhein maaf kardiya to tum namaz qayam karte ho, aur zakat dete raho, aur Allah aur us ke Rasool ki farmanbardari karte raho. Aur jo kaam bhi tum karte ho Allah us se poori tarah bakhabar hai.

Kya tum ne un ko nahin dekha jinhon ne aise logon ko dost banaya hua hai jin par Allah ka gazab hai ? Yeh na to tumhare hain aur na un ke, aur yeh jante boojhte jhooti baaton par qasmen kha jate hain.
Allah ne un ke liye sakht azab tayyar kar rakhha hai. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke bohat bure hain woh kaam jo yeh karte rahe hain.
Unhon ne apni qasmon ko ek dhaal bana liya hai. Phir woh dusron ko Allah ke raaste se rokte rahe hain. Us liye un ke liye aisa azab hai jo zaleel kar ke rakaha de ga.
Un ke maal aur un ki aulad Allah ke muqable mein un ke kuchh kaam nahin aayein ge. Yeh dozakh wale hain. Yeh hamesha usi mein rahen ge.

Jis din Allah un sab ko dobara zinda kare ga to us ke samne bhi yeh usi tarah qasmen kahyenge jaise tumhare samne kahate hain, aur yeh samjhen ge ke unhein koi sahara mill gaya hai. Yaad rakho yeh log bilkul jhoote hain.
Un par shetan ne poori tarah qabze jamaa kar unhein Allah ki yaad se ghafil kardiya hai. Yeh shetan ka giroh hai. Yaad rakho shetan ka giroh hi na-murad hone wala hai.
Be-shak jo log Allah aur us ke Rasool ki mukhalifat karte hain, woh zaleel tareen logon mein shamil hain.
Allah ne yeh baat lakaha di hai ke mein aur mere payghumbar zaroor ghalib aayein ge. Yaqeen rakho ke Allah bara qooat wala, bare iqtedar wala hai.

Jo log Allah aur aakhirat ke din par iman rakhte hain, un ko tum aisa nahin pao ge ke woh un se dosti rakhte hon, jinhon ne Allah aur us ke Rasool ki mukhalifat ki hai, chahaye woh un ke baap hon, ya un ke bete ya un ke bhai ya un ke khandaan wale. Yeh woh log hain jin ke d loon mein Allah ne iman nakshe kardiya hai, aur apni rooh se un ki madad ki hai, aur unhein woh aise baaghon mein dakhil kare ga jin ke niche nehrein behti hon gi, jahan woh hamesha rahen ge. Allah un se razi hogaya hai aur woh Allah se razi hogaye hain. Yeh Allah ka giroh hai. Yaad rakho ke Allah ka giroh hi falaah pane wala hai.
Aasmanon aur zameen mein jo bhi koi cheez hai us ne Allah ki tasbeeh ki hai, aur wahi hai jo iqtedar ka bhi maalik hai, hikmat ka bhi maalik.

Wahi hai jis ne ehle kitab mein se kafir logon ko un ke gharon se pehle ijtima ke mauqa par nikal diya. (musalmano) tumhein yeh khayal bhi nahin tha ke woh niklen ge, aur woh bhi yeh samjhe hue the ke un ke qile unhein Allah se bacha len ge. Phir Allah un ke paas aisi jagah se aaya jahan un ka gumaan bhi nahin tha, aur Allah ne un ke d loon mein rob daal diya ke woh apne gharon ko khud apne haathon se bhi aur musalmanon ke haath se bhi ujaar rahe the. Lihaza ae aankhon walo ! Ibrat hasil karo.
Aur agar Allah ne un ki qismat mein jila watani na lakaha di hoti to woh duniya hi mein un ko azab de deta, albatta aakhirat mein un ke liye dozakh ka azab hai.
Yeh us liye ke unhon ne Allah aur us ke Rasool se dushmani thani, aur jo shaks Allah se dushmani karta hai, to Allah bara sakht azab dene wala hai.
Tum ne khajoor ke jo darakht kaate, ya unhein apni jaron par khra rehne diya, to yeh sab kuchh Allah ke hukum se tha, aur us liye tha taake Allah nafarmaano ko ruswa kare.

Aur Allah ne apne Rasool ko un ka jo maal bhi fii ke tor par dloaia. Us ke liye tum ne na apne ghore doraye, na ount, lekin Allah apne payghumbaron ko jis par chahta hai, tasallut ata farma deta hai. Aur Allah har cheez par poori qudrat rakhne wala hai.

Allah apne Rasool ko (dusri) bastiyon se jo maal bhi fii ke tor par dloa de, to woh Allah ka haqq hai aur us ke Rasool ka, aur qarabat daron ka, aur yateemon, miskeeno aur musafiron ka, taake woh maal sirf unhi ke darmiyan gardish karta na reh jaye jo tum mein daulat mand log hain. Aur Rasool tumhein jo kuchh den, woh le lo, aur jis cheez se mana karen us se ruk jao, aur Allah se darte raho. Be-shak Allah sakht saza dene o illa hai.

(neiz yeh maal fii) un haajat mand muhajireen ka haqq hai jinhen apne gharon aur apne maalon se bedkhl kiya gaya hai. Woh Allah ki taraf se fazal aur us ki khushnudi ke talab gar hain, aur Allah aur us ke Rasool ki madad karte hain. Yehi log hain jo raast baaz hain.

(aur yeh maal fii) un logon ka haqq hai jo pehle hi se us jagah (yani madina mein) iman ke saath muqeem hain. Jo koi un ke paas hijrat ke aata hai yeh us se mohabbat karte hain, aur jo kuchh un (muhajireen) ko diya jata hai, yeh apne seeno mein us ki koi khwahish bhi mehsoos nahin karte, aur un ko apne aap par tarjeeh dete hain, chahaye un par tangg dasti ki halat guzar rahi ho. Aur jo log apni tabiyat ke bukhl se mehfooz hojayen, wahi hain jo falaah pane wale hain.

Aur (yeh maal fii) un logon ka bhi haqq hai jo un (muhajireen aur ansar) ke baad aaye. Woh yeh kehte hain ke : ae humare Parwardigar ! Hamari bhi magfirat frmaiie, aur humare un bhaiyon ki bhi jo hum se pehle iman lachke hain, aur humare dilon mein iman lane walon ke liye koi bugz na rkhie. Ae humare Parwardigar ! Aap bohat shafeeq, bohat meharban hain.

Kiya tum ne un ko nahin dekha jinhon ne munafiqat se kaam liya hai ke woh apne un bhaiyon se jo kafir ehle kitab mein se hain yeh kehte hain ke : agar tumhein nikala gaya to hum bhi tumhare saath niklen ge aur tumhare bare mein kabhi kisi aur ka kehna nahin manen ge, aur agar tum se jung ki gayi to hum tumhari madad karen ge, aur Allah gawahi deta hai ke yeh log bilkul jhoote hain.

Yeh paki baat hai ke agar un (ehle kitab) ko nikala gaya to yeh un ke saath nahin niklen ge. Aur agar un se jung ki gayi to yeh un ki madad nahin karen ge, aur agar bil-farz un ki madad ki bhi to pith phir kar bhaagein ge, phir un ki koi madad nahin kare ga.
(musalmano) haqeeqat yeh hai ke un ke dilon mein tumhari dehshat Allah se ziyada hai. Yeh us liye ke yeh woh log hain jinhen samajh nahin hai.

Yeh sab log akthe ho kar bhi tum se jung nahin karen ge, magar aisi bastiyon mein jo qilon mein mehfooz hon, ya phir deewaron ke peechhe cahahap kar. Un ki aapas ki mkhalftin bohat sakht hain. Tum unhein aktha samajhte ho, halaanke un ke dil phte hue hain. Yeh us liye ke yeh woh log hain jinhen aqal nahin hai.
Un ki halat un logon ki si hai jo un se kuchh hi pehle apne kartoot ka mza cahakah chuke hain. Aur un ke liye dardnaak azab hai.

Un ki misal shetan ki si hai ke woh insan se kehta hai ke : kafir hoja. Phir jab woh kafir hojata hai to kehta hai ke : mein tujh se buri hon, mein Allah se darta hon jo sare jahano ka Parwardigar hai.
Chunanche un dono ka anjaam yeh hai ke woh dono dozakh mein hon ge jahan woh hamesha rahen ge, aur yehi zulm karne walon ki saza hai.
Ae iman walo ! Allah se daro, aur har shaks yeh dikhe ke us ne kal ke liye kiya aage bheja hai. Aur Allah se daro. Yaqeen rakho ke jo kuchh tum karte ho, Allah us se poori tarah bakhabar hai.
Aur tum un jaise na hojana jo Allah ko bhool bithe the, to Allah ne unhein khud apne aap se ghafil kardiya. Wahi log hain jo nafarman hain.
Jannat wale aur dozakh wale barabar nahin sakte. Jannat wale hi woh hain jo kaamyaab hain.

Agar hum ne yeh quran kisi pahar par utara hota to tum use dekhte ke woh Allah ke rob se jhuka jaraha hai, aur phta parta hai. Aur hum yeh misalen logon ke samne us liye biyan karte hain taake woh gaur o fikr se kaam len.
Woh Allah wahi hai jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin. Woh chhpi aur khuli har baat ko janne wala hai. Wahi hai jo sab par meharban hai, bohat meharban hai.

Woh Allah wahi hai jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin hai, jo baadshah hai, taqadas ka maalik hai, salamati dene wala hai, aman bakhshne wala hai, sab ka nigehbaan hai, bare iqtedar wala hai, har kharabi ki islaah karne wala hai, baraee ka maalik hai. Pak hai Allah us shirk se jo yeh log karte hain.

Woh Allah wahi hai jo paida karne wala hai, wajood mein lane wala hai surat banane wala hai, usi ke sab se achhe naam hain. Aasmanon aur zameen mein jitni cheezen hain woh us ki tasbeeh karti hain, aur wahi hai jo iqtedar ka bhi maalik hai, hikmat ka bhi maalik.

Ae iman walo ! Agar tum mere raaste mein jihad karne ki khatir aur meri khushnudi hasil karne ke liye (gharon se) nikle ho to mere dushmano aur apne dushmano ko aisa dost mat banao ke un ko mohabbat ke paygham bhejne lago, halaanke tumhare paas jo haqq aaya hai, unhon ne us ko itna jhutlaya hai ke woh Rasool ko bhi aur tumhein bhi sirf us wajah se (mke se) bahar nikalte rahe hain ke tum apne Parwardigar Allah par iman laye ho. Tum un se khfia tor par dosti ki baat karte ho, halaanke jo kuchh tum khfia tor par karte ho, aur jo kuchh lania karte ho, mein us sab ko poori tarah jaanta hai. Aur tum mein se koi bhi aisa kare, woh raah raast se bhatak gaya.
Agar tum un ke haath aajao to woh tumhare dushman bann jayen ge aur apne haath aur zubaanein pehla pehla kar tumhare saath buraee karen ge, aur un ki khwahish yeh hai ke tum kafir bann jao.
Qayamat ke din na tumhari rishta darian hargiz tumhare kaam aayein gi, aur na tumhari aulad. Allah hi tumhare darmiyan faisla kare ga, aur tum jo kuchh karte ho, Allah use poori tarah dekhta hai.

Tumhare liye Ibrahim aur un ke saathiyon mein behtareen namuna hai, jab unhon ne apni qaum se kaha tha ke : hamara tum se aur Allah ke siwa tum jin jin ki ibadat karte ho, un se koi talluq nahin hai. Hum tumhare (aqaid ke) munkir hain, aur humare aur tumhare darmiyan hamesha ke liye dushmani aur bugz paida hogaya hai jab tak tum sirf ek Allah par iman na lao. Albatta Ibrahim ne apne baap se yeh zaroor kaha tha ke : mein aap ke liye Allah se magfirat ki dua zaroor maangoon ga, agarche Allah ke samne mein aap ko koi faida pahunchane ka koi ikhtiyar nahin rakhta. Ae humare Parwardigar aap hi par hum ne bharosa kiya hai, aur aap hi ki taraf hum rujoo hue hain, aur aap hi ki taraf sab ko lot kar jana hai.

Ae humare Parwardigar ! Humein kafiron ka tkhta masahaq na bnaiie aur humare Parwardigar ! Hamari magfirat farma dijiye. Yaqeenan aap, aur sirf aap ki zaat woh hai jis ka iqtedar bhi kamil hai, jis ki hikmat bhi kamil.

(musalmano) yaqeenan tumhare liye un logon ke tarz amal mein behtareen namuna hai, har us shaks ke liye jo Allah aur roz aakhirat se umeed rakhta ho. Aur jo shaks moonh more to (woh yaad rkhe ke) Allah sab se bey-niaz hai, bzat khud qabil tareef.
Kuchh baeed nahin hai ke Allah tumhare aur jin logon se tumhari dushmani hai, un ke darmiyan dosti paida karde, aur Allah bari qudrat wala hai, aur Allah bohat bakhshne wala, bohat meharban hai.

Allah tumhein us baat se mana nahin karta ke jin logon ne deen ke maamle mein tum se jung nahin ki, aur tumhein tumhare gharon se nahin nikala, un ke saath tum koi neki ka ya insaf ka mamla karo, yaqeenan Allah insaf karne walon ko pasand karta hai.

Allah to tumhein us baat se mana karta hai ke jin logon ne tumhare saath deen ke maamle mein jung ki hai, aur tumhein apne gharon se nikala hai, aur tumhein nikalne mein ek dusre ki madad ki hai, tum un se dosti rakho. Aur jo log un se dosti rakhen ge, woh zalim hain.

Ae iman walo ! Jab tumhare paas aurten hijrat kar ke aayein to tum un ko jaanch liya karo. Allah hi un ke iman ke bare mein behtar jaanta hai. Phir jab tumhein yeh maloom hojaye ke woh momin aurten hain to tum unhein kafiron ke paas wapas na bhejna. Woh un kafiron ke liye halal nahin hain, aur woh kafir un ke liye halal nahin hain. Aur un kafiron ne jo kuchh (un aurton par mehar ki surat mein) kharch kiya ho, woh unhein ada karo. Aur tum par un aurton se nikah karne mein koi gunaah nahin hai, jab tak ke tum ne un ke mehar ada nahin krdie hon. Aur tum kafir aurton ki smtin apne qabze mein baqi na rakho, aur jo kuchh tum ne (un kafir biwiyon par mehar ki surat mein) kharch kiya tha, woh tum (un ke naye shoharon se) maang lo. Aur unhon ne jo kuchh (apni musalman hojane wali biwiyon par) kharch kiya tha, woh (un ke naye musalman shoharon se) maang len. Yeh Allah ka faisla hai, wahi tumhare darmiyan faisla karta hai, aur Allah bare ilm wala, bari hikmat wala hai.

Aur agar tumhari biwiyon mein se koi kafiron ke paas jakr tumhare haath se nikal jaye, phir tumhari naubat aaye to jin logon ki biwiyan jati rahi hain un ko itni rakam ada kardo jitni unhon ne (apni un biwiyon par) kharch ki thi, aur Allah se darte raho, jis par tum iman laye ho.

Ae nabi ! Jab tumhare paas musalman aurten us baat par bayt karne ke liye aayein ke woh Allah ke saath kisi bhi cheez ko shareek nahin manen gi, aur chori nahin karen gi, aur zina nahin karen gi, aur apni aulad ko qatal nahin karen gi, aur na koi aisa bohatan bandhen gi jo unhon ne apne haathon aur paon ke darmiyan gahara liya ho, aur na kisi bhale kaam mein tumhari nafarmani karen gi, to tum un ko bayt karliya karo, aur un ke haqq mein Allah se magfirat ki dua kiya karo, yaqeenan Allah bohat bakhshne wala, bohat meharban hai.
Ae iman walo ! Un logon ko dost na banao jin par Allah ne gazab farmaya hai. Woh aakhirat se usi tarah mayous hochke hain jaise kafir log qabron mein madfoon logon se mayous hain.
Aasmanon aur zameen mein jo bhi koi cheez hai, us ne Allah ki tasbeeh ki hai aur wahi hai jo iqtedar ka bhi maalik hai, hikmat ka bhi maalik.
Ae iman walo ! Tum aisi baat kyun kehte ho jo karte nahin ?
Allah ke nazdeek yeh baat bari qabil nafrat hai ke tum aisi baat kaho jo karo nahin.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke Allah un logon se mohabbat karta hai jo us ke raaste mein us tarah saff bana kar larte hain jaise woh sisa pilayi hui imarat hon.

Aur woh waqt yaad karo jab musa ne apni qaum se kaha tha ke : ae meri qaum ke logo ! Tum mujhe takleef kyun pahunchate ho, halaanke tum jante ho ke mein tumhare paas Allah ka payghumbar bann kar aaya hon ? Phir jab unhon ne terh ikhtiyar ki to Allah ne un ke dilon ko tairhaa kardiya, aur Allah nafarman logon ko hidayat tak nahin pahunchata.

Aur woh waqt yaad karo jab essa bann marium ne kaha tha ke : ae bano israel mein tumhare paas Allah ka aisa payghumbar bann kar aaya hon ke mujh se pehle jo toraat (nazil hui) thi, mein us ki tasdeeq karne wala hon, aur us Rasool ki khushkhabri dene wala hon jo mere baad aaye ga, jis ka naam ahmed hai. Phir jab woh un ke paas khuli khuli nishaniyan le kar aaye to woh kehne lage ke : yeh to khla hua jadoo hai.
Aur us shaks se bara zalim kaun hoga jo Allah par jhoot bandhe, jabke use islam ki taraf bulaya jaraha ho ? Aur Allah aise zalim logon ko hidayat tak nahin pahunchata.
Yeh log chahte hain ke apne moonh se Allah ke noor ko bujha den, halaanke Allah apne noor ki takmeel kar ke rahe ga, chahaye kafiron ko yeh baat kitni buri lage.
Wahi to hai jis ne apne Rasool ko hidayat aur sacchayi ka deen de kar bheja hai taake woh use tamam dusre dinon par ghalib karde, chahaye mushrik logon ko yeh baat kitni buri lage.
Ae iman walo ! Kya mein tumhein ek aisi tijarat ka pata doon jo tumhein dardnaak azab se nijat dila de ?
(woh yeh hai ke) tum Allah aur us ke Rasool par iman lao, aur apne maal o daulat aur apni janon se Allah ke raaste mein jihad karo. Yeh tumhare liye behtareen baat hai, agar tum samjho.

Us ke natije mein Allah tumhari khatir tumhare gunahon ko baksh de ga aur tumhein un baaghon mein dakhil kare ga jin ke niche nehrein behti hon gi, aur aise umdah gharon mein bsaie ga jo hamesha hamesha rehne wali jannaton mein waqe hon ge. Yehi zabardast kamiyabi hai.

Aur ek aur cheez tumhein de ga jo tumhein pasand hai (aur woh hai) Allah ki taraf se madad, aur ek aisi fatah jo anqareeb hasil hogi, aur (ae payghumbar) iman walon ko (us baat ki) khushkhabri suna do .

Ae iman walo ! Tum Allah (ke deen) ke madadgar bann jao, usi tarah jaise essa bann marium (alh alh-e-salam) ne hawariyon se kaha tha ke : woh kaun hain jo Allah ke waste mere madadgar banein ? Hawariyon ne kaha : hum Allah ke (deen ke) madadgar hain. Phir bani israel ka ek giroh iman le aaya, aur ek giroh ne kufr ikhtiyar kya, chunanche jo log iman laye the hum ne un ke dushmano ke khilaf un ki madad ki, nateeja yeh hua ke woh ghalib aaye.
Aasmanon aur zameen mein jo cheez bhi hai woh Allah ki tasbeeh karti hai jo baadshah hai bare taqadas ka maalik hai jis ka iqtedar bhi kamil hai jis ki hikmat bhi kamil.

Wahi hai jis ne ummi logon mein unhi mein se ek Rasool ko bheja jo un ke samne us ki aayaton ki tilawat karen aur un ko pakeeza banayen aur unhein kitab aur hikmat ki taleem den, jabke woh us se pehle khuli gumrahi mein pare hue the.
Aur (yeh Rasool jin ki taraf bheje gaye hain) un mein kuchh aur bhi hain jo abhi un ke saath aaker nahin mile. Aur woh bare iqtedar wala, bari hikmat wala hai.
Yeh Allah ka fazal hai woh jise chahta hai deta hai, aur Allah bare fazal wala hai.

Jin logon par toraat ka bojh dala gaya, phir unhon ne us ka bojh nahin utahaya, un ki misal us gadhe ki si hai jo bohat si kitabein lade hue ho. Bohat buri misal hai un logon ki jinhon ne Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaya, aur Allah aise zalim logon ko hidayat tak nahin pahunchata.
(ae payghumbar un se) kaho ke : ae logo jo yahudi bann gaye ho, agar tumhara doi yeh hai ke sare logon ko chhor kar tum hi Allah ke dost ho to maut ki tamanna karo agar tum sache ho.
Aur unhon ne apne haathon jo aemaal aage bhej rkhe hain un ki wajah se yeh kabhi maut ki tamanna nahin karen ge, aur Allah un zalimon ko khoob jaanta hai.

Kaho ke : jis maut se tum bhaagte ho woh tum se aamlne wali hai, phir tumhein us (Allah) ki taraf lotaya jaye ga jise tamam posheeda aur khuli hui baaton ka poora ilm hai, phir woh tumhein bataye ga ke tum kiya kuchh kiya karte the.
Ae iman walo ! Jab jma ke din namaz ke liye pukara jaye to Allah ke zikr ki taraf lpko, aur khareed farokht chhor do . Yeh tumhare liye behtar hai agar tum samjho.
Phir jab namaz poori hojaye to zameen mein muntashir hojao, aur Allah ka fazal talash karo. Aur Allah ko kasrat se yaad karo taake tumhein falaah naseeb ho.

Aur jab kuchh logon ne koi tijarat ya koi khil dekha to us ki taraf toot pare, aur tumhein khra hua chhor diya. Keh do ke : jo kuchh Allah ke paas hai woh khil aur tijarat se kahin ziyada behtar hai, aur Allah sab se behtar rizq dene wala hai.

Jab munafiq log tumhare paas aate hain to kehte hain : hum gawahi dete hain ke aap Allah ke Rasool hain aur Allah jaanta hai ke aap waqayi us ke Rasool hain, aur Allah (yeh bhi) gawahi deta hai ke yeh munafiq log jhoote hain.
Unhon ne apni qasmon ko ek dhaal bana rakhha hai. Phir yeh log dusron ko Allah ke raaste se rokte hain. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke bohat hi bure hain woh kaam jo yeh log karte rahe hain.

Yeh saari baatein us wajah se hain ke yeh (shuroo mein bazahir) iman le aaye phir unhon ne kufr apna liya us liye un ke dilon par mehar laga di gayi, nateeja yeh ke yeh log (haqq baat) samajhte hi nahin hain.

Jab tum un ko dekho to un ke deel dol tumhein bohat achhe lagen, aur agar woh baat karen to tum un ki baatein sunte reh jao, un ki misal aisi hai jaise yeh lakriyan hain jo kisi sahare se laga rkhi hain, yeh har cheekh pukar ko apne khilaf samajhte hain. Yehi hain jo (tumhare) dushman hain, us liye un se hoshiyaar raho. Allah ki maar ho un par. Yeh kahan ondhe chale jarahe hain ?

Aur jab un se kaha jata hai ke aao, Allah ke Rasool tumhare haqq mein magfirat ki dua karen, to yeh apne siron ko matkate hain, aur tum unhein dekho ge ke woh bare ghamand ke aalam mein byrukhi se kaam lete hain.

(ae payghumbar) un ke haqq mein dono baatein barabar hain, chahaye tum un ke liye magfirat ki dua karo ya na karo, Allah unhein hargiz nahin bakshe ga, yaqeen jaano Allah aise nafarman logon ko hidayat tak nahin pahunchata.

Yehi to hain jo kehte hain ke jo log Rasool Allah ke paas hain un par kuchh kharch na karo, yahan tak ke yeh khud hi muntashir hojayen ge, halaanke aasmanon aur zameen ke tamam khazane Allah hi ke hain, lekin munafiq log samajhte nahin hain.

Kehte hain ke : agar hum madina ko lot kar jayen ge to jo izzat wala hai, woh wahan se zillat wale ko nikal bahar kare ga, halaanke izzat to Allah hi ko hasil hai aur us ke Rasool ko, aur iman walon ko, lekin munafiq log nahin jante.
Ae iman walo ! Tumhari daulat aur tumhari aulad tumhein Allah ki yaad se ghafil na karne payen. Aur jo log aisa karen ge, woh bare ghate ka sauda karne wale hon ge.

Aur hum ne tumhein jo rizq diya hai us mein se (Allah ke hukum ke mutabiq) kharch karlo, qabl us ke ke tum mein se kisi ke paas maut aajaye to woh yeh kahe ke : ae mere Parwardigar ! To ne mujhe thori dair ke liye aur mohlat kyun na de di ke mein khoob sadqa karta, aur nek logon mein shamil hojata.
Aur jab kisi shaks ka moyyen waqt aajaye ga to Allah use hargiz mohlat nahin de ga, aur jo kuchh tum karte ho, Allah us se poori tarah bakhabar hai.
Aasmanon aur zameen mein jo cheez bhi hai woh Allah ki tasbeeh karti hai, aur baadshahi usi ki hai, aur tareef usi ki, aur woh har cheez par poori qudrat rakhta hai.
Wahi hai jis ne tumhein paida kiya, phir tum mein se koi kafir hai, aur koi momin, aur jo kuchh tum karte ho, Allah use khoob dekhta hai.
Us ne aasmanon aur zameen ko barhaqq paida kiya hai, aur tumhari soorten banaee hain aur tumhari soorten achhi banaee hain, aur usi ki taraf aakhir kaar (sab ko) palat kar jana hai.

Aasmanon aur zameen mein jo kuchh hai, woh use jaanta hai, aur jo kuchh tum cahahap kar karte ho aur jo kuchh khullam khla karte ho, us ka bhi use poora ilm hai, aur Allah dilon ki baaton tak ka khoob janne wala hai.
Kya tumhare paas un logon ke waqiyaat nahin pahunche jinhon ne pehle kufr ikhtiyar kya tha, phir apne kaamon ka wabal chkha, aur (aainda) un ke hisse mein ek dardnaak azab hai ?

Yeh sab kuchh us liye hua ke un ke paas un ke payghumbar roshan dalail le kar aate the to woh kehte the ke : kya (hum jaise) insan hain jo humein hidayat den ge ? Garz unhon ne kufr ikhtiyar kya aur moonh mora, aur Allah ne bhi beniazi barti, aur Allah bilkul bey-niaz hai bzat khud qabil tareef.

Jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai, woh yeh doi karte hain ke unhein kabhi dobara zinda nahin kya jaye ga. Keh do : kyun nahin ? Mere Parwardigar ki qasam ! Tumhein zaroor zinda kya jaye ga, phir tumhein bataya jaye ga ke tum ne kya kuchh kya tha, aur yeh Allah ke liye mamooli si baat hai.
Lihaza Allah par aur us ke Rasool par aur us roshni par iman lao jo hum ne nazil ki hai, aur tum jo kuchh karte ho, Allah us se poori tarah bakhabar hai.

(yeh dusri zindagi) us din (hogi) jab Allah tumhein roz hashar mein aktha kare ga. Woh aisa din hoga jis mein kuchh log dusron ko hasrat mein daal den ge. Aur jo shaks Allah par iman laya hoga, aur us ne nek amal kiye hon ge, Allah us ke gunahon ko maaf karde ga, aur us ko aise baaghon mein dakhil kare ga jin ke niche nehrein behti hon gi, jin mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen ge. Yeh hai bari kamiyabi.
Aur jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyar kiya hoga, aur hamari aayaton ko jhutlaya hoga woh dozakh wale hon ge jis mein woh hamesha rahen ge aur woh bohat bura thikana hai.
Koi museebat Allah ke hukum ke baghair nahin aati, aur jo koi Allah par iman laata hai woh us ke dil ko hidayat bakshta hai, aur Allah har cheez ko khoob janne wala hai.
Aur tum Allah ki farmanbardari karo, aur Rasool ki farmanbardari karo. Phir agar tum ne moonh mora to humare Rasool ki zma daari sirf yeh hai ke woh saaf saaf baat pahuncha de.
Allah woh hai jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin hai, aur momino ko Allah hi par bharosa karna chahiye.

Ae iman walo ! Tumhari biwiyon aur tumhari aulad mein se kuchh tumhare dushman hain, us liye un se hoshiyaar raho. Aur agar tum maaf kardo aur darguzar karo, aur baksh do to Allah bohat bakhshne wala, bohat meharban hai.
Tumhare maal aur tumhari aulad to tumhare liye ek aazmaish hain. Aur woh Allah hi hai jis ke paas bara ajar hai.

Lihaza jahan tak tum se hosake Allah se darte raho, aur suno aur mano aur (Allah ke hukum ke mutabiq) kharch karo, yeh tumhare hi liye behtar hai, aur jo log apne dil ki lalach se mehfooz hojayen, wahi falaah pane wale hain.
Agar tum Allah ko achhi tarah qarz do ge to Allah tumhare liye us ko kaee gunaa barha de ga, aur tumhare gunaah baksh de ga, aur Allah bara qadardaan, bohat burdbaar hai.
Woh har bhed ka aur har khuli hui cheez ka janne wala hai, bare iqtedar ka, bari hikmat ka maalik.

Ae nabi ! Jab tum log aurton ko talaq dene lago to unhein un ki iddat ke waqt talaq do , aur iddat ko achhi tarah shumar karo aur Allah se daro jo tumhara Parwardigar hai, un aurton ko un ke gharon se na nikalo, aur na woh khud niklen illa yeh ke woh kisi khuli behiaii ka irteqab karen, aur yeh Allah ki (muqarrar ki hui) hudood hain aur jo koi Allah ki (muqarrar ki hui) hudood se aage nikle, us ne khud apni jaan par zulm kiya, tum nahin jante, shayad Allah us ke baad koi naee baat paida karde.

Phir jab woh aurten apni (iddat ki) miyad ko pahunchne lagen to tum ya to unhein bhale tareeqe par (apne nikah mein) rok rakho, ya phir bhale tareeqe se un ko alag kardo, aur apne mein se do aise aadmiyon ko gawah bana lo jo adal wale hon. Aur Allah ki khatir seedhi seedhi gawahi do , logo ! Yeh woh baat hai jis ki naseehat us shaks ko ki jarhi hai jo Allah par aur yaum aakhirat par iman rakhta ho, aur jo koi Allah se dare ga Allah us ke liye mushkil se nikalne ka koi raasta paida karde ga.

Aur use aisi jagah se rizq ata kare ga jahan se use gumaan bhi nahin hoga. Aur jo koi Allah par bharosa kare, to Allah us (ka kaam banane) ke liye kafi hai. Yaqeen rakho ke Allah apna kaam poora kar ke rehta hai. (albatta) Allah ne har cheez ka ek andaza muqarrar kar rakhha hai.

Aur tumhari aurton mein se jo mahwari aane se mayous hochuki hon agar tumhein (un ki iddat ke bare mein) shakk ho to (yaad rakho ke) un ki iddat teen mahine hai, aur un aurton ki (iddat) bhi (yehi hai) jinhen abhi mahwari aayi hi nahin, aur jo aurten hamila hon, un ki (iddat ki) miyad yeh hai ke woh apne pait ka bcha jin len. Aur jo koi Allah se dare ga, Allah us ke kaam mein aasani paida karde ga.
Yeh Allah ka hukum hai jo us ne tum par utara hai, aur jo koi Allah se dare ga, Allah us ke gunahon ko maaf karde ga, aur us ko zabardast sawab de ga.

Un aurton ko apni haisiyat ke mutabiq usi jagah rehaeesh muhaiyya karo jahan tum rehte ho aur unhein tangg karne ke liye unhein satao nahin, aur agar woh hamila hon to un ko us waqt tak nafqa dete raho jab tak woh apne pait ka bcha jin len. Phir agar woh tumhare liye bache ko doodh pilayein to unhein un ki ujrat ada karo, aur (ujrat muqarrar karne ke liye) aapas mein bhale tareeqe se baat tai karliya karo, aur agar tum ek dusre ke liye mushkil paida karo ge to use koi aur aurat doodh pilaye gi.

Har wusat rakhne wala apni wusat ke mutabiq nafqa de. Aur jis shaks ke liye us ka rizq tangg kardiya gaya ho, to jo kuchh Allah ne use diya hai woh usi mein se nafqa de, Allah ne kisi ko jitna diya hai, us par us se ziyada ka bojh nahin daalta. Koi mushkil ho to Allah us ke baad koi aasani bhi paida karde ga.

Aur kitni hi bastiyan aisi hain jinhon ne apne Parwardigar aur us ke rasoolon ke hukum se sarkashi ki to hum ne un ka sakht hisab liya, aur unhein saza di, aisi buri saza jo unhon ne pehle kabhi na dikhi thi.
Chunanche unhon ne apne aemaal ka wabal chkha, aur un ke aemaal ka aakhri anjaam nuksan hi nuksan hua.
(aur aakhirat mein) hum ne un ke liye ek sakht azab tayyar kar rakhha hai. Lihaza ae aqal walo jo iman le aaye ho, Allah se darte raho. Allah ne tumhare paas ek sarapa naseehat bheji hai.

Yani woh Rasool jo tumhare samne roshni dene wali Allah ki aayaten parh kar sunate hain, taake jo log iman laye hain aur jinhon ne nek amal kiye hain un ko andheron se nikal kar roshni mein le aayein, aur jo shaks Allah par iman le aaye, aur nek amal kare, Allah us ko aise baghaat mein dakhil kare ga jin ke niche nehrein behti hon gi, jahan jannati log hamesha hamesha rahen ge. Allah ne aise shaks ke liye behtareen rizq tai kardiya hai.

Allah woh hai jis ne saat aasman paida kiye, aur zameen bhi unhi ki tarah Allah ka hukum un ke darmiyan utarta rehta hai, taake tumhein maloom hojaye ke Allah har cheez par poori qudrat rakhta hai aur yeh ke Allah ke ilm ne har cheez ka ahata kiya hua hai.
Ae nabi ! Jo cheez Allah ne tumhare liye halal ki hai, tum apni biwiyon ki khushnudi hasil karne ke liye use kyun haram karte ho ? Aur Allah bohat bakhshne wala, bohat meharban hai.
Allah ne tumhari qasmon se nikalne ka tareeqa muqarrar kardiya hai, aur Allah tumhara kaarsaaz hai aur wahi hai jis ka ilm bhi kamil hai, hikmat bhi kamil.

Aur yaad karo jab nabi ne apni kisi biwi se raaz ke tor par ek baat kahi thi. Phir jab us biwi ne woh baat kisi aur ko batla di, aur Allah ne yeh baat nabi par zaahir kardi to us ne us ka kuchh hissa jtla diya aur kuchh hisse ko taal gaye. Phir jab unhon ne us biwi ko woh baat jtlaii to woh kehne lagen ke : aap ko yeh baat kis ne batayi ? Nabi ne kaha ke : mujhe us ne batayi jo bare ilm wala, bohat bakhabar hai.

(ae nabi ki biwiyo) agar tum Allah ke huzoor toubah karlo (to yehi munasib hai) kyunke tum dono ke d l maeel hogaye hain, aur agar nabi ke muqable mein tum ne ek dusri ki madad ki, to (yaad rakho ke) un ka sathi Allah hai aur jibrael hain aur nek musalman hain, aur us ke laoa farishte un ke madadgar hain.

Agar woh tumhein talaq de den to un ke Parwardigar ko us baat mein dair nahin lage gi ke woh un ko (tumhare) badle mein aisi biwiyan ata farma de jo tum sab se behtar hon, musalman, iman wali, itaat shiaar, toubah karne wali, ibadat guzar aur roza daar hon, chahaye pehle un ke shohar rahe hon, ya kunwari hon.

Ae iman walo ! Apne aap ko aur apne ghar walon ko us aag se bachao jis ka indhan insan aur pathar hon ge us par sakht kare mzaj ke farishte muqarrar hain jo Allah ke kisi hukum mein us ki nafarmani nahin karte, aur wahi karte hain jis ka unhein hukum diya jata hai.
Ae kufr ikhtiyar karne walo ! Aaj maazratein pesh mat karo, tumhein unhi aemaal ka badla diya jaraha hai jo tum kiya karte the.

Ae iman walo ! Allah ke huzoor sachi toubah karo, kuchh baeed nahin ke tumhara Parwardigar tumhari buraiyan tum se jhaar de, aur tumhein aise baghaat mein dakhil karde jin ke niche nehrein behti hain, us din jab Allah nabi ko aur jo log un ke saath iman laye hain un ko ruswa nahin kare ga. Un ka noor un ke aage aur un ki dayen taraf dor raha hoga. Woh keh rahe hon ge ke : ae humare Parwardigar ! Humare liye us noor ko mukammal krdijie aur hamari magfirat farma dijiye. Yaqeenan aap har cheez par poori qudrat rakhne wale hain.
Ae nabi ! Kafiron aur munafiqon se jihad karo aur un ke muqable mein sakht hojao. Aur un ka thikana jahannam hai aur woh bohat bura thikana hai.

Jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai, Allah un ke liye nooh ki biwi aur loot ki biwi ko misal ke tor par pesh karta hai. Yeh dono humare do aise bandon ke nikah mein thin jo bohat nek the. Phir unhon ne un ke saath beofaii ki, to woh dono Allah ke muqable mein un ke kuchh bhi kaam nahin aaye aur (un biwiyon se) kaha gaya ke : dusre jane walon ke saath tum bhi jahannam mein chali jao.

Aur jin logon ne iman ikhtiyar kiya hai un ke liye Allah, Firaun ki biwi ko misal ke tor par pesh karta hai. Jab us ne kaha tha ke : mere Parwardigar mere liye apne paas jannat mein ek ghar bana de, aur mujhe Firaun aur us ke amal se nijat de, aur mujhe zalim logon se bhi nijat ata farma.

Neiz imran ki beti marium ko (misal ke tor par pesh karta hai) jinhon ne apni ismat ki hifazat ki, to hum ne us mein apni rooh phonk di, aur unhon ne apne Parwardigar ki baaton aur us ki kitabon ki tasdeeq ki, aur woh itaat shiaar logon mein shamil thin.
Bari shaan hai us zaat ki jis ke haath mein saari baadshahi hai aur woh har cheez par poori tarah qadir hai.
Jis ne maut aur zindagi us liye paida ki taake woh tumhein aazmaye ke tum mein se kaun amal mein ziyada behtar hai, aur wahi hai jo mukammal iqtedar ka maalik, bohat bakhshne wala hai.
Jis ne saat aasman upar tale paida kiye, tum khuda Rahman ki takhleeq mein koi farq nahin pao ge. Ab phir se nazar dora kar dekho kya tumhein koi rakhna nazar aata hai ?
Phir baar baar nazar dora, nateeja yehi hoga ke nazar tahaka haar kar tumhare paas na-murad lot aaye gi.
Aur hum ne qareeb wale aasman ko roshan chiraagon se saja rakhha hai, aur un ko shetanon par pathar barsane ka zria bhi banaya hai, aur un ke liye dehakti aag ka azab tayyar kar rakhha hai.
Aur jin logon ne apne Parwardigar se kufr ka mamla kiya hai, un ke liye jahannam ka azab hai, aur woh bohat bura thikana hai.
Jab woh us mein dale jayen ge to us ke dhar ne ki aawaz sunen ge, ao woh josh maarti hogi.
Aisa lage ga jaise woh gusse se pahata pare gi. Jab bhi us mein (kafiron ka) koi giroh phinka jaye ga to us ke muhafiz un se poochen ge ke kya tumhare paas koi khabardar karne wala nahin aaya tha ?

Woh kahin ge ke haan be-shak humare paas khabardar karne wala aaya tha, magar hum ne (use) jhutla diya, aur kaha ke : Allah ne kuchh nazil nahin kiya, tumhari haqeeqat us ke siwa kuchh nahin ke tum bari bhari gumrahi mein pare hue ho.
Aur woh kahin ge ke : agar hum sunn liya karte aur samajh se kaam liya karte to (aaj) dozakh walon mein shamil na hote.
Us tarah woh apne gunaah ka khud aitraaf karlen ge. Garz phtkar hai dozakh walon par.
(us ke bar-khilaf) jo log bann dikhe apne Parwardigar se darte hain, un ke liye be-shak magfirat aur bara ajar hai.
Aur tum apni baat chhpa kar karo, ya zoar se karo (sab us ke ilm mein hai, kyunke) woh dilon tak ki baaton ka poora ilm rakhne wala hai.
Bhala jis ne paida kya wahi na jane ? Jabke woh bohat bareek been, mukammal tor par bakhabar hai.
Wahi hai jis ne tumhare liye zameen ko ram kardiya hai, lihaza tum us ke mondhon par chalo phro, aur us ka rizq kha, aur usi ke paas dobara zinda ho kar jana hai.
Kya tum aasman wale ki us baat se bekhof ho bithe ho ke woh tumhein zameen mein dhansa de, to woh ek dum tahara thrane lage ?
Ya kya tum aasman wale ki us baat se bekhof ho bithe ho ke woh tum par pathron ki baarish barsa ? Phir tumhein pata chale ga ke mera darana kaisa tha ?
Aur un se pehle jo log the, unhon ne bhi (payghumbaron ko) jhutlaya tha. Phir (dekh lo ke) mera azab kaisa tha ?

Aur kiya unhon ne parindon ko apne upar nazar atha kar nahin dekha ke woh paron ko philaie hue hote hain, aur sameit bhi lete hain. Un ko khuda Rahman ke siwa koi thame hue nahin hai. Yaqeenan woh har cheez ki khoob dekh bhaal karne wala hai.
Bhala khuda Rahman ke siwa woh kaun hai jo tumhara lashkar bann kar tumhari madad kare ? Kafir log to nire dhoke mein pare hue hain.
Agar woh apna rizq bandh karde to bhala woh kaun hai jo tumhein rizq ata karsake ? Us ke bawajood woh sarkashi aur bezari par jame hue hain.
Bhala jo shaks apne moonh ke bal ondha chal raha ho, woh manzil tak ziyada pahunchne wala hoga ya woh jo ek seedhe raaste par seedha seedha chal raha ho ?
Keh do ke : wahi hai jis ne tumhein paida kiya, aur tumhare liye kaan aur aankhein aur dil banaye. (magar) tum log shukar thora hi karte ho.
Keh do ke : wahi hai jis ne tumhein zameen mein philaia, aur usi ke paas tumhein aktha kar ke le jaya jaye ga.
Aur yeh log kehte hain ke : agar tum sache ho to batao ke yeh wada kab poora hoga ?
Keh do ke : us ka ilm to sirf Allah ke paas hai, aur mein to bas saaf saaf tareeqe par khabardar karne wala hon.
Phir jab woh us (qayamat ke azab) ko paas aata dekh len ge to kafiron ke chehre bigar jayen ge, aur kaha jaye ga ke : yeh hai woh cheez jo tum maanga karte the.

(ae payghumbar ! Un se) kaho ke : zara yeh batlao ke chahaye Allah mujhe aur mere saathiyon ko halaak karde ya hum par reham farma de, (dono suraton mein) kafiron ko dardnaak azab se kaun bachaye ga ?
Keh do ke : woh Rahman hai, hum us par iman laye hain, aur usi par hum ne bharosa kiya hai. Chunanche anqareeb tumhein pata chal jaye ga ke kaun hai jo khuli gumrahi mein mubtila hai.
Keh do ke : zara yeh batlao ke agar kisi subah tumhara pani niche ko utar kar gayab hojaye to kaun hai jo tumhein chashme se ubalta hua pani lakr de ?
Noon
Apne Parwardigar ke fazal se tum deewane nahin ho.
Aur yaqeen jaano tumhare liye aisa ajar hai jo kabhi khatam nahin hoga.
Aur yaqeenan tum akhlaq ke ali darje par ho.
Chunanche tum bhi dekh lo ge aur yeh log bhi dekh len ge.
Ke tum mein se kaun deewangi mein mubtila hai.
Yaqeenan tumhara Parwardigar use bhi khoob jaanta hai jo apne raaste se bhatak gaya hai aur un logon ko bhi khoob jaanta hai jinhon ne seedhi raah paali hai.
Lihaza tum un ki baaton mein na aana jo (tumhein) jhutla rahe hain.
Yeh chahte hain ke tum dheele prja to yeh bhi dheele prjaiin.
Aur kisi bhi aise shaks ki baaton mein na aana jo bohat qasmen khane wala, beoqt shaks hai.
Taane dene ka aadi hai, chugliyan lagata phrta hai.
Bhalayi se roakne wala, zyadati karne wala, bad amal hai.
Bad mzaj hai aur us ke laoa nchle nasab wala bhi.
Sirf us wajah se ke woh bare maal aur aulad wala hai.
Jab us ke samne hamari aayaten parh kar sunayi jati hain to woh kehta hai ke yeh pichle logon ki kahaniyan hain.
Anqareeb hum us ki sund par daag laga den ge.
Hum ne un (makkah walon) ko usi tarah aazmaish mein dala hai jaise (ek) baagh walon ko us waqt aazmaish mein dala tha jab unhon ne qasam khaii thi ke subah hote hi hum us baagh ka pahala tor len ge.
Aur yeh (kehte hue) woh koi istasna nahin kar rahe the.
Phir hua yeh ke jis waqt woh so rahe the, us waqt tumhare Parwardigar ki taraf se ek bula us baagh par phira laga gayi.
Jis se woh baagh subah ko kati hui khiti ki tarah hogaya.
Phir subah hote hi unhon ne ek dusre ko aawaz di.
Ke agar pahala toryne hain to apne khit ki taraf sawere chal niklo.
Chunanche woh ek dusre se chupke chupke yeh kehte hue roana hue.
Ke aaj koi miskeen tumhare paas us baagh mein na aane paye.
Aur woh bare zoron mein tez tez chalte hue nikle.
Phir jab us baagh ko dekha to kehne lage ke : hum zaroor raasta bhatak gaye hain.
(phir kuchh dair baad ke baad kaha ke) nahin bulke hum sab lata gaye hain.
Un mein jo shaks sab se achha tha, woh kehne laga : kya mein ne tum se nahin kaha tha ke tum tasbeeh kyun nahin karte ?
Kehne lage : hum apne Parwardigar ki tasbeeh karte hain, yaqeenan hum zalim the.
Phir ek dusre ki taraf mutawajja ho kar ek dusre ko malamat karne lage.
(phir) sab ne (matafaq hoker) kaha ke : afsos hai hum sab par ! Yaqeenan hum sab ne sarkashi ikhtiyar karli thi.
Kiya baeed hai ke hamara Parwardigar humein us baagh ke badle us se achha ata farma. Be-shak hum apne Parwardigar ki taraf rujoo karte hain.
Azab aisa hi hota hai aur aakhirat ka azab yaqeenan sab se bara hai. Kaash yeh log jante.
Albatta muttaqiyon ke liye un ke Parwardigar ke paas nematon bhare baghaat hain.
Bhala kya hum frmanbrdaron ko mujreemon ke barabar karden ge ?
Tumhein kya hogaya hai ? Tum kaisi baatein tai krlite ho ?
Kiya tumhare paas koi kitab hai jis mein tum yeh parhte ho.
Ke tumhein wahan wahi kuchh mile ga jo tum pasand karo ge ?
Ya tum ne hum se qayamat ke din tak baqi rehne wali qasmen le rkhi hain ke tumhein wahi kuchh mile ga jo tum tai karo ge ?
(ae payghumbar) un se pochho ke : un mein se kaun hai jis ne us baat ki zmant le rkhi ho ?
Kya khudayi mein un ke maane hue kuchh shareek hain (jo yeh zmant lete hon ?) to phir le aayein apne un shareekon ko, agar woh sache hain.
Jis din saq khol di jaye gi, aur un ko sajde ke liye bulaya jaye ga to yeh sajda kar nahin saken ge.
Un ki nigahen jhuki hui hon gi, un par zillat chhaii hui hogi. Us waqt bhi unhein sajde ke liye bulaya jata tha jab yeh log sahih saalim the (us waqt qudrat ke bawajood yeh inkar karte the)
Lihaza (ae payghumbar) jo log us kalaam ko jhutla rahe hain unhein mujh par chhor do . Hum unhein us tarah dhire dhire (tabahi ki taraf) le jayen ge ke unhein pata bhi nahin chale ga.
Aur mein unhein dheel de raha hon. Yaqeen rakho meri tadbeer bari mazboot hai.
Kya tum un se koi ujrat maang rahe ho ke woh tawaan ke bojh se dabe jarahe hain ?
Ya un ke paas gaib ka ilm hai jise woh lakaha rahe hon ?
Garz tum apne Parwardigar ka hukum aane tak sabar kiye jao, aur machli wale ki tarah mat hojana. Jab unhon ne ghum se gahata gahata kar (humein) pukara tha.
Agar un ke Parwardigar ke fazal ne unhein samnbhal na liya hota to unhein buri halat ke saath usi khle maidan mein phink diya jata.
Phir un ke Parwardigar ne unhein muntakhab farma liya, aur unhein saliheen mein shamil kardiya.
Jin logon ne kufr apna liya hai jab woh naseehat ki yeh baat sunte hain to aisa lagta hai ke yeh apni (tez tez) aankhon se tumhein dagmaga den ge, aur woh kehte hain ke yeh shaks to dioana hai.
Halaanke yeh to duniya jahaan ke logon ke liye ek naseehat hi naseehat hai.
Woh haqeeqat ho kar rahe gi.
Kya hai woh haqeeqat jo ho kar rahe gi ?
Aur tumhein kya pata ke woh haqeeqat kya hai jo ho kar rahe gi ?
Samood aur aad ki qaumon ne usi jhnjor daalne wali haqeeqat ko jhutlaya tha.
Nateeja yeh ke jo samood ke log the, woh (chinghar ki) aisi aafat se halaak kiye gaye jo hadd se ziyada (khaufnaak) thi.
Aur jo aad ke log the, unhein ek aisi beqabo toofaani hua se halaak kiya gaya.
Jise Allah ne un par saat raat aur aath din lagataar musallat rakhha. Chunanche tum (agar wahan hote to) dekhte ke woh log wahan khajoor ke khokhle tano ki tarah pchhare hue pare the.
Ab kya un mein se koi bacha hua nazar aata hai ?
Aur Firaun aur us se pehle ke logon ne aur (loot (alh alh-e-salam) ki) ulti hui bastiyon ne bhi usi jurm ka irteqab kiya tha.
Ke unhon ne apne Parwardigar ke payghumbar ki nafarmani ki thi, us liye Allah ne unhein sakht pakar mein le liya.
Jab pani tughyani par aaya to hum ne tumhein kashti mein sawar kardiya.
Taake hum us waqiye ko tumhare liye sabaq aamoz banadein aur yaad rakhne wale kaan use (sunn kar) yaad rakhen.
Phir jab ek hi dfa soor mein phonk maar di jaye gi.
Aur zameen aur paharon ko atha kar ek hi zarb mein riza riza kardiya jaye ga.
To us din woh waqa pesh aajaye ga jise pesh aana hai.
Aur aasman pahata phre ga aur woh us din bilkul boda prjaie ga.
Aur farishte us ke kinaron par hon ge, aur tumhare Parwardigar ke arsh ko us din aath farishte apne upar athaie hue hon ge.
Us din tumhari peshi usi tarah hogi ke tumhari koi chhpi hui cheez chhpi nahin rahe gi.
Phir jis kisi ko us ka aemaal nama us ke dayen haath mein diya jaye ga. Woh kahe ga ke : logo ! Lo yeh mera aemaal nama parho.
Mein pehle hi samajhta tha ke mujhe apne hisab ka saamna karna hoga.
Chunanche woh mann pasand aish mein hoga.
Us unchi jannat mein
Jis ke pahala jhuke parr rahe hon ge.
(kaha jaye ga ke) apne un aemaal ke sile mein maze se kha piyo, jo tum ne guzre hue dino mein kiye the.
Raha woh shaks jis ka aemaal nama us ke bayein haath mein diya jaye ga to woh kahe ga ke : ae kaash ! Mujhe mera aemaal diya hi na jata.
Aur mujhe khabar bhi na hoti ke mera hisab kya hai ?
Ae kaash ! Ke meri maut hi par mera kaam tamam hojata.
Mera maal mere kuchh kaam na aaya.
Mera sara zoar mujh se jata raha.
(aise shaks ke bare mein hukum hoga) pakro use, aur us ke gale mein toq daal do .
Phir use dozakh mein jhonk do .
Phir use aisi zanjeer mein pro do jis ki paymaish satter haath ke barabar ho.
Yeh na to khuda buzurg o bartar par iman laata tha.
Aur na gareeb ko khana khilane ki targeeb deta tha.
Lihaza aaj yahan na us ka koi yaro madadgar hai.
Aur na us ko koi khane ki cheez muyassar hai. Siwaye ghslin ke.
Jise gunehgaron ke siwa koi nahin kahe ga.
Ab mein qasam khata hon us ki bhi jise tum dekhte ho.
Aur us ki bhi jise tum nahin dekhte.
Ke yeh (quran) ek muazzaz paygham lane wale ka kalaam hai.
Aur yeh kisi shayar ka kalaam nahin hai. (magar) tum iman thora hi late ho.
Aur na yeh kisi kaahin ka kalaam hai. (magar) tum sabaq thora hi lete ho.
Yeh kalaam tamam jahano ke Parwardigar ki taraf se utara jaraha hai.
Aur agar (bil-farz) yeh payghumbar kuchh (jhooti) baatein bana kar hamari taraf mansoob kardete.
To hum un ka dahana haath pakar te.
Phir hum un ki sha raga kaat dete.
Phir tum mein se koi na hota jo un ke bachao ke liye aare sakta.
Aur yaqeen jaano ke yeh perhezgaron ke liye ek naseehat hai.
Aur humein khoob maloom hai ke tum mein kuchh log jhutlane wale bhi hain.
Aur yeh (quran) aise kafiron ke liye hasrat ka sabab hai.
Aur yehi woh yaqeeni baat hai jo sarasar haqq hai.
Lihaza tum apne Parwardigar ke azmat wale naam ki tasbeeh karte raho.
Ek maangne wale ne woh azab maanga hai
Jo kafiron par aane wala hai koi nahin hai jo use rok sake.
Woh Allah ki taraf se aaye ga jo charhne ke tamam raaston ka maalik hai.
Farishte aur rooh alqds us ki taraf ek aise din mein charh kar jate hain jis ki miqdar pachhas hazar saal hai.
Lihaza tum khobsorti ke saath sabar se kaam lo.
Yeh log use door samajh rahe hain.
Aur hum use qareeb dekh rahe hain.
(woh azab) us din hoga jab aasman tel ki talchat ki tarah hojaye ga.
Aur pahar rangeen roii ki tarah hojayen ge.
Aur koi jigri dost kisi jigri dost ko pochhe ga bhi nahin.
Halaanke woh ek dusre ko dkha bhi diye jayen ge. Mujrim yeh chahaye ga ke us din ke azab se chootne ke liye apne bete fdia mein de.
Aur apni biwi aur apna bhai
Aur apna woh khandaan jo use panaah deta tha.
Aur zameen ke sare ke sare bashinde. Phir (un sab ko fdia mein de kar) apne aap ko bacha le.
(lekin) aisa hargiz nahin hosake ga. Woh to ek bharakti hui aag hai.
Jo khal utaar le gi.
Har us shaks ko bulaye gi jis ne pith phir kar moonh mora hoga.
Aur (maal) aktha kiya hoga phir use seint seint kar rakhha hoga.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke insan bohat kam hausla paida kiya gaya hai.
Jab use koi takleef pahunchti hai to bohat ghabra jata hai.
Aur jab us ke paas khushali aati hai to bohat bakheel bann jata hai.
Magar woh namazi aise nahin hain.
Jo apni namaz ki hamesha pabandi karte hain.
Aur jin ke maal o daulat mein ek mutayin haqq hai.
Sawali aur besoali ka
Aur jo roz jza ko barhaqq maante hain.
Aur jo apne Parwardigar ke zaba se shme rehte hain.
Yaqeenan un ke Parwardigar ka azab aisi cheez nahin hai jis se befkri barti jaye.
Aur jo apni sharmgaahon ki (aur sab se) hifazat karte hain.
Siwaye apni biwiyon aur un bandion ke jo un ki milkiyat mein chuki hon, kyunke aise logon par koi malamat nahin hai.
Albatta jo log un ke laoa koi aur tareeqa ikhtiyar karna chahein woh hadd se guzre hue log hain.
Aur jo apni amanaton aur ahad ka paas rakhne wale hain.
Aur jo apni gawahiyan theek theek dene wale hain.
Aur jo apni namaz ki poori poori hifazat karne wale hain.
Woh log hain jo jannaton mein izzat ke saath rahen ge.
To (ae payghumbar) un kafiron ko kiya hogaya ke yeh tumhari taraf charhe chale aarahe hain.
Dayen taraf se bhi aur bayein taraf se bhi, tolian bana bana kar.
Kya un mein se har shaks ko yeh lalach hai ke use nematon wali jannat mein dakhil kya jaye ?
Hargiz aisa nahin hoga hum ne un ko us cheez se paida kiya hai jise yeh khud jante hain.
Ab mein qasam khata hon un tamam muqamaat ke maalik ki jahan se sitare nikalte aur jahan se ghuroob hote hain ke hum yaqeenan us baat par qadir hain.
Ke un ki jagah un se behtar log le aayein, aur koi humein hara nahin sakta.
Lihaza tum unhein chhor do ke yeh apni behoda baaton mein munhamik aur khil kood mein parr rahen, yahan tak ke apne us din se jaa milen jis ka un se wada kiya jaraha hai.
Jis din yeh jaldi jaldi qabron se us tarah niklen ge jaise apne buthon ki taraf dore jarahe hon.
Un ki nigahen jhuki hui hon gi, zillat un par chhaii hui hogi. Yeh wahi din hoga jis ka un se wada kiya jaraha hai.
Hum ne nooh ko un ki qaum ke paas bheja ke apni qaum ko khabardar karo, qabl us ke ke un par koi dardnaak azab aakhra ho.
(chunanche) unhon ne (apni qaum se) kaha ke : ae meri qaum ! Mein tumhare liye ek saaf saaf khabardar karne wala hon.
Ke Allah ki ibadat karo, aur us se daro, aur mera kehna mano.

Allah tumhare gunahon ki magfirat farmaye ga, aur tumhein ek muqarrar waqt tak baqi rkhe ga. Be-shak jab Allah ka muqarrar kiya hua waqt aajata hai to phir woh mokhr nahin hota. Kaash ke tum samajhte hote.
(phir) nooh ne (Allah taalaa se) kaha ke : mere Parwardigar ! Mein ne apni qaum ko raat din (haqq ki) dawat di hai.
Lekin meri dawat ka us ke siwa koi nateeja nahin hua ke woh aur ziyada bhagne lage.

Aur mein ne jab bhi unhein dawat di, taake aap un ki magfirat farmaeen to unhon ne apni ungliyan apne kaano mein de len, apne kapre apne ae wapara lapet liye, apni baat par arr rahe, aur takabbur hi takabbur ka mzahra karte rahe.
Phir mein ne unhein pukar pukar kar dawat di
Phir mein ne un se lania bhi baat ki, aur chupke chupke bhi samjhaya.
Chunanche mein ne kaha ke : apne Parwardigar se magfirat maango, yaqeen jaano woh bohat bakhshne wala hai.
Woh tum par aasman se khoob baarishein barsaye ga.
Aur tumhare maal aur aulad mein taraqqi de ga, aur tumhare liye baghaat paida kare ga, aur tumhari khatir nehrein muhaiyya karde ga.
Tumhein kya hogaya hai ke tum Allah ki azmat se bilkul nahin darte ?
Halaanke us ne tumhein takhleeq ke mukhtalif mrhlon se guzar kar paida kiya hai
Kya tum ne yeh nahin dekha ke Allah ne kis tarah saat aasman upar tale paida farmaye hain ?
Aur un mein chand ko noor bana kar aur suraj ko chiraag bana kar paida kiya hai.
Aur Allah ne tumhein zameen se behtareen tareeqe par ugaya hai.
Phir woh tumhein dobara usi mein bhej de ga, aur (wahin se phir) bahar nikal khra kare ga.
Aur Allah ne hi tumhare liye zameen ko ek farsh banadiya hai.
Taake tum us ke khle hue raaston par chalo.

Nooh ne kaha : ae mere Parwardigar ! Haqeeqat yeh hai ke un logon ne mera kehna nahin maana, aur un (sardaron) ke peechhe chal pare jin ko un ke maal aur aulad ne nuksan pahunchane ke siwa kuchh nahin diya.
Aur unhon ne bari bhari makkari se kaam liya hai.
Aur (apne aadmiyon se) kaha hai ke : apne maboodon ko hargiz mat chorna. Na wad aur suwaa ko kisi surat mein chorna, aur na yaghoos, yaooq aur nasar ko chorna.
Us tarah unhon ne bohat son ko gumraah kardiya hai, lihaza (ya rubb) aap bhi un ko gumrahi ke siwa kisi aur cheez mein taraqqi na dijiye.
Un logon ke gunahon ki wajah hi se unhein garq kiya gaya, phir aag mein dakhil kiya gaya, aur unhein Allah ko chhor kar koi himayati muyassar nahin aaye.
Aur nooh ne yeh bhi kaha ke : mere Parwardigar ! Un kafiron mein se koi ek bashnda bhi zameen par baqi na rkhie.
Agar aap un ko baqi rakhen ge to yeh aap ke bandon ko gumraah karen ge, aur un se jo aulad paida hogi woh badhkaar aur kafir hi paida hogi.

Mere Parwardigar ! Meri bhi bakhsish farma dijiye, mere walidain ki bhi, har us shaks ki bhi jo mere ghar mein iman ki halat mein dakhil hua hai. Aur tamam momin mardon aur momin aurton ki bhi. Aur jo log zalim hain un ko tabahi ke siwa koi aur cheez ata na frmaie.
(ae payghumbar) keh do : mere paas wahee aayi hai ke jinnat ki ek jamat ne (quran) gaur se suna, aur (apni qaum se jakr) kaha ke : hum ne ek ajeeb quran suna hai.
Jo raah raast ki taraf rehnumayi karta hai, us liye hum us par iman le aaye hain, aur ab apne Parwardigar ke saath kisi ko (ibadat mein) hargiz shareek nahin manen ge.
Aur yeh ke : humare Parwardigar ki bohat unchi shaan hai, us ne na koi biwi rkhi hai, aur na koi beta.
Aur yeh ke : hum mein se bewaqoof log Allah ke bare mein aisi baatein kehte the jo haqeeqat se bohat door hain.
Aur yeh ke hum ne yeh samjha tha ke insan aur jinnat Allah ke bare mein jhooti baat nahin kahin ge.
Aur yeh ke : insano mein se kuchh log jinnat ke kuchh logon ki panaah liya karte the, us tarah un logon ne jinnat ko aur sar charha diya tha.
Aur yeh ke : jaisa gumaan tum logon ka tha, insano ne bhi yehi gumaan kiya tha ke Allah kisi ko bhi marne ke baad dusri zindagi nahin de ga.
Aur yeh ke : hum ne aasman ko ttolna chaha to hum ne paya ke woh bare sakht pehre daron aur sholon se bhara hua hai.
Aur yeh ke : hum pehle sunn gin lene ke liye aasman ki kuchh jaghon par jaa bitha karte the. Lekin ab jo koi sunna chahta hai woh dekhta hai ke ek shla us ki ghat mein laga hua hai.
Aur yeh ke : humein yeh pata nahin tha ke aaya zameen walon se koi bura mamla karne ka arada kiya gaya hai ya un ke Parwardigar ne un ko raah raast dikhane ka arada farmaya hai.
Aur yeh ke : hum mein kuchh nek hain, aur kuchh aise nahin hain aur hum mukhtalif tareeqon par chale aarahe hain.
Aur yeh ke : hum yeh samajh chuke hain ke na hum zameen mein Allah ko aajiz krskte hain aur na (kahin aur) bhaag kar use bus krskte hain.
Aur yeh ke : jab hum ne hidayat ki baat sunn li to hum us par iman le aaye. Chunanche jo koi apne Parwardigar par iman le aaye to us ko na kisi ghate ka andesha hoga, aur na kisi zyadati ka.
Aur yeh ke : hum mein se kuchh to musalman hogaye hain, aur hum mein se (ab bhi) kuchh zalim hain. Chunanche jo islam lachke hain, unhon ne hidayat ka raasta dhoond liya hai.
Aur rahe woh log jo zalim hain to woh jahannam ka indhan hain.
Aur (ae payghumbar ! Ehle makkah se kaho ke mujh par) yeh (wahee bhi aayi hai) ke : agar yeh log raaste par aaker seedhe hojayen to hum unhein waffir miqdar mein pani se sairaab karen.
Taake us ke zariye un ko aazmayein. Aur jo koi apne Parwardigar ki yaad se moonh more ga. Allah use charhte hue azab mein pro de ga.
Aur yeh ke : sajde to tamam tar Allah hi ka haqq hain. Us liye Allah ke saath kisi aur ki ibadat mat karo.
Aur yeh ke : jab Allah ka banda us ki ibadat karne ke liye kahara ahoa to aisa maloom hua jaise yeh log us par tote parr rahe hain.
Keh do ke : mein to sirf apne Parwardigar ki ibadat karta hon, aur us ke saath koi shareek nahin maanta.
Keh do ke : na tumhara koi nuksan mere ikhtiyar mein hai, aur na koi bhalayi.
Keh do ke : mujhe Allah se na koi bacha sakta hai aur na mein use chhor kar koi panaah ki jagah paskta hon.

Albatta (jis cheez par mujhe ikhtiyar diya gaya hai, woh) Allah ki taraf se baat pahuncha dena, aur us ke paigamaat hain. Aur jo koi Allah aur us ke Rasool ki nafarmani kare ga to us ke liye jahannam ki aag hai jis mein aise log hamesha hamesha rahen ge.

(aur yeh log nafarmani karte rahen ge) yahan tak ke jab woh cheez unhein nazar aajaye gi jis se unhein daraya jaraha hai to us waqt unhein pata chal jaye ga ke kis ke madadgar kamzor hain, aur kaun tadaad mein kam hai.
Keh do ke : mujhe maloom nahin hai ke jis cheez se tumhein daraya jaraha hai, aaya woh nazdeek hai ya mera Parwardigar us ke liye koi lambi muddat muqarrar farmata hai.
Wahi sare bhed janne wala hai, chunanche woh apne bhed par kisi ko mutlaa nahin karta.
Siwaye kisi pighbr ke jise us ne (us kaam ke liye) pasand farma liya ho. Aisi surat mein woh us payghumbar ke aage aur peechhe kuchh muhafiz laga deta hai.
Taake Allah jaan le ke unhon ne apne Parwardigar ke paigamaat pahuncha diye hain, aur woh un ke sare halaat ka ahata kiye hue hai, aur us ne har har cheez ki poori tarah ginti kar rkhi hai.
Ae chadr mein lipatne wale.
Raat ka thora hissa chhor kar baqi raat mein (ibadat ke liye) khre hojaya karo.
Raat ka aadha hissa, ya aadhe se kuchh kam karlo.
Ya us se kuchh ziyada karlo, aur quran ki tilawat itminaan se saaf saaf kiya karo.
Hum tum par ek bhari kalaam nazil karne wale hain.
Be-shak raat ke waqt athna hi aisa amal hai jis se nafs achhi tarah kchla jata hai, aur baat bhi behtar tareeqe par kahi jati hai.
Din mein to tum lambi msrofit mein rawan doan rehte ho.
Aur apne Parwardigar ke naam ka zikr karo, aur sab se alag ho kar poore ke poore usi ke ho raho.
Woh mashriq o magrib ka maalik hai, us ke siwa koi mabood nahin, us liye usi ko kaarsaaz bana lo.
Aur jo baatein yeh (kafir log) kehte hain un par sabar se kaam lo, aur khobsorti ke saath un se kinara karlo.
Aur tumhein jhutlane wale jo aish o aish-o-ishrat ke maalik bane hue hain, un ka mamla mujh par chhor do , aur unhein thore din aur mohlat do .
Yaqeen jaano humare paas bari sakht biriyan hain, aur dehakti hui aag hai.
Aur gale mein pahanas jane wala khana hai, aur dakaha dene wala azab hai.
Us din jab zameen aur pahar laraz athin ge, aur sare pahar rait ke bikhre hue tode bann kar reh jayen ge.
(jhutlane walo !) yaqeen jaano hum ne tumhare paas tum par gawah banne wala ek Rasool usi tarah bheja hai, jaise hum ne Firaun ke paas ek Rasool bheja tha.
Phir Firaun ne Rasool ka kehna nahin maana, to hum ne use aisi pakar mein le liya jo us ke liye zabardast wabal thi.
Agar tum bhi na maane to phir us din se kaise bacho ge jo bacchon ko boorha bana de ga.
(aur) jis se aasman pahata pare ga. Allah ke wade ko to poora ho kar rehna hai.
Yeh ek naseehat ki baat hai. Ab jo chahaye, apne Parwardigar ki taraf jane wala raasta ikhtiyar karle.

(ae payghumbar) tumhara Parwardigar jaanta hai ke tum do tihayi raat ke qareeb, aur kabhi aadhi raat aur kabhi ek tihayi raat (tahajjud ki namaz ke liye) khre hote ho, aur tumhare saathiyon mein se bhi ek jamat (aisa hi karti hai) aur raat aur din ki theek theek miqdar Allah hi muqarrar farmata hai. Use maloom hai ke tum us ka theek hisab rakaha sako ge, us liye us ne tum par inayat farma di hai. Ab tum itna quran parh liya karo jitna aasan ho. Allah ko ilm hai ke tum mein kuchh log beemar hon ge, aur kuchh dusre aise hon ge jo Allah ka fazal talash karne ke liye zameen mein safar kar rahe hon ge. Aur kuchh aise jo Allah ke raaste mein jung kar rahe hon ge. Lihaza tum us (quran) mein se itna hi parh liya karo jitna aasan ho. Aur namaz qayam karo, aur zakat ada karo, aur Allah ko qarz do , achha wala qarz ! Aur tum apne aap ke liye jo bhalayi bhi aage bhejo ge, use Allah ke paas jakr us tarah pao ge ke woh kahin behtar halat mein aur bare zabardast sawab ki shakal mein maujood hai. Aur Allah se magfirat maangte raho. Yaqeen rakho ke Allah bohat bakhshne wala, bohat meharban hai.

To woh bara mushkil din hoga.

Kuchh nahin yeh to ek insan ka kalaam hai.

Aur tumhein kya pata ke dozakh kya cheez hai ?

Woh khaalon ko jhulas dene wali cheez hai.
Us par unis (kaarinde) muqarrar hon ge.

Aur hum ne dozakh ke yeh kaarinde koi aur nahin, farishte muqarrar kiye hain. Aur un ki jo tadaad muqarrar ki hai woh sirf us liye ke us ke zariye kafiron ki aazmaish ho, taake ehle kitab ko yaqeen aajaye aur jo log iman lachke hain un ke iman mein aur azafa ho, aur ehle kitab aur momin log kisi shakk mein na paren, aur taake woh log jin ke dilon mein rog hai aur jo log kafir hain, woh yeh kahin ke bhala us ajeeb si baat se Allah ki kya murad hai ? Usi tarah Allah jis ko chahta hai gumraah kardyta hai aur jis ko chahta hai hidayat deta hai, aur tumhare Parwardigar ke lashkaron ko us ke siwa koi nahin jaanta. Aur yeh saari baat to naw bashar ke liye ek yaad dihani karane wali naseehat hai aur bas.

Chunanche sifarish karne walon ki sifarish aise logon ke kaam nahin aaye gi.
