Us tarah jaise woh jungli gadhe hon.
Jo kisi sher se (darr kar) bhaag pare hon.
Bulke un mein se har shaks yeh chahta hai ke use khle hue saheefe pakra diye jayen.
Hargiz nahin ! Baat asal mein yeh hai ke un ko aakhirat ka khof nahin hai.
Hargiz nahin ! Yeh (quran hi) ek naseehat hai.
Ab jo chahaye, us se naseehat hasil karle.
Aur yeh log naseehat hasil karen ge nahin, illa yeh ke Allah hi aisa chahaye. Wahi us baat ka ehle hai ke us se dara jaye aur wahi us ka ehle hai ke logon ki magfirat kare.
Mein qasam khata hon qayamat ke din ki.
Aur qasam khata hon malamat karne wale nafs ki. (ke hum insan ko zaroor dobara zinda karen ge)
Kya insan yeh samajh raha hai ke hum us ki haddiyon ko aktha nahin krskin ge ?
Kyun nahin ? Jabke humein us par bhi qudrat hai ke us ki ungliyon ke por por ko theek theek banadein.
Asal baat yeh hai ke insan chahta yeh hai ke apni aage ki zindagi mein bhi dhitayi se gunaah karta hai.
Puchta hai ke : kab aaye ga woh qayamat ka din ?
Phir jab aankhein chndhia jayen gi.
Aur chand benor hojaye ga.
Aur chand aur suraj akthe kardie jayen ge.
Us waqt insan kahe ga ke : kahan hai koi jagah jahan bhaag kar jaon ?
Nahin nahin ! Panaah ki koi jagah nahin hogi.
Us din to har ek ko tumhare Parwardigar hi ke samne jakr theharna pare ga.
Us din har insan ko jtla diya jaye ga ke us ne kiya kuchh aage bheja hai, aur kiya kuchh peechhe chhora hai.
Bulke insan khud apne aap se achhi tarah waqif hoga.
Chahaye woh kitne bahane banaye.
(ae payghumbar) tum us quran ko jaldi jaldi yaad karne ke liye apni zubaan ko hlaia na karo.
Yaqeen rakho ke us ko yaad karana aur prhoana hamari zma daari hai.
Phir jab hum use (jibraeel ke waste se) parh rahe hon to tum us ke parhne ki pairwi karo
Phir us ki wazahat bhi hamari zma daari hai.
Khabardar (ae kafiron) asal baat yeh hai ke tum fori tor par hasil hone wali cheez (yani duniya) se mohabbat karte ho.
Aur aakhirat ko nazar andaz kiie hue ho.
Us din bohat se chehre shadaab hon ge.
Apne Parwardigar ki taraf dekh rahe hon ge.
Aur bohat se chehre us din bgre hue hon ge.
Samajh rahe hon ge ke un ke saath woh mamla hoga jo kamar tor dene wala hai.
Khabardar ! Jab jaan hnslion tak pahunch jaye gi.
Aur (timar daron ki taraf se) kaha jaye ga ke : hai koi jhaar phonk karne wala ?
Aur insan samajh jaye ga ke judaee ka waqt aagaya.
Aur pindli se pindli lapat jaye gi.
To us din tumhare Parwardigar hi ki taraf rawangi hogi.
Us ke bawajood insan ne na maana, aur na namaz parhi.
Bulke haqq ko jhutlaya aur moonh mor liya.
Phir akar dikhata hua apne ghar walon ke paas chala gaya.
Barbadi hai teri, haan barbadi hai teri !.
Phir sunn le ke barbadi hai teri, haan barbadi hai teri !.
Kya insan yeh samajhta hai ke use yunhi chhor diya jaye ga ?
Kya woh us mani ka ek qtra nahin tha jo (man ke reham mein) tapkaya jata hai ?
Phir woh ek lothra bana, phir Allah ne use banaya, aur use theek thak kiya,
Neiz usi se mard aur aurat ki do sftin banayen.
Kya woh us baat par qadir nahin hai ke mardon ko phir se zinda karde ?
Insan par kabhi aisa waqt aaya hai ke nahin jab woh koi qabil zikr cheez nahin tha ?
Hum ne insan ko ek mile jule nutfe se us tarah paida kiya ke use aazmayein. Phir use aisa banaya ke woh sunta bhi hai, dekhta bhi hai.
Hum ne use raasta dkhaia ke woh ya to shukar guzar ho, ya shukra bann jaye.
Hum ne hi kafiron ke liye zanjeerein, gale ke toq aur bharakti hui aag tayyar ki hai.
Be-shak nek log aise jaam se mashrubaat piyein ge jis mein kafoor ki aamezish hogi.
Yeh mashrubaat ek aise chashme ke hon ge jo Allah ke (nek) bandon ke peene ke liye makhsoos hai, woh use (jahan chahein ge) aasani se baha karle jayen ge.
Yeh woh log hain jo apni mntin poori karte hain, aur us din ka khof dil mein rakhte hain jis ke bure asraat har taraf phile hue hon ge.
Aur woh Allah ki mohabbat ki khatir miskeeno, yateemon aur qaidiyon ko khana khilate hain.
(aur un se kehte hain ke) hum to tumhein sirf Allah taalaa ki khushnudi hasil karne ke liye khla rahe hain. Hum tum se na koi badla chahte hain aur na koi shukriya.
Humein to apne Parwardigar ki taraf se us din ka darr laga hua hai jis mein chehre buri tarah bgre hue hon ge.
Us ka nateeja yeh hai ke Allah aise logon ko us din ke bure asraat se bacha le ga, aur un ko shadabi aur suroor se nawaze ga.
Aur unhon ne jo sabar se kaam liya tha, us ke badle mein unhein jannat aur reshmi libas ata farmaye ga.
Woh un baaghon mein aaram da unchi nshston par tkia lagaye bithe hon ge, jahan na dhoop ki tapish dekhen ge aur na kara ke ki srdi.
Aur halat yeh hogi ke un baaghon ke saaye un par jhuke hue hon ge, aur un ke pahala mukammal tor se un ke aage ram krdie jayen ge.
Aur un ke samne chandi ke bartan aur woh pyale gardish mein laye jayen ge jo sheshe ke hon ge.
Sheshe bhi chandi ke jinhen bharne walon ne tawazun ke saath bhara hoga
Aur wahan un ko aisa jaam pilaya jaye ga jis mein soont mila hua hoga.
Wahan ke aise chashme se jis ka naam salsabil hai.
Un ke samne (khuda mat ke liye) aise larke gardish mein hon ge jo hamesha larke hi rahen ge. Jab tum unhein dekho ge to yeh mehsoos karo ge ke woh moti hain jo bikhair diye gaye hain.
Aur (haqeeqat to yeh hai ke) jab tum woh jagah dekho ge to tumhein nematon ka ek jahaan aur ek bari sultanat nazar aaye gi.
Un ke upar bareek resham ka sabz libas aur dabeez resham ke kapre hon ge, aur unhein chandi ke kangano se aarasta kiya jaye ga, aur un ka Parwardigar unhein nihayat pakeeza sharab pilaye ga.
(aur farmaye ga ke) yeh hai tumhara inam aur tum ne (duniya mein) jo mehnat ki thi us ki poori qadar dani ki gayi hai.
(ae payghumbar) hum ne hi tum par quran thora thora kar ke nazil kiya hai.
Lihaza tum apne Parwardigar ke hukum par saabit qadam raho, aur un logon mein se kisi nafarman ya kafir ki baat na mano.
Aur apne Parwardigar ke naam ka subah o shaam zikr kiya karo.
Aur kuchh raat ko bhi us ke aage sajde kiya karo, aur raat ke lambe waqt mein us ki tasbeeh karo.
Yeh log to (duniya ki) fori cheezon se mohabbat karte hain aur apne aage jo bhari din aane wala, use nazar andaz kiye hue hain.
Hum ne hi unhein paida kiya hai aur un ke jor bandh mazboot kiye hain, aur hum jab chahein un ke badle un jaise dusre paida karden.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh ek naseehat ki baat hai. Ab jo chahaye apne Parwardigar ki taraf jane wala raasta ikhtiyar karle.
Aur tum chahoge nahin jab tak Allah na chahaye. Aur Allah ilm ka bhi maalik hai, hikmat ka bhi maalik.
Woh jis ko chahta hai apni rehmat mein dakhil krlita hai, aur yeh jo zalim log hain un ke liye us ne dardnaak azab tayyar kar rakhha hai.
Qasam hai un (hawaon) ki jo ek ke baad ek bheji jati hain.
Phir jo aandhi bann kar zoar se chalti hain.
Aur jo (baadalon ko) khoob achhi tarah pehla deti hain.
Phir qasam hai un (farishton) ki jo haqq aur baatil ko alag alag kardete hain.
Phir naseehat ki baatein nazil karte hain.
Jo ya to logon ke liye maafi maangne ka sabab banti hain ya darane ka.
Yaqeenan woh waqa zaroor pesh aaker rahe ga jis ka tum se wada kiya jaraha hai.
Chunanche (woh waqa us waqt hoga) jab sitare bujha diye jayen ge.
Aur jab aasman ko cheer diya jaye ga.
Aur jab pahar riza riza kardie jayen ge.
Aur jab payghumbaron ke jama hone ka waqt aajaye ga.
(koi pochhe ke) us maamle ko kis din ke liye multawi kya gaya hai ?
(to jawab yeh hai ke) faisle ke din ke liye.
Aur tumhein kya maloom ke faisle ka din kya cheez hai ?
Bari kharabi hogi us din aise logon ki jo haqq ko jhutlate hain.
Kya hum ne pehle logon ko halaak nahin kya ?
Phir unhi ke peechhe baad walon ko bhi chalta karden ge.
Aisa hi sulook hum mujreemon ke saath kiya karte hain.
Bari kharabi hogi us din aise logon ki jo haqq ko jhutlate hain.
Kya hum ne tumhein ek hakeer pani se paida nahin kya ?
Phir hum ne use ek mazboot qarar ki jagah mein rakhha.
Muqarrara waqt tak
Phir hum ne tawazun paida kiya, chunanche achha tawazun paida karne wale hum hain.
Bari kharabi hogi us din aise logon ki jo haqq ko jhutlate hain.
Kiya hum ne zameen ko aisa nahin banaya ke woh sameit kar rakhne wali hai.
Zindon ko bhi aur mardon ko bhi ?
Aur hum ne us mein garhe hue unche unche pahar paida kiye, aur tumhein mithe pani se sairaab karne ka intezam kiya.

(un se kaha jaye ga ke) chalo ab usi cheez ki taraf jise tum jhutlaya karte the.

Jis mein na to (thandak wala) saia hai, aur na woh aag ki lapet se bacha sakta hai.
Woh aag to mehal jaise bare bare shole phinke gi.
Aisa lage ga jaise woh zard rang ke ount hon.

Aur apne mann pasand mewon ke darmiyan

Baghaat aur angoor.

Phir bhi unhon ne pighbr ko jhutlaya, aur us ountni ko maar dala nateeja yeh ke un ke Parwardigar ne un ke gunaah ki wajah se un ki aint se aint baja kar sab ko barabar kardiya.
Aur Allah ko us ke kisi bure anjaam ka koi khof nahin hai.
Qasam hai raat ki jab woh chah jaye.
Aur din ki jab us ka ajala phil jaye.
Aur us zaat ki jis ne narr aur mada ko paida kiya.
Ke haqeeqat mein tum logon ki koshishein alag alag qasam ki hain.
Ab jis kisi ne (Allah ke raaste mein maal) diya, aur taqwa ikhtiyar kiya.
Aur sab se achhi baat ko dil se maana.
To hum us ko aaram ki manzil tak pahunchne ki tayyari kara den ge.
Raha woh shaks jis ne bukhl se kaam liya, aur (Allah se) beniazi ikhtiyar ki.
Aur sab se achhi baat ko jhutlaya.
To hum us ko takleef ki manzil tak pahunchne ki tayyari kara den ge.
Aur jab aisa shaks tabahi ke garhe mein gire ga to us ka maal us ke kuchh kaam nahin aaye ga.
Yeh sach hai ke raasta batla dena humare zimme hai.
Aur yeh bhi sach hai ke aakhirat aur duniya dono humare qabze mein hain.
Lihaza mein ne tumhein ek bharakti hui aag se khabardar kardiya hai.
Us aag mein koi aur nahin, wahi badbakht dakhil hoga.
Jis ne haqq ko jhutlaya, aur moonh mora.
Aur us se aise perhezgar shaks ko door rakhha jaye ga.
Jo apna maal pakeezgi hasil karne ke liye (Allah ke raaste mein) deta hai.
Halaanke us par kisi ka koi ehsan nahin tha jis ka badla diya jata.
Albatta woh sirf apne us Parwardigar ki khushnudi chahta hai jis ki shaan sab se unchi hai.
Yaqeen rakho aisa shaks anqareeb khush hojaye ga.
(ae payghumbar) qasam hai charhte din ki roshni ki.
Aur raat ki jab us ka andhera bith jaye.
Ke tumhare Parwardigar ne na tumhein chhora hai aur na naraaz hua hai.
Aur yaqeenan aage aane wale halaat tumhare liye pehle halaat se behtar hain.
Aur yaqeen jaano ke anqareeb tumhara Parwardigar tumhein itna itna de ga ke tum khush hojao ge.
Kya us ne tumhein yateem nahin paya tha, phir (tumhein) thikana diya ?
Aur tumhein raaste se nawaqif paya to raasta dkhaia
Aur tumhein nadaar paya to gani kardiya.
Ab jo yateem hai tum us par sakhti mat karna.
Aur jo sawal karne wala ho, use jhrkna nahin.
Aur jo tumhare Parwardigar ki niyamat hai us ka tzkra karte rehna.
(ae payghumbar) kya hum ne tumhari khatir tumhara sina khol nahin diya ?
Aur hum ne tum se tumhara woh bojh utaar diya hai.
Jis ne tumhari kamar tor rkhi thi.
Aur hum ne tumhari khatir tumhare tazkeere ko ooncha muqaam ata kardiya hai.
Chunanche haqeeqat yeh hai ke mushkilaat ke saath aasani bhi hoti hai.
Yaqeenan mushkilaat ke saath aasani bhi hoti hai.
Lihaza jab tum faarig hojao to (ibadat mein) apne aap ko thka.
Aur apne Parwardigar hi se dil lagao.
Qasam hai injir aur zaitoon ki.
Aur shraie sinai ke pahar tor ki.
Aur us aman mein wale shehar ki.
Ke hum ne insan ko behtareen sanche mein dhaal kar paida kiya hai.
Phir hum use pasti walon mein sab se ziyada nchli halat mein kardete hain.
Siwaye un ke jo iman laye, aur unhon ne nek amal kiye, to un ko aisa ajar mile ga jo kabhi khatam nahin hoga.
Phir (ae insan) woh kya cheez hai jo tujhe jza o saza ko jhutlane par aamada kar rahi hai ?
Kya Allah sare hkmranon se barh kar hukmaran nahin hai ?
Parho apne Parwardigar ka naam le kar jis ne sab kuchh paida kiya.
Us ne insan ko jame hue khoon se paida kiya hai.
Parho, aur tumhara Parwardigar sab se ziyada karam wala hai.
Jis ne qalam se taleem di.
Insan ko us baat ki taleem di jo woh nahin jaanta tha.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke insan khuli sarkashi kar raha hai.
Kyunke us ne apne aap ko bey-niaz samajh liya hai.
Sach to yeh hai ke tumhare Parwardigar hi ki taraf sab ko lotna hai.
Bhala tum ne us shaks ko bhi dekha jo ek bande ko mana karta hai
Jab woh namaz parhta hai ?
Bhala batlao ke agar woh (namaz parhne wala) hidayat par ho.
Ya taqwa ka hukum deta ho (to kya use rokna gumrahi nahin ?)
Bhala batlao ke agar woh (roakne wala) haqq ko jhutlata ho, aur moonh morta ho.
Kya use yeh maloom nahin hai ke Allah dekh raha hai ?
Khabardar ! Agar woh baaz na aaya to hum (use) peshani ke baal pakar kar ghaseetein ge.
Us peshani ke baal jo jhooti hai, gunehgar hai
Ab woh bula apni majlis walon ko.
Hum dozakh ke farishton ko bula len ge.
Hargiz nahin ! Us ki baat na mano, aur sajda karo, aur qareeb aajao.
Be-shak hum ne us (quran) ko shab qadar mein nazil kiya hai.
Aur tumhein kya maloom ke shab qadar kya cheez hai ?
Shab qadar ek hazar maheenon se bhi behtar hai.
Us mein farishte aur rooh apne Parwardigar ki ijazat se har kaam ke liye utarte hain.
Woh raat sarapa salamati hai fajr ke tulu hone tak.
Ehle kitab aur mushrikeen mein se jo log kafir the, woh us waqt tak baaz aane wale nahin the jab tak ke un ke paas roshan daleel na aati.
Yani ek Allah ka Rasool jo pak saheefe parh kar sunaye.
Jin mein seedhi tehrirein lkhi hon.
Aur jo ehle kitab the, unhon ne juda raasta usi ke baad ikhtiyar kiya jab un ke paas roshan daleel chuki thi.

Aur unhein us ke siwa koi aur hukum nahin diya gaya tha ke woh Allah ki ibadat us tarah karen ke bandagi ko bilkul yaksu ho kar sirf usi ke liye khaas rakhen, aur namaz qayam karen aur zakat ada karen, aur yehi seedhi sachi ummat ka deen hai.
Yaqeen jaano ke ehle kitab aur mushrikeen mein se jinhon ne kufr apna liya hai woh jahannam ki aag mein jayen ge jahan woh hamesha rahen ge. Yeh log saari makhlooq mein sab se bure hain.
Jo log iman laye hain aur unhon ne nek amal kiye hain woh be-shak saari makhlooq mein sab se behtar hain

Un ke Parwardigar ke paas un ka inam woh sada bahaar jannaten hain jin ke niche se nehrein behti hain. Wahan woh hamesha hamesha rahen ge. Allah un se khush hoga aur woh us se khush hon ge. Yeh sab kuchh us ke liye hai jo apne Parwardigar ka khof dil mein rakhta hon.
Jab zameen apne bhonchal se jhanjhor di jaye gi.
Aur zameen apne bojh bahar nikal de gi.
Aur insan kahe ga ke us ko kya hogaya hai ?
Us din zameen apni saari khabren btade gi.
Kyunke tumhare Parwardigar ne use yehi hukum diya hoga.
Us roz log mukhtalif tolion mein wapas hon ge, taake un ke aemaal unhein dkha diye jayen.
Chunanche jis ne zra barabar koi achhaii ki hogi woh use dikhe ga.
Aur jis ne zra barabar koi buraee ki hogi, woh use dikhe ga.
Qasam hai un ghoron ki jo hanp hanp kar dorte hain.
Phir jo (apni tapon se) chingariyan urate hain.
Phir subah ke waqt ylghar karte hain.
Phir us mauqa par gubar urate hain.
Phir usi waqt kisi jmghte ke beechon bech jaghste hain.
Ke insan apne Parwardigar ka bara shukra hai.
Aur woh khud us baat ka gawah hai.
Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke woh maal ki mohabbat mein bohat pakka hai.
Bhala kiya woh waqt use maloom nahin hai jab qabron mein jo kuchh hai use bahar bikhair diya jaye ga.
Aur seeno mein jo kuchh hai use zaahir kardiya jaye ga.
Yaqeenan un ka Parwardigar us din un (ki jo halat hogi us) se poori tarah bakhabar hai.
(yaad karo) woh waqa jo dil dehla kar rakaha de ga.
Kya hai woh dil dhlane wala waqa ?
Aur tumhein kya maloom woh dil dhlane wala waqa kya hai ?
Jis din sare log phile hue parwano ki tarah hojayen ge.
Aur pahar dhnki hui rangeen oon ki tarah hojayen ge.
Ab jis shaks ke palry wzni hon ge.
To woh mann pasand zindagi mein hoga.
Aur woh jis ke palry halke hon ge.
To us ka thikana ek ghra grha hoga.
Aur tumhein kya maloom ke woh ghra grha kya cheez hai ?
Ek dehakti hui aag
Ek dusre se barh charh kar (duniya ka aish) hasil karne ki hos ne tumhein gahalaft mein daal rakhha hai.
Yahan tak ke tum qbrstanon mein pahunch jate ho.
Hargiz aisa nahin chahiye. Tumhein anqareeb sab pata chal jaye ga.
Phir (sunn lo ke) hargiz aisa nahin chahiye. Tumhein anqareeb sab pata chal jaye ga.
Hargiz nahin ! Agar tum yaqeeni ilm ke saath yeh baat jante hote (to aisa na karte)
Yaqeen jaano tum dozakh ko zaroor dekho ge.
Phir yaqeen jaano ke tum use bilkul yaqeen ke saath dekh lo ge.
Phir tum se us din nematon ke bare mein pochha jaye ga (ke un ka kiya haqq ada kiya)
Zamane ki qasam.
Insan dar-haqeeqat bare ghate mein hai.
Siwaye un logon ke jo iman layein aur nek amal karen aur ek dusre ko haqq baat ki naseehat karen, aur ek dusre ko sabar ki naseehat karen.
Bari kharabi hai us shaks ki jo pith peechhe dusron par aib lagane wala (aur) moonh par taane dene ka aadi ho.
Jis ne maal aktha kiya ho aur use ginta rehta ho.
Woh samajhta hai ke aska maal use hamesha zinda rkhe ga.
Hargiz nahin ! Us ko to aisi jagah mein phinka jaye ga jo choora choora karne wali hai.
Aur tumhein kya maloom woh choora choora karne wali cheez kya hai ?
Allah ki sulgai hui aag
Jo dilon tak jaa charhe gi.
Yaqeenan jaano woh un par bandh kardi jaye gi.
Jabke woh (aage ke) lambe chore sutuno mein (ghre hue) hon ge.
Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke tumhare Parwardigar ne hathi walon ke saath kaisa mamla kya ?
Kya us ne un logon ki saari chalein bekar nahin kardi thin ?
Aur un par ghol ke ghol parinde chhor diye the.
Jo un par paki mitti ke pathar phink rahe the.
Chunanche unhein aisa kar dala jaise khaia hua bhusa.
Chunke quresh ke log aadi hain.
Yani woh srdi aur garmi ke mosmon mein (yamana aur shaam ke) safar karne ke aadi hain.
Us liye unhein chahiye ke woh us ghar ke maalik ki ibadat karen.
Jis ne bhook ki halat mein unhein khane ko diya, aur badh-amani se unhein mehfooz rakhha.
Kya tum ne use dekha jo jza o saza ko jhutlata hai ?
Wahi to hai jo yateem ko dhakke deta hai.
Aur miskeen ko khana dene ki targeeb nahin deta.
Phir bari kharabi hai un namaz parhne walon ki
Jo apni namaz se gaflat baratte hain.
Jo dkhaoa karte hain.
Aur dusron ko mamooli cheez dene se bhi inkar karte hain.
(ae payghumbar) yaqeen jaano hum ne tumhein kausar ata kardi hai.
Lihaza tum apne Parwardigar (ki khushnudi) ke liye namaz parho, aur qurbani karo.
Yaqeen jaano tumhara dushman hi woh hai jis ki jarr kati hui hai.
Tum keh do ke : ae haqq ka inkar karne walo.
Mein un cheezon ki ibadat nahin karta jin ki tum ibadat karte ho.
Aur tum us ki ibadat nahin karte jis ki mein ibadat karta hon.
Aur na mein (aainda) us ki ibadat karne wala hon jis ki ibadat tum karte ho.
Aur na tum us ki ibadat karne wale ho jis ki mein ibadat karta hon.
Tumhare liye tumhara deen hai aur mere liye mera deen.
Jab Allah ki madad aur fatah aajaye.
Aur tum logon ko dekh lo ke woh fauj dar fauj Allah ke deen mein dakhil horahe hain.
To apne Parwardigar ki hamd ke saath us ki tasbeeh karo, aur us se magfirat maango. Yaqeen jaano woh bohat maaf karne wala hai.
Haath lahab ke barbaad hon, aur woh khud barbaad hochka hai.
Us ki daulat aur us ne jo kamayi ki thi woh us ke kuchh kaam nahin aayi.
Woh bhrkte sholon wali aag mein dakhil hoga.
Aur us ki biwi bhi lakriyan dhoti hui.
Apni gardan mein moonj ki rassi liye hue.
Keh do : baat yeh hai ke Allah har lihaz se ek hai.
Allah hi aisa hai ke sab us ke mohtaj hain, woh kisi ka mohtaj nahin.
Na us ki koi aulad hai, aur na woh kisi ki aulad hai.
Aur us ke jor ka koi nahin.
Kaho ke : mein subah ke maalik ki panaah maangta hon.
Har us cheez ke sharr se jo us ne paida ki hai.
Aur andheri raat ke sharr se jab woh phil jaye.
Aur un janon ke sharr se jo (gnde ki) girhon mein phonk maarti hain.
Aur hasad karne wale ke sharr se jab woh hasad kare.
Kaho ke : mein panaah maangta hon sab logon ke Parwardigar ki.
Sab logon ke baadshah ki.
Sab logon ke mabood ki.
Us wsosa daalne wale ke sharr se jo peechhe ko cahahap jata hai.
Jo logon ke dilon mein wsosa daalta hai.
Chahaye woh jinnat mein se ho, ya insano mein se.
